`/Users/yuai/Projects/.worktrees/agenttool-collab-bridge/packages/collab-bridge/src/nuance/pipe.ts`:

```ts
// The Claude MCP pipe on Nuance (C4, spec §6.2, §9.1–§9.4). It answers the harness itself from the cached tool list, so
// initialize and tools/list work with the hub away (R16), and sends each tools/call once over its link to the Air hub.
// "Not sent" ends at the write to the relay socket (§9.3 item 3): every refusal before that write is delivered:false;
// after it, the answer is the hub's result or hub_outcome_unknown, never a JSON-RPC error (R17) and never a resend (R18).
import { realpathSync } from 'node:fs'
import { basename } from 'node:path'
import { bridgeFailure, deliveredOf, withPriorUnknown, type AgentCode } from '../failure.ts'
import { appendLedger, NUANCE_LEDGER_KEYS, type LedgerFields } from '../ledger.ts'
import { LineReader, LineTooLong, type JsonRpcId } from '../jsonrpc.ts'
import { FRAME_HEADER_BYTES } from '../link/frame.ts'
import {
  encodeMessage, LABEL_TOKEN_RE, MAX_FOLDER_BYTES, MAX_PIPE_TO_HUB, newPipeInstance,
  type AttachMsg, type CallMsg, type Declared, type NoticeMsg, type ReadyMsg, type ResultMsg, type ToolDef, type ToolResult, type ToolsMsg,
} from '../link/messages.ts'
import type { NuancePaths } from '../paths.ts'
import type { ProcTable } from '../proc.ts'
import type { Env } from '../sysbin.ts'
import { scaled, TIMING } from '../timing.ts'
import { declaredState } from './gitstate.ts'
import { addInflight, argsHash, clearByIdempotencyKey, clearByTool, clearInflight, isStale, MAX_INFLIGHT, priorConflict, unresolved } from './inflight.ts'
import { readShares, type InstalledInfo } from './installed.ts'
import { findHost, interactiveCheck, openLineage, SESSION_ID_RE, sweepLineages, type HostInfo, type Interactive } from './lineage.ts'
import { bunConnect, LinkClient, type Connect } from './link-client.ts'
import { McpLocalServer } from './mcp-local.ts'
import { loadSeatPrivate, signSeat } from './seatkey.ts'
import { acceptHubTools, readCurrentTools } from './tools-cache.ts'

/** Claim and complete may fetch, check and check out on the Air: 150 s instead of 60 (§9.4). */
export const LONG_CALL_TOOLS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['collab_task_claim', 'collab_task_complete'])
/** Calls that carry the folder's declared git state (§7.5); recover only for a takeover (its action, or Collab's default). */
export const DECLARING_TOOLS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['collab_task_claim', 'collab_task_complete', 'collab_task_recover'])
/** Tools that change nothing (§6.3's pinned reads; §9.3 item 7: collab_next is harmless): no in-flight record, never capped (P65). */
export const UNRECORDED_TOOLS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['collab_workspace_status', 'collab_task_list', 'collab_task_get',
  'collab_report_list', 'collab_events_since', 'collab_anchor_status', 'collab_journal_verify', 'collab_next'])
/** Claude never sends a line this long; a longer one is dropped through its newline and the reader goes on (P59). */
export const PIPE_STDIN_MAX_LINE = 8 * 1024 * 1024

export interface PipeDeps {
  paths: NuancePaths; env: Env; cwd: string; selfPid: number; table(): ProcTable | null; ttyOf(pid: number): string | null
  mono(): number; now(): Date; rand(): number; stdin: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>; write(line: string): void; installed: InstalledInfo; user: string
  connect?: Connect; callTimeouts?: { default: number; long: number }
}

interface InFlight { tool: string; idempotencyKey: string | null; requestId: JsonRpcId; resolve(r: ToolResult): void; timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null }

/** The agent-facing sentence for each refusal the pipe itself makes. */
const MESSAGES = {
  tool_not_available_remote: 'This tool is not offered to remote seats in this phase.',
  hub_version_mismatch: "The hub's tool list changed; re-list the tools (/mcp), then call again.",
  folder_not_shared: "This folder is not shared with the Air; start Claude at a shared folder's root.",
  harness_not_interactive: 'Collab through the Air hub is only for an interactive Claude session.',
  hub_away: 'The Air hub is not reachable now; nothing was sent.',
  seat_session_ended: 'This Collab session has ended on the Air; start a new session.',
  lineage_cap: 'Too many Claude sessions on this Mac are attached to the Air hub; close another session first.',
  frame_too_large: 'This call is larger than a call may be; nothing was sent.',
  rate_limited: 'Too many earlier calls of this session have no known outcome; check them with a read tool, or replay one with its own idempotency_key.',
  fetch_failed: "Could not read this folder's git state.",
  unrecorded: 'This pipe could not record the call before sending it; nothing was sent.',
} as const

const REFUSAL_CODES_FROM_HUB = new Set(['seat_session_ended', 'lineage_cap', 'folder_not_shared', 'frame_too_large'])

/** Whether this call declares the folder's git state: claim, complete, and a takeover (Collab's default action). */
function declares(name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
  if (name === 'collab_task_recover') return args.action === undefined || args.action === 'takeover'
  return DECLARING_TOOLS.has(name)
}

function labelOf(v: string | undefined): string {
  return typeof v === 'string' && LABEL_TOKEN_RE.test(v) ? v : 'unknown'
}

/** The error code of a result, Collab's or the bridge's, or null for a success. */
function errorOf(r: ToolResult): string | null {
  return r.isError === true && typeof r.structuredContent?.error === 'string' ? r.structuredContent.error : null
}

/** A session id in Collab's id shape, else null: a record must never hold one its lineage file would drop. */
function sessionIdOf(v: unknown): string | null {
  return typeof v === 'string' && SESSION_ID_RE.test(v) ? v : null
}

/**
 * §9.3 item 7, P65: an answer that tells what this lineage's earlier calls of a keyless tool did. cursor_ack is fenced by
 * expected_cursor_version, so any answer from Collab settles the earlier ones; session_end by Collab's answer or the hub's
 * seat_session_ended; session_start by a start or by Collab's session_already_bound. A hub refusal settles nothing.
 */
function settlesKeyless(tool: string, r: ToolResult, own: boolean): boolean {
  const code = errorOf(r)
  if (tool === 'collab_cursor_ack') return own
  if (tool === 'collab_session_end') return own || code === 'seat_session_ended'
  if (tool === 'collab_session_start') return own && (code === null || code === 'session_already_bound')
  return false
}

export class Pipe {
  private readonly instance = newPipeInstance()
  private seq = 0
  private host: HostInfo | null = null
  private key: string | null = null
  private lineage: string | null = null
  private folder: string | null = null
  private shared = false
  private interactive: Interactive = { ok: false, reason: 'no_claude_host' }
  /** The Collab session this pipe believes its lineage has bound (P66); every in-flight record names it. */
  private session: string | null = null
  private tools: { digest: string; list: ToolDef[] } | null = null
  private relist = false
  private readonly refusedDigests = new Set<string>()
  private link: LinkClient | null = null
  private readonly inflight = new Map<string, InFlight>()
  private readonly server: McpLocalServer
  private readonly timeouts: { default: number; long: number }

  constructor(private readonly deps: PipeDeps) {
    this.timeouts = deps.callTimeouts ?? { default: scaled(TIMING.callDefaultMs, deps.env), long: scaled(TIMING.callLongMs, deps.env) }
    this.server = new McpLocalServer({
      device: deps.installed.device, user: deps.user, build: deps.installed.build,
      tools: () => this.tools,
      onList: () => { this.relist = false },
      onCall: (id, name, args) => this.handleCall(id, name, args),
      onCancel: (requestId) => this.cancel(requestId),
      write: (line) => deps.write(line),
    })
  }

  async start(): Promise<void> {
    const { deps } = this
    const table = deps.table()
    if (table) {
      // §6.2: lineage files whose host is gone are swept after 7 days; our own host is alive, so its file stays.
      try { sweepLineages(deps.paths, table, deps.now().getTime()) } catch { /* best effort */ }
      this.host = findHost(deps.selfPid, table)
    }
    this.interactive = interactiveCheck(deps.env, this.host, deps.ttyOf)
    if (this.host) {
      try {
        const l = openLineage(deps.paths, this.host, deps.now)
        this.key = l.key
        this.lineage = l.file.lineage
      } catch { /* no lineage file: every call answers harness_not_interactive */ }
    }
    try { this.folder = realpathSync.native(deps.cwd) } catch { this.folder = null }
    const shares = readShares(deps.paths) ?? []
    this.shared = this.folder !== null && Buffer.byteLength(this.folder, 'utf8') <= MAX_FOLDER_BYTES && shares.some((s) => s.realpath === this.folder)
    this.tools = readCurrentTools(deps.paths)
    this.ledger({ event: 'pipe_start', lineage: this.lineage ?? undefined, outcome: this.shared ? 'shared' : 'not_shared' })
    // A folder outside shares.json never dials (§9.2 folder_not_shared); nor does a pipe with no lineage or no tool list.
    if (this.lineage && this.host && this.shared && this.tools) this.startLink(this.host, this.lineage)
  }

  async stop(): Promise<void> {
    this.link?.stop()
    this.link = null
    for (const ref of [...this.inflight.keys()]) this.settleUnknown(ref, 'stopped')
  }

  lineageId(): string | null {
    return this.lineage
  }

  /** One JSON-RPC line from the harness, answered by the local MCP server (Task 28). */
  handleLine(line: string): Promise<void> {
    return this.server.handleLine(line)
  }

  async handleCall(id: JsonRpcId, name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ToolResult> {
    const { deps } = this
    const ref = this.lineage ? `${this.lineage}:${this.instance}:${this.seq++}` : '<none>'
    const refuse = (code: AgentCode, message: string, extra?: Record<string, unknown>) => this.withPrior(bridgeFailure(code, message, ref, extra))
    if (!this.tools || !this.tools.list.some((t) => t.name === name)) return refuse('tool_not_available_remote', MESSAGES.tool_not_available_remote)
    if (this.relist) return refuse('hub_version_mismatch', MESSAGES.hub_version_mismatch)
    if (!this.shared) return refuse('folder_not_shared', MESSAGES.folder_not_shared)
    if (!this.lineage || !this.key || !this.folder) return refuse('harness_not_interactive', MESSAGES.harness_not_interactive)
    if (name === 'collab_session_start' && !this.interactive.ok) return refuse('harness_not_interactive', MESSAGES.harness_not_interactive)
    const link = this.link
    if (!link || !link.fresh()) {
      const code = link?.lastRefused() ?? null
      if (code !== null && REFUSAL_CODES_FROM_HUB.has(code)) {
        const c = code as 'seat_session_ended' | 'lineage_cap' | 'folder_not_shared' | 'frame_too_large'
        if (c === 'seat_session_ended') this.session = null   // P66: the old session's unknowns can no longer be replayed
        return refuse(c, MESSAGES[c])
      }
      return refuse('hub_away', MESSAGES.hub_away)   // seat_proof_failed and socket_path_too_long stay hub_away (P29)
    }
    const idempotencyKey = typeof args.idempotency_key === 'string' ? args.idempotency_key : null
    // P65: a read or collab_next changes nothing, so it writes no record and is never capped. A same-key replay of an
    // unresolved call of this session writes none either: Collab's receipt settles both (§9.3 item 5), the earlier record
    // stays until Collab answers that key, and the 64 cap never refuses the call that can settle it.
    const recorded = !UNRECORDED_TOOLS.has(name)
    let replay = false
    if (recorded) {
      const records = unresolved(deps.paths, this.key)
      const prior = priorConflict(records, name, args, this.session)
      if (prior) {
        const old = JSON.stringify(prior.idempotency_key)
        return refuse('prior_outcome_unknown', isStale(prior, this.session)
          ? `An earlier call with the same content (idempotency_key ${old}) has no known outcome and its Collab session has ended; a replay would run it again. Check with collab_report_list or collab_task_list first.`
          : `An earlier call with the same content under idempotency_key ${old} has no known outcome; replay it with that key, or check first.`,
        { prior_call_ref: prior.call_ref, prior_idempotency_key: prior.idempotency_key })
      }
      replay = idempotencyKey !== null && records.some((r) => r.tool === name && r.idempotency_key === idempotencyKey && !isStale(r, this.session))
      if (!replay && records.length >= MAX_INFLIGHT) return refuse('rate_limited', MESSAGES.rate_limited)
    }
    let declared: Declared | undefined
    if (declares(name, args)) {
      const d = declaredState(this.folder, deps.installed.git.path, deps.paths.home)
      if ('error' in d) return refuse('fetch_failed', MESSAGES.fetch_failed)   // P48: a definite refusal, nothing sent
      declared = d
    }
    const timeout = LONG_CALL_TOOLS.has(name) ? this.timeouts.long : this.timeouts.default
    const call: CallMsg = { t: 'call', call_ref: ref, name, arguments: args, timeout_ms: timeout, ...(declared ? { declared } : {}) }
    // §6.6, P59: the relay would close the whole connection on an oversized frame and turn every call on it into unknown.
    if (encodeMessage(call).byteLength + FRAME_HEADER_BYTES > MAX_PIPE_TO_HUB) return refuse('frame_too_large', MESSAGES.frame_too_large)
    // Persisted before the write, so a pipe that dies mid-call leaves the record for the next pipe (§9.3 item 6). A record
    // that cannot be written (a lock timeout, a lineage file gone) means the call is not sent at all.
    const writes = recorded && !replay
    if (writes) {
      let added: boolean
      try {
        added = addInflight(deps.paths, this.key, { call_ref: ref, tool: name, idempotency_key: idempotencyKey, args_hash: argsHash(args),
          at: deps.now().toISOString(), session_id: this.session })
      } catch {
        this.ledger({ event: 'inflight_unwritable', call_ref: ref, tool: name, lineage: this.lineage })
        return refuse('hub_away', MESSAGES.unrecorded)
      }
      if (!added) return refuse('rate_limited', MESSAGES.rate_limited)
    }
    const key = this.key
    return await new Promise<ToolResult>((resolve) => {
      const f: InFlight = { tool: name, idempotencyKey, requestId: id, resolve, timer: null }
      // Registered only once the write has returned. A write that throws took nothing (§9.3 item 3), and the lost() it runs
      // inside send must not answer this call unknown.
      if (link.send(call) !== 'written') {
        if (writes) this.clearRecords(key, ref, null)
        resolve(refuse('hub_away', MESSAGES.hub_away))
        return
      }
      this.inflight.set(ref, f)
      // bunConnect's flush can see the socket gone (write < 0) and drop the link inside send, which still returns 'written'.
      // The call was handed to the stream, so it is unknown at once (§9.3 item 3), not at the deadline.
      if (link.state() !== 'ready') { this.settleUnknown(ref, 'link_lost'); return }
      // A relative deadline on this side's own clock (§5.4); the hub never cancels on it.
      f.timer = setTimeout(() => this.settleUnknown(ref, 'deadline'), timeout)
    })
  }

  private startLink(host: HostInfo, lineage: string): void {
    const { deps } = this
    let priv: ReturnType<typeof loadSeatPrivate>
    try { priv = loadSeatPrivate(deps.paths) } catch {
      this.ledger({ event: 'seat_key_unreadable', lineage })
      return
    }
    const entrypoint = this.interactive.ok ? this.interactive.entrypoint : labelOf(deps.env.CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT)
    const harness = LABEL_TOKEN_RE.test(basename(host.comm)) ? basename(host.comm) : 'claude'
    this.link = new LinkClient({
      sockPath: deps.paths.hubSock,
      attach: (): AttachMsg => ({
        t: 'attach', v: 1, lineage, harness, entrypoint, folder: this.folder!, pipe_build: deps.installed.build,
        tools_digest: this.tools!.digest, clock: deps.now().toISOString(),
      }),
      sign: (nonce) => signSeat(priv, deps.installed.device, deps.user, lineage, nonce),
      mono: deps.mono,
      rand: deps.rand,
      // The same host process, by pid and start time, from the same table the lineage came from (P40).
      hostAlive: () => {
        const r = deps.table()?.get(host.pid)
        return r !== undefined && r.started_at === host.lstart
      },
      on: {
        ready: (r) => this.onReady(r),
        result: (r) => this.onResult(r),
        tools: (t) => this.onTools(t),
        knockReport: () => {},
        notice: (n) => this.onNotice(n),
        refused: () => {},
        lost: () => this.onLost(),
      },
      connect: deps.connect ?? bunConnect,
      reattachMs: scaled(TIMING.reattachMs, deps.env),
      staleMs: scaled(TIMING.staleMs, deps.env),
      stepMs: scaled(TIMING.handshakeStepMs, deps.env),
    })
    this.link.start()
  }

  private onReady(r: ReadyMsg): void {
    // The hub's view of this lineage's session (P66): null when none is live, so no earlier unknown is advised for a replay.
    this.session = r.session_hint?.session_id ?? null
    if (this.tools && r.tools_digest !== this.tools.digest) this.link?.send({ t: 'tools_get', digest: r.tools_digest })
  }

  private onTools(t: ToolsMsg): void {
    const before = this.tools?.digest ?? null
    const v = acceptHubTools(this.deps.paths, { digest: t.digest, list: t.list })
    if (!v.ok) {
      // Keep the current list; tell the hub once per refused digest, so its status shows the refusal (§6.2, P51).
      if (!this.refusedDigests.has(t.digest)) {
        this.refusedDigests.add(t.digest)
        this.link?.send({ t: 'tools_refused', digest: t.digest, reason: v.reason })
        this.ledger({ event: 'tools_refused', code: v.reason, lineage: this.lineage ?? undefined })
      }
      return
    }
    const now = readCurrentTools(this.deps.paths)
    if (now) this.tools = now
    if (v.digest !== before) {
      this.relist = true   // calls answer hub_version_mismatch until the harness re-lists
      this.server.notifyToolsChanged()
    }
  }

  private onResult(r: ResultMsg): void {
    const f = this.inflight.get(r.call_ref)
    if (!f) {
      // P49: the agent was already told hub_outcome_unknown (or this pipe never sent it); the record stays.
      this.ledger({ event: 'late_result', call_ref: r.call_ref, outcome: r.outcome, lineage: this.lineage ?? undefined })
      return
    }
    this.inflight.delete(r.call_ref)
    if (f.timer !== null) clearTimeout(f.timer)
    if (r.outcome === 'unknown') {
      this.afterUnknown(f.tool)
      const result = r.result && deliveredOf(r.result) === 'unknown' ? r.result
        : bridgeFailure('hub_outcome_unknown', 'The Air could not settle this call; it may have taken effect.', r.call_ref)
      f.resolve(this.withPrior(result))
      return
    }
    const result = r.result!
    // A definite answer clears this call's own record. Only Collab's own answer (deliveredOf null, idempotency_conflict
    // included) settles earlier calls under the same idempotency_key, or of the same keyless tool (§9.3 items 5–7). A bridge
    // refusal (delivered:false, P50) never reached Collab, so it settles nothing about them, and their records and the
    // prior_outcome_unknown guard stay.
    const own = deliveredOf(result) === null
    if (this.key) {
      this.clearRecords(this.key, r.call_ref, own ? f.idempotencyKey : null)
      if (settlesKeyless(f.tool, result, own)) this.clearTool(this.key, f.tool)
    }
    this.afterAnswer(f.tool, result, own)
    f.resolve(this.withPrior(result))
  }

  /** P66: what an answer says about the bound session. Read before withPrior, so its prior_unknown already reflects it. */
  private afterAnswer(tool: string, r: ToolResult, own: boolean): void {
    const code = errorOf(r)
    if (code === 'seat_session_ended') { this.session = null; return }   // the credential is gone (§9.2)
    if (!own) return
    if (tool === 'collab_session_start') {
      const started = r.structuredContent?.session
      if (code === null) this.session = sessionIdOf(typeof started === 'object' && started !== null ? (started as Record<string, unknown>).id : null)
      else if (code === 'session_already_bound') this.session = sessionIdOf(r.structuredContent?.session_id)
    } else if (tool === 'collab_session_end' && (code === null || code === 'session_not_bound')) {
      this.session = null
    }
  }

  /** P66: an unknown session_end may have ended the session, an unknown session_start begun one (§9.3 item 8). */
  private afterUnknown(tool: string): void {
    if (tool === 'collab_session_end' || tool === 'collab_session_start') this.session = null
  }

  private onNotice(n: NoticeMsg): void {
    if (n.code === 'hub_lost' || n.code === 'link_closing') this.onLost()
  }

  private onLost(): void {
    for (const ref of [...this.inflight.keys()]) this.settleUnknown(ref, 'link_lost')
  }

  private cancel(requestId: JsonRpcId): void {
    for (const [ref, f] of this.inflight) {
      if (f.requestId !== requestId) continue
      // Recorded by the hub and never forwarded to a child (§9.3 item 4); the call may still take effect (K28).
      this.link?.send({ t: 'cancel', call_ref: ref })
      this.settleUnknown(ref, 'cancelled')
      return
    }
  }

  /** After the write: the call may have taken effect. The record stays until a definite answer clears it (P49). */
  private settleUnknown(ref: string, why: 'deadline' | 'link_lost' | 'cancelled' | 'stopped'): void {
    const f = this.inflight.get(ref)
    if (!f) return
    this.inflight.delete(ref)
    if (f.timer !== null) clearTimeout(f.timer)
    this.ledger({ event: 'call_unknown', call_ref: ref, tool: f.tool, code: why, lineage: this.lineage ?? undefined })
    this.afterUnknown(f.tool)
    const message = why === 'deadline' ? 'The Air did not answer in time; this call may have taken effect.'
      : why === 'cancelled' ? 'This call was cancelled after it was sent; it may have taken effect.'
      : 'The link to the Air was lost after this call was sent; it may have taken effect.'
    f.resolve(this.withPrior(bridgeFailure('hub_outcome_unknown', message, ref)))
  }

  /**
   * Clears records after a definite answer: the call's own, and with `idempotencyKey` this session's records under that key
   * (P66). A failed write keeps them: one spurious prior_unknown, never a lost result.
   */
  private clearRecords(key: string, callRef: string, idempotencyKey: string | null): void {
    try {
      clearInflight(this.deps.paths, key, callRef)
      if (idempotencyKey !== null) clearByIdempotencyKey(this.deps.paths, key, idempotencyKey, this.session)
    } catch {
      this.ledger({ event: 'inflight_unwritable', call_ref: callRef, lineage: this.lineage ?? undefined })
    }
  }

  /** Settles every record of one keyless tool (§9.3 item 7, P65); a failed write keeps them, as above. */
  private clearTool(key: string, tool: string): void {
    try { clearByTool(this.deps.paths, key, tool) } catch {
      this.ledger({ event: 'inflight_unwritable', tool, lineage: this.lineage ?? undefined })
    }
  }

  /** §9.3 item 6: every result names this lineage's unresolved calls, except the ones still in flight here. */
  private withPrior(r: ToolResult): ToolResult {
    if (!this.key) return r
    let records
    try { records = unresolved(this.deps.paths, this.key) } catch { return r }
    const prior = records.filter((x) => !this.inflight.has(x.call_ref))
      .map((x) => ({ call_ref: x.call_ref, tool: x.tool, idempotency_key: x.idempotency_key, session_ended: isStale(x, this.session) }))
    return withPriorUnknown(r, prior)
  }

  private ledger(f: LedgerFields): void {
    try { appendLedger(this.deps.paths.ledger, NUANCE_LEDGER_KEYS, f, this.deps.now().getTime()) } catch { /* the ledger never breaks a call */ }
  }
}

/** The `pipe` verb's body: stdin lines into the local MCP server until EOF, then stop, exit 0. */
export async function runPipe(deps: PipeDeps): Promise<number> {
  const pipe = new Pipe(deps)
  await pipe.start()
  const reader = new LineReader(PIPE_STDIN_MAX_LINE)
  const handling = new Set<Promise<void>>()
  const handle = (line: string) => {
    // Lines are handled concurrently: a 150 s claim never holds up a ping or another call.
    const p: Promise<void> = pipe.handleLine(line).catch(() => {}).finally(() => { handling.delete(p) })
    handling.add(p)
  }
  const src = deps.stdin.getReader()
  try {
    for (;;) {
      const { done, value } = await src.read()
      if (done) break
      let lines: string[]
      try {
        lines = reader.push(value)
      } catch (e) {
        if (!(e instanceof LineTooLong)) throw e
        // No id can be read from it and nothing was sent; Claude's own entry timeout ends that call.
        try { appendLedger(deps.paths.ledger, NUANCE_LEDGER_KEYS, { event: 'stdin_too_long', bytes: e.bytes }, deps.now().getTime()) } catch { /* best effort */ }
        lines = e.lines
      }
      for (const line of lines) handle(line)
    }
  } catch { /* a broken stdin ends the pipe like EOF */ }
  await pipe.stop()
  await Promise.all([...handling])
  return 0
}

Notes for the implementer. The pipe's tap socket answers exactly one question per connection and always ends the exchange itself (P18). `requestKnocks` matches hub answers to waiters oldest first: a `knock_report` that is not `expired` and has a count above 0 is merged into the pending set by its seqs (P41), then the oldest waiter, if any, gets `pending.take()` (or null for `expired`); with no waiter the report simply stays pending and shows once at the next tap. A count with no seqs adds nothing, which is silence: the hub of Task 49 always sends the seqs. The pending set is cleared only when a `collab_next` or `collab_cursor_ack` answer is `ok`: an error answer means the agent did not read its notes. The tap socket's lifecycle belongs to the `TapServer`: it removes its own host's dead siblings first (P61), unlinks its own name before binding (F8: a stale file would fail `EADDRINUSE`), binds under `umask 0177` and chmods 0600 (P17), all three through Task 23's `listenPrivate(path, handlers, { replace: false })`, and installs `exit`, `SIGTERM` and `SIGINT` listeners that it removes again on `stop()`. Bun fires `exit` on an uncaught error too (measured: an uncaught throw exits 1 and runs the `exit` listener), so the `exit` listener covers that path, and SIGTERM and SIGINT call `process.exit(143)` and `process.exit(130)`, which run it. The pipe rewrites its `.json` on every ready, refusal and loss, so `collab-bridge status` (Task 24) sees the link state. A tap server that cannot start (a socket path over 103 bytes, P16) is ledgered `tap_socket_failed` and leaves calls working. The `pipe` verb runs `runPipe` on main's own stdio (`io.stdin` is `Bun.stdin.stream()`, which Bun returns as one shared object, so `livePipeDeps`' own call does not compete for it); a missing INSTALLED throws, and main answers 70 with one stderr line, so Claude shows the server as failed rather than half-working. Two pipe instances of one host in one process (Task 30's `call_refs are unique …` test) share a tap socket name; that test asserts nothing about tap files.

  tool('collab_session_start', 'Start a session.'),
  tool('collab_session_end', 'End the session.'),
  tool('collab_next', 'Read what is new.'),
  tool('collab_cursor_ack', 'Acknowledge a cursor.'),
  tool('collab_task_list', 'List tasks.'),
  tool('collab_task_create', 'Create a task.'),
  tool('collab_task_claim', 'Claim a task.'),
  tool('collab_task_complete', 'Complete a task.'),
  tool('collab_task_recover', 'Recover an expired lease.'),
  tool('collab_report_append', 'Append a report.'),
]

/** The fake claude host every fake table chains to; lstart in Collab's squeezed form (one space before the day). */
export const FAKE_HOST = { pid: 4100, lstart: 'Wed Oct 7 16:22:59 2026', comm: 'claude' } as const

/** `selfPid` as a child of the fake claude host, or (host: null) of launchd with no claude anywhere. */
export function fakeTable(selfPid: number = process.pid, host: { pid: number; lstart: string; comm: string } | null = FAKE_HOST): ProcTable {
  const rows: ProcRecord[] = [{ pid: selfPid, ppid: host ? host.pid : 1, started_at: 'Tue Oct 13 11:33:11 2026', comm: 'collab-bridge' }]
  if (host) rows.push({ pid: host.pid, ppid: 1, started_at: host.lstart, comm: host.comm })
  return new Map(rows.map((r) => [r.pid, r]))
}

/** A git repo with one commit on `main` (Task 27's makeRepo, the trial shape), by its realpath. */
export function gitRepo(prefix = 'cb-share-'): string {
  const dir = temp(prefix)
  makeRepo(dir)
  return dir
}

/** Task 21's INSTALLED with the pipe world's values: the seeded tool list's digest and a recorded git the pipe never runs. */
export function testInstalled(o: Partial<InstalledInfo> = {}): InstalledInfo {
  return nuanceInstalled({
    build: '1a2b3c4d', tools_seed: toolsDigest(TEST_TOOLS),
    git: { path: REAL_GIT, version: '2.52.0', sha256: 'b'.repeat(64), guard: true, apple: false },
    summon_dropin_stat: '1 2 3 501 600', ...o,
  })
}

export interface NuanceFixture { home: string; env: Record<string, string>; paths: NuancePaths; share: string; installed: InstalledInfo }

/**
 * A Nuance home as `install write` leaves it: INSTALLED, the seat key, the seeded tool list, shares.json naming `share`
 * (or another folder, with shared: false) and the 0700 state dirs. `share` is a git repo unless gitRepo: false.
 */
export function nuanceFixture(o: { shared?: boolean; gitRepo?: boolean; env?: Record<string, string> } = {}): NuanceFixture {
  const home = temp('cb-nuance-')
  const env = testEnv(home, o.env ?? {})
  const paths = nuancePaths(home, env)
  const share = o.gitRepo === false ? temp('cb-plain-') : gitRepo()
  const installed = testInstalled()
  for (const d of [paths.share, paths.state, paths.run, paths.pipes, paths.lineages, paths.tools]) mkdirSync(d, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 })
  writeFileDurable(paths.installed, renderInstalled(installed), 0o600)
  writeSeatKeyIfAbsent(paths)
  seedTools(paths, TEST_TOOLS, toolsDigest(TEST_TOOLS))
  const sharedPath = o.shared === false ? join(temp('cb-other-'), 'elsewhere') : share
  writeShares(paths, [{ realpath: sharedPath, gitdir: join(sharedPath, '.git') }])
  return { home, env, paths, share, installed }
}

export interface TestPipeDeps extends PipeDeps { lines: string[] }

/** Deps for an in-process Pipe in `f.share`, hosted by the fake claude, with an interactive entrypoint and a stdin that never ends. */
export function pipeDeps(f: NuanceFixture, o: Partial<PipeDeps> = {}): TestPipeDeps {
  const lines: string[] = []
  return {
    paths: f.paths, env: { ...f.env, CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT: 'cli' }, cwd: f.share, selfPid: process.pid,
    table: () => fakeTable(), ttyOf: () => 'ttys001', mono: () => performance.now(), now: () => new Date(), rand: Math.random,
    stdin: new ReadableStream<Uint8Array>({ start() {} }), write: (line: string) => { lines.push(line) }, installed: f.installed, user: 'macair',
    ...o, lines,
  }
}

/** Polls `fn` every 10 ms until it returns something truthy; fails after `ms`. */
export async function waitFor<T>(fn: () => T | null | undefined | false, ms = 5000, what = 'condition'): Promise<T> {
  const end = Date.now() + ms
  for (;;) {
    const v = fn()
    if (v) return v
    if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`waitFor: ${what} not met within ${ms} ms`)
    await Bun.sleep(10)
  }
}

/** The error code of a bridge failure, or null for a Collab result. */
export const codeOf = (r: ToolResult): string | null => (r.isError === true && typeof r.structuredContent?.error === 'string' ? r.structuredContent.error : null)

/** The parsed JSON-RPC lines a pipe wrote. */
export const written = (d: TestPipeDeps): any[] => d.lines.map((l) => JSON.parse(l))

/** Ledger events in the Nuance ledger, oldest first. */
export const ledgerEvents = (paths: NuancePaths): string[] => {
  try { return readLedger(paths.ledger).map((e) => e.event) } catch { return [] }
}

/** `collab-bridge pipe` from source, as Claude runs it (bun with no .env and no bunfig, like the compiled binary). */
export const PIPE_ARGV = [process.execPath, '--no-env-file', '--config=/dev/null', `${PKG}/src/nuance/main.ts`, 'pipe']

export interface TapExchange { frames: string[]; report: { count: number; origins: string[] } | null }

/**
 * One tap exchange on a pipe's socket, as the hook makes it: DATA {t:'knocks'}, then every frame until the pipe's CLOSE
 * or the connection's end. closeAfterMs makes the tap leave early, as a hook whose budget ran out does.
 */
export async function tapExchange(sockPath: string, o: { closeAfterMs?: number; timeoutMs?: number } = {}): Promise<TapExchange> {
  const frames: string[] = []
  let report: TapExchange['report'] = null
  const dec = new FrameDecoder(64 * 1024)
  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    let done = false
    const finish = () => { if (!done) { done = true; resolve() } }
    const t = setTimeout(finish, o.timeoutMs ?? 6000)
    Bun.connect({ unix: sockPath, socket: {
      open(s) {
        s.write(encodeFrame(FRAME_TYPE.DATA, 0, encodeMessage({ t: 'knocks' })))
        if (o.closeAfterMs !== undefined) setTimeout(() => { s.end(); clearTimeout(t); finish() }, o.closeAfterMs)
      },
      data(s, d) {
        for (const f of dec.push(d)) {
          if (f.type === FRAME_TYPE.CLOSE) { frames.push('CLOSE'); s.end(); clearTimeout(t); finish(); return }
          if (f.type !== FRAME_TYPE.DATA) continue
          const m = decodeJson(f.payload)
          frames.push(String(m?.t))
          if (m?.t === 'knock_report') report = { count: m.count as number, origins: m.origins as string[] }
        }
      },
      close() { clearTimeout(t); finish() },
      error() { clearTimeout(t); finish() },
    } }).catch(reject)
  })
  return { frames, report }
}

import { cleanupTmps } from './helpers.ts'
import { FAKE_HOST, nuanceFixture, pipeDeps, tapExchange, TEST_TOOLS, waitFor, type NuanceFixture } from './pipe-fixture.ts'

const DIGEST = toolsDigest(TEST_TOOLS)
const OK: ToolResult = { content: [{ type: 'text', text: '{"ok":true}' }], structuredContent: { ok: true } }
const pipes: Pipe[] = []
const links: FakeLink[] = []
afterEach(async () => {
  for (const p of pipes.splice(0)) await p.stop()
  for (const l of links.splice(0)) await l.close()
  cleanupTmps()
})

/** A started pipe in a shared folder, attached to a fake hub when `hub` is true. */
async function world(hub = true): Promise<{ f: NuanceFixture; p: Pipe; l: FakeLink | null; sock: string }> {
  const f = nuanceFixture()
  let l: FakeLink | null = null
  if (hub) {
    l = await makeFakeLink(f.paths.hubSock)
    links.push(l)
    l.accept({ ready: { tools_digest: DIGEST } })
  }
  const p = new Pipe(pipeDeps(f))
  pipes.push(p)
  await p.start()
  if (l) {
    await waitFor(() => l!.frames().some((m) => m.t === 'prove'))
    await Bun.sleep(100)
  }
  return { f, p, l, sock: f.paths.pipeSock(FAKE_HOST.pid, process.pid) }
}

const knocks = (l: FakeLink) => l.frames().filter((m) => m.t === 'knocks')
const report = (count: number, origins: string[], seqs: number[]) => ({ t: 'knock_report', count, origins, seqs })
const NONE = report(0, [], [])

describe('the pipe relays a tap to the hub', () => {
  test('with the link down the tap gets CLOSE', async () => {
    const { sock } = await world(false)
    const t0 = performance.now()

  })

  test('knocks never asks the hub for more than 2000 ms, and 1800 for a tap', async () => {

    await waitFor(() => knocks(l!).length === 1)
    l!.send(NONE)
    expect(await direct).toBeNull()

    l!.send(NONE)

    expect(knocks(l!).map((m) => m.timeout_ms)).toEqual([2000, 1800])
  })

    await Bun.sleep(5000 - 2000)
    l!.send(report(1, ['air'], [11]))                                    // the stalled answer arrives 5 s late
    await Bun.sleep(50)

  test('a report that arrives after the tap closed shows at the next prompt exactly once', async () => {
    const { l, sock } = await world()

    await waitFor(() => knocks(l!).length === 1)

    await Bun.sleep(100)

    await waitFor(() => knocks(l!).length === 2)

    expect(await next).toEqual({ frames: ['knock_report', 'CLOSE'], report: { count: 1, origins: ['nuance/macair'] } })
    const after = tapExchange(sock)
    await waitFor(() => knocks(l!).length === 3)
    l!.send(NONE)
    expect((await after).report).toBeNull()
  }, 10_000)

  test('a kept report and a new one merge by seq', async () => {
    const { p, l, sock } = await world()
    const late = p.requestKnocks(300)
    await waitFor(() => knocks(l!).length === 1)
    expect(await late).toBeNull()
    l!.send(report(1, ['air'], [5]))
    await Bun.sleep(50)
    const tap = tapExchange(sock)
    await waitFor(() => knocks(l!).length === 2)
    l!.send(report(2, ['air', 'nuance/macair'], [5, 6]))
    expect((await tap).report).toEqual({ count: 2, origins: ['air', 'nuance/macair'] })
  })

  test('a collab_next result clears the pending report', async () => {
    const { p, l, sock } = await world()
    const late = p.requestKnocks(300)
    await waitFor(() => knocks(l!).length === 1)
    expect(await late).toBeNull()

    const call = await waitFor(() => l!.frames().find((m) => m.t === 'call'))
    l!.send({ t: 'result', call_ref: call.call_ref, outcome: 'ok', result: OK })
    expect(await next).toEqual(OK)
    const tap = tapExchange(sock)
    await waitFor(() => knocks(l!).length === 2)
    l!.send(NONE)
    expect(await tap).toEqual({ frames: ['CLOSE'], report: null })
  })
})

// The pipe's tap socket (spec §8 items 1, 2 and 5): pipes/<host_pid>-<pipe_pid>.sock, 0600 in the 0700 pipes dir, with
// the .json record beside it so the hook can find the one pipe of its own Claude. One exchange per connection: the tap
// sends DATA {t:'knocks'}; the pipe answers DATA knock_report and then CLOSE when there is something to show, else CLOSE
// alone, which means silence. The answering side always ends the exchange (P18: under Bun a reply after a node:net
// client's end() is lost, F9). Notes the hook could not show go back to the pipe's pending set and show once, later.
import { chmodSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, unlinkSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { encodeFrame, FRAME_TYPE, FrameDecoder } from '../link/frame.ts'
import { decodeJson, encodeMessage, MAX_HANDSHAKE_BYTES, MAX_KNOCK_COUNT, ORIGIN_RE, type TapKnockReportMsg } from '../link/messages.ts'
import { socketPathOk, type NuancePaths } from '../paths.ts'
import { pidAlive } from '../proc.ts'
import { TIMING } from '../timing.ts'
import type { HostInfo } from './lineage.ts'
import { writePipeRecord } from './pipe-record.ts'
import { listenPrivate } from './unix.ts'

/** What a tap may show: a count of distinct notes, their origins (at most 3), and the seqs, so a report can be merged again. */
export interface KnockShow { count: number; origins: string[]; seqs: number[] }

/** Knock reports the agent has not seen yet (§8 item 5): merged by seq, bounded, dropped after collab_next or cursor_ack. */
export interface PendingKnocks { add(r: { seqs: number[]; origins: string[] }): void; take(): KnockShow | null; clear(): void; size(): number }

const MAX_ORIGINS = 3

export function makePendingKnocks(maxSeqs: number = MAX_KNOCK_COUNT): PendingKnocks {
  const seqs = new Set<number>()
  let origins: string[] = []
  return {
    add(r) {
      for (const s of r.seqs) {
        if (seqs.size >= maxSeqs) break
        if (Number.isSafeInteger(s) && s >= 0) seqs.add(s)
      }
      for (const o of r.origins) if (ORIGIN_RE.test(o) && !origins.includes(o) && origins.length < MAX_ORIGINS) origins.push(o)
    },
    take() {
      if (seqs.size === 0) return null
      const out: KnockShow = { count: seqs.size, origins: [...origins], seqs: [...seqs].sort((a, b) => a - b) }
      seqs.clear()
      origins = []
      return out
    },
    clear() { seqs.clear(); origins = [] },
    size: () => seqs.size,
  }
}

export interface TapServerDeps {
  paths: NuancePaths; host: HostInfo; pipePid: number; lineage(): string | null; state(): string; refused(): string | null
  ask(budgetMs: number): Promise<{ count: number; origins: string[]; seqs?: number[] } | null>
  /** A report the hook could not be given (its connection closed, or the write failed): back into the pending set. */
  giveBack?(r: { count: number; origins: string[]; seqs?: number[] }): void
}

interface Conn { dec: FrameDecoder; asked: boolean; closed: boolean }
type Sock = { data: Conn; write(b: Uint8Array): number; end(): void }

const SOCK_NAME_RE = /^([1-9][0-9]{0,9})-([1-9][0-9]{0,9})\.(sock|json)$/

export class TapServer {
  private server: { stop(closeActive?: boolean): void } | null = null
  private readonly sockPath: string
  private readonly jsonPath: string
  private readonly onExit = () => this.unlinkFiles()
  private readonly onTerm = () => process.exit(143)   // 'exit' then runs onExit
  private readonly onInt = () => process.exit(130)

  constructor(private readonly deps: TapServerDeps) {
    this.sockPath = deps.paths.pipeSock(deps.host.pid, deps.pipePid)
    this.jsonPath = deps.paths.pipeJson(deps.host.pid, deps.pipePid)
  }

  async start(): Promise<void> {
    const { paths } = this.deps
    mkdirSync(paths.pipes, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 })
    chmodSync(paths.pipes, 0o700)
    this.removeDeadSiblings()
    if (!socketPathOk(this.sockPath)) throw new Error('tap socket path is longer than 103 bytes')   // P16, F7
    // listenPrivate unlinks the name first (a stale file of ours would fail EADDRINUSE, F8), binds under umask 0177 and
    // chmods 0600 (P17).
    this.server = listenPrivate<Conn>(this.sockPath, {
      open: (s) => { s.data = { dec: new FrameDecoder(MAX_HANDSHAKE_BYTES), asked: false, closed: false } },
      data: (s, chunk) => this.onData(s as unknown as Sock, chunk),
      close: (s) => { if (s.data) s.data.closed = true },
      error: (s) => { if (s.data) s.data.closed = true },
    }, { replace: false }).server
    this.writeJson()
    process.on('exit', this.onExit)
    process.on('SIGTERM', this.onTerm)
    process.on('SIGINT', this.onInt)
  }

  stop(): void {
    process.off('exit', this.onExit)
    process.off('SIGTERM', this.onTerm)
    process.off('SIGINT', this.onInt)
    try { this.server?.stop(true) } catch { /* already stopped */ }
    this.server = null
    this.unlinkFiles()
  }

  /** Rewrites pipes/<host_pid>-<pipe_pid>.json with the pipe's lineage, link state and latest refusal (for status, Task 24). */
  writeJson(): void {
    if (this.server === null) return
    const { deps } = this
    try {
      writePipeRecord(deps.paths, { v: 1, host_pid: deps.host.pid, host_lstart: deps.host.lstart, pipe_pid: deps.pipePid,
        lineage: deps.lineage(), state: deps.state(), refused: deps.refused() })
    } catch { /* a record the tap cannot read only means silence */ }
  }

  /** P61: a SIGKILLed pipe of this same host left its files (F8); two records for one host would silence every tap (§8 item 2). */
  private removeDeadSiblings(): void {
    const { paths, host, pipePid } = this.deps
    let names: string[]
    try { names = readdirSync(paths.pipes) } catch { return }
    for (const name of names) {
      const m = SOCK_NAME_RE.exec(name)
      if (!m || Number(m[1]) !== host.pid) continue
      const pid = Number(m[2])
      if (pid === pipePid || pidAlive(pid)) continue
      try { unlinkSync(join(paths.pipes, name)) } catch { /* raced */ }
    }
  }

  private unlinkFiles(): void {
    for (const p of [this.sockPath, this.jsonPath]) try { unlinkSync(p) } catch { /* gone */ }
  }

  private onData(s: Sock, chunk: Uint8Array): void {
    const c = s.data
    if (c.asked) return   // one exchange per connection
    let frames
    try { frames = c.dec.push(chunk) } catch { c.asked = true; return this.close(s) }
    for (const f of frames) {
      if (f.type === FRAME_TYPE.CLOSE) { c.asked = true; return this.close(s) }
      if (f.type !== FRAME_TYPE.DATA) continue
      c.asked = true
      const m = decodeJson(f.payload)
      if (!m || m.t !== 'knocks') return this.close(s)
      void this.exchange(s)
      return
    }
  }

  private async exchange(s: Sock): Promise<void> {
    let r: { count: number; origins: string[]; seqs?: number[] } | null = null
    try { r = await this.deps.ask(TIMING.tapAskMs) } catch { r = null }
    if (r === null || r.count <= 0) return this.close(s)
    // §8 item 5: the hook's budget ran out before the answer, so the report is kept for the next tap.
    if (s.data.closed) { this.deps.giveBack?.(r); return }
    const report: TapKnockReportMsg = { t: 'knock_report', count: r.count, origins: r.origins }
    const bytes = encodeFrame(FRAME_TYPE.DATA, 0, encodeMessage(report))
    let n = -1
    try { n = s.write(bytes) } catch { n = -1 }
    if (n !== bytes.byteLength) {
      this.deps.giveBack?.(r)
      try { s.end() } catch { /* gone */ }
      return
    }
    this.close(s)
  }

  private close(s: Sock): void {
    try { s.write(encodeFrame(FRAME_TYPE.CLOSE, 0)) } catch { /* gone */ }
    try { s.end() } catch { /* gone */ }
  }
}

Against Task 30's file it changes only: the header comment; the `HubKnockReportMsg` type import and the `tap-server.ts` import; `KnockWait`, `KNOCKS_MARGIN_MS` and `READS_NOTES`; the fields `pending`, `knockWaits` and `tap`; `start()` starts the tap server once a host and a lineage exist; `stop()` stops it and answers waiting knocks with null; the new `requestKnocks`, `startTap` and `onKnockReport`; the link handlers `knockReport`, `refused` and `lost` and `onReady` rewrite the pipe record; `onResult` clears the pending set after an `ok` collab_next or collab_cursor_ack.

```ts
// The Claude MCP pipe on Nuance (C4, spec §6.2, §8, §9.1–§9.4). It answers the harness itself from the cached tool list,
// so initialize and tools/list work with the hub away (R16), and sends each tools/call once over its link to the Air hub.
// "Not sent" ends at the write to the relay socket (§9.3 item 3): every refusal before that write is delivered:false;
// after it, the answer is the hub's result or hub_outcome_unknown, never a JSON-RPC error (R17) and never a resend (R18).
// It also serves its Claude's knock tap on pipes/<host_pid>-<pipe_pid>.sock (tap-server.ts) and relays each tap's
// question to the hub as one bounded knocks request (§8 items 3–5).
import { realpathSync } from 'node:fs'
import { basename } from 'node:path'
import { bridgeFailure, deliveredOf, withPriorUnknown, type AgentCode } from '../failure.ts'
import { appendLedger, NUANCE_LEDGER_KEYS, type LedgerFields } from '../ledger.ts'
import { LineReader, LineTooLong, type JsonRpcId } from '../jsonrpc.ts'
import { FRAME_HEADER_BYTES } from '../link/frame.ts'
import {
  encodeMessage, LABEL_TOKEN_RE, MAX_FOLDER_BYTES, MAX_PIPE_TO_HUB, newPipeInstance,
  type AttachMsg, type CallMsg, type Declared, type HubKnockReportMsg, type NoticeMsg, type ReadyMsg, type ResultMsg, type ToolDef,
  type ToolResult, type ToolsMsg,
} from '../link/messages.ts'
import type { NuancePaths } from '../paths.ts'
import type { ProcTable } from '../proc.ts'
import type { Env } from '../sysbin.ts'
import { scaled, TIMING } from '../timing.ts'
import { declaredState } from './gitstate.ts'
import { addInflight, argsHash, clearByIdempotencyKey, clearByTool, clearInflight, isStale, MAX_INFLIGHT, priorConflict, unresolved } from './inflight.ts'
import { readShares, type InstalledInfo } from './installed.ts'
import { findHost, interactiveCheck, openLineage, SESSION_ID_RE, sweepLineages, type HostInfo, type Interactive } from './lineage.ts'
import { bunConnect, LinkClient, type Connect } from './link-client.ts'
import { McpLocalServer } from './mcp-local.ts'
import { loadSeatPrivate, signSeat } from './seatkey.ts'
import { makePendingKnocks, TapServer, type KnockShow } from './tap-server.ts'
import { acceptHubTools, readCurrentTools } from './tools-cache.ts'

/** Claim and complete may fetch, check and check out on the Air: 150 s instead of 60 (§9.4). */
export const LONG_CALL_TOOLS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['collab_task_claim', 'collab_task_complete'])
/** Calls that carry the folder's declared git state (§7.5); recover only for a takeover (its action, or Collab's default). */
export const DECLARING_TOOLS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['collab_task_claim', 'collab_task_complete', 'collab_task_recover'])
/** Tools that change nothing (§6.3's pinned reads; §9.3 item 7: collab_next is harmless): no in-flight record, never capped (P65). */
export const UNRECORDED_TOOLS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['collab_workspace_status', 'collab_task_list', 'collab_task_get',
  'collab_report_list', 'collab_events_since', 'collab_anchor_status', 'collab_journal_verify', 'collab_next'])
/** Claude never sends a line this long; a longer one is dropped through its newline and the reader goes on (P59). */
export const PIPE_STDIN_MAX_LINE = 8 * 1024 * 1024

export interface PipeDeps {
  paths: NuancePaths; env: Env; cwd: string; selfPid: number; table(): ProcTable | null; ttyOf(pid: number): string | null
  mono(): number; now(): Date; rand(): number; stdin: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>; write(line: string): void; installed: InstalledInfo; user: string
  connect?: Connect; callTimeouts?: { default: number; long: number }
}

interface InFlight { tool: string; idempotencyKey: string | null; requestId: JsonRpcId; resolve(r: ToolResult): void; timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null }
interface KnockWait { resolve(r: KnockShow | null): void; timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> }

/** The margin the pipe keeps between a tap's budget and the timeout it gives the hub (2000 → 1800, §8 item 3). */
const KNOCKS_MARGIN_MS = 200
/** Results that mean the agent has read its notes, so a kept knock report is dropped (§8 item 5). */
const READS_NOTES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['collab_next', 'collab_cursor_ack'])

/** The agent-facing sentence for each refusal the pipe itself makes. */
const MESSAGES = {
  tool_not_available_remote: 'This tool is not offered to remote seats in this phase.',
  hub_version_mismatch: "The hub's tool list changed; re-list the tools (/mcp), then call again.",
  folder_not_shared: "This folder is not shared with the Air; start Claude at a shared folder's root.",
  harness_not_interactive: 'Collab through the Air hub is only for an interactive Claude session.',
  hub_away: 'The Air hub is not reachable now; nothing was sent.',
  seat_session_ended: 'This Collab session has ended on the Air; start a new session.',
  lineage_cap: 'Too many Claude sessions on this Mac are attached to the Air hub; close another session first.',
  frame_too_large: 'This call is larger than a call may be; nothing was sent.',
  rate_limited: 'Too many earlier calls of this session have no known outcome; check them with a read tool, or replay one with its own idempotency_key.',
  fetch_failed: "Could not read this folder's git state.",
  unrecorded: 'This pipe could not record the call before sending it; nothing was sent.',
} as const

const REFUSAL_CODES_FROM_HUB = new Set(['seat_session_ended', 'lineage_cap', 'folder_not_shared', 'frame_too_large'])

/** Whether this call declares the folder's git state: claim, complete, and a takeover (Collab's default action). */
function declares(name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
  if (name === 'collab_task_recover') return args.action === undefined || args.action === 'takeover'
  return DECLARING_TOOLS.has(name)
}

function labelOf(v: string | undefined): string {
  return typeof v === 'string' && LABEL_TOKEN_RE.test(v) ? v : 'unknown'
}

/** The error code of a result, Collab's or the bridge's, or null for a success. */
function errorOf(r: ToolResult): string | null {
  return r.isError === true && typeof r.structuredContent?.error === 'string' ? r.structuredContent.error : null
}

/** A session id in Collab's id shape, else null: a record must never hold one its lineage file would drop. */
function sessionIdOf(v: unknown): string | null {
  return typeof v === 'string' && SESSION_ID_RE.test(v) ? v : null
}

/**
 * §9.3 item 7, P65: an answer that tells what this lineage's earlier calls of a keyless tool did. cursor_ack is fenced by
 * expected_cursor_version, so any answer from Collab settles the earlier ones; session_end by Collab's answer or the hub's
 * seat_session_ended; session_start by a start or by Collab's session_already_bound. A hub refusal settles nothing.
 */
function settlesKeyless(tool: string, r: ToolResult, own: boolean): boolean {
  const code = errorOf(r)
  if (tool === 'collab_cursor_ack') return own
  if (tool === 'collab_session_end') return own || code === 'seat_session_ended'
  if (tool === 'collab_session_start') return own && (code === null || code === 'session_already_bound')
  return false
}

export class Pipe {
  private readonly instance = newPipeInstance()
  private seq = 0
  private host: HostInfo | null = null
  private key: string | null = null
  private lineage: string | null = null
  private folder: string | null = null
  private shared = false
  private interactive: Interactive = { ok: false, reason: 'no_claude_host' }
  /** The Collab session this pipe believes its lineage has bound (P66); every in-flight record names it. */
  private session: string | null = null
  private tools: { digest: string; list: ToolDef[] } | null = null
  private relist = false
  private readonly refusedDigests = new Set<string>()
  private link: LinkClient | null = null
  private readonly inflight = new Map<string, InFlight>()
  private readonly server: McpLocalServer
  private readonly timeouts: { default: number; long: number }
  private readonly pending = makePendingKnocks()
  private knockWaits: KnockWait[] = []
  private tap: TapServer | null = null

  constructor(private readonly deps: PipeDeps) {
    this.timeouts = deps.callTimeouts ?? { default: scaled(TIMING.callDefaultMs, deps.env), long: scaled(TIMING.callLongMs, deps.env) }
    this.server = new McpLocalServer({
      device: deps.installed.device, user: deps.user, build: deps.installed.build,
      tools: () => this.tools,
      onList: () => { this.relist = false },
      onCall: (id, name, args) => this.handleCall(id, name, args),
      onCancel: (requestId) => this.cancel(requestId),
      write: (line) => deps.write(line),
    })
  }

  async start(): Promise<void> {
    const { deps } = this
    const table = deps.table()
    if (table) {
      // §6.2: lineage files whose host is gone are swept after 7 days; our own host is alive, so its file stays.
      try { sweepLineages(deps.paths, table, deps.now().getTime()) } catch { /* best effort */ }
      this.host = findHost(deps.selfPid, table)
    }
    this.interactive = interactiveCheck(deps.env, this.host, deps.ttyOf)
    if (this.host) {
      try {
        const l = openLineage(deps.paths, this.host, deps.now)
        this.key = l.key
        this.lineage = l.file.lineage
      } catch { /* no lineage file: every call answers harness_not_interactive */ }
    }
    try { this.folder = realpathSync.native(deps.cwd) } catch { this.folder = null }
    const shares = readShares(deps.paths) ?? []
    this.shared = this.folder !== null && Buffer.byteLength(this.folder, 'utf8') <= MAX_FOLDER_BYTES && shares.some((s) => s.realpath === this.folder)
    this.tools = readCurrentTools(deps.paths)
    this.ledger({ event: 'pipe_start', lineage: this.lineage ?? undefined, outcome: this.shared ? 'shared' : 'not_shared' })
    if (this.host && this.lineage) await this.startTap(this.host)
    // A folder outside shares.json never dials (§9.2 folder_not_shared); nor does a pipe with no lineage or no tool list.
    if (this.lineage && this.host && this.shared && this.tools) this.startLink(this.host, this.lineage)
  }

  async stop(): Promise<void> {
    this.tap?.stop()
    this.tap = null
    this.link?.stop()
    this.link = null
    for (const ref of [...this.inflight.keys()]) this.settleUnknown(ref, 'stopped')
    for (const w of this.knockWaits.splice(0)) { clearTimeout(w.timer); w.resolve(null) }
  }

  lineageId(): string | null {
    return this.lineage
  }

  /**
   * One tap's question (§8 item 3). With no fresh link the answer is silence, and a kept report waits for a later tap.
   * Otherwise one knocks request goes to the hub with at most 2000 ms, 200 ms under the budget (1800 for the tap's 2000);
   * an expired report or no answer within the budget is silence, and a later answer is kept for the next tap.
   */
  requestKnocks(budgetMs: number): Promise<KnockShow | null> {
    const link = this.link
    if (!link || !link.fresh()) return Promise.resolve(null)
    const timeout = Math.min(TIMING.knocksMaxMs, Math.floor(budgetMs) - KNOCKS_MARGIN_MS)
    if (timeout < 1) return Promise.resolve(null)
    if (link.send({ t: 'knocks', timeout_ms: timeout }) !== 'written') return Promise.resolve(null)
    return new Promise<KnockShow | null>((resolve) => {
      const w: KnockWait = {
        resolve,
        timer: setTimeout(() => {
          this.knockWaits = this.knockWaits.filter((x) => x !== w)
          resolve(null)
        }, budgetMs),
      }
      this.knockWaits.push(w)
    })
  }

  /** One JSON-RPC line from the harness, answered by the local MCP server (Task 28). */
  handleLine(line: string): Promise<void> {
    return this.server.handleLine(line)
  }

  async handleCall(id: JsonRpcId, name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<ToolResult> {
    const { deps } = this
    const ref = this.lineage ? `${this.lineage}:${this.instance}:${this.seq++}` : '<none>'
    const refuse = (code: AgentCode, message: string, extra?: Record<string, unknown>) => this.withPrior(bridgeFailure(code, message, ref, extra))
    if (!this.tools || !this.tools.list.some((t) => t.name === name)) return refuse('tool_not_available_remote', MESSAGES.tool_not_available_remote)
    if (this.relist) return refuse('hub_version_mismatch', MESSAGES.hub_version_mismatch)
    if (!this.shared) return refuse('folder_not_shared', MESSAGES.folder_not_shared)
    if (!this.lineage || !this.key || !this.folder) return refuse('harness_not_interactive', MESSAGES.harness_not_interactive)
    if (name === 'collab_session_start' && !this.interactive.ok) return refuse('harness_not_interactive', MESSAGES.harness_not_interactive)
    const link = this.link
    if (!link || !link.fresh()) {
      const code = link?.lastRefused() ?? null
      if (code !== null && REFUSAL_CODES_FROM_HUB.has(code)) {
        const c = code as 'seat_session_ended' | 'lineage_cap' | 'folder_not_shared' | 'frame_too_large'
        if (c === 'seat_session_ended') this.session = null   // P66: the old session's unknowns can no longer be replayed
        return refuse(c, MESSAGES[c])
      }
      return refuse('hub_away', MESSAGES.hub_away)   // seat_proof_failed and socket_path_too_long stay hub_away (P29)
    }
    const idempotencyKey = typeof args.idempotency_key === 'string' ? args.idempotency_key : null
    // P65: a read or collab_next changes nothing, so it writes no record and is never capped. A same-key replay of an
    // unresolved call of this session writes none either: Collab's receipt settles both (§9.3 item 5), the earlier record
    // stays until Collab answers that key, and the 64 cap never refuses the call that can settle it.
    const recorded = !UNRECORDED_TOOLS.has(name)
    let replay = false
    if (recorded) {
      const records = unresolved(deps.paths, this.key)
      const prior = priorConflict(records, name, args, this.session)
      if (prior) {
        const old = JSON.stringify(prior.idempotency_key)
        return refuse('prior_outcome_unknown', isStale(prior, this.session)
          ? `An earlier call with the same content (idempotency_key ${old}) has no known outcome and its Collab session has ended; a replay would run it again. Check with collab_report_list or collab_task_list first.`
          : `An earlier call with the same content under idempotency_key ${old} has no known outcome; replay it with that key, or check first.`,
        { prior_call_ref: prior.call_ref, prior_idempotency_key: prior.idempotency_key })
      }
      replay = idempotencyKey !== null && records.some((r) => r.tool === name && r.idempotency_key === idempotencyKey && !isStale(r, this.session))
      if (!replay && records.length >= MAX_INFLIGHT) return refuse('rate_limited', MESSAGES.rate_limited)
    }
    let declared: Declared | undefined
    if (declares(name, args)) {
      const d = declaredState(this.folder, deps.installed.git.path, deps.paths.home)
      if ('error' in d) return refuse('fetch_failed', MESSAGES.fetch_failed)   // P48: a definite refusal, nothing sent
      declared = d
    }
    const timeout = LONG_CALL_TOOLS.has(name) ? this.timeouts.long : this.timeouts.default
    const call: CallMsg = { t: 'call', call_ref: ref, name, arguments: args, timeout_ms: timeout, ...(declared ? { declared } : {}) }
    // §6.6, P59: the relay would close the whole connection on an oversized frame and turn every call on it into unknown.
    if (encodeMessage(call).byteLength + FRAME_HEADER_BYTES > MAX_PIPE_TO_HUB) return refuse('frame_too_large', MESSAGES.frame_too_large)
    // Persisted before the write, so a pipe that dies mid-call leaves the record for the next pipe (§9.3 item 6). A record
    // that cannot be written (a lock timeout, a lineage file gone) means the call is not sent at all.
    const writes = recorded && !replay
    if (writes) {
      let added: boolean
      try {
        added = addInflight(deps.paths, this.key, { call_ref: ref, tool: name, idempotency_key: idempotencyKey, args_hash: argsHash(args),
          at: deps.now().toISOString(), session_id: this.session })
      } catch {
        this.ledger({ event: 'inflight_unwritable', call_ref: ref, tool: name, lineage: this.lineage })
        return refuse('hub_away', MESSAGES.unrecorded)
      }
      if (!added) return refuse('rate_limited', MESSAGES.rate_limited)
    }
    const key = this.key
    return await new Promise<ToolResult>((resolve) => {
      const f: InFlight = { tool: name, idempotencyKey, requestId: id, resolve, timer: null }
      // Registered only once the write has returned. A write that throws took nothing (§9.3 item 3), and the lost() it runs
      // inside send must not answer this call unknown.
      if (link.send(call) !== 'written') {
        if (writes) this.clearRecords(key, ref, null)
        resolve(refuse('hub_away', MESSAGES.hub_away))
        return
      }
      this.inflight.set(ref, f)
      // bunConnect's flush can see the socket gone (write < 0) and drop the link inside send, which still returns 'written'.
      // The call was handed to the stream, so it is unknown at once (§9.3 item 3), not at the deadline.
      if (link.state() !== 'ready') { this.settleUnknown(ref, 'link_lost'); return }
      // A relative deadline on this side's own clock (§5.4); the hub never cancels on it.
      f.timer = setTimeout(() => this.settleUnknown(ref, 'deadline'), timeout)
    })
  }

  private startLink(host: HostInfo, lineage: string): void {
    const { deps } = this
    let priv: ReturnType<typeof loadSeatPrivate>
    try { priv = loadSeatPrivate(deps.paths) } catch {
      this.ledger({ event: 'seat_key_unreadable', lineage })
      return
    }
    const entrypoint = this.interactive.ok ? this.interactive.entrypoint : labelOf(deps.env.CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT)
    const harness = LABEL_TOKEN_RE.test(basename(host.comm)) ? basename(host.comm) : 'claude'
    this.link = new LinkClient({
      sockPath: deps.paths.hubSock,
      attach: (): AttachMsg => ({
        t: 'attach', v: 1, lineage, harness, entrypoint, folder: this.folder!, pipe_build: deps.installed.build,
        tools_digest: this.tools!.digest, clock: deps.now().toISOString(),
      }),
      sign: (nonce) => signSeat(priv, deps.installed.device, deps.user, lineage, nonce),
      mono: deps.mono,
      rand: deps.rand,
      // The same host process, by pid and start time, from the same table the lineage came from (P40).
      hostAlive: () => {
        const r = deps.table()?.get(host.pid)
        return r !== undefined && r.started_at === host.lstart
      },
      on: {
        ready: (r) => this.onReady(r),
        result: (r) => this.onResult(r),
        tools: (t) => this.onTools(t),
        knockReport: (k) => this.onKnockReport(k),
        notice: (n) => this.onNotice(n),
        refused: () => this.tap?.writeJson(),
        lost: () => { this.tap?.writeJson(); this.onLost() },
      },
      connect: deps.connect ?? bunConnect,
      reattachMs: scaled(TIMING.reattachMs, deps.env),
      staleMs: scaled(TIMING.staleMs, deps.env),
      stepMs: scaled(TIMING.handshakeStepMs, deps.env),
    })
    this.link.start()
  }

  private async startTap(host: HostInfo): Promise<void> {
    const tap = new TapServer({
      paths: this.deps.paths, host, pipePid: this.deps.selfPid,
      lineage: () => this.lineage,
      state: () => this.link?.state() ?? 'detached',
      refused: () => this.link?.lastRefused() ?? null,
      ask: (budgetMs) => this.requestKnocks(budgetMs),
      giveBack: (r) => this.pending.add({ seqs: r.seqs ?? [], origins: r.origins }),
    })
    try {
      await tap.start()
      this.tap = tap
    } catch {
      this.ledger({ event: 'tap_socket_failed', lineage: this.lineage ?? undefined })   // calls still work; the tap is silent
    }
  }

  private onKnockReport(k: HubKnockReportMsg): void {
    if (!('expired' in k) && k.count > 0) this.pending.add({ seqs: k.seqs, origins: k.origins })
    const w = this.knockWaits.shift()
    if (!w) return   // late: it waits in pending and shows once at the next tap (§8 item 5)
    clearTimeout(w.timer)
    w.resolve('expired' in k ? null : this.pending.take())
  }

  private onReady(r: ReadyMsg): void {
    this.tap?.writeJson()
    // The hub's view of this lineage's session (P66): null when none is live, so no earlier unknown is advised for a replay.
    this.session = r.session_hint?.session_id ?? null
    if (this.tools && r.tools_digest !== this.tools.digest) this.link?.send({ t: 'tools_get', digest: r.tools_digest })
  }

  private onTools(t: ToolsMsg): void {
    const before = this.tools?.digest ?? null
    const v = acceptHubTools(this.deps.paths, { digest: t.digest, list: t.list })
    if (!v.ok) {
      // Keep the current list; tell the hub once per refused digest, so its status shows the refusal (§6.2, P51).
      if (!this.refusedDigests.has(t.digest)) {
        this.refusedDigests.add(t.digest)
        this.link?.send({ t: 'tools_refused', digest: t.digest, reason: v.reason })
        this.ledger({ event: 'tools_refused', code: v.reason, lineage: this.lineage ?? undefined })
      }
      return
    }
    const now = readCurrentTools(this.deps.paths)
    if (now) this.tools = now
    if (v.digest !== before) {
      this.relist = true   // calls answer hub_version_mismatch until the harness re-lists
      this.server.notifyToolsChanged()
    }
  }

  private onResult(r: ResultMsg): void {
    const f = this.inflight.get(r.call_ref)
    if (!f) {
      // P49: the agent was already told hub_outcome_unknown (or this pipe never sent it); the record stays.
      this.ledger({ event: 'late_result', call_ref: r.call_ref, outcome: r.outcome, lineage: this.lineage ?? undefined })
      return
    }
    this.inflight.delete(r.call_ref)
    if (f.timer !== null) clearTimeout(f.timer)
    if (r.outcome === 'unknown') {
      this.afterUnknown(f.tool)
      const result = r.result && deliveredOf(r.result) === 'unknown' ? r.result
        : bridgeFailure('hub_outcome_unknown', 'The Air could not settle this call; it may have taken effect.', r.call_ref)
      f.resolve(this.withPrior(result))
      return
    }
    const result = r.result!
    // A definite answer clears this call's own record. Only Collab's own answer (deliveredOf null, idempotency_conflict
    // included) settles earlier calls under the same idempotency_key, or of the same keyless tool (§9.3 items 5–7). A bridge
    // refusal (delivered:false, P50) never reached Collab, so it settles nothing about them, and their records and the
    // prior_outcome_unknown guard stay.
    const own = deliveredOf(result) === null
    if (this.key) {
      this.clearRecords(this.key, r.call_ref, own ? f.idempotencyKey : null)
      if (settlesKeyless(f.tool, result, own)) this.clearTool(this.key, f.tool)
    }
    if (r.outcome === 'ok' && READS_NOTES.has(f.tool)) this.pending.clear()
    this.afterAnswer(f.tool, result, own)
    f.resolve(this.withPrior(result))
  }

  /** P66: what an answer says about the bound session. Read before withPrior, so its prior_unknown already reflects it. */
  private afterAnswer(tool: string, r: ToolResult, own: boolean): void {
    const code = errorOf(r)
    if (code === 'seat_session_ended') { this.session = null; return }   // the credential is gone (§9.2)
    if (!own) return
    if (tool === 'collab_session_start') {
      const started = r.structuredContent?.session
      if (code === null) this.session = sessionIdOf(typeof started === 'object' && started !== null ? (started as Record<string, unknown>).id : null)
      else if (code === 'session_already_bound') this.session = sessionIdOf(r.structuredContent?.session_id)
    } else if (tool === 'collab_session_end' && (code === null || code === 'session_not_bound')) {
      this.session = null
    }
  }

  /** P66: an unknown session_end may have ended the session, an unknown session_start begun one (§9.3 item 8). */
  private afterUnknown(tool: string): void {
    if (tool === 'collab_session_end' || tool === 'collab_session_start') this.session = null
  }

  private onNotice(n: NoticeMsg): void {
    if (n.code === 'hub_lost' || n.code === 'link_closing') this.onLost()
  }

  private onLost(): void {
    for (const ref of [...this.inflight.keys()]) this.settleUnknown(ref, 'link_lost')
  }

  private cancel(requestId: JsonRpcId): void {
    for (const [ref, f] of this.inflight) {
      if (f.requestId !== requestId) continue
      // Recorded by the hub and never forwarded to a child (§9.3 item 4); the call may still take effect (K28).
      this.link?.send({ t: 'cancel', call_ref: ref })
      this.settleUnknown(ref, 'cancelled')
      return
    }
  }

  /** After the write: the call may have taken effect. The record stays until a definite answer clears it (P49). */
  private settleUnknown(ref: string, why: 'deadline' | 'link_lost' | 'cancelled' | 'stopped'): void {
    const f = this.inflight.get(ref)
    if (!f) return
    this.inflight.delete(ref)
    if (f.timer !== null) clearTimeout(f.timer)
    this.ledger({ event: 'call_unknown', call_ref: ref, tool: f.tool, code: why, lineage: this.lineage ?? undefined })
    this.afterUnknown(f.tool)
    const message = why === 'deadline' ? 'The Air did not answer in time; this call may have taken effect.'
      : why === 'cancelled' ? 'This call was cancelled after it was sent; it may have taken effect.'
      : 'The link to the Air was lost after this call was sent; it may have taken effect.'
    f.resolve(this.withPrior(bridgeFailure('hub_outcome_unknown', message, ref)))
  }

  /**
   * Clears records after a definite answer: the call's own, and with `idempotencyKey` this session's records under that key
   * (P66). A failed write keeps them: one spurious prior_unknown, never a lost result.
   */
  private clearRecords(key: string, callRef: string, idempotencyKey: string | null): void {
    try {
      clearInflight(this.deps.paths, key, callRef)
      if (idempotencyKey !== null) clearByIdempotencyKey(this.deps.paths, key, idempotencyKey, this.session)
    } catch {
      this.ledger({ event: 'inflight_unwritable', call_ref: callRef, lineage: this.lineage ?? undefined })
    }
  }

  /** Settles every record of one keyless tool (§9.3 item 7, P65); a failed write keeps them, as above. */
  private clearTool(key: string, tool: string): void {
    try { clearByTool(this.deps.paths, key, tool) } catch {
      this.ledger({ event: 'inflight_unwritable', tool, lineage: this.lineage ?? undefined })
    }
  }

  /** §9.3 item 6: every result names this lineage's unresolved calls, except the ones still in flight here. */
  private withPrior(r: ToolResult): ToolResult {
    if (!this.key) return r
    let records
    try { records = unresolved(this.deps.paths, this.key) } catch { return r }
    const prior = records.filter((x) => !this.inflight.has(x.call_ref))
      .map((x) => ({ call_ref: x.call_ref, tool: x.tool, idempotency_key: x.idempotency_key, session_ended: isStale(x, this.session) }))
    return withPriorUnknown(r, prior)
  }

  private ledger(f: LedgerFields): void {
    try { appendLedger(this.deps.paths.ledger, NUANCE_LEDGER_KEYS, f, this.deps.now().getTime()) } catch { /* the ledger never breaks a call */ }
  }
}

/** The `pipe` verb's body: stdin lines into the local MCP server until EOF, then stop, exit 0. */
export async function runPipe(deps: PipeDeps): Promise<number> {
  const pipe = new Pipe(deps)
  await pipe.start()
  const reader = new LineReader(PIPE_STDIN_MAX_LINE)
  const handling = new Set<Promise<void>>()
  const handle = (line: string) => {
    // Lines are handled concurrently: a 150 s claim never holds up a ping or another call.
    const p: Promise<void> = pipe.handleLine(line).catch(() => {}).finally(() => { handling.delete(p) })
    handling.add(p)
  }
  const src = deps.stdin.getReader()
  try {
    for (;;) {
      const { done, value } = await src.read()
      if (done) break
      let lines: string[]
      try {
        lines = reader.push(value)
      } catch (e) {
        if (!(e instanceof LineTooLong)) throw e
        // No id can be read from it and nothing was sent; Claude's own entry timeout ends that call.
        try { appendLedger(deps.paths.ledger, NUANCE_LEDGER_KEYS, { event: 'stdin_too_long', bytes: e.bytes }, deps.now().getTime()) } catch { /* best effort */ }
        lines = e.lines
      }
      for (const line of lines) handle(line)
    }
  } catch { /* a broken stdin ends the pipe like EOF */ }
  await pipe.stop()
  await Promise.all([...handling])
  return 0
}

```ts
// The one compiled Nuance program (P20). sshd's forced command runs `collab-bridge gate`; Claude runs `collab-bridge pipe`
// and its hook `collab-bridge tap --host claude` (Tasks 31, 32); Yu runs `collab-bridge status`; the installer runs the
// hidden `install …` verbs (Tasks 55, 56). Nothing Air-side is in here.
import { monoNowMs, passwdOfSelf } from '../native.ts'
import { homeOf, nuancePaths } from '../paths.ts'
import { readPs, ttyOf } from '../proc.ts'
import { systemBin, type Env } from '../sysbin.ts'
import { scaled, TIMING } from '../timing.ts'
import { runGate, type GateIo } from './gate-main.ts'
import { readInstalled } from './installed.ts'
import { bunConnect } from './link-client.ts'
import { runPipe, type PipeDeps } from './pipe.ts'
import { nuanceStatus, renderNuanceStatus } from './status.ts'

export const NUANCE_USAGE = 'usage: collab-bridge gate | pipe | status'

/**
 * The pipe's deps from the env Claude gave it: this Mac's paths, INSTALLED, the real process table (`ps` by systemBin, so a
 * test's P43 stub), the monotonic clock that counts sleep, the passwd user name (never $USER, F3) and this process's stdio.
 * A missing or malformed INSTALLED throws: the binary is not installed, and Claude shows the server as failed.
 */
export function livePipeDeps(env: Env): PipeDeps {
  const paths = nuancePaths(homeOf(env), env)
  const installed = readInstalled(paths)
  if (!installed) throw new Error('INSTALLED is missing or malformed; run the installer again')
  const ps = systemBin('ps', env)
  return {
    paths, env, cwd: process.cwd(), selfPid: process.pid,
    table: () => readPs(ps),
    ttyOf: (pid) => ttyOf(pid, ps),
    mono: monoNowMs,
    now: () => new Date(),
    rand: Math.random,
    stdin: Bun.stdin.stream(),
    write: (line) => { try { process.stdout.write(line) } catch { /* Claude is gone */ } },
    installed,
    user: passwdOfSelf().name,
    connect: bunConnect,
  }
}

/** argv is the verb and its arguments (process.argv.slice(2)); the result is the exit code. */
export async function runNuanceCli(argv: string[], env: Env, io: GateIo): Promise<number> {
  const [verb, ...rest] = argv
  switch (verb) {
    case 'gate':
      if (rest.length === 0) return runGate(env, io)
      break
    case 'pipe':
      // Claude's MCP server (§6.2): JSON-RPC on this process's stdio until stdin ends.
      if (rest.length === 0) return runPipe({ ...livePipeDeps(env), stdin: io.stdin, write: (line) => io.stdout.write(line) })
      break
    case 'status': {
      if (rest.length > 0) break
      const paths = nuancePaths(homeOf(env), env)
      const s = nuanceStatus(paths, monoNowMs, { staleMs: scaled(TIMING.staleMs, env) })
      for (const line of renderNuanceStatus(s, monoNowMs())) io.stdout.write(line + '\n')
      return 0
    }
  }
  io.stderr.write(NUANCE_USAGE + '\n')
  return 2
}

if (import.meta.main) {
  // First, before anything reads them: the gate's children and every path lookup see one locale and the system PATH (§5.2).
  process.env.LC_ALL = 'C'
  process.env.PATH = '/usr/bin:/bin'
  let flushed: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve()
  const io: GateIo = {
    stdin: Bun.stdin.stream(),
    // A write's callback means its bytes reached the kernel. process.exit right after a plain write loses what is still
    // buffered (8 MiB written, 64 KiB arrived, on this Air), so the exit below waits for the last write's callback.
    stdout: { write: (b) => { flushed = new Promise<void>((done) => { process.stdout.write(b, () => done()) }) } },
    stderr: { write: (s) => { process.stderr.write(s) } },
  }
  let code: number
  try {
    code = await runNuanceCli(process.argv.slice(2), process.env, io)
  } catch (e) {
    process.stderr.write(`collab-bridge: ${String(e instanceof Error ? e.message : e).replace(/[^\x20-\x7e]/g, '?').slice(0, 200)}\n`)
    code = 70
  }
  await Promise.race([flushed, Bun.sleep(2000)])
  process.exit(code)
}
