```ts
// A scriptable stand-in for the Collab MCP bin (Task 37). It is written into a temp "dist" dir as
// agenttool-collab-mcp.js, so CollabChild runs it exactly the way the hub runs Collab: the same argv, env and cwd.
// The hub passes exactly three env keys, so the script comes from a file beside the program, never from the env.
// It records every message it receives, and at start its env keys, cwd and whether a planted bunfig or .env leaked in.
import { existsSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import type { ToolDef } from '../src/link/messages.ts'

export type FakeTool =
  | { kind: 'reply' } | { kind: 'error' } | { kind: 'delay'; ms: number } | { kind: 'stall' }
  | { kind: 'die' } | { kind: 'garbage' } | { kind: 'big'; bytes: number }
export interface FakeScript {
  startup?: { kind: 'ok' } | { kind: 'fail'; line: string; code: number } | { kind: 'hang' }
  tools?: Record<string, FakeTool>
}
export interface FakeLogLine {
  start?: true; env?: string[]; cwd?: string; leak_env?: string | null; leak_define?: string | null; preload?: string | null
  method?: string; id?: number | string | null; name?: string
}

export const FAKE_TOOLS: ToolDef[] = [
  { name: 'fake_echo', description: 'Echo the arguments.', inputSchema: { type: 'object', properties: {} } },
  { name: 'fake_slow', description: 'Answer later.', inputSchema: { type: 'object', properties: {} } },
]

const PROGRAM = `// fake Collab MCP bin (tests/fake-collab.ts)
import { appendFileSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
const here = import.meta.dir
const script = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(here, 'fake-collab.json'), 'utf8'))
const log = (o) => appendFileSync(join(here, 'fake-collab.log'), JSON.stringify(o) + '\\n')
log({ start: true, env: Object.keys(process.env).sort(), cwd: process.cwd(), leak_env: process.env.LEAK ?? null,
  leak_define: typeof LEAK_DEFINE !== 'undefined' ? LEAK_DEFINE : null, preload: globalThis.__FAKE_PRELOADED ?? null })
const startup = script.startup ?? { kind: 'ok' }
if (startup.kind === 'fail') { process.stderr.write('· starting\\n' + startup.line + '\\n'); process.exit(startup.code) }
const tools = ${JSON.stringify(FAKE_TOOLS)}
const out = (m) => process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(m) + '\\n')
let n = 0
function onMessage(m) {
  log({ method: m.method ?? null, id: m.id ?? null, name: m.params?.name })
  if (m.method === 'initialize') {
    if (startup.kind === 'hang') return
    out({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: m.id, result: { protocolVersion: m.params.protocolVersion, capabilities: { tools: {} }, serverInfo: { name: 'fake-collab', version: '0' } } })
  } else if (m.method === 'tools/list') {
    out({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: m.id, result: { tools } })
  } else if (m.method === 'tools/call') {
    const t = (script.tools ?? {})[m.params.name] ?? { kind: 'reply' }
    n += 1
    const sc = { ok: true, name: m.params.name, args: m.params.arguments, n }
    const ok = { content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(sc) }], structuredContent: sc }
    if (t.kind === 'reply') out({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: m.id, result: ok })
    else if (t.kind === 'error') out({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: m.id, result: { content: [{ type: 'text', text: '{"error":"fake_error"}' }], structuredContent: { error: 'fake_error', message: 'refused' }, isError: true } })
    else if (t.kind === 'delay') setTimeout(() => out({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: m.id, result: ok }), t.ms)
    else if (t.kind === 'die') process.exit(9)
    else if (t.kind === 'garbage') process.stdout.write('this is not json\\n')
    else if (t.kind === 'big') out({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: m.id, result: { content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'x'.repeat(t.bytes) }] } })
  }
}
let buf = ''
const dec = new TextDecoder()
for await (const chunk of Bun.stdin.stream()) {
  buf += dec.decode(chunk, { stream: true })
  let i
  while ((i = buf.indexOf('\\n')) >= 0) { const line = buf.slice(0, i); buf = buf.slice(i + 1); if (line.trim()) onMessage(JSON.parse(line)) }
}
log({ method: 'eof' })
`

/** Writes the fake as `<dir>/agenttool-collab-mcp.js` with its script; returns `dir`, which then serves as a ChildSpec dist. */
export function writeFakeCollab(dir: string, script: FakeScript = {}): string {
  writeFileSync(join(dir, 'agenttool-collab-mcp.js'), PROGRAM, { mode: 0o755 })
  writeFileSync(join(dir, 'fake-collab.json'), JSON.stringify(script))
  return dir
}

export function fakeLog(dir: string): FakeLogLine[] {
  const p = join(dir, 'fake-collab.log')
  return existsSync(p) ? readFileSync(p, 'utf8').split('\n').filter(Boolean).map((l) => JSON.parse(l) as FakeLogLine) : []
}

/** A bunfig.toml with a preload and a define, and a .env, as a fetched mirror tree could carry them (K66, T29). */
export function plantBunConfig(dir: string): void {
  writeFileSync(join(dir, 'bunfig.toml'), 'preload = ["./preload.ts"]\n[define]\n"LEAK_DEFINE" = "\'defined\'"\n')
  writeFileSync(join(dir, 'preload.ts'), "(globalThis as any).__FAKE_PRELOADED = 'yes'\n")
  writeFileSync(join(dir, '.env'), 'LEAK=from-dotenv\n')
}
```

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test'
import { readdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import {
  CHILD_MAX_REPLY_BYTES, CHILD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS, childArgv, childEnv, CollabChild, probeCollabTools, type ChildSpec, type StartFailure,
} from '../src/air/children.ts'
import { COLLAB_DIST, cleanupTmps, temp } from './helpers.ts'
import { collabHarness } from './mcp-harness.ts'
import { fakeLog, plantBunConfig, writeFakeCollab, type FakeScript } from './fake-collab.ts'

const running: CollabChild[] = []
afterEach(async () => {
  for (const c of running.splice(0)) if (c.alive()) { process.kill(c.pid, 'SIGKILL'); await c.exited }
  cleanupTmps()
})

function isFailure(x: CollabChild | StartFailure): x is StartFailure {
  return (x as StartFailure).failed === true
}

async function started(spec: ChildSpec, o?: Parameters<typeof CollabChild.start>[1]): Promise<CollabChild> {
  const c = await CollabChild.start(spec, o)
  if (isFailure(c)) throw new Error(`the child did not start: ${c.lastErrLine}`)
  running.push(c)
  return c
}

/** A spec on the tracked dist with a temp home and a journal under it, never a real one (P35). */
function realSpec(): ChildSpec {
  const home = temp('cb-child-')
  return { bun: process.execPath, dist: COLLAB_DIST, journal: join(home, 'collab-shared', 'collab.sqlite'), home }
}

/** A spec on the fake Collab bin. */
function fakeSpec(script: FakeScript = {}): ChildSpec & { dir: string } {
  const home = temp('cb-fake-home-')
  const dir = writeFakeCollab(temp('cb-fake-dist-'), script)
  return { bun: process.execPath, dist: dir, journal: join(home, 'collab.sqlite'), home, dir }
}

    expect(await b.call('fake_slow', {})).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'unknown', reason: 'oversized' })
    // The reader skips the long line and the child goes on answering.
    expect((await b.call('fake_echo', {})).outcome).toBe('ok')
    const small = await started(fakeSpec({ tools: { fake_slow: { kind: 'big', bytes: 70_000 } } }), { maxReplyBytes: 64 * 1024 })
    expect(await small.call('fake_slow', {})).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'unknown', reason: 'oversized' })
  }, 20_000)

  test('stop waits for a call in flight', async () => {
    const spec = fakeSpec({ tools: { fake_slow: { kind: 'delay', ms: 600 } } })
    const c = await started(spec)
    const order: string[] = []
    const call = c.call('fake_slow', {}).then((o) => { order.push(`call ${o.outcome}`) })
    await Bun.sleep(50)
    expect(c.inFlight()).toBe(1)
    await c.stop(2000).then(() => { order.push('stopped') })
    await call
    expect(order).toEqual(['call ok', 'stopped'])
    expect(c.alive()).toBe(false)
    expect(await c.exited).toBe(0) // stdin EOF, not a signal
    expect(fakeLog(spec.dir).at(-1)?.method).toBe('eof')
  }, 20_000)

  test('accepting() is true while call() would write, and false once a stop has begun or the child has exited', async () => {
    const c = await started(fakeSpec())
    expect(c.accepting()).toBe(true)
    const stopping = c.stop(2000)
    expect(c.accepting()).toBe(false) // at once, before the stop resolves
    expect(c.alive()).toBe(true)
    await stopping
    expect(c.accepting()).toBe(false)
    const k = await started(fakeSpec())
    expect(k.accepting()).toBe(true)
    process.kill(k.pid, 'SIGKILL')
    await k.exited
    expect(k.accepting()).toBe(false)
  }, 20_000)

  test('a child that exits before initialize returns StartFailure with its ✖ line', async () => {
    const spec = fakeSpec({ startup: { kind: 'fail', line: '✖ Session credentials are invalid', code: 1 } })
    const r = await CollabChild.start(spec)
    expect(r).toEqual({ failed: true, lastErrLine: '✖ Session credentials are invalid', exitCode: 1 })
    const hang = fakeSpec({ startup: { kind: 'hang' } })
    const h = await CollabChild.start(hang, { startTimeoutMs: 300 })
    expect(h).toEqual({ failed: true, lastErrLine: null, exitCode: null })
    const missing = await CollabChild.start({ ...realSpec(), bun: '/nonexistent/bun' })
    expect(missing).toEqual({ failed: true, lastErrLine: null, exitCode: null })
  }, 20_000)
})
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write the implementation**

`/Users/yuai/Projects/.worktrees/agenttool-collab-bridge/packages/collab-bridge/src/air/children.ts`:

```ts
// The hub's client for one Collab child (C9): the installed Collab MCP bin, run the hub's way, spoken to with hand-rolled
// newline-delimited JSON-RPC (P3). Three rules from spec §9.3 item 4 shape it. The request timer is finite (a timer above
// 2^31−1 ms fires at once, K65). There is no abort signal and notifications/cancelled is never sent: a cancel cannot stop
// Collab's synchronous handlers and would only drop the result (K28, K65). And once the request bytes are written, every
// failure (the timer, an exit, an unparsable or oversized reply, a failed write) is `unknown`, never `error`: `error` is
// only an answer the child gave.
import { mkdtempSync, realpathSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { monoNowMs } from '../native.ts'
import { encodeLine, LineReader, LineTooLong, parseJsonRpc, type JsonRpcResponse } from '../jsonrpc.ts'
import type { ToolDef, ToolResult } from '../link/messages.ts'
import { TIMING } from '../timing.ts'

export interface ChildSpec { bun: string; dist: string; journal: string; home: string; sessionFile?: string }

/** Every Air bun runs with --no-env-file --config=/dev/null, so no bunfig.toml or .env anywhere is ever read (R39, K66). */
export function childArgv(spec: ChildSpec): string[] {
  return [spec.bun, '--no-env-file', '--config=/dev/null', `${spec.dist}/agenttool-collab-mcp.js`]
}

/** Built from an explicit key list, never inherited (P14); the session file only to resume (§10.4). */
export function childEnv(spec: ChildSpec): Record<string, string> {
  const env: Record<string, string> = { HOME: spec.home, PATH: '/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin', AGENTOOL_COLLAB_DB: spec.journal }
  if (spec.sessionFile !== undefined) env.AGENTOOL_COLLAB_SESSION_FILE = spec.sessionFile
  return env
}

export type CallOutcome =
  | { outcome: 'ok' | 'error'; result: ToolResult; ms: number; bytes: number }
  | { outcome: 'unknown'; reason: 'timeout' | 'exit' | 'unparsable' | 'oversized' | 'write_failed'; ms: number }
export interface StartFailure { failed: true; lastErrLine: string | null; exitCode: number | null }

export const CHILD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS = TIMING.childRequestMs // 600000, always finite (§9.3 item 4)
/** What still fits one hub→pipe frame (4 MiB) with its envelope. */
export const CHILD_MAX_REPLY_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024 - 64 * 1024
/** The largest delay a timer honours; anything above it fires at once (K65). */
const MAX_TIMER_MS = 2_147_483_647
const DEFAULT_START_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000 // two chain passes and a resume; far above a small journal's start (K21)
const STDERR_LINE_MAX = 4096
const DRAIN_AFTER_EXIT_MS = 2_000

type UnknownReason = Extract<CallOutcome, { outcome: 'unknown' }>['reason']
interface Pending {
  started: number
  timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null
  settle(o: CallOutcome): void
  raw?: (m: JsonRpcResponse) => void // the hub's own requests (tools/list) take the reply as it came
}

function spawnChild(spec: ChildSpec) {
  return Bun.spawn(childArgv(spec), { cwd: '/', env: childEnv(spec), stdin: 'pipe', stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'pipe' })
}
type Proc = ReturnType<typeof spawnChild>

function timerMs(name: string, v: number): number {
  if (!Number.isInteger(v) || v < 1 || v > MAX_TIMER_MS) {
    throw new Error(`CollabChild: ${name} must be a whole number of ms from 1 to ${MAX_TIMER_MS} (K65), got ${v}`)
  }
  return v
}

/** True when `p` settles within `ms`; the timer is cleared either way, so nothing lingers. */
async function within(p: Promise<unknown>, ms: number): Promise<boolean> {
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined
  const late = new Promise<false>((resolve) => { timer = setTimeout(() => resolve(false), ms) })
  try {
    return await Promise.race([p.then(() => true as const), late])
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer)
  }
}

const isRecord = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> => typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v)

/** A reply the child gave, as a tool result. A JSON-RPC error (an unknown tool or a malformed request, refused by the SDK
 *  before any handler ran) becomes an isError result in Collab's two-channel shape, so nothing above ever sees one (R17). */
function resultOf(msg: JsonRpcResponse): { outcome: 'ok' | 'error'; result: ToolResult } | null {
  if (msg.error) {
    const sc = { error: 'collab_jsonrpc_error', message: msg.error.message, jsonrpc_code: msg.error.code }
    return { outcome: 'error', result: { content: [{ type: 'text', text: JSON.stringify(sc, null, 2) }], structuredContent: sc, isError: true } }
  }
  const r = msg.result
  if (!isRecord(r) || !Array.isArray(r.content)) return null
  return { outcome: r.isError === true ? 'error' : 'ok', result: r as unknown as ToolResult }
}

export class CollabChild {
  readonly pid: number
  readonly exited: Promise<number | null>
  private nextId = 1
  private readonly pending = new Map<number, Pending>()
  private readonly idle: Array<() => void> = []
  private dead = false
  private closed = false
  private stopping: Promise<void> | null = null
  private lastErr: string | null = null
  private initWaiter: ((m: JsonRpcResponse | null) => void) | null = null
  private readonly stderrDone: Promise<void>

  private constructor(private readonly proc: Proc, private readonly requestTimeoutMs: number, maxReplyBytes: number) {
    this.pid = proc.pid
    this.exited = proc.exited.then(() => {
      this.dead = true
      return proc.exitCode
    })
    this.stderrDone = this.readStderr().catch(() => {})
    const stdoutDone = this.readStdout(new LineReader(maxReplyBytes)).catch(() => {})
    // What is still pending is settled only once stdout has drained: a reply written just before the exit still counts.
    void this.exited.then(() => within(stdoutDone, DRAIN_AFTER_EXIT_MS)).then(() => {
      this.initWaiter?.(null)
      this.failAll('exit')
    })
  }

  static async start(spec: ChildSpec, o: { requestTimeoutMs?: number; startTimeoutMs?: number; maxReplyBytes?: number } = {}): Promise<CollabChild | StartFailure> {
    const requestTimeoutMs = timerMs('requestTimeoutMs', o.requestTimeoutMs ?? CHILD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS)
    const startTimeoutMs = timerMs('startTimeoutMs', o.startTimeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_START_TIMEOUT_MS)
    let proc: Proc
    try {
      proc = spawnChild(spec)
    } catch {
      return { failed: true, lastErrLine: null, exitCode: null } // no executable at spec.bun
    }
    const child = new CollabChild(proc, requestTimeoutMs, o.maxReplyBytes ?? CHILD_MAX_REPLY_BYTES)
    if (await child.initialize(startTimeoutMs)) return child
    if (!child.dead) proc.kill('SIGKILL')
    await child.exited
    await within(child.stderrDone, 1000)
    return { failed: true, lastErrLine: child.lastErr, exitCode: proc.exitCode }
  }

  /** initialize, then notifications/initialized; false when the child exits, refuses or stays silent first. */
  private async initialize(timeoutMs: number): Promise<boolean> {
    const id = this.nextId++
    const reply = new Promise<JsonRpcResponse | null>((resolve) => { this.initWaiter = resolve })
    const timer = setTimeout(() => this.initWaiter?.(null), timeoutMs)
    this.write(encodeLine({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id, method: 'initialize', params: {
      protocolVersion: '2025-06-18', capabilities: {}, clientInfo: { name: 'agenttool-collab-bridge-hub', version: '1' },
    } }))
    const m = await reply
    clearTimeout(timer)
    this.initWaiter = null
    if (!m || m.id !== id || m.error || !isRecord(m.result)) return false
    return this.write(encodeLine({ jsonrpc: '2.0', method: 'notifications/initialized' }))
  }

  /** One tools/list. Any failure throws: the hub's start probe treats it as a refusal to start. */
  async listTools(): Promise<ToolDef[]> {
    const m = await this.request('tools/list', {})
    const tools = isRecord(m.result) ? m.result.tools : undefined
    if (m.error || !Array.isArray(tools)) throw new Error('CollabChild: tools/list failed')
    return tools as ToolDef[]
  }

  /** Exactly one tools/call, written once and never cancelled. */
  call(name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<CallOutcome> {
    if (this.dead || this.closed) return Promise.resolve({ outcome: 'unknown', reason: 'exit', ms: 0 })
    const id = this.nextId++
    return new Promise<CallOutcome>((resolve) => {
      const p: Pending = { started: monoNowMs(), timer: null, settle: resolve }
      this.pending.set(id, p)
      if (!this.write(encodeLine({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id, method: 'tools/call', params: { name, arguments: args } }))) {
        this.settleUnknown(id, 'write_failed')
        return
      }
      // The clock starts once the request is written, so time spent queued inside the child counts (§9.3 item 4).
      p.started = monoNowMs()
      p.timer = setTimeout(() => this.settleUnknown(id, 'timeout'), this.requestTimeoutMs)
    })
  }

  inFlight(): number {
    return this.pending.size
  }

  alive(): boolean {
    return !this.dead
  }

  /** True while call() would write: alive and not stopping. A caller that forwards an agent's call checks it in the same
   *  synchronous turn as call(), so a child stopped after it was handed out answers as not sent, never as unknown (§9.3). */
  accepting(): boolean {
    return !this.dead && !this.closed
  }

  /** Takes no new call, waits for zero in flight, closes stdin (Collab exits on EOF), then SIGTERM, then SIGKILL. */
  stop(graceMs = 5000): Promise<void> {
    if (this.stopping) return this.stopping
    this.closed = true
    this.stopping = (async () => {
      if (this.pending.size > 0) await new Promise<void>((resolve) => this.idle.push(resolve))
      try { void this.proc.stdin.end() } catch { /* already closed */ }
      if (this.dead || await within(this.exited, graceMs)) return
      this.proc.kill('SIGTERM')
      if (this.dead || await within(this.exited, graceMs)) return
      this.proc.kill('SIGKILL')
      await this.exited
    })()
    return this.stopping
  }

  /** A request the hub itself makes (tools/list); never used for tools/call. */
  private request(method: string, params: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<JsonRpcResponse> {
    if (this.dead || this.closed) return Promise.reject(new Error(`CollabChild: ${method} after exit`))
    const id = this.nextId++
    return new Promise<JsonRpcResponse>((resolve, reject) => {
      const p: Pending = {
        started: monoNowMs(), timer: null, raw: resolve,
        settle: (o) => reject(new Error(`CollabChild: ${method} ${o.outcome === 'unknown' ? o.reason : 'failed'}`)),
      }
      this.pending.set(id, p)
      if (!this.write(encodeLine({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id, method, params }))) {
        this.settleUnknown(id, 'write_failed')
        return
      }
      p.timer = setTimeout(() => this.settleUnknown(id, 'timeout'), this.requestTimeoutMs)
    })
  }

  /** One line to stdin; false when the pipe refused it. A FileSink write never throws EPIPE (air-env §13), so a dead
   *  child shows up through `exited`, never here. */
  private write(line: string): boolean {
    try {
      void this.proc.stdin.write(line)
      void this.proc.stdin.flush()
      return true
    } catch {
      return false
    }
  }

  /** Removes a pending call; the caller settles it, then calls released(). */
  private take(id: number): Pending | undefined {
    const p = this.pending.get(id)
    if (!p) return undefined
    this.pending.delete(id)
    if (p.timer) clearTimeout(p.timer)
    return p
  }

  /** After a settle: at zero in flight, a waiting stop() goes on. */
  private released(): void {
    if (this.pending.size === 0) for (const r of this.idle.splice(0)) r()
  }

  private settleUnknown(id: number, reason: UnknownReason): void {
    const p = this.take(id)
    if (!p) return
    p.settle({ outcome: 'unknown', reason, ms: Math.round(monoNowMs() - p.started) })
    this.released()
  }

  private failAll(reason: UnknownReason): void {
    for (const id of [...this.pending.keys()]) this.settleUnknown(id, reason)
  }

  private onLine(line: string): void {
    const parsed = parseJsonRpc(line)
    if (parsed.kind === 'invalid') {
      // A line no one can attribute: every call in flight may have been its subject, so they all become unknown, and a
      // child whose stdout carries garbage is not trusted with another call.
      this.failAll('unparsable')
      if (!this.dead) this.proc.kill('SIGTERM')
      return
    }
    if (parsed.kind !== 'response') return // Collab sends its client no requests or notifications (K2)
    const msg = parsed.msg
    if (this.initWaiter) return this.initWaiter(msg)
    if (typeof msg.id !== 'number') return
    const p = this.take(msg.id)
    if (!p) return // late, after the timer: that call was already answered unknown
    const ms = Math.round(monoNowMs() - p.started)
    const r = p.raw ? null : resultOf(msg)
    if (p.raw) p.raw(msg)
    else if (!r) p.settle({ outcome: 'unknown', reason: 'unparsable', ms })
    else p.settle({ ...r, ms, bytes: Buffer.byteLength(line, 'utf8') })
    this.released()
  }

  private async readStdout(reader: LineReader): Promise<void> {
    for await (const chunk of this.proc.stdout) {
      let lines: string[]
      try {
        lines = reader.push(chunk)
      } catch (e) {
        if (!(e instanceof LineTooLong)) throw e
        // This chunk's complete lines are real replies. Then, as with garbage, every call still in flight may have been
        // the over-long one. The reader resynchronises at the next newline, so the child stays usable.
        for (const l of e.lines) this.onLine(l)
        this.failAll('oversized')
        continue
      }
      for (const l of lines) this.onLine(l)
    }
  }

  /** Keeps reading stderr so the child never blocks on it, remembering only its last `✖ ` line (K64). */
  private async readStderr(): Promise<void> {
    const dec = new TextDecoder()
    let buf = ''
    for await (const chunk of this.proc.stderr) {
      buf += dec.decode(chunk, { stream: true })
      let i: number
      while ((i = buf.indexOf('\n')) >= 0) {
        const line = buf.slice(0, i)
        buf = buf.slice(i + 1)
        if (line.startsWith('✖ ')) this.lastErr = line.slice(0, STDERR_LINE_MAX)
      }
      if (buf.length > STDERR_LINE_MAX) buf = buf.slice(-STDERR_LINE_MAX)
    }
    if (buf.startsWith('✖ ')) this.lastErr = buf.slice(0, STDERR_LINE_MAX)
  }
}

export type ToolProbe = { ok: true; list: ToolDef[] } | { ok: false; stage: 'start'; failure: StartFailure } | { ok: false; stage: 'list'; message: string }

/** One tools/list from a child on a throwaway journal in a fresh dir under `tmpRoot`, removed afterwards: never the shared
 *  or the private journal (§10.4 step 3). The hub's start probe and prepare-pairing both use it. */
export async function probeCollabTools(o: { bun: string; dist: string; tmpRoot: string; home?: string }): Promise<ToolProbe> {
  const dir = realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(o.tmpRoot, 'probe-')))
  try {
    const c = await CollabChild.start({ bun: o.bun, dist: o.dist, journal: join(dir, 'probe.sqlite'), home: o.home ?? dir })
    if ('failed' in c) return { ok: false, stage: 'start', failure: c }
    try {
      return { ok: true, list: await c.listTools() }
    } catch (e) {
      return { ok: false, stage: 'list', message: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e) }
    } finally {
      await c.stop()
    }
  } finally {
    rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })
  }
}
```

```ts
/** Starts one real Collab session through the hub-way harness and closes the harness; the session stays active and its
 *  credential stays beside the journal, as Collab writes it (K22). */
export async function startCollabSession(o: { journal: string; home: string; root: string; actor: string; role?: string }):
  Promise<{ sessionId: string; workspaceId: string; worktreeId: string; credentialFile: string }> {
  const h = collabHarness({ journal: o.journal, home: o.home })
  try {
    await h.initialize()
    const r = await h.callTool('collab_session_start', { root_path: o.root, actor: o.actor, ...(o.role === undefined ? {} : { role: o.role }) })
    if (r.isError) throw new Error(`collab_session_start failed: ${r.content[0].text}`)
    const sc = r.structuredContent
    return { sessionId: sc.session.id, workspaceId: sc.workspace.id, worktreeId: sc.worktree.id,
      credentialFile: join(dirname(o.journal), 'collab-sessions', `${sc.session.id}.json`) }
  } finally {
    await h.close()
  }
}

/** Breaks a temp journal's hash chain the way Collab's own tests do, through the system sqlite3 (never a real journal). */
export function tamperJournal(journal: string): void {
  const r = Bun.spawnSync(['/usr/bin/sqlite3', journal, `UPDATE events SET hash = '${'0'.repeat(64)}' WHERE sequence = 1`], { env: { PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin' } })
  if (r.exitCode !== 0) throw new Error(`sqlite3 failed: ${r.stderr.toString()}`)
}
```

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test'
import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { CollabChild, type ChildSpec, type StartFailure } from '../src/air/children.ts'

import { COLLAB_DIST, cleanupTmps, temp } from './helpers.ts'

/** A temp home, a shared-journal path under it and a plain mirror dir: never a real journal (P35). */
function world() {
  const home = temp('cb-start-')
  const journal = join(home, '.local', 'share', 'agenttool', 'collab-shared', 'collab.sqlite')
  const root = join(home, 'mirror')
  mkdirSync(root)
  const spec: ChildSpec = { bun: process.execPath, dist: COLLAB_DIST, journal, home }
  return { home, journal, root, spec }
}

/** Starts a child that must fail, and classifies its last ✖ line. */
async function failedStart(spec: ChildSpec): Promise<{ failure: StartFailure; cls: StartClass }> {
  const r = await CollabChild.start(spec)
  if (!('failed' in r)) {
    await r.stop()
    throw new Error('the child started')
  }
  return { failure: r, cls: classifyStart(r.lastErrLine) }
}

describe('the pinned start-up messages', () => {
  test('every pinned message occurs in the tracked dist', () => {
    expect(PINNED_START_MESSAGES).toHaveLength(10)
    for (const { message } of PINNED_START_MESSAGES) {
      const r = Bun.spawnSync(['/usr/bin/grep', '-cF', message, join(COLLAB_DIST, 'agenttool-collab-mcp.js')], { env: { PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin' } })
      expect(Number(r.stdout.toString().trim())).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1)
    }
  })

  test('each pinned message maps to its class', () => {
    expect(classifyStart('✖ The host and persisted session cursors require an explicit audited reset')).toBe('seat_recovery_required')
    expect(classifyStart('✖ A workspace event journal failed hash-chain verification')).toBe('journal_invalid')
    expect(classifyStart('✖ Session credentials are invalid')).toBe('seat_session_ended')
    expect(classifyStart('✖ Could not read the local session credential file')).toBe('seat_session_ended')
    expect(PINNED_START_MESSAGES.filter((m) => m.class === 'seat_session_ended')).toHaveLength(8)
    expect(classifyStart(null)).toBe('child_start_failed')
    expect(classifyStart('✖ The SQLite file belongs to another application')).toBe('child_start_failed')
  })

  test('a line that only contains a pinned message is not a match', () => {
    for (const { message } of PINNED_START_MESSAGES) {
      for (const line of [message, `✖ Error: ${message}`, `✖ ${message}.`, ` ✖ ${message}`, `✖  ${message}`, `✖ ${message} (retry)`, `x ✖ ${message}`]) {
        expect(classifyStart(line)).toBe('child_start_failed')
      }
    }
  })
})

  test('a tampered event hash is journal_invalid', async () => {
```

`/Users/yuai/Projects/.worktrees/agenttool-collab-bridge/packages/collab-bridge/src/air/startup.ts`:

```ts
// What a Collab child that died before initialize means (spec §9.6 item 4). The bin prints only `✖ <message>` and exits 1,
// so the error code is lost (K64); the hub matches that one line exactly against strings pinned from the installed build
// (collab.md §7.1). A hermetic test greps each one out of the tracked dist, so a Collab change that rewords a message
// shows up there, and the hub's dist check (§10.4) catches an installed build that drifted. Anything else is
// child_start_failed. No class is ever respawned automatically, so a broken journal is never re-verified in a loop.
export type StartClass = 'seat_recovery_required' | 'journal_invalid' | 'seat_session_ended' | 'child_start_failed'

export const PINNED_START_MESSAGES: ReadonlyArray<{ message: string; class: StartClass }> = Object.freeze([
  // store.resumeSession: the persisted or host cursor needs an audited reset (cursor_reset_required).
  { message: 'The host and persisted session cursors require an explicit audited reset', class: 'seat_recovery_required' },
  // store open: validateAllJournals (database_journal_invalid).
  { message: 'A workspace event journal failed hash-chain verification', class: 'journal_invalid' },
  // store.resumeSession: unknown session, wrong token or a session that is no longer active (session_auth_failed).
  { message: 'Session credentials are invalid', class: 'seat_session_ended' },
  // session-file.ts, read before resuming and rewritten after it.
  { message: 'Session credential path must be a private regular file owned by this user', class: 'seat_session_ended' },
  { message: 'Session credential file must not be accessible by group or other users', class: 'seat_session_ended' },
  { message: 'Session credential file has an unsupported or malformed format', class: 'seat_session_ended' },
  { message: 'Could not read the local session credential file', class: 'seat_session_ended' },
  { message: 'Session credential directory must be a private non-symlink directory owned by this user', class: 'seat_session_ended' },
  { message: 'Replacement requires a private regular credential file owned by this user', class: 'seat_session_ended' },
  { message: 'Could not atomically write the local session credential file', class: 'seat_session_ended' },
])

const BY_LINE: ReadonlyMap<string, StartClass> = new Map(PINNED_START_MESSAGES.map((m) => [`✖ ${m.message}`, m.class]))

/** The whole line must be `✖ ` and a pinned message, byte for byte: a line that merely contains one is not a match. */
export function classifyStart(lastErrLine: string | null): StartClass {
  if (lastErrLine === null) return 'child_start_failed'
  return BY_LINE.get(lastErrLine) ?? 'child_start_failed'
}
```

```ts
// src/air/calls.ts
export type CallRefVerdict = 'ok' | 'foreign_prefix' | 'duplicate' | 'malformed'
export class CallRegistry { accept(lineage: string, callRef: string): CallRefVerdict; size(): number }   // per hub run, in memory
// src/air/lineages.ts
export type LineageState = 'pending' | 'live' | 'ended' | 'retired'
//   pending: attached, no session yet; live: a session; ended: its session ended (session_end or a host end), a new session_start
//   may begin a new session and every other call is seat_session_ended (§9.2, P53); retired: 7 days detached, never used again
export interface PendingStart { nonce: string; call_ref: string; child_pid: number; child_lstart: string | null; workspace_id: string; at: string }
//   workspace_id: the workspace this start binds to, known before the first session (P55), so reconcile can always read it
export interface LineageEntry { lineage: string; device: string; user: string; harness: string; folder: string; state: LineageState;
  session_id: string | null; credential_path: string | null; past_sessions: string[]; mirror_id: string; workspace_id: string | null;
  pending_start: PendingStart | null; parked: { cause: string; details: Record<string, unknown> } | null;
  detached_since: string | null; created_at: string }
//   past_sessions: every earlier session of this lineage, so knock origins and parent_not_same_seat still know them (§8 item 4)
export const LINEAGES_FORMAT = 'agenttool.collab-bridge-lineages/1'   // +
export class LineageStore {
  constructor(path: string)
  load(): void                                   // a missing file is empty; a damaged one throws (the hub writes needs Yu: config)
  get(lineage: string): LineageEntry | undefined
  upsert(e: LineageEntry): void                  // writeFileDurable, 0600 (F_FULLFSYNC)
  all(): LineageEntry[]
  sessionIndex(): Map<string, { device: string; user: string }>   // every session ever stamped: session_id and past_sessions, retired included
  sameSeat(device: string, user: string): Set<string>              // session ids of that seat, past sessions included
}
```

  What later tasks rely on (Tasks 40a, 40b, 49, 50, 51, 52, 53, 54): the store validates every entry it loads or writes and refuses the whole file, or the one upsert, otherwise (load throws `lineages.json is damaged: …`, upsert throws `lineages: refused entry: …` and leaves file and memory unchanged). An entry has exactly the fifteen keys; `lineage` matches `LINEAGE_RE`; `device` matches `^[a-z0-9-]{1,32}$` and `user` `^[a-z0-9._-]{1,32}$`, so every session-index entry makes a valid knock origin (`ORIGIN_RE`); `harness` matches `LABEL_TOKEN_RE`; `folder` is absolute and at most 1019 bytes; `mirror_id` is 16 hex; ids follow Collab's own rule `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,199}$`; times parse as dates. `session_id` and `credential_path` are set exactly when `state` is `live`, and a live entry has a `workspace_id`. A `pending_start` has a 16-hex nonce, a call_ref of this lineage, a positive pid and a workspace_id (P55). The entry Task 50 writes at a first attach is therefore `{state: 'pending', session_id: null, credential_path: null, past_sessions: [], pending_start: null, parked: null, detached_since: null, created_at: <now>, workspace_id: <the share's or null>, …}`. `get` and `all` return copies: a change reaches the store only through `upsert`. `all` keeps the order of first upsert.

```ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test'
import { existsSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { LineageStore, type LineageEntry } from '../src/air/lineages.ts'
import { cleanupTmps, temp } from './helpers.ts'

afterEach(cleanupTmps)

const lin = (c: string) => `lin_${c.repeat(32)}`

function entry(over: Partial<LineageEntry> = {}): LineageEntry {
  return {
    lineage: lin('a'), device: 'nuance', user: 'macair', harness: 'claude', folder: '/Users/macair/Projects/collab-trial',
    state: 'pending', session_id: null, credential_path: null, past_sessions: [], mirror_id: '0123456789abcdef',
    workspace_id: null, pending_start: null, parked: null, detached_since: null, created_at: '2026-10-13T12:00:00.000Z',
    ...over,
  }
}

/** The store's file under a fresh state dir that does not exist yet (the store makes it 0700). */
function storePath(): string {
  return join(temp('cb-lineages-'), 'state', 'lineages.json')
}

describe('LineageStore', () => {
  test('entries survive a reload', () => {
    const p = storePath()
    const s = new LineageStore(p)
    s.load()
    expect(s.all()).toEqual([])
    const live = entry({ state: 'live', session_id: 'session_1', credential_path: '/x/collab-sessions/session_1.json', workspace_id: 'ws_1' })
    s.upsert(live)
    s.upsert(entry({ lineage: lin('b') }))
    const again = new LineageStore(p)
    again.load()
    expect(again.get(lin('a'))).toEqual(live)
    expect(again.all().map((e) => e.lineage)).toEqual([lin('a'), lin('b')])
    expect(again.get(lin('c'))).toBeUndefined()
  })

  test('upsert is atomic and 0600', () => {
    const p = storePath()
    const s = new LineageStore(p)
    s.load()
    s.upsert(entry())
    s.upsert(entry({ state: 'live', session_id: 'session_2', credential_path: '/c.json', workspace_id: 'ws_2' }))
    expect(statSync(p).mode & 0o777).toBe(0o600)
    expect(statSync(join(p, '..')).mode & 0o777).toBe(0o700)
    expect(readdirSync(join(p, '..'))).toEqual(['lineages.json']) // no temp file left behind
    const file = JSON.parse(readFileSync(p, 'utf8'))
    expect(file.format).toBe('agenttool.collab-bridge-lineages/1')
    expect(file.lineages).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(file.lineages[0].session_id).toBe('session_2')
    // a refused entry leaves the file as it was
    expect(() => s.upsert(entry({ state: 'bogus' as never }))).toThrow('lineages')
    expect(JSON.parse(readFileSync(p, 'utf8'))).toEqual(file)
  })

  test('retired entries stay and stay in the session index', () => {
    const p = storePath()
    const s = new LineageStore(p)
    s.load()
    s.upsert(entry({ state: 'retired', past_sessions: ['session_old'], detached_since: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z' }))
    s.upsert(entry({ lineage: lin('b'), state: 'live', session_id: 'session_new', credential_path: '/n.json', workspace_id: 'ws_1' }))
    s.upsert(entry({ lineage: lin('c'), device: 'zerone', user: 'yu', state: 'live', session_id: 'session_z', credential_path: '/z.json', workspace_id: 'ws_1' }))
    const again = new LineageStore(p)
    again.load()
    expect(again.get(lin('a'))?.state).toBe('retired')
    expect(again.sessionIndex()).toEqual(new Map([
      ['session_old', { device: 'nuance', user: 'macair' }],
      ['session_new', { device: 'nuance', user: 'macair' }],
      ['session_z', { device: 'zerone', user: 'yu' }],
    ]))
  })

  test('an ended lineage keeps its past sessions in the session index and its seat', () => {
    const s = new LineageStore(storePath())
    s.load()
    s.upsert(entry({ state: 'ended', past_sessions: ['session_1', 'session_2'] }))
    s.upsert(entry({ lineage: lin('b'), state: 'live', session_id: 'session_3', credential_path: '/3.json', workspace_id: 'ws_1', past_sessions: ['session_0'] }))
    s.upsert(entry({ lineage: lin('c'), user: 'guest', state: 'live', session_id: 'session_g', credential_path: '/g.json', workspace_id: 'ws_1' }))
    expect([...s.sessionIndex().keys()].sort()).toEqual(['session_0', 'session_1', 'session_2', 'session_3', 'session_g'])
    expect(s.sameSeat('nuance', 'macair')).toEqual(new Set(['session_0', 'session_1', 'session_2', 'session_3']))
    expect(s.sameSeat('nuance', 'guest')).toEqual(new Set(['session_g']))
    expect(s.sameSeat('zerone', 'macair')).toEqual(new Set())
  })

  test('a pending_start without a workspace_id is refused on load', () => {
    const p = storePath()
    const s = new LineageStore(p)
    s.load()
    const marker = { nonce: '0123456789abcdef', call_ref: `${lin('a')}:0000abcd:1`, child_pid: 4242, child_lstart: null, workspace_id: 'ws_1', at: '2026-10-13T12:00:00.000Z' }
    s.upsert(entry({ pending_start: marker }))
    const file = JSON.parse(readFileSync(p, 'utf8'))
    delete file.lineages[0].pending_start.workspace_id
    writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(file))
    expect(() => new LineageStore(p).load()).toThrow('lineages.json')
    file.lineages[0].pending_start.workspace_id = ''
    writeFileSync(p, JSON.stringify(file))
    expect(() => new LineageStore(p).load()).toThrow('lineages.json')
    expect(() => s.upsert(entry({ pending_start: { ...marker, workspace_id: '' } }))).toThrow('lineages')
  })

  test('a damaged file throws on load', () => {
    const p = storePath()
    const s = new LineageStore(p)
    s.load()
    s.upsert(entry())
    for (const bad of ['{', '[]', '{"format":"other","lineages":[]}', '{"format":"agenttool.collab-bridge-lineages/1"}',
      JSON.stringify({ format: 'agenttool.collab-bridge-lineages/1', lineages: [{ ...entry(), lineage: 'lin_short' }] }),
      JSON.stringify({ format: 'agenttool.collab-bridge-lineages/1', lineages: [entry(), entry()] })]) {
      writeFileSync(p, bad)
      expect(() => new LineageStore(p).load()).toThrow('lineages.json')
    }
    expect(existsSync(p)).toBe(true)
  })
})
```

```ts
// The hub's record of every call_ref it has received in this run (spec §9.3 item 2). A call_ref is recorded on receipt,
// before anything is forwarded, so a repeat can never run twice: it answers duplicate_call_ref. A call_ref carrying
// another lineage's prefix means the stream is not who it attached as, so the hub closes it. There is no result cache:
// settling an outcome rests on Collab's own receipts (K24) and the agent's reads.
import { CALL_REF_RE, callRefLineage } from '../link/messages.ts'

export type CallRefVerdict = 'ok' | 'foreign_prefix' | 'duplicate' | 'malformed'

export class CallRegistry {
  private readonly seen = new Set<string>()

  accept(lineage: string, callRef: string): CallRefVerdict {
    if (typeof callRef !== 'string' || !CALL_REF_RE.test(callRef)) return 'malformed'
    if (callRefLineage(callRef) !== lineage) return 'foreign_prefix'
    if (this.seen.has(callRef)) return 'duplicate'
    this.seen.add(callRef)
    return 'ok'
  }

  size(): number {
    return this.seen.size
  }
}
```

```ts
// lineages.json (spec §6.2, §4.3): every lineage the hub has seen, with its Collab session, never pruned. It holds no
// secret: credential_path names Collab's 0600 credential file beside the shared journal, never its contents. Every write
// is whole-file and durable (temp file, F_FULLFSYNC, rename, dir fsync; P13), because the session_start marker must be on
// disk before a start is forwarded (§9.3 item 8). A damaged file throws on load, and the hub then writes
// `needs Yu: config` instead of guessing which sessions exist.
import { chmodSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { dirname, isAbsolute } from 'node:path'
import { writeFileDurable } from '../native.ts'
import { CALL_REF_RE, callRefLineage, LABEL_TOKEN_RE, LINEAGE_RE, MAX_FOLDER_BYTES, START_NONCE_RE } from '../link/messages.ts'

export type LineageState = 'pending' | 'live' | 'ended' | 'retired'
//   pending: attached, no session yet; live: a session; ended: its session ended (session_end or a host end), a new
//   session_start may begin a new session and every other call is seat_session_ended (§9.2, P53); retired: 7 days
//   detached, never used again
export interface PendingStart { nonce: string; call_ref: string; child_pid: number; child_lstart: string | null; workspace_id: string; at: string }
//   workspace_id: the workspace this start binds to, known before the first session (P55), so reconcile can always read it
export interface LineageEntry {
  lineage: string; device: string; user: string; harness: string; folder: string; state: LineageState
  session_id: string | null; credential_path: string | null; past_sessions: string[]; mirror_id: string; workspace_id: string | null
  pending_start: PendingStart | null; parked: { cause: string; details: Record<string, unknown> } | null
  detached_since: string | null; created_at: string
}
//   past_sessions: every earlier session of this lineage, so knock origins and parent_not_same_seat still know them (§8 item 4)

export const LINEAGES_FORMAT = 'agenttool.collab-bridge-lineages/1'

const KEYS = ['lineage', 'device', 'user', 'harness', 'folder', 'state', 'session_id', 'credential_path', 'past_sessions',
  'mirror_id', 'workspace_id', 'pending_start', 'parked', 'detached_since', 'created_at'] as const
const MARKER_KEYS = ['nonce', 'call_ref', 'child_pid', 'child_lstart', 'workspace_id', 'at'] as const
const STATES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['pending', 'live', 'ended', 'retired'])
// device and user as they appear in a knock origin (`<device>/<user>`, ORIGIN_RE), so an index entry always makes a valid one
const DEVICE_RE = /^[a-z0-9-]{1,32}$/
const USER_RE = /^[a-z0-9._-]{1,32}$/
const COLLAB_ID_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,199}$/ // Collab's own id rule (validateId)
const MIRROR_ID_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{16}$/

const isRecord = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> => typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v)
const isTime = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && !Number.isNaN(Date.parse(v))
const isId = (v: unknown): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && COLLAB_ID_RE.test(v)
const exactKeys = (o: Record<string, unknown>, keys: readonly string[]) =>
  Object.keys(o).length === keys.length && keys.every((k) => Object.hasOwn(o, k))

/** Why `v` is not a valid entry, or null when it is. */
function problem(v: unknown): string | null {
  if (!isRecord(v) || !exactKeys(v, KEYS)) return 'an entry does not have exactly the known keys'
  if (typeof v.lineage !== 'string' || !LINEAGE_RE.test(v.lineage)) return 'a lineage id is malformed'
  const at = v.lineage
  if (typeof v.device !== 'string' || !DEVICE_RE.test(v.device)) return `${at}: device`
  if (typeof v.user !== 'string' || !USER_RE.test(v.user)) return `${at}: user`
  if (typeof v.harness !== 'string' || !LABEL_TOKEN_RE.test(v.harness)) return `${at}: harness`
  if (typeof v.folder !== 'string' || !isAbsolute(v.folder) || Buffer.byteLength(v.folder) > MAX_FOLDER_BYTES) return `${at}: folder`
  if (typeof v.state !== 'string' || !STATES.has(v.state)) return `${at}: state`
  if (v.session_id !== null && !isId(v.session_id)) return `${at}: session_id`
  if (v.credential_path !== null && (typeof v.credential_path !== 'string' || !isAbsolute(v.credential_path))) return `${at}: credential_path`
  // A session and its credential come and go together, and only a live lineage has one.
  const live = v.state === 'live'
  if (live !== (v.session_id !== null) || live !== (v.credential_path !== null)) return `${at}: session_id and credential_path must be set exactly when live`
  if (!Array.isArray(v.past_sessions) || !v.past_sessions.every(isId)) return `${at}: past_sessions`
  if (typeof v.mirror_id !== 'string' || !MIRROR_ID_RE.test(v.mirror_id)) return `${at}: mirror_id`
  if (v.workspace_id !== null && !isId(v.workspace_id)) return `${at}: workspace_id`
  if (live && v.workspace_id === null) return `${at}: a live lineage has a workspace_id`
  if (v.pending_start !== null) {
    const m = v.pending_start
    if (!isRecord(m) || !exactKeys(m, MARKER_KEYS)) return `${at}: pending_start`
    if (typeof m.nonce !== 'string' || !START_NONCE_RE.test(m.nonce)) return `${at}: pending_start.nonce`
    if (typeof m.call_ref !== 'string' || !CALL_REF_RE.test(m.call_ref) || callRefLineage(m.call_ref) !== at) return `${at}: pending_start.call_ref`
    if (!Number.isInteger(m.child_pid) || (m.child_pid as number) < 1) return `${at}: pending_start.child_pid`
    if (m.child_lstart !== null && typeof m.child_lstart !== 'string') return `${at}: pending_start.child_lstart`
    if (!isId(m.workspace_id)) return `${at}: pending_start.workspace_id` // P55: always known before the forward
    if (!isTime(m.at)) return `${at}: pending_start.at`
  }
  if (v.parked !== null && (!isRecord(v.parked) || !exactKeys(v.parked, ['cause', 'details']) || typeof v.parked.cause !== 'string' || !isRecord(v.parked.details))) return `${at}: parked`
  if (v.detached_since !== null && !isTime(v.detached_since)) return `${at}: detached_since`
  if (!isTime(v.created_at)) return `${at}: created_at`
  return null
}

export class LineageStore {
  private entries = new Map<string, LineageEntry>()

  constructor(readonly path: string) {}

  /** A missing file is an empty store; anything that does not validate throws. */
  load(): void {
    if (!existsSync(this.path)) {
      this.entries = new Map()
      return
    }
    let doc: unknown
    try {
      doc = JSON.parse(readFileSync(this.path, 'utf8'))
    } catch {
      throw new Error('lineages.json is damaged: it does not parse')
    }
    if (!isRecord(doc) || doc.format !== LINEAGES_FORMAT || !Array.isArray(doc.lineages)) throw new Error('lineages.json is damaged: unknown format')
    const next = new Map<string, LineageEntry>()
    for (const e of doc.lineages) {
      const p = problem(e)
      if (p) throw new Error(`lineages.json is damaged: ${p}`)
      const entry = e as LineageEntry
      if (next.has(entry.lineage)) throw new Error(`lineages.json is damaged: ${entry.lineage} appears twice`)
      next.set(entry.lineage, entry)
    }
    this.entries = next
  }

  get(lineage: string): LineageEntry | undefined {
    const e = this.entries.get(lineage)
    return e && structuredClone(e)
  }

  /** Validates, then writes the whole file durably (0600 in a 0700 dir); memory changes only after the write. */
  upsert(e: LineageEntry): void {
    const p = problem(e)
    if (p) throw new Error(`lineages: refused entry: ${p}`)
    const next = new Map(this.entries)
    next.set(e.lineage, structuredClone(e))
    const dir = dirname(this.path)
    mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 })
    chmodSync(dir, 0o700)
    writeFileDurable(this.path, JSON.stringify({ format: LINEAGES_FORMAT, lineages: [...next.values()] }, null, 2) + '\n', 0o600)
    this.entries = next
  }

  all(): LineageEntry[] {
    return [...this.entries.values()].map((e) => structuredClone(e))
  }

  /** Every session the hub ever stamped, retired lineages included: knock origins come only from here (§8 item 4). */
  sessionIndex(): Map<string, { device: string; user: string }> {
    const index = new Map<string, { device: string; user: string }>()
    for (const e of this.entries.values()) {
      for (const s of [...e.past_sessions, ...(e.session_id ? [e.session_id] : [])]) index.set(s, { device: e.device, user: e.user })
    }
    return index
  }

  /** The session ids of one seat, past sessions included (parent_not_same_seat, §6.3). */
  sameSeat(device: string, user: string): Set<string> {
    const ids = new Set<string>()
    for (const e of this.entries.values()) {
      if (e.device !== device || e.user !== user) continue
      for (const s of e.past_sessions) ids.add(s)
      if (e.session_id) ids.add(e.session_id)
    }
    return ids
  }
}
```

```ts
// src/air/pool.ts
export interface PoolDeps { spec: Omit<ChildSpec, 'sessionFile'>; store: LineageStore; paths: AirPaths;
  mono(): number; now(): Date; ledger(f: LedgerFields): void;
  status(lineage: string, note: string | null): void; buildChanged(): boolean;
  childWindowMs?: number; requestTimeoutMs?: number }   // Task 40b adds hostCli, procAlive, retireAfterMs?, lstartOf?
export type ChildFor = { ok: true; child: CollabChild } | { ok: false; code: AgentCode; message: string }
export class ChildPool {
  constructor(deps: PoolDeps)
  childFor(lineage: string, o?: { forStart?: boolean }): Promise<ChildFor>
  //   live child → it (a live child keeps forwarding after a Collab reinstall, §10.4); retired → seat_session_ended; parked →
  //   seat_recovery_required; the pool's journal_invalid flag (P64) → hub_away; state 'ended' → forStart: a fresh unbound child,
  //   else seat_session_ended; a session whose credential file is missing (a host end, K23) → forStart: the entry moves to 'ended'
  //   (session to past_sessions, session_id and credential_path cleared), any old child is drained, then a fresh unbound child;
  //   else seat_session_ended without a spawn; otherwise start (resume with AGENTOOL_COLLAB_SESSION_FILE when a session exists)
  //   only after any old child exited. Before any spawn: deps.buildChanged() → collab_build_changed (§10.4 "refuses new children").
  //   A StartFailure is classified (Task 38): seat_recovery_required parks the lineage; journal_invalid sets the pool-wide flag
  //   (no new child for any lineage until the hub restarts, §9.8) and status journal_invalid; seat_session_ended answers that code;
  //   child_start_failed answers hub_away with status child_start_failed and is not respawned for that lineage until a hub restart
  sessionEnded(lineage: string): void              // after a successful session_end: session to past_sessions, session_id and
                                                   // credential_path cleared, state 'ended', the child drained (P53)
  attached(lineage: string): void                 // clears draining and the detach window
  detached(lineage: string): void                 // starts the 10-minute window (mono) and sets detached_since (wall clock)
  liveCount(device: string): number               // running children: attached, inside the window, or resuming
  tick(): Promise<void>                           // window passed → drain, stop at zero in flight (Task 40b adds the 7-day retirement)
  park(lineage: string, cause: string, details: Record<string, unknown>): void   // status `needs Ai: seat_recovery <session_id>`
  unpark(lineage: string): 'ok' | 'not_parked' | 'child_alive'                  // §9.6 item 5, after Ai's repair (P54)
  stopDevice(device: string): Promise<void>       // drain that device's children to zero in flight, then stop them (§9.10 step 4)
  unboundChild(): Promise<CollabChild | StartFailure>                           // fresh child, cwd '/', shared journal, no session file
  stopAll(): Promise<void>
}
// tests/pool-world.ts (test helper; Task 40b adds hostCalls and the host CLI, procAlive and lstartOf deps)
export interface World { home: string; paths: AirPaths; mirror: string; workspaceId: string; store: LineageStore;
  clock: { mono: number; now: number }; statuses: Array<[string, string | null]>; build: { changed: boolean };
  deps(over?: Partial<PoolDeps>): PoolDeps }
export function cleanupPools(): Promise<void>                       // every pool test file's afterEach
export function pathWorkspaceId(root: string): string                // Collab's K11 rule for a plain root
export function world(): World
export function pool(w: World, over?: Partial<PoolDeps>): ChildPool
export function entry(w: World, over?: Partial<LineageEntry>): LineageEntry     // upserted
export function seedLive(w: World, e: LineageEntry): Promise<string>  // a real session, as an earlier hub run left it (generation 1)
export function childOf(p: ChildPool, lineage: string, forStart?: boolean): Promise<CollabChild>
export function activeSessions(w: World): Promise<Array<{ id: string; role: string | null; generation: number }>>
export const events: (w: World, event: string) => LedgerEntry[]
export const fresh: (w: World) => LineageStore                        // lineages.json as it is on disk
```

  What later tasks rely on (Tasks 40b, 49, 50, 51, 52, 54, 62), beyond the comments above:
  - The constructor throws unless `deps.spec.journal === deps.paths.sharedJournal`: a pool can never give a child the private journal (§11.2). Children run on `deps.spec.dist`; the hub passes `collabDist(env)`, tests the tracked dist.
  - `childFor` on a `pending` lineage without `forStart` answers `session_required`; on a lineage with no entry, `hub_away` (the entry is Task 50's to create at attach). A live session whose credential file has gone moves the entry to `ended` on any call, not only a start (P53), and drains the child that was bound to it. Concurrent `childFor` calls for one lineage share one spawn.
  - `tick` marks a detached child draining once `mono() − detachedAt ≥ childWindowMs` (default `TIMING.childDetachedMs`) and stops it only at zero calls in flight, so a call in flight finishes first; a reattach before the stop has begun clears the mark and the same child keeps forwarding, with no respawn (§9.6 item 3, §12.2 "a retire with a call in flight waits for it").
  - The pool never parks on its own from a live call: the forwarder calls `park(lineage, 'cursor_reset_required', details)` when a live child answers that code (Task 51). `park` persists `parked`, writes the status and drains the child; `unpark` clears `parked`, the status (`status(lineage, null)`) and a `child_start_failed` mark.
  - `unboundChild` is not a seat child: neither the build check nor the `journal_invalid` flag gates it, and its caller stops it.
  - Ledger lines (keys from `AIR_LEDGER_KEYS`, never arguments): `child_start` (outcome `ok` with code `fresh`, `resume` or `unbound`, or `failed` with the start class, plus `journal`), `child_exit`, `session_ended` (code `session_end`, `credential_missing` or `credential_invalid`), `park`, `unpark`.

```ts
// The pool tests' world: a temp Air home whose shared journal and lineages.json are temp files, with real Collab children
// on the tracked dist (P35). Every pool test file calls cleanupPools() in its afterEach.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { mkdirSync, realpathSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { AIR_LEDGER_KEYS, appendLedger, readLedger, type LedgerEntry } from '../src/ledger.ts'
import { airPaths, type AirPaths } from '../src/paths.ts'
import type { CollabChild } from '../src/air/children.ts'
import { LineageStore, type LineageEntry } from '../src/air/lineages.ts'
import { ChildPool, type PoolDeps } from '../src/air/pool.ts'
import { rolePrefix } from '../src/air/stamp.ts'
import { newLineage, newStartNonce } from '../src/link/messages.ts'
import { COLLAB_DIST, cleanupTmps, temp } from './helpers.ts'
import { collabHarness, startCollabSession } from './mcp-harness.ts'

const pools: ChildPool[] = []

/** Stops every pool's children, then removes the temp dirs. */
export async function cleanupPools(): Promise<void> {
  for (const p of pools.splice(0)) await p.stopAll()
  cleanupTmps()
}

/** Collab's K11 rule for a plain (non-git) root: `ws_` + sha256(`local-path:` + sha256(realpath))[:24]. */
export function pathWorkspaceId(root: string): string {
  const sha = (s: string) => createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex')
  return `ws_${sha(`local-path:${sha(realpathSync(root))}`).slice(0, 24)}`
}

export interface World {
  home: string; paths: AirPaths; mirror: string; workspaceId: string; store: LineageStore
  clock: { mono: number; now: number }; statuses: Array<[string, string | null]>
  build: { changed: boolean }; deps(over?: Partial<PoolDeps>): PoolDeps
}

export function world(): World {
  const home = temp('cb-pool-')
  const paths = airPaths(home)
  const mirror = join(home, 'mirror')
  mkdirSync(mirror)
  const store = new LineageStore(paths.lineages)
  store.load()
  const clock = { mono: 1_000, now: Date.parse('2026-10-13T12:00:00.000Z') }
  const statuses: Array<[string, string | null]> = []
  const build = { changed: false }
  const w: World = {
    home, paths, mirror, workspaceId: pathWorkspaceId(mirror), store, clock, statuses, build,
    deps: (over = {}) => ({
      spec: { bun: process.execPath, dist: COLLAB_DIST, journal: paths.sharedJournal, home },
      store: w.store, paths,
      mono: () => clock.mono, now: () => new Date(clock.now),
      ledger: (f) => { appendLedger(paths.ledger, AIR_LEDGER_KEYS, f) },
      status: (l, n) => { statuses.push([l, n]) },
      buildChanged: () => build.changed,
      childWindowMs: 1_000,
      ...over,
    }),
  }
  return w
}

export function pool(w: World, over: Partial<PoolDeps> = {}): ChildPool {
  const p = new ChildPool(w.deps(over))
  pools.push(p)
  return p
}

export function entry(w: World, over: Partial<LineageEntry> = {}): LineageEntry {
  const e: LineageEntry = {
    lineage: newLineage(), device: 'nuance', user: 'macair', harness: 'claude', folder: '/Users/macair/Projects/collab-trial',
    state: 'pending', session_id: null, credential_path: null, past_sessions: [], mirror_id: '0123456789abcdef',
    workspace_id: null, pending_start: null, parked: null, detached_since: null, created_at: new Date(w.clock.now).toISOString(), ...over,
  }
  w.store.upsert(e)
  return e
}

/** Makes `e` live on a real session, as if an earlier hub run had started it: one collab_session_start through a separate
 *  hub-way harness, with root_path injected and the hub role stamp, which is that session's generation 1. Returns its id. */
export async function seedLive(w: World, e: LineageEntry): Promise<string> {
  const nonce = newStartNonce()
  const s = await startCollabSession({
    journal: w.paths.sharedJournal, home: w.home, root: w.mirror,
    actor: `${e.device}/${e.user} · self-declared: claude`, role: `${rolePrefix(e.device, e.user, nonce, 'claude')}tester`,
  })
  w.store.upsert({ ...w.store.get(e.lineage)!, state: 'live', session_id: s.sessionId, credential_path: s.credentialFile, workspace_id: s.workspaceId })
  return s.sessionId
}

export async function childOf(p: ChildPool, lineage: string, forStart = false): Promise<CollabChild> {
  const got = await p.childFor(lineage, { forStart })
  if (!got.ok) throw new Error(`childFor: ${got.code}`)
  return got.child
}

/** The active sessions of the shared journal's workspace, read through a separate hub-way harness. */
export async function activeSessions(w: World): Promise<Array<{ id: string; role: string | null; generation: number }>> {
  const h = collabHarness({ journal: w.paths.sharedJournal, home: w.home })
  try {
    await h.initialize()
    const r = await h.callTool('collab_workspace_status', { workspace_id: w.workspaceId })
    return r.isError ? [] : r.structuredContent.active_sessions
  } finally {
    await h.close()
  }
}

export const events = (w: World, event: string): LedgerEntry[] => readLedger(w.paths.ledger).filter((l) => l.event === event)
export const fresh = (w: World): LineageStore => { const s = new LineageStore(w.paths.lineages); s.load(); return s }
```

`/Users/yuai/Projects/.worktrees/agenttool-collab-bridge/packages/collab-bridge/src/air/pool.ts`:

```ts
// The hub's Collab children (C9, R4, R6): one long-lived child per lineage, so a harness session keeps one Collab session
// across Wi-Fi drops, pipe respawns and hub restarts. The rules, all from the spec:
// - A detached child lives 10 minutes, then is drained (no new forwards; a reattach clears it) and stopped only at zero
//   calls in flight; a respawn waits for the old child's exit; a resume runs the child with AGENTOOL_COLLAB_SESSION_FILE
//   and never with AGENTOOL_COLLAB_ALLOW_CURSOR_RECOVERY (§9.6 item 3).
// - A child that dies before initialize is classified by its pinned ✖ line and never respawned automatically (§9.6 item 4).
// - A session whose credential file is gone has ended, and a parked lineage waits for Ai's repair (§9.6 item 5, P53, P54).
// Every age in memory reads the injected monotonic clock (CLOCK_MONOTONIC in the hub, which counts sleep; Review Focus 4).
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs'
import type { AgentCode } from '../failure.ts'
import type { LedgerFields } from '../ledger.ts'
import type { AirPaths } from '../paths.ts'
import { TIMING } from '../timing.ts'
import { CHILD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS, CollabChild, type ChildSpec, type StartFailure } from './children.ts'
import type { LineageEntry, LineageStore } from './lineages.ts'
import { classifyStart } from './startup.ts'

export interface PoolDeps {
  spec: Omit<ChildSpec, 'sessionFile'>; store: LineageStore; paths: AirPaths
  mono(): number; now(): Date; ledger(f: LedgerFields): void
  status(lineage: string, note: string | null): void; buildChanged(): boolean
  childWindowMs?: number; requestTimeoutMs?: number
}
export type ChildFor = { ok: true; child: CollabChild } | { ok: false; code: AgentCode; message: string }

/** What the pool knows about one lineage in this hub run; lineages.json holds everything that must outlive it. */
interface Runtime {
  child: CollabChild | null
  starting: Promise<ChildFor> | null // one spawn per lineage at a time
  stopping: Promise<void> | null
  draining: boolean // no new forwards; a reattach clears it until the stop has begun
  attached: boolean
  detachedAt: number | null // monotonic
  startFailed: boolean // child_start_failed: not respawned for this lineage until the hub restarts
}

const MSG = {
  unknownLineage: 'The hub has no record of this Collab session; nothing was sent.',
  retired: 'This Collab session was retired after 7 days detached; start a new Claude session.',
  parked: 'This Collab session needs a cursor repair on the Air before it can continue; nothing was sent.',
  ended: 'This Collab session has ended; start a new one with collab_session_start.',
  required: 'Start a Collab session first with collab_session_start; nothing was sent.',
  journal: 'The shared Collab journal on the Air failed verification; nothing was sent.',
  startFailed: 'Collab could not start on the Air for this session; nothing was sent.',
  build: 'The Collab build on the Air changed under the hub; nothing was sent.',
} as const

const isRecord = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> => typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v)
const refuse = (code: AgentCode, message: string): ChildFor => ({ ok: false, code, message })

export class ChildPool {
  private readonly rts = new Map<string, Runtime>()
  private journalInvalid = false // P64: no new child for any lineage until the hub restarts
  private ticking = false
  private readonly windowMs: number
  private readonly requestTimeoutMs: number

  constructor(private readonly deps: PoolDeps) {
    // Children only ever get the shared journal; the private one is never opened (§11.2).
    if (deps.spec.journal !== deps.paths.sharedJournal) throw new Error('ChildPool: children only ever get the shared journal')
    this.windowMs = deps.childWindowMs ?? TIMING.childDetachedMs
    this.requestTimeoutMs = deps.requestTimeoutMs ?? CHILD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
  }

  private rt(lineage: string): Runtime {
    let r = this.rts.get(lineage)
    if (!r) {
      r = { child: null, starting: null, stopping: null, draining: false, attached: false, detachedAt: null, startFailed: false }
      this.rts.set(lineage, r)
    }
    return r
  }

  async childFor(lineage: string, o: { forStart?: boolean } = {}): Promise<ChildFor> {
    const rt = this.rt(lineage)
    if (rt.starting) return rt.starting
    let e = this.deps.store.get(lineage)
    if (!e) return refuse('hub_away', MSG.unknownLineage)
    if (e.state === 'retired') return refuse('seat_session_ended', MSG.retired)
    if (e.parked) return refuse('seat_recovery_required', MSG.parked)
    // A session whose credential is gone was ended from outside (a host end, K23): the lineage has ended (P53).
    if (e.state === 'live' && !existsSync(e.credential_path!)) e = this.markEnded(e, 'credential_missing')
    const c = rt.child
    // A live child keeps forwarding, even after a Collab reinstall (§10.4).
    if (c && c.alive() && !rt.draining && !rt.stopping && (e.state === 'live' || o.forStart)) return { ok: true, child: c }
    if (e.state !== 'live' && !o.forStart) return e.state === 'ended' ? refuse('seat_session_ended', MSG.ended) : refuse('session_required', MSG.required)
    if (this.journalInvalid) return refuse('hub_away', MSG.journal)
    if (rt.startFailed) return refuse('hub_away', MSG.startFailed)
    if (this.deps.buildChanged()) {
      this.deps.status(lineage, 'collab_build_changed')
      return refuse('collab_build_changed', MSG.build)
    }
    rt.starting = this.spawn(lineage, rt, e).finally(() => { rt.starting = null })
    return rt.starting
  }

  /** A fresh child, or a resume of the lineage's session; only after any old child of the lineage has exited. */
  private async spawn(lineage: string, rt: Runtime, e: LineageEntry): Promise<ChildFor> {
    if (rt.child) await this.stopChild(rt)
    const resume = e.state === 'live'
    const spec: ChildSpec = resume ? { ...this.deps.spec, sessionFile: e.credential_path! } : { ...this.deps.spec }
    const started = await CollabChild.start(spec, { requestTimeoutMs: this.requestTimeoutMs })
    const base = { event: 'child_start', device: e.device, user: e.user, lineage, session_id: e.session_id ?? undefined, journal: spec.journal }
    if ('failed' in started) {
      const cls = classifyStart(started.lastErrLine)
      this.deps.ledger({ ...base, outcome: 'failed', code: cls })
      return this.startFailed(lineage, rt, cls, started)
    }
    this.deps.ledger({ ...base, outcome: 'ok', code: resume ? 'resume' : 'fresh' })
    rt.child = started
    rt.draining = false
    rt.stopping = null
    void started.exited.then((code) => {
      this.deps.ledger({ event: 'child_exit', device: e.device, user: e.user, lineage, outcome: code === 0 ? 'ok' : 'error', code: code === null ? 'signal' : String(code) })
      if (rt.child === started) {
        rt.child = null
        rt.draining = false
      }
    })
    return { ok: true, child: started }
  }

  private startFailed(lineage: string, rt: Runtime, cls: ReturnType<typeof classifyStart>, f: StartFailure): ChildFor {
    if (cls === 'seat_recovery_required') {
      this.park(lineage, 'cursor_reset_required', { at: 'resume', message: f.lastErrLine ?? '' })
      return refuse('seat_recovery_required', MSG.parked)
    }
    if (cls === 'journal_invalid') {
      this.journalInvalid = true
      this.deps.status(lineage, 'journal_invalid')
      return refuse('hub_away', MSG.journal)
    }
    if (cls === 'seat_session_ended') {
      const e = this.deps.store.get(lineage)
      if (e && e.state === 'live') this.markEnded(e, 'credential_invalid')
      return refuse('seat_session_ended', MSG.ended)
    }
    rt.startFailed = true
    this.deps.status(lineage, 'child_start_failed')
    return refuse('hub_away', MSG.startFailed)
  }

  /** Drains a child: no new forwards, then the stop at zero in flight. Resolves once it has exited. */
  private stopChild(rt: Runtime): Promise<void> {
    const c = rt.child
    if (!c) return Promise.resolve()
    rt.draining = true
    if (!rt.stopping) {
      rt.stopping = c.stop().then(() => {
        if (rt.child === c) {
          rt.child = null
          rt.draining = false
        }
        rt.stopping = null
      })
    }
    return rt.stopping
  }

  private markEnded(e: LineageEntry, reason: string): LineageEntry {
    const past = e.session_id && !e.past_sessions.includes(e.session_id) ? [...e.past_sessions, e.session_id] : e.past_sessions
    const next: LineageEntry = { ...e, state: 'ended', session_id: null, credential_path: null, past_sessions: past }
    this.deps.store.upsert(next)
    this.deps.ledger({ event: 'session_ended', device: e.device, user: e.user, lineage: e.lineage, session_id: e.session_id ?? undefined, code: reason })
    const rt = this.rt(e.lineage)
    if (rt.child) void this.stopChild(rt)
    return next
  }

  /** After a successful session_end through the pipe (P53). */
  sessionEnded(lineage: string): void {
    const e = this.deps.store.get(lineage)
    if (e && e.state === 'live') this.markEnded(e, 'session_end')
  }

  attached(lineage: string): void {
    const rt = this.rt(lineage)
    rt.attached = true
    rt.detachedAt = null
    if (!rt.stopping) rt.draining = false
    const e = this.deps.store.get(lineage)
    if (e && e.state !== 'retired' && e.detached_since !== null) this.deps.store.upsert({ ...e, detached_since: null })
  }

  detached(lineage: string): void {
    const rt = this.rt(lineage)
    rt.attached = false
    rt.detachedAt = this.deps.mono()
    const e = this.deps.store.get(lineage)
    if (e && e.state !== 'retired') this.deps.store.upsert({ ...e, detached_since: this.deps.now().toISOString() })
  }

  liveCount(device: string): number {
    let n = 0
    for (const e of this.deps.store.all()) {
      if (e.device !== device) continue
      const rt = this.rts.get(e.lineage)
      if (rt && (rt.attached || rt.starting !== null || (rt.child !== null && rt.child.alive()))) n += 1
    }
    return n
  }

  async tick(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.ticking) return
    this.ticking = true
    try {
      await this.drainDetached()
    } finally {
      this.ticking = false
    }
  }

  /** A child detached for the whole window is marked draining, and stopped once it has no call in flight (§9.6 item 3). */
  private async drainDetached(): Promise<void> {
    const mono = this.deps.mono()
    const stops: Promise<void>[] = []
    for (const rt of this.rts.values()) {
      if (!rt.child) continue
      if (!rt.attached && rt.detachedAt !== null && mono - rt.detachedAt >= this.windowMs) rt.draining = true
      if (rt.draining && !rt.stopping && rt.child.inFlight() === 0) stops.push(this.stopChild(rt))
    }
    await Promise.all(stops)
  }

  park(lineage: string, cause: string, details: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    const e = this.deps.store.get(lineage)
    if (!e) return
    this.deps.store.upsert({ ...e, parked: { cause, details: isRecord(details) ? details : {} } })
    this.deps.ledger({ event: 'park', device: e.device, user: e.user, lineage, session_id: e.session_id ?? undefined, code: cause })
    this.deps.status(lineage, `needs Ai: seat_recovery ${e.session_id ?? lineage}`)
    const rt = this.rt(lineage)
    if (rt.child) void this.stopChild(rt)
  }

  /** After Ai's repair (§9.6 item 5, P54): refused while a child of the lineage still runs. */
  unpark(lineage: string): 'ok' | 'not_parked' | 'child_alive' {
    const e = this.deps.store.get(lineage)
    if (!e?.parked) return 'not_parked'
    const rt = this.rts.get(lineage)
    if (rt?.child?.alive()) return 'child_alive'
    this.deps.store.upsert({ ...e, parked: null })
    if (rt) rt.startFailed = false
    this.deps.status(lineage, null)
    this.deps.ledger({ event: 'unpark', device: e.device, user: e.user, lineage, session_id: e.session_id ?? undefined, outcome: 'ok' })
    return 'ok'
  }

  /** Drains that device's children to zero in flight, then stops them (§9.10 step 4). */
  async stopDevice(device: string): Promise<void> {
    const stops: Promise<void>[] = []
    for (const e of this.deps.store.all()) {
      const rt = this.rts.get(e.lineage)
      if (e.device === device && rt?.child) stops.push(this.stopChild(rt))
    }
    await Promise.all(stops)
  }

  /** A fresh child on the shared journal with no session (reconcile, unpair). Not a seat child: it forwards no seat call,
   *  so neither the build check nor journal_invalid gates it; its caller stops it. */
  async unboundChild(): Promise<CollabChild | StartFailure> {
    const c = await CollabChild.start({ ...this.deps.spec }, { requestTimeoutMs: this.requestTimeoutMs })
    const failed = 'failed' in c
    this.deps.ledger({ event: 'child_start', journal: this.deps.spec.journal, outcome: failed ? 'failed' : 'ok', code: failed ? classifyStart(c.lastErrLine) : 'unbound' })
    return c
  }

  async stopAll(): Promise<void> {
    await Promise.all([...this.rts.values()].map((rt) => this.stopChild(rt)))
  }
}
```

  What later tasks rely on (Tasks 49, 51, 52, 54, 62), beyond the comments above:
  - `makeHostCli` runs the host CLI with the children's three-key env (§10.4 "The host CLI for knocks (§8) runs the same way"), so a call that leaves out `--db` still reads the shared journal, never the private one (§11.2). Every call still passes `--db <shared journal>`: the retirement `end` here, Task 49's `knocksArgs`, Task 54's unpair `end`; the env is the backstop. Every caller passes the spec the pool holds: `makeHostCli({ bun, dist, journal: paths.sharedJournal, home })`.
  - `startSession` runs one at a time per lineage. On a lineage whose entry is `live` it writes no marker and forwards once to the live or resumed child, which answers `session_already_bound` (§6.3; the skeleton's "only for an entry with no session" is the marker path). On a lineage that still has a marker from an earlier start in this run (its outcome was unknown) it first stops that child and settles the marker exactly as `reconcile` does; while the recorded child still runs it answers `{refuse: 'hub_away'}` and sends nothing. A Collab `error` result clears the marker (nothing was created, the unbound child stays); an `unknown` keeps it and stops the child, so the next start settles it.
  - With `notAfterMono` (the forwarder's deadline, `TIMING.callMinRemainingMs` before the call's `timeout_ms` runs out, Task 51), a start that waited in the pool (the start chain, a drain, a reconcile) until `mono() >= notAfterMono` answers `{refuse: 'hub_away', message: MSG.late}` with no marker written and nothing sent; it is checked after the earlier marker is settled, after `childFor` on a live lineage, and after `childFor` before the marker. A start already written is never withdrawn.
  - Before writing the marker, and before the forward on a live lineage, `startSession` checks `child.accepting()` in the same synchronous turn as `call`: a child stopped after `childFor` answered gives `{refuse: 'hub_away'}` with no marker written and nothing sent, never an `unknown` (§9.3 item 3).
  - `reconcile` also stamps `detached_since = now` on every non-retired entry that has none, because at a hub start every lineage is detached until its pipe reattaches; a lineage that was attached when the hub stopped therefore still retires 7 days after the restart. It stops at the first `journal_invalid` and leaves the remaining markers for the next hub start.
  - Ledger lines (keys from `AIR_LEDGER_KEYS`, never arguments), beyond Task 40a's: `session_start`, `reconcile` (outcome `cleared`, `recorded`, `orphan` or `kept`), `retire_end`, `retire`.
