```ts
// The pool tests' world: a temp Air home whose shared journal and lineages.json are temp files, with real Collab children
// on the tracked dist (P35). Every pool test file calls cleanupPools() in its afterEach.
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto'
import { mkdirSync, realpathSync } from 'node:fs'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { AIR_LEDGER_KEYS, appendLedger, readLedger, type LedgerEntry } from '../src/ledger.ts'
import { airPaths, type AirPaths } from '../src/paths.ts'
import type { CollabChild } from '../src/air/children.ts'
import { LineageStore, type LineageEntry } from '../src/air/lineages.ts'
import { ChildPool, liveLstartOf, liveProcAlive, makeHostCli, type HostCli, type PoolDeps } from '../src/air/pool.ts'
import { rolePrefix } from '../src/air/stamp.ts'
import { newLineage, newStartNonce } from '../src/link/messages.ts'
import { COLLAB_DIST, cleanupTmps, temp } from './helpers.ts'
import { collabHarness, startCollabSession } from './mcp-harness.ts'

const pools: ChildPool[] = []

/** Stops every pool's children, then removes the temp dirs. */
export async function cleanupPools(): Promise<void> {
  for (const p of pools.splice(0)) await p.stopAll()
  cleanupTmps()
}

/** Collab's K11 rule for a plain (non-git) root: `ws_` + sha256(`local-path:` + sha256(realpath))[:24]. */
export function pathWorkspaceId(root: string): string {
  const sha = (s: string) => createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex')
  return `ws_${sha(`local-path:${sha(realpathSync(root))}`).slice(0, 24)}`
}

export interface World {
  home: string; paths: AirPaths; mirror: string; workspaceId: string; store: LineageStore
  clock: { mono: number; now: number }; statuses: Array<[string, string | null]>; hostCalls: string[][]
  build: { changed: boolean }; deps(over?: Partial<PoolDeps>): PoolDeps
}

export function world(): World {
  const home = temp('cb-pool-')
  const paths = airPaths(home)
  const mirror = join(home, 'mirror')
  mkdirSync(mirror)
  const store = new LineageStore(paths.lineages)
  store.load()
  const clock = { mono: 1_000, now: Date.parse('2026-10-13T12:00:00.000Z') }
  const statuses: Array<[string, string | null]> = []
  const hostCalls: string[][] = []
  const build = { changed: false }
  // The real host CLI on the tracked dist, run the children's way, recording each argv.
  const real = makeHostCli({ bun: process.execPath, dist: COLLAB_DIST, journal: paths.sharedJournal, home })
  const hostCli: HostCli = async (args, ms) => { hostCalls.push(args); return real(args, ms) }
  const w: World = {
    home, paths, mirror, workspaceId: pathWorkspaceId(mirror), store, clock, statuses, hostCalls, build,
    deps: (over = {}) => ({
      spec: { bun: process.execPath, dist: COLLAB_DIST, journal: paths.sharedJournal, home },
      store: w.store, paths, hostCli,
      mono: () => clock.mono, now: () => new Date(clock.now),
      ledger: (f) => { appendLedger(paths.ledger, AIR_LEDGER_KEYS, f) },
      procAlive: liveProcAlive('/bin/ps'), lstartOf: liveLstartOf('/bin/ps'),
      status: (l, n) => { statuses.push([l, n]) },
      buildChanged: () => build.changed,
      childWindowMs: 1_000,
      ...over,
    }),
  }
  return w
}

export function pool(w: World, over: Partial<PoolDeps> = {}): ChildPool {
  const p = new ChildPool(w.deps(over))
  pools.push(p)
  return p
}

export function entry(w: World, over: Partial<LineageEntry> = {}): LineageEntry {
  const e: LineageEntry = {
    lineage: newLineage(), device: 'nuance', user: 'macair', harness: 'claude', folder: '/Users/macair/Projects/collab-trial',
    state: 'pending', session_id: null, credential_path: null, past_sessions: [], mirror_id: '0123456789abcdef',
    workspace_id: null, pending_start: null, parked: null, detached_since: null, created_at: new Date(w.clock.now).toISOString(), ...over,
  }
  w.store.upsert(e)
  return e
}

/** Makes `e` live on a real session, as if an earlier hub run had started it: one collab_session_start through a separate
 *  hub-way harness, with root_path injected and the hub role stamp, which is that session's generation 1. Returns its id. */
export async function seedLive(w: World, e: LineageEntry): Promise<string> {
  const nonce = newStartNonce()
  const s = await startCollabSession({
    journal: w.paths.sharedJournal, home: w.home, root: w.mirror,
    actor: `${e.device}/${e.user} · self-declared: claude`, role: `${rolePrefix(e.device, e.user, nonce, 'claude')}tester`,
  })
  w.store.upsert({ ...w.store.get(e.lineage)!, state: 'live', session_id: s.sessionId, credential_path: s.credentialFile, workspace_id: s.workspaceId })
  return s.sessionId
}

export async function childOf(p: ChildPool, lineage: string, forStart = false): Promise<CollabChild> {
  const got = await p.childFor(lineage, { forStart })
  if (!got.ok) throw new Error(`childFor: ${got.code}`)
  return got.child
}

/** The active sessions of the shared journal's workspace, read through a separate hub-way harness. */
export async function activeSessions(w: World): Promise<Array<{ id: string; role: string | null; generation: number }>> {
  const h = collabHarness({ journal: w.paths.sharedJournal, home: w.home })
  try {
    await h.initialize()
    const r = await h.callTool('collab_workspace_status', { workspace_id: w.workspaceId })
    return r.isError ? [] : r.structuredContent.active_sessions
  } finally {
    await h.close()
  }
}

export const events = (w: World, event: string): LedgerEntry[] => readLedger(w.paths.ledger).filter((l) => l.event === event)
export const fresh = (w: World): LineageStore => { const s = new LineageStore(w.paths.lineages); s.load(); return s }
```

```ts
import { newStartNonce } from '../src/link/messages.ts'
import { COLLAB_DIST, temp, writeStub } from './helpers.ts'
import { startCollabSession, tamperJournal } from './mcp-harness.ts'
import { activeSessions, childOf, cleanupPools, entry, events, fresh, pool, world, type World } from './pool-world.ts'

const DAY = 86_400_000
const frozen: number[] = []
afterEach(async () => {
  // A failed assertion must never leave a SIGSTOPped child behind: thaw first, then stop every pool's children.
  for (const pid of frozen.splice(0)) try { process.kill(pid, 'SIGCONT') } catch { /* already gone */ }
  await cleanupPools()
})

/** SIGSTOPs a child so a request waits in its stdin pipe; afterEach thaws it whatever happens. */
function freeze(c: CollabChild): void {
  frozen.push(c.pid)
  process.kill(c.pid, 'SIGSTOP')
}

const ref = (e: LineageEntry, n: number) => `${e.lineage}:0000abcd:${n}`
/** What the forwarder sends Collab for a remote start: root_path injected, actor and role stamped with the start nonce. */
const startArgs = (w: World, nonce: string, device = 'nuance', user = 'macair') =>
  ({ root_path: w.mirror, actor: `${device}/${user} · self-declared: claude`, role: `${rolePrefix(device, user, nonce, 'claude')}tester` })

/** Starts a session for `e` through the pool and returns its id. */
async function live(w: World, p: ChildPool, e: LineageEntry, n = 1): Promise<string> {
  const nonce = newStartNonce()
  const out = await p.startSession(e.lineage, startArgs(w, nonce, e.device, e.user), ref(e, n), nonce, w.workspaceId)
  if (!('outcome' in out) || out.outcome !== 'ok') throw new Error(`session_start: ${JSON.stringify(out)}`)
  return w.store.get(e.lineage)!.session_id!
}

const outcome = (o: CallOutcome | { refuse: string }) => ('outcome' in o ? o.outcome : `refuse:${o.refuse}`)
async function deadPid(): Promise<number> {
  const p = Bun.spawn(['/usr/bin/true'], { stdio: ['ignore', 'ignore', 'ignore'] })
  await p.exited
  return p.pid
}
async function until(cond: () => boolean, ms = 5000): Promise<void> {
  const end = Date.now() + ms
  while (!cond()) {
    if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error('timed out waiting')
    await Bun.sleep(10)
  }
}

describe('session_start at most once', () => {
  test('the pending_start marker, with its workspace_id, is on disk before the forward and gone before the result', async () => {
    const w = world()
    const p = pool(w)
    const e = entry(w)
    const c = await childOf(p, e.lineage, true)
    freeze(c) // the request waits in the pipe until the marker has been checked
    const nonce = newStartNonce()
    let seenAtResult: unknown = 'unset'
    const run = p.startSession(e.lineage, startArgs(w, nonce), ref(e, 1), nonce, w.workspaceId)
      .then((out) => { seenAtResult = fresh(w).get(e.lineage)!.pending_start; return out })
    await until(() => fresh(w).get(e.lineage)!.pending_start !== null)
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)!.pending_start).toMatchObject({ nonce, call_ref: ref(e, 1), child_pid: c.pid, workspace_id: w.workspaceId })
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)!.pending_start!.child_lstart).toMatch(/^[A-Z][a-z]{2} [A-Z][a-z]{2} \d{1,2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2} \d{4}$/)
    expect(await activeSessions(w)).toEqual([]) // not forwarded yet
    process.kill(c.pid, 'SIGCONT')
    expect(outcome(await run)).toBe('ok')
    expect(seenAtResult).toBeNull()
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)).toMatchObject({ state: 'live', workspace_id: w.workspaceId })
  }, 30_000)

  test('a start whose child stopped after the pool handed it out is hub_away, with no marker and nothing sent', async () => {
    const w = world()
    const p = pool(w)
    const e = entry(w)
    const handOut = p.childFor.bind(p)
    // The child stops in the gap between childFor's answer and the forward (a park, an end or a drain in that gap).
    p.childFor = async (lineage, o) => {
      const got = await handOut(lineage, o)
      if (got.ok) await got.child.stop(2000)
      return got
    }
    const nonce = newStartNonce()
    const out = await p.startSession(e.lineage, startArgs(w, nonce), ref(e, 1), nonce, w.workspaceId)
    expect(out).toMatchObject({ refuse: 'hub_away' })
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)).toMatchObject({ state: 'pending', pending_start: null })
    expect(events(w, 'session_start')).toEqual([])
    expect(await activeSessions(w)).toEqual([])
  }, 30_000)

  test('a start whose deadline passed while it waited in the pool writes no marker and sends nothing', async () => {
    const w = world()
    const p = pool(w)
    const e = entry(w)
    const nonce = newStartNonce()
    const out = await p.startSession(e.lineage, startArgs(w, nonce), ref(e, 1), nonce, w.workspaceId, w.clock.mono)
    expect(out).toMatchObject({ refuse: 'hub_away' })
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)).toMatchObject({ state: 'pending', pending_start: null })
    expect(events(w, 'session_start')).toEqual([])
    expect(await activeSessions(w)).toEqual([])
  }, 30_000)

  test('reconcile: no session clears the marker', async () => {
    const w = world()
    // A session exists in the workspace, but its role carries another nonce; and a marker for a workspace that never existed.
    await startCollabSession({ journal: w.paths.sharedJournal, home: w.home, root: w.mirror, actor: 'other', role: `${rolePrefix('nuance', 'macair', newStartNonce(), 'claude')}x` })
    const marker = async (e: LineageEntry, ws: string) => ({ nonce: newStartNonce(), call_ref: ref(e, 1), child_pid: await deadPid(), child_lstart: null, workspace_id: ws, at: new Date(w.clock.now).toISOString() })
    const a = entry(w)
    w.store.upsert({ ...a, pending_start: await marker(a, w.workspaceId) })
    const b = entry(w)
    w.store.upsert({ ...b, pending_start: await marker(b, 'ws_000000000000000000000000') })
    const p = pool(w)
    await p.reconcile()
    expect(fresh(w).get(a.lineage)).toMatchObject({ state: 'pending', pending_start: null })
    expect(fresh(w).get(b.lineage)).toMatchObject({ state: 'pending', pending_start: null })
    expect(events(w, 'reconcile').map((l) => l.outcome)).toEqual(['cleared', 'cleared'])
  }, 30_000)

  test('reconcile: a session with its credential is recorded, and the next session_start answers session_already_bound', async () => {
    const w = world()
    const nonce = newStartNonce()
    const s = await startCollabSession({ journal: w.paths.sharedJournal, home: w.home, root: w.mirror, actor: 'nuance/macair · self-declared: claude', role: `${rolePrefix('nuance', 'macair', nonce, 'claude')}tester` })
    const e = entry(w)
    w.store.upsert({ ...e, pending_start: { nonce, call_ref: ref(e, 1), child_pid: await deadPid(), child_lstart: null, workspace_id: w.workspaceId, at: new Date(w.clock.now).toISOString() } })
    const p = pool(w)
    await p.reconcile()
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)).toMatchObject({ state: 'live', session_id: s.sessionId, credential_path: s.credentialFile, workspace_id: s.workspaceId, pending_start: null })
    const n2 = newStartNonce()
    const out = await p.startSession(e.lineage, startArgs(w, n2), ref(e, 2), n2, w.workspaceId)
    expect(outcome(out)).toBe('error')
    if (!('outcome' in out) || out.outcome !== 'error') throw new Error('unreachable')
    expect(out.result.structuredContent?.error).toBe('session_already_bound')
    expect((await activeSessions(w)).map((x) => x.id)).toEqual([s.sessionId])
  }, 30_000)

  test('reconcile: a session without its credential becomes orphan_session and a new start is allowed', async () => {
    const w = world()
    const nonce = newStartNonce()
    const s = await startCollabSession({ journal: w.paths.sharedJournal, home: w.home, root: w.mirror, actor: 'nuance/macair · self-declared: claude', role: `${rolePrefix('nuance', 'macair', nonce, 'claude')}tester` })
    rmSync(s.credentialFile) // killed between Collab's commit and its credential write (K23)
    const e = entry(w)
    w.store.upsert({ ...e, pending_start: { nonce, call_ref: ref(e, 1), child_pid: await deadPid(), child_lstart: null, workspace_id: w.workspaceId, at: new Date(w.clock.now).toISOString() } })
    const p = pool(w)
    await p.reconcile()
    expect(w.statuses).toContainEqual([e.lineage, `orphan_session ${s.sessionId}`])
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)).toMatchObject({ state: 'pending', pending_start: null })
    const n2 = newStartNonce()
    expect(outcome(await p.startSession(e.lineage, startArgs(w, n2), ref(e, 2), n2, w.workspaceId))).toBe('ok')
    expect(await activeSessions(w)).toHaveLength(2)
  }, 30_000)

  test('reconcile keeps a marker whose recorded child still runs', async () => {
    const w = world()
    const e = entry(w)
    const self = liveLstartOf('/bin/ps')(process.pid) // a pid that is certainly alive, with its real lstart
    w.store.upsert({ ...e, pending_start: { nonce: newStartNonce(), call_ref: ref(e, 1), child_pid: process.pid, child_lstart: self, workspace_id: w.workspaceId, at: new Date(w.clock.now).toISOString() } })
    const p = pool(w)
    await p.reconcile()
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)!.pending_start).not.toBeNull()
    expect(events(w, 'reconcile').map((l) => [l.outcome, l.code])).toEqual([['kept', 'child_alive']])
    expect(events(w, 'child_start')).toEqual([]) // nothing read the journal while the old child might still write
    const nonce = newStartNonce()
    expect(outcome(await p.startSession(e.lineage, startArgs(w, nonce), ref(e, 2), nonce, w.workspaceId))).toBe('refuse:hub_away')
  }, 30_000)

  test("a child SIGKILLed mid-session_start leaves exactly one active session after the agent's next start", async () => {
    const w = world()
    const p = pool(w)
    const e = entry(w) // a brand-new lineage on a fresh shared journal
    const c = await childOf(p, e.lineage, true)
    freeze(c)
    const n1 = newStartNonce()
    const first = p.startSession(e.lineage, startArgs(w, n1), ref(e, 1), n1, w.workspaceId)
    await until(() => fresh(w).get(e.lineage)!.pending_start !== null)
    process.kill(c.pid, 'SIGKILL')
    expect(await first).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'unknown', reason: 'exit' })
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)!.pending_start?.nonce).toBe(n1) // the marker stays: the outcome is unknown
    const n2 = newStartNonce()
    expect(outcome(await p.startSession(e.lineage, startArgs(w, n2), ref(e, 2), n2, w.workspaceId))).toBe('ok')
    expect(events(w, 'reconcile').map((l) => l.outcome)).toEqual(['cleared'])
    expect(await activeSessions(w)).toHaveLength(1)
  }, 30_000)

  test('a pool stopped during the lineage\'s first session_start, after the child committed and before the marker cleared, reconciles on restart: the session is recorded and the next start answers session_already_bound', async () => {
    const w = world()
    // The hub dies right where it would record the new session: Collab has committed it and written its credential.
    class DyingStore extends LineageStore {
      override upsert(e: LineageEntry): void {
        if (e.pending_start === null && e.session_id !== null) throw new Error('the hub died here')
        super.upsert(e)
      }
    }
    w.store = new DyingStore(w.paths.lineages)
    w.store.load()
    const p1 = pool(w)
    const e = entry(w)
    const n1 = newStartNonce()
    await expect(p1.startSession(e.lineage, startArgs(w, n1), ref(e, 1), n1, w.workspaceId)).rejects.toThrow('the hub died here')
    await p1.stopAll()
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)!.pending_start?.nonce).toBe(n1)
    const [only] = await activeSessions(w)
    expect(only).toBeDefined()
    w.store = fresh(w)
    const p2 = pool(w)
    await p2.reconcile()
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)).toMatchObject({ state: 'live', session_id: only!.id, pending_start: null })
    const n2 = newStartNonce()
    const out = await p2.startSession(e.lineage, startArgs(w, n2), ref(e, 2), n2, w.workspaceId)
    expect('outcome' in out && out.outcome === 'error' && out.result.structuredContent?.error).toBe('session_already_bound')
    expect((await activeSessions(w)).map((s) => s.id)).toEqual([only!.id])
  }, 30_000)

  test('with a pending_start and a tampered journal, reconcile keeps running, writes journal_invalid, keeps the marker and spawns no further child', async () => {
    const w = world()
    await startCollabSession({ journal: w.paths.sharedJournal, home: w.home, root: w.mirror, actor: 'air' })
    tamperJournal(w.paths.sharedJournal)
    const a = entry(w)
    const b = entry(w)
    for (const x of [a, b]) {
      w.store.upsert({ ...x, pending_start: { nonce: newStartNonce(), call_ref: ref(x, 1), child_pid: await deadPid(), child_lstart: null, workspace_id: w.workspaceId, at: new Date(w.clock.now).toISOString() } })
    }
    const p = pool(w)
    await p.reconcile() // resolves: never throws
    expect(w.statuses).toContainEqual([a.lineage, 'journal_invalid'])
    expect(fresh(w).get(a.lineage)!.pending_start).not.toBeNull()
    expect(fresh(w).get(b.lineage)!.pending_start).not.toBeNull()
    expect(events(w, 'child_start').map((l) => [l.outcome, l.code])).toEqual([['failed', 'journal_invalid']])
    await p.reconcile() // once per hub start
    expect(events(w, 'child_start')).toHaveLength(1)
  }, 30_000)
})

describe('sessions across ends', () => {
  test('after a host end, a session_start on the same lineage starts a new session', async () => {
    const w = world()
    const p = pool(w)
    const e = entry(w)
    const old = await live(w, p, e)
    const oldChild = await childOf(p, e.lineage)
    // Ai ends the session from the Air while its child still runs (T8).
    const ended = await makeHostCli({ bun: process.execPath, dist: COLLAB_DIST, journal: w.paths.sharedJournal, home: w.home })(
      ['end', '--session-file', w.paths.credentialFile(old), '--reason', 'operator end', '--db', w.paths.sharedJournal], 30_000)
    expect(ended.code).toBe(0)
    const nonce = newStartNonce()
    const out = await p.startSession(e.lineage, startArgs(w, nonce), ref(e, 2), nonce, w.workspaceId)
    expect(outcome(out)).toBe('ok')
    expect(oldChild.alive()).toBe(false)
    const now = fresh(w).get(e.lineage)!
    expect(now.state).toBe('live')
    expect(now.session_id).not.toBe(old)
    expect(now.past_sessions).toEqual([old])
    expect((await activeSessions(w)).map((s) => s.id)).toEqual([now.session_id!])
  }, 30_000)

  test('after session_end, a new session_start starts a new session', async () => {
    const w = world()
    const p = pool(w)
    const e = entry(w)
    const old = await live(w, p, e)
    const c = await childOf(p, e.lineage)
    expect((await c.call('collab_session_end', { reason: 'done' })).outcome).toBe('ok')
    p.sessionEnded(e.lineage)
    const nonce = newStartNonce()
    expect(outcome(await p.startSession(e.lineage, startArgs(w, nonce), ref(e, 2), nonce, w.workspaceId))).toBe('ok')
    const now = fresh(w).get(e.lineage)!
    expect(now.session_id).not.toBe(old)
    expect(now.past_sessions).toEqual([old])
    expect(c.alive()).toBe(false)
    expect((await activeSessions(w)).map((s) => s.id)).toEqual([now.session_id!])
  }, 30_000)

  test('startSession refuses a lineage whose child failed to start, and a parked one, with no marker and nothing sent', async () => {
    const w = world()
    mkdirSync(w.paths.sharedJournal, { recursive: true }) // the store refuses a journal that is a directory
    const p = pool(w)
    const failed = entry(w)
    const parked = entry(w, { parked: { cause: 'cursor_reset_required', details: {} } })
    const tries: Array<[LineageEntry, string]> = [[failed, 'refuse:hub_away'], [failed, 'refuse:hub_away'], [parked, 'refuse:seat_recovery_required']]
    for (const [i, [e, want]] of tries.entries()) {
      const nonce = newStartNonce()
      expect(outcome(await p.startSession(e.lineage, startArgs(w, nonce), ref(e, i + 1), nonce, w.workspaceId))).toBe(want)
      expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)!.pending_start).toBeNull()
    }
    expect(w.statuses).toContainEqual([failed.lineage, 'child_start_failed'])
    expect(events(w, 'child_start').map((l) => [l.outcome, l.code])).toEqual([['failed', 'child_start_failed']]) // once, never respawned
  }, 30_000)
})

describe('retirement', () => {
  test('a lineage detached 6 days before a pool restart retires 1 day after it, read from detached_since', async () => {
    const w = world()
    const p1 = pool(w)
    const e = entry(w)
    const sid = await live(w, p1, e)
    await p1.stopAll()
    w.store.upsert({ ...w.store.get(e.lineage)!, detached_since: new Date(w.clock.now - 6 * DAY).toISOString() })
    w.store = fresh(w)
    w.clock.mono = 5 // a new boot: the monotonic clock knows nothing of the old run
    const p2 = pool(w, { retireAfterMs: TIMING.lineageRetireMs })
    await p2.reconcile()
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)!.detached_since).toBe(new Date(w.clock.now - 6 * DAY).toISOString())
    await p2.tick()
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)!.state).toBe('live')
    w.clock.now += DAY
    await p2.tick()
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)).toMatchObject({ state: 'retired', session_id: null, past_sessions: [sid] })
    expect(w.hostCalls).toEqual([['end', '--session-file', w.paths.credentialFile(sid), '--reason', 'lineage retired', '--db', w.paths.sharedJournal]])
  }, 30_000)

  test('a lineage still attached when the hub stopped counts as detached from the next hub start', async () => {
    const w = world()
    const p1 = pool(w)
    const e = entry(w)
    await live(w, p1, e)
    p1.attached(e.lineage)
    await p1.stopAll() // the hub stops with the pipe attached: detached_since stays null on disk
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)!.detached_since).toBeNull()
    w.store = fresh(w)
    const p2 = pool(w)
    await p2.reconcile()
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)!.detached_since).toBe(new Date(w.clock.now).toISOString())
    w.clock.now += 7 * DAY
    await p2.tick()
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)!.state).toBe('retired')
  }, 30_000)

  test('after 7 days detached the lineage is ended without --release-leases and retired, and a late reattach gets seat_session_ended', async () => {
    const w = world()
    const p = pool(w)
    const e = entry(w)
    const sid = await live(w, p, e)
    const c = await childOf(p, e.lineage)
    p.detached(e.lineage)
    w.clock.now += 7 * DAY
    w.clock.mono += 7 * DAY
    await p.tick()
    expect(c.alive()).toBe(false)
    expect(w.hostCalls).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(w.hostCalls[0]).not.toContain('--release-leases')
    expect(events(w, 'retire_end').at(-1)).toMatchObject({ outcome: 'ok', session_id: sid })
    expect(await activeSessions(w)).toEqual([])
    expect(fresh(w).get(e.lineage)).toMatchObject({ state: 'retired', past_sessions: [sid] })
    expect(fresh(w).sessionIndex().get(sid)).toEqual({ device: 'nuance', user: 'macair' })
    p.attached(e.lineage)
    expect(await p.childFor(e.lineage)).toMatchObject({ ok: false, code: 'seat_session_ended' })
    const nonce = newStartNonce()
    expect(outcome(await p.startSession(e.lineage, startArgs(w, nonce), ref(e, 2), nonce, w.workspaceId))).toBe('refuse:seat_session_ended')
  }, 30_000)
})

describe('the hub way, always', () => {
  test('liveProcAlive fails closed when ps fails', async () => {
    const dir = temp('cb-ps-')
    const broken = writeStub(dir, 'ps', 'exit 1')
    expect(liveProcAlive(broken)(await deadPid(), null)).toBe(true)
    const real = liveProcAlive('/bin/ps')
    expect(real(process.pid, null)).toBe(true)
    expect(real(await deadPid(), null)).toBe(false)
    const own = liveLstartOf('/bin/ps')(process.pid)
    expect(own).not.toBeNull()
    expect(real(process.pid, own)).toBe(true)
    expect(real(process.pid, 'Thu Jan 1 00:00:00 1970')).toBe(false)
  })

  test("the host CLI runs the children's way: the three-key env naming the shared journal, cwd /", async () => {
    const dist = temp('cb-hostcli-')
    const home = temp('cb-hostcli-home-')
    writeFileSync(join(dist, 'agenttool-collab-host.js'),
      'console.log(JSON.stringify({ env: Object.keys(process.env).sort(), db: process.env.AGENTOOL_COLLAB_DB, cwd: process.cwd(), args: process.argv.slice(2) }))\n')
    const r = await makeHostCli({ bun: process.execPath, dist, journal: '/j/collab.sqlite', home })(['knocks', '--session', 'ses_1'], 5_000)
    expect(r.code).toBe(0)
    expect(JSON.parse(r.stdout)).toEqual({ env: ['AGENTOOL_COLLAB_DB', 'HOME', 'PATH'], db: '/j/collab.sqlite', cwd: '/', args: ['knocks', '--session', 'ses_1'] })
  })

  test('a host CLI call that leaves out --db still reads the shared journal, never the private one', async () => {
    const w = world()
    const p = pool(w)
    const e = entry(w)
    const sid = await live(w, p, e)
    // Collab's default journal is the private one's place, which does not exist under the temp home: a CLI that fell back
    // to it would answer nothing at all.
    expect(existsSync(w.paths.privateJournal)).toBe(false)
    const r = await makeHostCli({ bun: process.execPath, dist: COLLAB_DIST, journal: w.paths.sharedJournal, home: w.home })(['knocks', '--session', sid], 5_000)
    expect(r.code).toBe(0)
    expect(JSON.parse(r.stdout.trim())).toMatchObject({ protocol: 'agenttool.collab-knock/1', session_id: sid, waiting: 0 })
  }, 30_000)
})
```

```ts
// The hub's Collab children (C9, R4, R6): one long-lived child per lineage, so a harness session keeps one Collab session
// across Wi-Fi drops, pipe respawns and hub restarts. The rules, all from the spec:
// - A detached child lives 10 minutes, then is drained (no new forwards; a reattach clears it) and stopped only at zero
//   calls in flight; a respawn waits for the old child's exit; a resume runs the child with AGENTOOL_COLLAB_SESSION_FILE
//   and never with AGENTOOL_COLLAB_ALLOW_CURSOR_RECOVERY (§9.6 item 3).
// - A child that dies before initialize is classified by its pinned ✖ line and never respawned automatically (§9.6 item 4).
// - A session whose credential file is gone has ended, and a parked lineage waits for Ai's repair (§9.6 item 5, P53, P54).
// - session_start is the one keyless call that creates state, so its marker is on disk before it is forwarded, and an
//   unknown outcome is settled from Collab's own journal, by the start nonce in the role stamp, never by re-sending
//   (§9.3 item 8, P55, P64).
// - A lineage whose session ended may start a new one; a lineage 7 days detached is retired for good (§6.2, P53).
// Every age in memory reads the injected monotonic clock (CLOCK_MONOTONIC in the hub, which counts sleep); the 7-day
// retirement reads the wall-clock detached_since kept in lineages.json, so it survives restarts (Review Focus 4).
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs'
import type { AgentCode } from '../failure.ts'
import type { LedgerFields } from '../ledger.ts'
import type { AirPaths } from '../paths.ts'
import { readPs } from '../proc.ts'
import { TIMING } from '../timing.ts'
import { CHILD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS, childEnv, CollabChild, type CallOutcome, type ChildSpec, type StartFailure } from './children.ts'
import type { LineageEntry, LineageStore } from './lineages.ts'
import { roleNonce } from './stamp.ts'
import { classifyStart } from './startup.ts'

export type HostCli = (args: string[], timeoutMs: number) => Promise<{ code: number | null; stdout: string; stderr: string }>

const MAX_TIMER_MS = 2_147_483_647
const HOST_OUTPUT_MAX = 1024 * 1024

async function readCapped(stream: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, max: number): Promise<string> {
  const parts: Uint8Array[] = []
  let size = 0
  for await (const chunk of stream) {
    if (size < max) parts.push(chunk.subarray(0, max - size))
    size += chunk.byteLength
  }
  return Buffer.concat(parts).toString('utf8')
}

/** The installed host CLI, run the children's way: --no-env-file --config=/dev/null, cwd '/', and the children's
 *  three-key env, so a call that leaves out --db still names the shared journal, never the private one (§10.4, §11.2,
 *  R39, P14). Never a session file: `end` takes the credential as --session-file. */
export function makeHostCli(spec: Omit<ChildSpec, 'sessionFile'>): HostCli {
  const env = childEnv({ bun: spec.bun, dist: spec.dist, journal: spec.journal, home: spec.home })
  return async (args, timeoutMs) => {
    let proc: ReturnType<typeof Bun.spawn>
    try {
      proc = Bun.spawn([spec.bun, '--no-env-file', '--config=/dev/null', `${spec.dist}/agenttool-collab-host.js`, ...args], {
        cwd: '/', env, stdin: 'ignore', stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'pipe',
      })
    } catch {
      return { code: null, stdout: '', stderr: 'the host CLI could not be started' }
    }
    let timedOut = false
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { timedOut = true; proc.kill('SIGTERM') }, Math.min(MAX_TIMER_MS, Math.max(1, Math.floor(timeoutMs))))
    const [stdout, stderr] = await Promise.all([
      readCapped(proc.stdout as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, HOST_OUTPUT_MAX),
      readCapped(proc.stderr as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, HOST_OUTPUT_MAX),
    ])
    await proc.exited
    clearTimeout(timer)
    return { code: timedOut ? null : proc.exitCode, stdout, stderr }
  }
}

/** Whether a recorded child still runs: its pid is in the table and, when an lstart was recorded, it is the same process.
 *  A failed ps answers true (fail closed: an unreadable table never lets reconcile run while the old child may live). The hub
 *  passes /bin/ps (P43). */
export function liveProcAlive(psBin: string): (pid: number, lstart: string | null) => boolean {
  return (pid, lstart) => {
    const table = readPs(psBin)
    if (!table) return true
    const rec = table.get(pid)
    if (!rec) return false
    return lstart === null || rec.started_at === lstart
  }
}

/** A child's squeezed lstart, recorded in the session_start marker so a reused pid is never taken for it. */
export function liveLstartOf(psBin: string): (pid: number) => string | null {
  return (pid) => readPs(psBin)?.get(pid)?.started_at ?? null
}

export interface PoolDeps {
  spec: Omit<ChildSpec, 'sessionFile'>; store: LineageStore; paths: AirPaths; hostCli: HostCli
  mono(): number; now(): Date; ledger(f: LedgerFields): void; procAlive(pid: number, lstart: string | null): boolean
  status(lineage: string, note: string | null): void; buildChanged(): boolean
  childWindowMs?: number; retireAfterMs?: number; requestTimeoutMs?: number
  lstartOf?(pid: number): string | null
}
export type ChildFor = { ok: true; child: CollabChild } | { ok: false; code: AgentCode; message: string }
type Refusal = { refuse: AgentCode; message: string }

/** What the pool knows about one lineage in this hub run; lineages.json holds everything that must outlive it. */
interface Runtime {
  child: CollabChild | null
  starting: Promise<ChildFor> | null // one spawn per lineage at a time
  stopping: Promise<void> | null
  draining: boolean // no new forwards; a reattach clears it until the stop has begun
  attached: boolean
  detachedAt: number | null // monotonic
  startFailed: boolean // child_start_failed: not respawned for this lineage until the hub restarts
  startChain: Promise<unknown> // session_starts of one lineage run one at a time
}

const MSG = {
  unknownLineage: 'The hub has no record of this Collab session; nothing was sent.',
  retired: 'This Collab session was retired after 7 days detached; start a new Claude session.',
  parked: 'This Collab session needs a cursor repair on the Air before it can continue; nothing was sent.',
  ended: 'This Collab session has ended; start a new one with collab_session_start.',
  required: 'Start a Collab session first with collab_session_start; nothing was sent.',
  journal: 'The shared Collab journal on the Air failed verification; nothing was sent.',
  startFailed: 'Collab could not start on the Air for this session; nothing was sent.',
  build: 'The Collab build on the Air changed under the hub; nothing was sent.',
  pending: 'An earlier collab_session_start of this session has no known outcome yet; nothing was sent. Call collab_session_start again shortly.',
  stopped: "This session's Collab child on the Air was stopping, so nothing was sent; call again if you choose.",
  late: 'This collab_session_start waited on the Air past its deadline and was not sent; nothing was applied.',
} as const

const isRecord = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> => typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v)
const refuse = (code: AgentCode, message: string): ChildFor => ({ ok: false, code, message })

export class ChildPool {
  private readonly rts = new Map<string, Runtime>()
  private journalInvalid = false // P64: no new child for any lineage until the hub restarts
  private reconciled = false
  private ticking = false
  private readonly windowMs: number
  private readonly retireMs: number
  private readonly requestTimeoutMs: number

  constructor(private readonly deps: PoolDeps) {
    // Children only ever get the shared journal; the private one is never opened (§11.2).
    if (deps.spec.journal !== deps.paths.sharedJournal) throw new Error('ChildPool: children only ever get the shared journal')
    this.windowMs = deps.childWindowMs ?? TIMING.childDetachedMs
    this.retireMs = deps.retireAfterMs ?? TIMING.lineageRetireMs
    this.requestTimeoutMs = deps.requestTimeoutMs ?? CHILD_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
  }

  private rt(lineage: string): Runtime {
    let r = this.rts.get(lineage)
    if (!r) {
      r = { child: null, starting: null, stopping: null, draining: false, attached: false, detachedAt: null, startFailed: false, startChain: Promise.resolve() }
      this.rts.set(lineage, r)
    }
    return r
  }

  async childFor(lineage: string, o: { forStart?: boolean } = {}): Promise<ChildFor> {
    const rt = this.rt(lineage)
    if (rt.starting) return rt.starting
    let e = this.deps.store.get(lineage)
    if (!e) return refuse('hub_away', MSG.unknownLineage)
    if (e.state === 'retired') return refuse('seat_session_ended', MSG.retired)
    if (e.parked) return refuse('seat_recovery_required', MSG.parked)
    // A session whose credential is gone was ended from outside (a host end, K23): the lineage has ended (P53).
    if (e.state === 'live' && !existsSync(e.credential_path!)) e = this.markEnded(e, 'credential_missing')
    const c = rt.child
    // A live child keeps forwarding, even after a Collab reinstall (§10.4).
    if (c && c.alive() && !rt.draining && !rt.stopping && (e.state === 'live' || o.forStart)) return { ok: true, child: c }
    if (e.state !== 'live' && !o.forStart) return e.state === 'ended' ? refuse('seat_session_ended', MSG.ended) : refuse('session_required', MSG.required)
    if (this.journalInvalid) return refuse('hub_away', MSG.journal)
    if (rt.startFailed) return refuse('hub_away', MSG.startFailed)
    if (this.deps.buildChanged()) {
      this.deps.status(lineage, 'collab_build_changed')
      return refuse('collab_build_changed', MSG.build)
    }
    rt.starting = this.spawn(lineage, rt, e).finally(() => { rt.starting = null })
    return rt.starting
  }

  /** A fresh child, or a resume of the lineage's session; only after any old child of the lineage has exited. */
  private async spawn(lineage: string, rt: Runtime, e: LineageEntry): Promise<ChildFor> {
    if (rt.child) await this.stopChild(rt)
    const resume = e.state === 'live'
    const spec: ChildSpec = resume ? { ...this.deps.spec, sessionFile: e.credential_path! } : { ...this.deps.spec }
    const started = await CollabChild.start(spec, { requestTimeoutMs: this.requestTimeoutMs })
    const base = { event: 'child_start', device: e.device, user: e.user, lineage, session_id: e.session_id ?? undefined, journal: spec.journal }
    if ('failed' in started) {
      const cls = classifyStart(started.lastErrLine)
      this.deps.ledger({ ...base, outcome: 'failed', code: cls })
      return this.startFailed(lineage, rt, cls, started)
    }
    this.deps.ledger({ ...base, outcome: 'ok', code: resume ? 'resume' : 'fresh' })
    rt.child = started
    rt.draining = false
    rt.stopping = null
    void started.exited.then((code) => {
      this.deps.ledger({ event: 'child_exit', device: e.device, user: e.user, lineage, outcome: code === 0 ? 'ok' : 'error', code: code === null ? 'signal' : String(code) })
      if (rt.child === started) {
        rt.child = null
        rt.draining = false
      }
    })
    return { ok: true, child: started }
  }

  private startFailed(lineage: string, rt: Runtime, cls: ReturnType<typeof classifyStart>, f: StartFailure): ChildFor {
    if (cls === 'seat_recovery_required') {
      this.park(lineage, 'cursor_reset_required', { at: 'resume', message: f.lastErrLine ?? '' })
      return refuse('seat_recovery_required', MSG.parked)
    }
    if (cls === 'journal_invalid') {
      this.journalInvalid = true
      this.deps.status(lineage, 'journal_invalid')
      return refuse('hub_away', MSG.journal)
    }
    if (cls === 'seat_session_ended') {
      const e = this.deps.store.get(lineage)
      if (e && e.state === 'live') this.markEnded(e, 'credential_invalid')
      return refuse('seat_session_ended', MSG.ended)
    }
    rt.startFailed = true
    this.deps.status(lineage, 'child_start_failed')
    return refuse('hub_away', MSG.startFailed)
  }

  /** Drains a child: no new forwards, then the stop at zero in flight. Resolves once it has exited. */
  private stopChild(rt: Runtime): Promise<void> {
    const c = rt.child
    if (!c) return Promise.resolve()
    rt.draining = true
    if (!rt.stopping) {
      rt.stopping = c.stop().then(() => {
        if (rt.child === c) {
          rt.child = null
          rt.draining = false
        }
        rt.stopping = null
      })
    }
    return rt.stopping
  }

  private markEnded(e: LineageEntry, reason: string): LineageEntry {
    const past = e.session_id && !e.past_sessions.includes(e.session_id) ? [...e.past_sessions, e.session_id] : e.past_sessions
    const next: LineageEntry = { ...e, state: 'ended', session_id: null, credential_path: null, past_sessions: past }
    this.deps.store.upsert(next)
    this.deps.ledger({ event: 'session_ended', device: e.device, user: e.user, lineage: e.lineage, session_id: e.session_id ?? undefined, code: reason })
    const rt = this.rt(e.lineage)
    if (rt.child) void this.stopChild(rt)
    return next
  }

  startSession(lineage: string, args: Record<string, unknown>, callRef: string, nonce: string, workspaceId: string, notAfterMono?: number): Promise<CallOutcome | Refusal> {
    const rt = this.rt(lineage)
    const run = rt.startChain.then(() => this.start(lineage, args, callRef, nonce, workspaceId, notAfterMono))
    rt.startChain = run.catch(() => {})
    return run
  }

  private async start(lineage: string, args: Record<string, unknown>, callRef: string, nonce: string, workspaceId: string, notAfterMono?: number): Promise<CallOutcome | Refusal> {
    // The forwarder's deadline (§5.4): a start that waited here (the start chain, a drain, a reconcile) until too little of
    // its timeout_ms remained is never sent, so no marker is left for it. A start already written is never withdrawn.
    const late = () => notAfterMono !== undefined && this.deps.mono() >= notAfterMono
    let e = this.deps.store.get(lineage)
    if (!e) return { refuse: 'hub_away', message: MSG.unknownLineage }
    if (e.state === 'retired') return { refuse: 'seat_session_ended', message: MSG.retired }
    if (e.parked) return { refuse: 'seat_recovery_required', message: MSG.parked }
    const rt = this.rt(lineage)
    if (e.pending_start) {
      // An earlier start of this lineage has no known outcome: settle it from Collab's own state, never re-send it.
      if (rt.child) await this.stopChild(rt)
      if ((await this.reconcileOne(lineage)) === 'kept') return { refuse: 'hub_away', message: MSG.pending }
      e = this.deps.store.get(lineage)!
    }
    if (e.state === 'live' && !existsSync(e.credential_path!)) e = this.markEnded(e, 'credential_missing')
    if (late()) return { refuse: 'hub_away', message: MSG.late }
    if (e.state === 'live') {
      // The lineage has a session: its child answers session_already_bound (§6.3). No marker: nothing new can start.
      // accepting() in the same turn as call(): a child stopped after childFor answered is not sent to (§9.3 item 3).
      const got = await this.childFor(lineage)
      if (!got.ok) return { refuse: got.code, message: got.message }
      if (late()) return { refuse: 'hub_away', message: MSG.late }
      return got.child.accepting() ? got.child.call('collab_session_start', args) : { refuse: 'hub_away', message: MSG.stopped }
    }
    const got = await this.childFor(lineage, { forStart: true })
    if (!got.ok) return { refuse: got.code, message: got.message }
    const child = got.child
    if (late()) return { refuse: 'hub_away', message: MSG.late }
    if (!child.accepting()) return { refuse: 'hub_away', message: MSG.stopped }
    // The marker, durably, before the forward (§9.3 item 8): the start nonce in the role stamp finds the session later.
    this.deps.store.upsert({
      ...this.deps.store.get(lineage)!,
      pending_start: { nonce, call_ref: callRef, child_pid: child.pid, child_lstart: this.deps.lstartOf?.(child.pid) ?? null, workspace_id: workspaceId, at: this.deps.now().toISOString() },
    })
    const out = await child.call('collab_session_start', args)
    const after = this.deps.store.get(lineage)!
    const sc = out.outcome === 'ok' ? out.result.structuredContent : undefined
    const sessionId = isRecord(sc) && isRecord(sc.session) && typeof sc.session.id === 'string' ? sc.session.id : null
    if (out.outcome === 'ok' && sessionId) {
      const ws = isRecord(sc!.workspace) && typeof sc!.workspace.id === 'string' ? sc!.workspace.id : workspaceId
      // Recorded and the marker cleared before the result goes back to the pipe.
      this.deps.store.upsert({ ...after, state: 'live', session_id: sessionId, credential_path: this.deps.paths.credentialFile(sessionId), workspace_id: ws, pending_start: null })
      this.deps.ledger({ event: 'session_start', device: after.device, user: after.user, lineage, session_id: sessionId, journal: this.deps.spec.journal, outcome: 'ok' })
      return out
    }
    if (out.outcome === 'error') {
      // Collab refused it, so nothing was created; the unbound child stays for the next start.
      this.deps.store.upsert({ ...after, pending_start: null })
      return out
    }
    // Unknown: the marker stays, and the child that may hold the new session is stopped, so the next start (or the next
    // hub start) settles it from the journal.
    void this.stopChild(rt)
    return out
  }

  /** After a successful session_end through the pipe (P53). */
  sessionEnded(lineage: string): void {
    const e = this.deps.store.get(lineage)
    if (e && e.state === 'live') this.markEnded(e, 'session_end')
  }

  attached(lineage: string): void {
    const rt = this.rt(lineage)
    rt.attached = true
    rt.detachedAt = null
    if (!rt.stopping) rt.draining = false
    const e = this.deps.store.get(lineage)
    if (e && e.state !== 'retired' && e.detached_since !== null) this.deps.store.upsert({ ...e, detached_since: null })
  }

  detached(lineage: string): void {
    const rt = this.rt(lineage)
    rt.attached = false
    rt.detachedAt = this.deps.mono()
    const e = this.deps.store.get(lineage)
    if (e && e.state !== 'retired') this.deps.store.upsert({ ...e, detached_since: this.deps.now().toISOString() })
  }

  liveCount(device: string): number {
    let n = 0
    for (const e of this.deps.store.all()) {
      if (e.device !== device) continue
      const rt = this.rts.get(e.lineage)
      if (rt && (rt.attached || rt.starting !== null || (rt.child !== null && rt.child.alive()))) n += 1
    }
    return n
  }

  async tick(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.ticking) return
    this.ticking = true
    try {
      await this.drainDetached()
      await this.retireDue()
    } finally {
      this.ticking = false
    }
  }

  /** A child detached for the whole window is marked draining, and stopped once it has no call in flight (§9.6 item 3). */
  private async drainDetached(): Promise<void> {
    const mono = this.deps.mono()
    const stops: Promise<void>[] = []
    for (const rt of this.rts.values()) {
      if (!rt.child) continue
      if (!rt.attached && rt.detachedAt !== null && mono - rt.detachedAt >= this.windowMs) rt.draining = true
      if (rt.draining && !rt.stopping && rt.child.inFlight() === 0) stops.push(this.stopChild(rt))
    }
    await Promise.all(stops)
  }

  /** A lineage detached for 7 days by the wall clock, read from detached_since so it survives restarts, is retired (§6.2). */
  private async retireDue(): Promise<void> {
    const now = this.deps.now().getTime()
    for (const e of this.deps.store.all()) {
      if (e.state === 'retired' || e.detached_since === null || e.pending_start !== null) continue
      if (this.rts.get(e.lineage)?.attached) continue
      if (now - Date.parse(e.detached_since) < this.retireMs) continue
      await this.retire(e)
    }
  }

  private async retire(e: LineageEntry): Promise<void> {
    const rt = this.rt(e.lineage)
    if (rt.child) await this.stopChild(rt)
    let past = e.past_sessions
    if (e.state === 'live' && e.session_id) {
      // Every lease has expired by now (the TTL maximum is 3600 s, K26). No --release-leases: the store refuses an end
      // only for unexpired leases, and expired claims stay recoverable (§6.2).
      if (existsSync(e.credential_path!)) {
        const r = await this.deps.hostCli(['end', '--session-file', e.credential_path!, '--reason', 'lineage retired', '--db', this.deps.spec.journal], TIMING.callDefaultMs)
        this.deps.ledger({ event: 'retire_end', device: e.device, user: e.user, lineage: e.lineage, session_id: e.session_id, outcome: r.code === 0 ? 'ok' : 'error', code: r.code === null ? 'timeout' : String(r.code) })
      }
      if (!past.includes(e.session_id)) past = [...past, e.session_id]
    }
    this.deps.store.upsert({ ...this.deps.store.get(e.lineage)!, state: 'retired', session_id: null, credential_path: null, past_sessions: past })
    this.deps.ledger({ event: 'retire', device: e.device, user: e.user, lineage: e.lineage, outcome: 'ok' })
  }

  /** Once per hub start; never throws and never loops (P64). */
  async reconcile(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.reconciled) return
    this.reconciled = true
    const at = this.deps.now().toISOString()
    for (const e of this.deps.store.all()) {
      // Every lineage begins a hub run detached, so a pipe that never comes back still retires 7 days from now.
      if (e.state === 'retired' || e.detached_since !== null) continue
      try {
        this.deps.store.upsert({ ...e, detached_since: at })
      } catch {
        this.deps.status(e.lineage, 'reconcile_failed')
      }
    }
    for (const e of this.deps.store.all()) {
      if (!e.pending_start) continue
      if (this.journalInvalid) break // a broken journal is never re-verified in a loop (§9.6 item 4)
      try {
        await this.reconcileOne(e.lineage)
      } catch {
        this.deps.status(e.lineage, 'reconcile_failed')
      }
    }
  }

  /** Settles one pending_start from Collab's journal: confirm the child is gone, then look for the start nonce. */
  private async reconcileOne(lineage: string): Promise<'cleared' | 'recorded' | 'orphan' | 'kept'> {
    const e = this.deps.store.get(lineage)
    if (!e?.pending_start) return 'cleared'
    const m = e.pending_start
    const note = (outcome: string, extra: Record<string, string> = {}) =>
      this.deps.ledger({ event: 'reconcile', device: e.device, user: e.user, lineage, outcome, ...extra })
    if (this.deps.procAlive(m.child_pid, m.child_lstart)) {
      note('kept', { code: 'child_alive' })
      return 'kept'
    }
    const u = await this.unboundChild()
    if ('failed' in u) {
      const cls = classifyStart(u.lastErrLine)
      if (cls === 'journal_invalid') this.journalInvalid = true
      this.deps.status(lineage, cls === 'journal_invalid' ? 'journal_invalid' : 'child_start_failed')
      note('kept', { code: cls })
      return 'kept'
    }
    let out: CallOutcome
    try {
      out = await u.call('collab_workspace_status', { workspace_id: m.workspace_id })
    } finally {
      await u.stop()
    }
    const clear = () => this.deps.store.upsert({ ...this.deps.store.get(lineage)!, pending_start: null })
    if (out.outcome === 'error' && out.result.structuredContent?.error === 'workspace_not_found') {
      clear()
      note('cleared')
      return 'cleared'
    }
    if (out.outcome !== 'ok') {
      note('kept', { code: out.outcome === 'unknown' ? out.reason : String(out.result.structuredContent?.error ?? 'error') })
      return 'kept'
    }
    const active = out.result.structuredContent?.active_sessions
    // The nonce sits at a fixed position in the hub-built role prefix; a nonce in free text never matches (§6.4).
    const found = (Array.isArray(active) ? active : []).filter((s): s is Record<string, unknown> & { id: string } =>
      isRecord(s) && typeof s.id === 'string' && typeof s.role === 'string' && roleNonce(s.role, e.device, e.user) === m.nonce)
    if (found.length === 0) {
      clear()
      note('cleared')
      return 'cleared'
    }
    const credential = this.deps.paths.credentialFile(found[0]!.id)
    if (found.length === 1 && existsSync(credential)) {
      const ws = typeof found[0]!.workspace_id === 'string' ? found[0]!.workspace_id : m.workspace_id
      this.deps.store.upsert({ ...this.deps.store.get(lineage)!, state: 'live', session_id: found[0]!.id, credential_path: credential, workspace_id: ws, pending_start: null })
      note('recorded', { session_id: found[0]!.id })
      return 'recorded'
    }
    // Killed between Collab's commit and its credential write (K23): Ai decides; a new start is allowed.
    this.deps.status(lineage, found.map((s) => `orphan_session ${s.id}`).join('; '))
    clear()
    note('orphan', { session_id: found[0]!.id })
    return 'orphan'
  }

  park(lineage: string, cause: string, details: Record<string, unknown>): void {
    const e = this.deps.store.get(lineage)
    if (!e) return
    this.deps.store.upsert({ ...e, parked: { cause, details: isRecord(details) ? details : {} } })
    this.deps.ledger({ event: 'park', device: e.device, user: e.user, lineage, session_id: e.session_id ?? undefined, code: cause })
    this.deps.status(lineage, `needs Ai: seat_recovery ${e.session_id ?? lineage}`)
    const rt = this.rt(lineage)
    if (rt.child) void this.stopChild(rt)
  }

  /** After Ai's repair (§9.6 item 5, P54): refused while a child of the lineage still runs. */
  unpark(lineage: string): 'ok' | 'not_parked' | 'child_alive' {
    const e = this.deps.store.get(lineage)
    if (!e?.parked) return 'not_parked'
    const rt = this.rts.get(lineage)
    if (rt?.child?.alive()) return 'child_alive'
    this.deps.store.upsert({ ...e, parked: null })
    if (rt) rt.startFailed = false
    this.deps.status(lineage, null)
    this.deps.ledger({ event: 'unpark', device: e.device, user: e.user, lineage, session_id: e.session_id ?? undefined, outcome: 'ok' })
    return 'ok'
  }

  /** Drains that device's children to zero in flight, then stops them (§9.10 step 4). */
  async stopDevice(device: string): Promise<void> {
    const stops: Promise<void>[] = []
    for (const e of this.deps.store.all()) {
      const rt = this.rts.get(e.lineage)
      if (e.device === device && rt?.child) stops.push(this.stopChild(rt))
    }
    await Promise.all(stops)
  }

  /** A fresh child on the shared journal with no session (reconcile, unpair). Not a seat child: it forwards no seat call,
   *  so neither the build check nor journal_invalid gates it; its caller stops it. */
  async unboundChild(): Promise<CollabChild | StartFailure> {
    const c = await CollabChild.start({ ...this.deps.spec }, { requestTimeoutMs: this.requestTimeoutMs })
    const failed = 'failed' in c
    this.deps.ledger({ event: 'child_start', journal: this.deps.spec.journal, outcome: failed ? 'failed' : 'ok', code: failed ? classifyStart(c.lastErrLine) : 'unbound' })
    return c
  }

  async stopAll(): Promise<void> {
    await Promise.all([...this.rts.values()].map((rt) => this.stopChild(rt)))
  }
}
```

```ts
// src/air/git.ts
export interface GitResult { code: number | null; stdout: Uint8Array; stderr: string; timedOut: boolean }
export interface GitRunner { path: string; run(args: string[], o?: { timeoutMs?: number; prefix?: string[]; env?: Record<string, string> }): Promise<GitResult>;
  records(args: string[], o?: { timeoutMs?: number }): AsyncIterable<string> }   // NUL-separated records streamed from stdout; the caller may stop early (kills git)
export function airGit(o: { git: string; home: string }): GitRunner   // cwd '/', env {HOME, PATH:'/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin', LC_ALL:'C', GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT:'0'}; SIGTERM on timeout
export const MIRROR_GIT_FLAGS: readonly ['-c', 'core.hooksPath=/dev/null', '-c', 'core.fsmonitor=false']
// src/air/diff-check.ts
export interface TreeCaps { maxEntries: number; maxTotalBytes: number; maxBlobBytes: number; maxChangedPaths: number }
export const DEFAULT_CAPS: TreeCaps                              // 10_000, 64 MiB, 16 MiB, 128
export const CONTROL_SEGMENTS: readonly string[]                 // the header's list; '.env' and '.env.*' matched by rule
export function isControlPath(path: string): boolean             // any segment, NFC and NFD folded, lower-cased
export function inScopes(path: string, scopes: readonly string[]): boolean   // path === scope || path.startsWith(scope + '/')
export type TreeCheck = { ok: true; entries: number; totalBytes: number } | { ok: false; code: 'remote_too_large' | 'remote_non_regular_path' | 'fetch_failed'; path?: string }
export function checkTree(git: GitRunner, repo: string, oid: string, caps: TreeCaps): Promise<TreeCheck>   // sizes summed per path entry; gitlink → non-regular
export type DiffCheck = { ok: true; changed: number } | { ok: false; code: 'remote_non_regular_path' | 'remote_out_of_scope' | 'remote_control_path' | 'remote_too_large' | 'fetch_failed'; path?: string }
export function checkDiff(git: GitRunner, repo: string, base: string, oid: string, scopes: readonly string[], caps: TreeCaps): Promise<DiffCheck>
//   modes other than 100644, 100755 or 000000 → non-regular; then scope; then control path; then the changed-path cap
export function ancestorCheck(git: GitRunner, repo: string, base: string, oid: string): Promise<'ok' | 'remote_base_not_ancestor' | 'fetch_failed'>
```
- Also produced (this task's additions; the signatures above are unchanged, and `airGit`'s extra parameter is optional):
  - `src/air/git.ts`: `export const OID_RE = /^(?:[0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$/` (a full SHA-1 or SHA-256 object id; every check refuses anything else as a revision, so no caller value can ever reach git as an option); `export const GIT_STDOUT_MAX = 64 * 1024 * 1024`; `export function airGitEnv(home: string): Record<string, string>` (the four keys); `airGit(o: { git: string; home: string; defaultTimeoutMs?: number })` with the default timeout `TIMING.gitCallMs` (5 s, §9.4).
  - `run()` never throws: a binary that cannot start, a timeout and stdout past `GIT_STDOUT_MAX` all return `code: null` (a timeout also sets `timedOut`), and `prefix` holds the words that run before the git path (Task 42's size-capped shell and `env -u GIT_SSH …`).
  - `records()` yields each NUL-terminated record as a string. After the last record it throws when git exited non-zero, timed out or ended on an unterminated record, so a caller never takes a cut stream as complete. A caller that stops early (`break` or `return` inside `for await`) has git SIGTERMed, its pipe released and the process reaped before the loop exits.

Notes for the implementer:
- Collab's scope rule is copied, not reinvented: `pathWithinScopes` (KN `packages/collab/src/store.ts:6799`) is `scopes.some((scope) => path === scope || path.startsWith(`${scope}/`))`, case-sensitive, and Collab stores scopes normalised (`normalizePathScopes`, `:6343`: no leading `./`, no trailing `/`). So `notes/**` is a literal directory name (K67), and the §12.3 task uses `["notes"]`.
- Control paths are compared after NFC and NFD folding and lower-casing (§7.3 step 7), and also after an upper-then-lower round trip. The Air's APFS compares names case-insensitively, so `.hus\u212Ay` (KELVIN SIGN, canonically `K`) and `agent\u017F.md` (LONG S, which case-folds to `s`) name the same files as `.husky` and `agents.md`; refusing a few more exotic spellings than the spec lists is the safe direction.
- A mode is checked on both sides of each change: a deleted or retyped symlink (old mode `120000`) is refused as well as a new one, matching "no symlinks, no gitlinks, as Collab's own successor path refuses" (KN `packages/collab/src/repository.ts:262-268`).
- `ls-tree -l` right-aligns the size and prints `-` for a gitlink; with `-z`, `diff-tree --raw` prints each change as two records, the `:<old mode> <new mode> <old oid> <new oid> <status>` header and then the path (git 2.52, measured on this Air). `--no-renames` leaves only the statuses A, D, M and T.
- The caps test for "stops reading early" uses a hand-made `GitRunner` whose records would never end: `checkTree` must read exactly one record past the cap and close the stream (the generator's `finally` runs). With real git, `return` inside `for await` reaches `records()`'s `finally`, which SIGTERMs git.

```ts
  for (const line of text.split('\n').filter(Boolean)) {

}
```

```ts
import { cleanupTmps, commitFiles, makeRepo, REAL_GIT, repoGit, temp } from './helpers.ts'

const caps = (o: Partial<TreeCaps> = {}): TreeCaps => ({ ...DEFAULT_CAPS, ...o })

/** A trial-shaped repo (README.md, notes/.gitkeep), the Air's git with an empty home, and the base commit. */
function setup(): { repo: string; git: GitRunner; base: string } {
  const repo = temp('cb-diff-repo-')
  const base = makeRepo(repo)
  return { repo, git: airGit({ git: REAL_GIT, home: temp('cb-diff-home-') }), base }

describe('scopes and control paths', () => {
  test('an in-scope regular change passes, and notes/a.md is inside the scope "notes"', async () => {
    const { repo, git, base } = setup()
    const oid = commitFiles(repo, { 'notes/a.md': 'hello\n' }, 'add a note')
    expect(inScopes('notes/a.md', ['notes'])).toBe(true)

    expect(inScopes('notesx/a.md', ['notes'])).toBe(false)

  })

    const outside = commitFiles(repo, { 'src/x.ts': 'export {}\n' }, 'outside')

    const three = commitFiles(repo, { 'notes/1': '1', 'notes/2': '2', 'notes/3': '3' }, 'three')
    expect(await checkDiff(git, repo, base, three, ['notes'], caps({ maxChangedPaths: 3 }))).toEqual({ ok: true, changed: 3 })
    const four = commitFiles(repo, { 'notes/4': '4' }, 'four')
    const r = await checkDiff(git, repo, base, four, ['notes'], caps({ maxChangedPaths: 3 }))
    expect(r.ok === false && r.code).toBe('remote_too_large')
  })

  test('many paths to one blob count fully against the total', async () => {
    const { repo, git } = setup()
    const same = 'y'.repeat(200)
    const files: Record<string, string> = {}
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) files[`notes/copy-${i}.txt`] = same
    const oid = commitFiles(repo, files, 'ten paths, one blob')
    const blobs = new Set(repoGit(repo, ['ls-tree', '-r', oid, 'notes/']).split('\n').filter((l) => l.includes('copy-')).map((l) => l.split(/\s+/)[2]))
    expect(blobs.size).toBe(1)
    // README.md (13 bytes) + 10 × 200: one stored blob, 2013 bytes counted
    expect(await checkTree(git, repo, oid, caps({ maxTotalBytes: 2013 }))).toEqual({ ok: true, entries: 12, totalBytes: 2013 })
    const r = await checkTree(git, repo, oid, caps({ maxTotalBytes: 2012 }))
    expect(r.ok === false && r.code).toBe('remote_too_large')
  })

  test('a constant non-zero blob over the blob cap is too large', async () => {
    const { repo, git } = setup()
    const oid = commitFiles(repo, { 'notes/big.bin': 'x'.repeat(4096), 'notes/noise.bin': randomBytes(64).toString('hex') }, 'blobs')
    expect((await checkTree(git, repo, oid, caps({ maxBlobBytes: 4096 }))).ok).toBe(true)
    expect(await checkTree(git, repo, oid, caps({ maxBlobBytes: 4095 }))).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'remote_too_large', path: 'notes/big.bin' })
  })

  test('a tree over the entry cap stops reading early', async () => {
    const { repo, git, base } = setup()
    expect(await checkTree(git, repo, base, caps({ maxEntries: 2 }))).toEqual({ ok: true, entries: 2, totalBytes: 13 })
    expect(await checkTree(git, repo, base, caps({ maxEntries: 1 }))).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'remote_too_large', path: 'notes/.gitkeep' })
    // A runner that would print a million entries: checkTree reads one past the cap and closes the stream.
    let produced = 0
    let closed = false
    const endless: GitRunner = {
      path: '/nonexistent/git',
      run: async () => ({ code: 0, stdout: new Uint8Array(), stderr: '', timedOut: false }),
      records: () => ({
        async *[Symbol.asyncIterator]() {
          try {
            for (let i = 0; i < 1_000_000; i++) {
              produced += 1
              yield `100644 blob ${'a'.repeat(40)}       1\tnotes/f${i}`
            }
          } finally {
            closed = true
          }
        },
      }),
    }
    const r = await checkTree(endless, repo, base, caps({ maxEntries: 5 }))
    expect(r).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'remote_too_large', path: 'notes/f5' })
    expect(produced).toBe(6)
    expect(closed).toBe(true)
  })

  test('an unreadable tree or a bad oid is fetch_failed', async () => {
    const { repo, git, base } = setup()
    expect(await checkTree(git, repo, 'e'.repeat(40), caps())).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'fetch_failed' })
    expect(await checkTree(git, repo, 'HEAD', caps())).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'fetch_failed' })
    expect(await checkDiff(git, repo, base, '--output=/tmp/x', ['notes'], caps())).toEqual({ ok: false, code: 'fetch_failed' })
  })
})
```

```ts
// The Air side's one way to run git (spec §7.1, §7.3): the Air's own git by absolute path, cwd '/', and an environment
// built from four keys, never inherited (P14). A hub started by launchd has only HOME and PATH; LC_ALL=C keeps git's
// messages fixed, and GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 means a fetch never waits on a prompt. Nothing here sets GIT_CONFIG_*: the
// mirror's filter check (Task 42) must see every config scope, exactly as the Air sessions' own git does.
import { TIMING } from '../timing.ts'

export interface GitResult { code: number | null; stdout: Uint8Array; stderr: string; timedOut: boolean }
export interface GitRunner {
  path: string
  run(args: string[], o?: { timeoutMs?: number; prefix?: string[]; env?: Record<string, string> }): Promise<GitResult>
  records(args: string[], o?: { timeoutMs?: number }): AsyncIterable<string>
}

/** Every git command that touches a mirror or the clone it lives in: no hook and no fsmonitor daemon ever runs (§7.3). */
export const MIRROR_GIT_FLAGS = ['-c', 'core.hooksPath=/dev/null', '-c', 'core.fsmonitor=false'] as const

/** A full object id, SHA-1 or SHA-256; anything else never reaches a git command line as a revision. */
export const OID_RE = /^(?:[0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$/

/** run() keeps at most this much stdout; past it git is stopped and the call fails (code null). */
export const GIT_STDOUT_MAX = 64 * 1024 * 1024

/** A SIGTERMed git gets this long to clean up its temporary files before SIGKILL. */
const KILL_GRACE_MS = 5_000

export function airGitEnv(home: string): Record<string, string> {
  return { HOME: home, PATH: '/opt/homebrew/bin:/usr/bin:/bin', LC_ALL: 'C', GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: '0' }
}

type Proc = ReturnType<typeof Bun.spawn>

/** SIGTERM now (git removes its lock and temp files on it), SIGKILL if it is still there after the grace. */
function stop(proc: Proc): void {
  if (proc.exitCode !== null || proc.signalCode !== null) return
  proc.kill('SIGTERM')
  const hard = setTimeout(() => { if (proc.exitCode === null && proc.signalCode === null) proc.kill('SIGKILL') }, KILL_GRACE_MS)
  void proc.exited.then(() => clearTimeout(hard))
}

function concat(a: Uint8Array, b: Uint8Array): Uint8Array {
  if (a.byteLength === 0) return b
  const out = new Uint8Array(a.byteLength + b.byteLength)
  out.set(a, 0)
  out.set(b, a.byteLength)
  return out
}

async function readCapped(stream: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, max: number, over: () => void): Promise<{ bytes: Uint8Array; over: boolean }> {
  const chunks: Uint8Array[] = []
  let size = 0
  let tooMuch = false
  for await (const chunk of stream) {
    if (tooMuch) continue // keep draining so git is never blocked on a full pipe while it dies
    size += chunk.byteLength
    if (size > max) {
      tooMuch = true
      over()
      continue
    }
    chunks.push(chunk)
  }
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(tooMuch ? 0 : size)
  if (!tooMuch) {
    let off = 0
    for (const c of chunks) { bytes.set(c, off); off += c.byteLength }
  }
  return { bytes, over: tooMuch }
}

export function airGit(o: { git: string; home: string; defaultTimeoutMs?: number }): GitRunner {
  const base = airGitEnv(o.home)
  const defaultTimeout = o.defaultTimeoutMs ?? TIMING.gitCallMs
  const spawn = (argv: string[], env: Record<string, string>) =>
    Bun.spawn(argv, { cwd: '/', env, stdin: 'ignore', stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'pipe' })

  return {
    path: o.git,

    async run(args, opts = {}) {
      let proc: Proc
      try {
        proc = spawn([...(opts.prefix ?? []), o.git, ...args], { ...base, ...(opts.env ?? {}) })
      } catch (e) {
        // A missing or unrunnable binary is a failed call, never a throw: callers turn code null into a definite refusal.
        return { code: null, stdout: new Uint8Array(0), stderr: `airGit: could not start ${o.git}: ${String(e)}\n`, timedOut: false }
      }
      let timedOut = false
      const timer = setTimeout(() => { timedOut = true; stop(proc) }, opts.timeoutMs ?? defaultTimeout)
      try {
        const [out, stderr] = await Promise.all([
          readCapped(proc.stdout as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, GIT_STDOUT_MAX, () => stop(proc)),
          new Response(proc.stderr as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>).text(),
        ])
        await proc.exited
        const failed = timedOut || out.over
        return {
          code: failed ? null : proc.exitCode,
          stdout: out.bytes,
          stderr: out.over ? `${stderr}airGit: stdout over ${GIT_STDOUT_MAX} bytes\n` : stderr,
          timedOut,
        }
      } finally {
        clearTimeout(timer)
      }
    },

    records(args, opts = {}) {
      const timeoutMs = opts.timeoutMs ?? defaultTimeout
      return {
        async *[Symbol.asyncIterator]() {
          const proc = spawn([o.git, ...args], base)
          let timedOut = false
          const timer = setTimeout(() => { timedOut = true; stop(proc) }, timeoutMs)
          const stderr = new Response(proc.stderr as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>).text()
          const reader = (proc.stdout as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>).getReader()
          const decoder = new TextDecoder()
          let finished = false
          let buf: Uint8Array = new Uint8Array(0)
          try {
            for (;;) {
              const { value, done } = await reader.read()
              if (done) break
              buf = concat(buf, value)
              let start = 0
              for (let i = buf.indexOf(0, start); i >= 0; i = buf.indexOf(0, start)) {
                const rec = decoder.decode(buf.subarray(start, i))
                start = i + 1
                yield rec
              }
              buf = buf.slice(start)
            }
            const code = await proc.exited
            const err = (await stderr).trim().split('\n')[0] ?? ''
            if (timedOut) throw new Error(`git ${args.join(' ')}: timed out after ${timeoutMs} ms`)
            if (code !== 0) throw new Error(`git ${args.join(' ')}: exit ${code}: ${err}`)
            if (buf.byteLength > 0) throw new Error(`git ${args.join(' ')}: output ended with an unterminated record`)
            finished = true
          } finally {
            clearTimeout(timer)
            if (!finished) {
              // The caller stopped early, or git failed: git gets SIGTERM, then the pipe is let go and git reaped.
              stop(proc)
              try { await reader.cancel() } catch { /* already closed */ }
              await proc.exited
            }
          }
        },
      }
    },
  }
}
```

```ts
// The checks a fetched remote commit must pass before any of it is written to a mirror (spec §7.3 steps 6–7, R38). They
// read git objects only (ls-tree, diff-tree, merge-base in the Air clone), so a refused commit never reaches a worktree.
// Each check refuses rather than repairs, and stops reading at the first refusal (the stream is closed, git is stopped).
import { MIRROR_GIT_FLAGS, OID_RE, type GitRunner } from './git.ts'

export interface TreeCaps { maxEntries: number; maxTotalBytes: number; maxBlobBytes: number; maxChangedPaths: number }

/** Per share, adjustable (§6.6): 10k entries, 64 MiB summed per path entry, 16 MiB per blob, 128 changed paths. */
export const DEFAULT_CAPS: TreeCaps = Object.freeze({
  maxEntries: 10_000,
  maxTotalBytes: 64 * 1024 * 1024,
  maxBlobBytes: 16 * 1024 * 1024,
  maxChangedPaths: 128,
})

/** §7.3 step 7: a path with any of these segments, at any depth, is a control path; `.env.*` is matched by rule. */
export const CONTROL_SEGMENTS: readonly string[] = Object.freeze([
  '.claude', '.mcp.json', 'claude.md', 'claude.local.md', 'agents.md', '.envrc', '.env', 'bunfig.toml', 'package.json',
  '.npmrc', '.gitattributes', '.gitmodules', '.lfsconfig', '.githooks', '.husky', '.vscode', '.cursor', '.codex',
])
const CONTROL = new Set(CONTROL_SEGMENTS)

/**
 * NFC and NFD folding, then lower-casing (§7.3 step 7). The Air's APFS compares names case-insensitively, so the
 * upper-then-lower round trip also folds letters such as ſ (long s) and the Kelvin sign that lower-casing alone keeps;
 * refusing a few more exotic spellings is the safe direction.
 */
export function isControlPath(path: string): boolean {
  for (const seg of path.split('/')) {
    for (const form of ['NFC', 'NFD'] as const) {
      const n = seg.normalize(form)
      for (const f of [n.toLowerCase(), n.toUpperCase().toLowerCase()]) {
        if (CONTROL.has(f) || f.startsWith('.env.')) return true
      }
    }
  }
  return false
}

/** Collab's own rule (KN `src/store.ts:6799`, K67): exact, case-sensitive, a literal prefix. `notes/**` is not a glob. */
export function inScopes(path: string, scopes: readonly string[]): boolean {
  return scopes.some((scope) => path === scope || path.startsWith(`${scope}/`))
}

export type TreeCheck =
  | { ok: true; entries: number; totalBytes: number }
  | { ok: false; code: 'remote_too_large' | 'remote_non_regular_path' | 'fetch_failed'; path?: string }

/** One `ls-tree -r -z -l` record: mode, type, object, size (right-aligned, `-` for a gitlink), a tab, the path. */
const TREE_RECORD = /^([0-7]{6}) (blob|tree|commit) ([0-9a-f]{40,64}) +([0-9]+|-)\t([\s\S]+)$/

/**
 * §7.3 step 6: streams the whole tree of `oid` and stops at the first refusal. Sizes are summed per path entry, so many
 * paths to one blob count fully (K70: checkout writes every path in full). A gitlink is non-regular.
 */
export async function checkTree(git: GitRunner, repo: string, oid: string, caps: TreeCaps): Promise<TreeCheck> {
  if (!OID_RE.test(oid)) return { ok: false, code: 'fetch_failed' }
  let entries = 0
  let totalBytes = 0
  try {
    for await (const rec of git.records(['-C', repo, ...MIRROR_GIT_FLAGS, 'ls-tree', '-r', '-z', '-l', '--full-tree', oid])) {
      const m = TREE_RECORD.exec(rec)
      if (!m) return { ok: false, code: 'fetch_failed' }
      const [, mode, type, , size, path] = m as unknown as [string, string, string, string, string, string]
      entries += 1
      if (entries > caps.maxEntries) return { ok: false, code: 'remote_too_large', path }
      if (mode === '160000' || type === 'commit') return { ok: false, code: 'remote_non_regular_path', path }
      const bytes = Number(size)
      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(bytes)) return { ok: false, code: 'fetch_failed' }
      if (bytes > caps.maxBlobBytes) return { ok: false, code: 'remote_too_large', path }
      totalBytes += bytes
      if (totalBytes > caps.maxTotalBytes) return { ok: false, code: 'remote_too_large', path }
    }
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, code: 'fetch_failed' }
  }
  return { ok: true, entries, totalBytes }
}

export type DiffCheck =
  | { ok: true; changed: number }
  | { ok: false; code: 'remote_non_regular_path' | 'remote_out_of_scope' | 'remote_control_path' | 'remote_too_large' | 'fetch_failed'; path?: string }

/** One `diff-tree -z --raw` header; with `-z` the path follows as its own record. */
const RAW_HEADER = /^:([0-7]{6}) ([0-7]{6}) ([0-9a-f]{40,64}) ([0-9a-f]{40,64}) ([A-Z])$/
/** Regular files and "no file" (the 000000 side of an add or a delete); a symlink (120000) or gitlink (160000) is refused. */
const REGULAR_MODES = new Set(['100644', '100755', '000000'])

/**
 * §7.3 step 7, every changed path from `base` to `oid`, in this order: a mode on either side other than 100644, 100755
 * or 000000 (no symlinks, no gitlinks, as Collab's own successor path refuses); a path outside the task's scopes by
 * Collab's literal-prefix rule; a control path; then the changed-path cap.
 */
export async function checkDiff(git: GitRunner, repo: string, base: string, oid: string, scopes: readonly string[], caps: TreeCaps): Promise<DiffCheck> {
  if (!OID_RE.test(base) || !OID_RE.test(oid)) return { ok: false, code: 'fetch_failed' }
  let changed = 0
  let header: RegExpExecArray | null = null
  try {
    for await (const rec of git.records(['-C', repo, ...MIRROR_GIT_FLAGS, 'diff-tree', '-r', '-z', '--raw', '--no-renames',
      '--no-textconv', '--no-ext-diff', base, oid])) {
      if (header === null) {
        header = RAW_HEADER.exec(rec)
        if (header === null) return { ok: false, code: 'fetch_failed' }
        continue
      }
      const path = rec
      const [, oldMode, newMode] = header as unknown as [string, string, string]
      header = null
      if (!REGULAR_MODES.has(oldMode) || !REGULAR_MODES.has(newMode)) return { ok: false, code: 'remote_non_regular_path', path }
      if (!inScopes(path, scopes)) return { ok: false, code: 'remote_out_of_scope', path }
      if (isControlPath(path)) return { ok: false, code: 'remote_control_path', path }
      changed += 1
      if (changed > caps.maxChangedPaths) return { ok: false, code: 'remote_too_large', path }
    }
  } catch {
    return { ok: false, code: 'fetch_failed' }
  }
  if (header !== null) return { ok: false, code: 'fetch_failed' } // a header without its path
  return { ok: true, changed }
}

/** `merge-base --is-ancestor`: exit 0 passes, 1 is remote_base_not_ancestor, anything else fetch_failed (§7.3 step 7). */
export async function ancestorCheck(git: GitRunner, repo: string, base: string, oid: string): Promise<'ok' | 'remote_base_not_ancestor' | 'fetch_failed'> {
  if (!OID_RE.test(base) || !OID_RE.test(oid)) return 'fetch_failed'
  const r = await git.run(['-C', repo, ...MIRROR_GIT_FLAGS, 'merge-base', '--is-ancestor', base, oid])
  return r.code === 0 ? 'ok' : r.code === 1 ? 'remote_base_not_ancestor' : 'fetch_failed'
}
```
