`/Users/yuai/Projects/.worktrees/agenttool-collab-bridge/packages/collab-bridge/src/air/dialer.ts`:

```ts
// The hub's dialer (spec §5.4 Preamble, §5.5, §9.7): one ssh per device, `ssh -F <config> collab-<device> relay 1
// <nonce>`, its stdout scanned for the relay's preamble, and a backoff that never re-keys and never stops on what may
// heal by itself. Three parts: dialOnce (one ssh and its preamble), DialPolicy (what to do after each outcome: pure,
// on an injected monotonic clock) and runDialLoop (the loop the hub runs per paired device).
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { connect } from 'node:net'
import { PreambleScanner } from '../link/frame.ts'
import { newRelayNonce, RELAY_NONCE_RE } from '../link/messages.ts'
import type { LedgerFields } from '../ledger.ts'
import { monoNowMs } from '../native.ts'
import type { AirPaths } from '../paths.ts'
import { BACKOFF, scaled, TIMING } from '../timing.ts'
import type { DeviceFile } from './devices.ts'
import { classifySshFailure, targetOfConfig, type DialFailure, type SshContext } from './ssh.ts'
import { mergeSticky, type DeviceStatus, type DeviceWord, type StickyWarning } from './status.ts'

export type PreambleFailure = { kind: 'gate_refused'; detail: string } | { kind: 'login_shell_noise' } | { kind: 'preamble_timeout' }
export interface DeviceLink { send(bytes: Uint8Array): void; onData(cb: (chunk: Uint8Array) => void): void; close(): void;
  closed: Promise<{ code: number | null; stderr: string }> }
export type DialOutcome = { ok: true; link: DeviceLink } | { ok: false; failure: DialFailure | PreambleFailure }

/** The status hint after three silent dials in a row (spec §5.4). */
export const ZSHENV_HINT = 'no preamble; check ~/.zshenv'
/** How much of ssh's stderr is kept for the classifier: its own lines come last, after any remote noise. */
const STDERR_KEEP = 256 * 1024
/** How long a SIGTERMed ssh gets before SIGKILL. */
const KILL_GRACE_MS = 2_000
const ALIAS_RE = /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$/

/** The one command the hub ever runs on a device (spec §5.5): the -F path absolute (ssh opens it as given, never expanding ~). */
export function dialArgv(ssh: string, config: string, alias: string, nonce: string): string[] {
  if (!ssh.startsWith('/')) throw new Error('dialer: ssh must be an absolute path')
  if (!config.startsWith('/')) throw new Error('dialer: the -F config must be an absolute path')
  if (!ALIAS_RE.test(alias)) throw new Error('dialer: not an ssh Host alias')
  if (!RELAY_NONCE_RE.test(nonce)) throw new Error('dialer: the relay nonce must be 32 lowercase hex')
  return [ssh, '-F', config, alias, 'relay', '1', nonce]
}

/** One line of the gate's refusal for the status: its last stderr line, printable ASCII, clipped. */
function gateLine(stderr: string): string {
  const last = stderr.split('\n').map((l) => l.replace(/\r$/, '')).filter((l) => l.trim() !== '').at(-1) ?? ''
  return last.slice(0, 200).replace(/[^\x20-\x7e]/g, '?')
}

/**
 * One dial. An overflow (64 KiB of stdout without the preamble) or the deadline kills ssh; when ssh ends without the
 * preamble, classifyDialEnd decides in spec §5.4's order. Once the preamble is found the link is returned: later stdout
 * bytes (and any after the preamble in the same chunk) go to onData, send() writes ssh's stdin. ssh gets an env built
 * here: PATH, and HOME when given (P14).
 */
export function dialOnce(o: { ssh: string; config: string; alias: string; nonce: string; ctx: SshContext; preambleMs: number; home?: string }): Promise<DialOutcome> {
  const argv = dialArgv(o.ssh, o.config, o.alias, o.nonce)
  const env: Record<string, string> = { PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin', ...(o.home ? { HOME: o.home } : {}) }
  let proc: Bun.Subprocess<'pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'>
  try {
    proc = Bun.spawn(argv, { stdin: 'pipe', stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'pipe', cwd: '/', env })
  } catch (e) {
    const code = String((e as NodeJS.ErrnoException).code ?? 'error').replace(/[^A-Z0-9_]/g, '')
    return Promise.resolve({ ok: false, failure: { status: 'config', detail: `ssh could not be started (${code})` } })
  }
  return new Promise<DialOutcome>((resolve) => {
    const scanner = new PreambleScanner(o.nonce)
    let state: DialEndState | 'found' = 'waiting'
    let consumer: ((chunk: Uint8Array) => void) | null = null
    const pending: Uint8Array[] = []
    let stderrText = ''
    let ended = false
    const deliver = (chunk: Uint8Array) => {
      if (chunk.byteLength === 0) return
      if (consumer) consumer(chunk)
      else pending.push(chunk)
    }
    const kill = () => {
      if (ended) return
      try { proc.kill('SIGTERM') } catch { /* already gone */ }
      setTimeout(() => { if (!ended) try { proc.kill('SIGKILL') } catch { /* gone */ } }, KILL_GRACE_MS).unref?.()
    }
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (state === 'waiting') { state = 'timeout'; kill() } }, o.preambleMs)
    let settle!: (v: { code: number | null; stderr: string }) => void
    const closed = new Promise<{ code: number | null; stderr: string }>((r) => { settle = r })
    const link: DeviceLink = {
      send(bytes) {
        if (ended) return
        try { proc.stdin.write(bytes); proc.stdin.flush() } catch { /* the exit is seen through closed */ }
      },
      onData(cb) {
        consumer = cb
        for (const c of pending.splice(0)) cb(c)
      },
      close() {
        try { proc.stdin.end() } catch { /* already closed */ }
        kill()
      },
      closed,
    }
    const stdoutDone = (async () => {
      const reader = proc.stdout.getReader()
      try {
        for (;;) {
          const { done, value } = await reader.read()
          if (done) break
          if (state === 'found') { deliver(value); continue }
          if (state !== 'waiting') continue // killed: the rest is discarded
          const r = scanner.push(value)
          if (r.state === 'found') {
            state = 'found'
            clearTimeout(timer)
            deliver(r.rest)
            resolve({ ok: true, link })
          } else if (r.state === 'overflow') {
            state = 'overflow'
            clearTimeout(timer)
            kill()
          }
        }
      } catch { /* the pipe broke: the exit decides */ }
    })()
    const stderrDone = (async () => {
      const dec = new TextDecoder()
      try {
        for await (const chunk of proc.stderr) {
          stderrText += dec.decode(chunk, { stream: true })
          if (stderrText.length > STDERR_KEEP) stderrText = stderrText.slice(-STDERR_KEEP)
        }
      } catch { /* the pipe broke: keep what came */ }
    })()
    void Promise.all([proc.exited, stdoutDone, stderrDone]).then(() => {
      ended = true
      settle({ code: proc.exitCode, stderr: stderrText })
    })
    void closed.then(({ code, stderr }) => {
      clearTimeout(timer)
      if (state === 'found') return
      resolve({ ok: false, failure: classifyDialEnd({ code, state, stderr }, o.ctx) })
    })
  })
}

/** Where dialOnce stood when ssh ended without the preamble: still waiting, or killed by the hub for an overflow or the deadline. */
export type DialEndState = 'waiting' | 'overflow' | 'timeout'

/**
 * How a dial that never saw the preamble ended, in spec §5.4's order. ssh's 255 goes to the copied classifier, but once
 * the hub has killed ssh itself (an overflow or the deadline) a 255 decides only when the classifier names a line ssh is
 * known to print: OpenSSH's client loop exits 255 on the hub's own SIGTERM (clientloop.c: received_signal, then
 * cleanup_exit(255)) with no line of its own at the default LogLevel, and that 255 is the hub's kill, not a failure of
 * ssh's. Only the gate exits 64. Any other end before the preamble is unknown, which backs off.
 */
export function classifyDialEnd(end: { code: number | null; state: DialEndState; stderr: string }, ctx: SshContext): DialFailure | PreambleFailure {
  if (end.code === 255) {
    const f = classifySshFailure(end.stderr, ctx)
    if (end.state === 'waiting' || f.status !== 'unknown') return f
  } else if (end.code === 64) return { kind: 'gate_refused', detail: gateLine(end.stderr) }
  if (end.state === 'overflow') return { kind: 'login_shell_noise' }
  if (end.state === 'timeout') return { kind: 'preamble_timeout' }
  return { status: 'unknown', detail: `ssh exited ${end.code === null ? 'on a signal' : end.code} before the preamble` }
}

export type DialDecision =
  | { action: 'wait'; delayMs: number; word: DeviceWord; reason: string | null; hint: string | null }
  | { action: 'stop'; word: 'needs_yu'; reason: 'auth_refused' | 'config' | 'login_shell_noise' }

/**
 * What the loop does after each dial (spec §5.4, §5.5). Every age is read from `mono` (CLOCK_MONOTONIC in the hub,
 * Review Focus 4); `now` stamps the sticky warnings; `rand` is the jitter. One policy per device lives across links, so
 * the 10-minute windows (the immediate redial, relay_replaced) and the sticky warnings span them.
 */
export class DialPolicy {
  private failures = 0
  private lastBaseMs = 0
  private failingSince: number | null = null
  private upSince: number | null = null
  private lastImmediate: number | null = null
  private silentInRow = 0
  private hostKeyAt: number[] = []
  private relayReplacedAt: number[] = []
  private warnings: StickyWarning[]

  constructor(private readonly o: { mono(): number; now(): Date; rand(): number; sticky?: StickyWarning[] }) {
    this.warnings = mergeSticky([], o.sticky ?? []) // seeded from the status file (P52)
  }

  onUp(): void {
    this.upSince = this.o.mono()
    this.failingSince = null
    this.silentInRow = 0
  }

  /** A link that was up dropped: once per 10 minutes redial at once; the backoff resets after 60 s of uptime. */
  onDrop(): DialDecision {
    const t = this.o.mono()
    if (this.upSince !== null && t - this.upSince >= BACKOFF.resetAfterUpMs) { this.failures = 0; this.lastBaseMs = 0 }
    this.upSince = null
    this.failingSince = t
    if (this.lastImmediate === null || t - this.lastImmediate >= BACKOFF.redialOncePerMs) {
      this.lastImmediate = t
      return { action: 'wait', delayMs: 0, word: 'connecting', reason: 'link_dropped', hint: null }
    }
    return this.backoff('link_dropped', null)
  }

  onFailure(f: DialFailure | PreambleFailure): DialDecision {
    if (this.failingSince === null) this.failingSince = this.o.mono()
    if ('kind' in f) {
      if (f.kind === 'gate_refused') return { action: 'stop', word: 'needs_yu', reason: 'config' } // a malformed form or an older bundle (§5.4)
      if (f.kind === 'login_shell_noise') return { action: 'stop', word: 'needs_yu', reason: 'login_shell_noise' }
      this.silentInRow++
      return this.backoff('preamble_timeout', this.silentInRow >= BACKOFF.preambleHintAfter ? ZSHENV_HINT : null)
    }
    this.silentInRow = 0
    switch (f.status) {
      case 'auth_refused': return { action: 'stop', word: 'needs_yu', reason: 'auth_refused' } // never re-key (§5.5)
      case 'config': return { action: 'stop', word: 'needs_yu', reason: 'config' }
      case 'host_key_mismatch': return this.hostKeyMismatch(f.fingerprint)
      case 'unreachable': return this.backoff(f.reason, null)
      case 'unknown': return this.backoff('unknown', null)
    }
  }

  /** Per device, across links: true once more than 3 relay_replaced arrive within 10 minutes (§5.3, T5). */
  noteRelayReplaced(): boolean {
    const t = this.o.mono()
    this.relayReplacedAt = this.relayReplacedAt.filter((x) => t - x < BACKOFF.relayContestedWindowMs)
    this.relayReplacedAt.push(t)
    return this.relayReplacedAt.length > BACKOFF.relayContestedAbove
  }

  sticky(): StickyWarning[] {
    return [...this.warnings]
  }

  private away(): boolean {
    return this.failingSince !== null && this.o.mono() - this.failingSince >= BACKOFF.awayAfterMs
  }

  private jittered(baseMs: number): number {
    return Math.round(baseMs * (1 - BACKOFF.jitter + 2 * BACKOFF.jitter * this.o.rand()))
  }

  /** 5, 10, 20, 40, then 60 s; once away (10 minutes of failures) doubling up to the 15-minute cap. */
  private backoff(reason: string, hint: string | null): DialDecision {
    const steps = BACKOFF.stepsMs
    const away = this.away()
    const last = steps[steps.length - 1]!
    const base = this.failures < steps.length ? steps[this.failures]! : away ? Math.min(BACKOFF.awayCapMs, Math.max(this.lastBaseMs, last) * 2) : last
    this.failures++
    this.lastBaseMs = base
    return { action: 'wait', delayMs: this.jittered(base), word: away ? 'away' : 'connecting', reason, hint }
  }

  /** Refuses this attempt only: the pin is never touched; retry at the 60 s cap (the away cap once away); escalate at 3 in 30 minutes. */
  private hostKeyMismatch(fingerprint: string | null): DialDecision {
    const t = this.o.mono()
    this.hostKeyAt = this.hostKeyAt.filter((x) => t - x < BACKOFF.hostKeyWindowMs)
    this.hostKeyAt.push(t)
    this.warnings = mergeSticky(this.warnings, [{ kind: 'host_key_mismatch', at: this.o.now().toISOString(), fingerprint }])
    const steps = BACKOFF.stepsMs
    this.failures = Math.max(this.failures + 1, steps.length) // a later plain failure stays at the cap
    const base = this.away() ? BACKOFF.awayCapMs : steps[steps.length - 1]!
    this.lastBaseMs = base
    const escalated = this.hostKeyAt.length >= BACKOFF.hostKeyEscalateAt
    return { action: 'wait', delayMs: this.jittered(base), word: escalated ? 'needs_yu' : 'host_key_mismatch', reason: 'host_key_mismatch', hint: null }
  }
}

export type TcpProbe = (host: string, port: number, timeoutMs: number) => Promise<'ok' | string>   // string: the error code

/**
 * A TCP connect from the hub process itself, closed at once (spec §13 S1, P56): a long-lived process making the Local
 * Network operation is what lets macOS show its alert, which a short-lived ssh child that fails and exits may never get.
 */
export const liveTcpProbe: TcpProbe = (host, port, timeoutMs) => new Promise((resolve) => {
  let done = false
  const s = connect({ host, port, family: 4 })
  const finish = (r: string) => {
    if (done) return
    done = true
    clearTimeout(timer)
    s.destroy()
    resolve(r)
  }
  const timer = setTimeout(() => finish('ETIMEDOUT'), timeoutMs)
  s.once('connect', () => finish('ok'))
  s.once('error', (e: NodeJS.ErrnoException) => finish(typeof e.code === 'string' ? e.code : 'error'))
})

function failureCode(f: DialFailure | PreambleFailure): string {
  if ('kind' in f) return f.kind
  return f.status === 'unreachable' ? f.reason : f.status
}

/**
 * The loop for one paired device, until `stopped()` or a stop that needs Yu. A missing config file stops before any
 * dial. Before the first dial of the loop, and after each no_route failure while no link has come up in it, the hub
 * makes one TCP connect to the config's HostName:22 (P56); it is ledgered and never stops the loop. Every dial appends
 * {event:'dial', device, outcome, code, ms} (the §9.7 wake check compares their times) and each host-key mismatch
 * {event:'host_key_mismatch', device, fingerprint}. `onLink` runs for as long as a link is up. Statuses carry the
 * policy's sticky warnings; `since` is when the current word began, and for connecting and away when the link was
 * last lost (or the loop started).
 */
export async function runDialLoop(o: { device: DeviceFile; paths: AirPaths; ssh: string; policy: DialPolicy; configExists(): boolean;
  onLink(link: DeviceLink): Promise<void>; status(s: Partial<DeviceStatus>): void; ledger(f: LedgerFields): void;
  tcpProbe: TcpProbe; stopped(): boolean; sleep(ms: number): Promise<void>; preambleMs?: number }): Promise<'stopped' | 'needs_yu'> {
  const device = o.device.device
  const alias = o.device.host_alias
  const config = o.paths.sshConfig
  const preambleMs = o.preambleMs ?? scaled(TIMING.preambleMs)
  let lastWord: DeviceWord | null = null
  let since = new Date().toISOString()
  let downSince: string | null = null
  const report = (word: DeviceWord, reason: string | null, hint: string | null) => {
    const t = new Date().toISOString()
    if (word === 'up') downSince = null
    else downSince ??= t
    if (word !== lastWord) {
      since = word === 'connecting' || word === 'away' ? downSince! : t
      lastWord = word
    }
    o.status({ word, reason, since, hint, sticky: o.policy.sticky() })
  }
  const needsYu = (reason: string): 'needs_yu' => {
    report('needs_yu', reason, null)
    return 'needs_yu'
  }

  if (!o.configExists()) {
    o.ledger({ event: 'dial', device, outcome: 'refused', code: 'config', ms: 0 })
    return needsYu('config')
  }
  let target: ReturnType<typeof targetOfConfig> = null
  try { target = targetOfConfig(readFileSync(config, 'utf8'), alias) } catch { target = null }
  if (!target?.host) {
    o.ledger({ event: 'dial', device, outcome: 'refused', code: 'config', ms: 0 })
    return needsYu('config')
  }
  const ctx: SshContext = { ...target, config }
  report('connecting', null, null)

  let linked = false
  let probeNext = true
  while (!o.stopped()) {
    if (probeNext && !linked) {
      probeNext = false
      const t0 = monoNowMs()
      const r = await o.tcpProbe(target.host, 22, 5_000).catch(() => 'error')
      o.ledger({ event: 'tcp_probe', device, outcome: r === 'ok' ? 'ok' : 'failed', code: r === 'ok' ? undefined : r, ms: Math.round(monoNowMs() - t0) })
      if (o.stopped()) break
    }
    const t0 = monoNowMs()
    const out = await dialOnce({ ssh: o.ssh, config, alias, nonce: newRelayNonce(), ctx, preambleMs, home: o.paths.home })
    const ms = Math.round(monoNowMs() - t0)
    let decision: DialDecision
    if (out.ok) {
      o.ledger({ event: 'dial', device, outcome: 'up', ms })
      o.policy.onUp()
      linked = true
      report('up', null, null)
      try { await o.onLink(out.link) } catch { /* the session ended: a drop like any other */ }
      out.link.close()
      await out.link.closed
      decision = o.policy.onDrop()
    } else {
      const f = out.failure
      o.ledger({ event: 'dial', device, outcome: 'failed', code: failureCode(f), ms })
      if ('status' in f && f.status === 'host_key_mismatch') o.ledger({ event: 'host_key_mismatch', device, fingerprint: f.fingerprint ?? undefined })
      decision = o.policy.onFailure(f)
      if ('status' in f && f.status === 'unreachable' && f.reason === 'no_route') probeNext = true
    }
    if (decision.action === 'stop') return needsYu(decision.reason)
    report(decision.word, decision.reason, decision.hint)
    if (o.stopped()) break
    await o.sleep(decision.delayMs)
  }
  return 'stopped'
}
```

```ts
// The hub's knock read (Task 49; spec §8 items 3–4, §12.2 Tap). Real Collab sessions on this tree's tracked dist, whose
// host bundle carries C10's `knocks --session`, in a temp shared journal; the session index is a plain map here (in the
// hub it is LineageStore.sessionIndex(), Task 39).
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test'
import { existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path'
import {
  COLLAB_KNOCK_PROTOCOL, knockReportFor, knocksArgs, mapKnock, parseKnockReport, type CollabKnockReport,
} from '../src/air/knocks.ts'
import { makeHostCli, type HostCli } from '../src/air/pool.ts'
import type { HubKnockReportMsg } from '../src/link/messages.ts'
import { cleanupTmps, COLLAB_DIST, temp } from './helpers.ts'
import { collabHarness, type StdioHarness } from './mcp-harness.ts'

const harnesses: StdioHarness[] = []
afterEach(async () => {
  for (const h of harnesses.splice(0)) await h.close()
  cleanupTmps()
})

type Index = Map<string, { device: string; user: string }>
const REMOTE = { device: 'nuance', user: 'macair' }
const QUIET: HubKnockReportMsg = { t: 'knock_report', count: 0, origins: [], seqs: [] }

interface World { journal: string; home: string; root: string; hostCli: HostCli; ledger: string }

/** A temp shared journal (created by the first session), its home and a plain folder every session is rooted at. */
function world(): World {
  const dir = temp('cb-knocks-')
  const home = join(dir, 'home')
  const root = join(dir, 'trial')
  mkdirSync(home, { mode: 0o700 })
  mkdirSync(root)
  const journal = join(dir, 'collab-shared', 'collab.sqlite')
  return { journal, home, root, hostCli: makeHostCli({ bun: process.execPath, dist: COLLAB_DIST, journal, home }),
    ledger: join(dirname(journal), 'collab-sessions', 'knock-ledger.json') }
}

interface Session { h: StdioHarness; id: string; workspace: string }

async function session(w: World, actor: string): Promise<Session> {
  const h = collabHarness({ journal: w.journal, home: w.home })
  harnesses.push(h)
  await h.initialize()
  const r = await h.callTool('collab_session_start', { root_path: w.root, actor })
  if (r.isError) throw new Error(`collab_session_start failed: ${r.content[0].text}`)
  return { h, id: r.structuredContent.session.id, workspace: r.structuredContent.workspace.id }
}

/** One report addressed to `to`; returns its journal sequence, which is the knock item's seq. */
async function note(from: Session, to: Session, key: string): Promise<number> {
  const r = await from.h.callTool('collab_report_append', {
    workspace_id: from.workspace, idempotency_key: key, kind: 'observation', body: `note ${key}`, to_session_id: to.id,
  })
  if (r.isError) throw new Error(`collab_report_append failed: ${r.content[0].text}`)
  return r.structuredContent.report.event_sequence
}

const read = (w: World, s: Session, index: Index = new Map()) =>
  knockReportFor(s.id, 2000, { hostCli: w.hostCli, journal: w.journal, index: () => index })

function report(items: Array<{ seq: number; from_session_id?: string | null; from_actor?: string }>, o: Partial<CollabKnockReport> = {}): CollabKnockReport {
  return {
    protocol: COLLAB_KNOCK_PROTOCOL, session_id: 'session_b', liveness: 'live', rest: null, waiting: items.length,
    new: items.map((i) => ({ seq: i.seq, kind: 'report.posted', from_actor: i.from_actor ?? 'someone', ref_id: `report_${i.seq}`,
      ...(i.from_session_id === undefined ? {} : { from_session_id: i.from_session_id }) })),
    ...o,
  }
}

    const r = report([{ seq: 3, from_session_id: 's1' }, { seq: 5, from_session_id: 's2' }, { seq: 6, from_session_id: 's3' },

    expect(await read(w, addressee, new Map([[sender.id, REMOTE]]))).toEqual({ t: 'knock_report', count: 1, origins: ['nuance/macair'], seqs: [seq] })
  }, 30_000)

  test('a forged from_actor never becomes an origin', async () => {
    const w = world()
    const remote = await session(w, 'nuance/macair · self-declared: claude')
    // An Air session may call itself anything; only the hub's session index can make a device/user origin (K31, K63).
    const forger = await session(w, 'zerone/yu · self-declared: forged')
    const seq = await note(forger, remote, 'n1')
    expect(await read(w, remote, new Map([[remote.id, REMOTE]]))).toEqual({ t: 'knock_report', count: 1, origins: ['air'], seqs: [seq] })
    expect(mapKnock(report([{ seq: 3, from_actor: 'nuance/macair', from_session_id: null }]), new Map()).origins).toEqual(['air'])
  }, 30_000)

  test('the second read is count 0: one tap per note', async () => {

    const air = await session(w, 'air-agent')
    const first = await note(air, remote, 'n1')
    expect(await read(w, remote)).toEqual({ t: 'knock_report', count: 1, origins: ['air'], seqs: [first] })
    expect(await read(w, remote)).toEqual(QUIET)

    expect(await read(w, remote)).toEqual({ t: 'knock_report', count: 1, origins: ['air'], seqs: [second] })
    expect(await read(w, remote)).toEqual(QUIET)
  }, 30_000)

  test('a tapped but unacknowledged note gives silence', async () => {
    const w = world()

    const air = await session(w, 'air-agent')
    await note(air, remote, 'n1')
    expect(await read(w, remote)).toMatchObject({ count: 1 })
    // collab_next reads the note but acknowledges nothing: it is still waiting, and still never tapped twice.
    const next = await remote.h.callTool('collab_next', { workspace_id: remote.workspace })
    expect(next.structuredContent.session.addressed_waiting).toBe(1)
    expect(await read(w, remote)).toEqual(QUIET)
    const peek = await w.hostCli(['knocks', '--session', remote.id, '--db', w.journal], 2000)
    expect(parseKnockReport(peek.stdout)).toMatchObject({ waiting: 1, new: [] })
  }, 30_000)

  test('a resting remote session is silent at two reads, shows one note after it returns, then is silent', async () => {
    const w = world()
    const remote = await session(w, 'nuance/macair · self-declared: claude')
    const air = await session(w, 'air-agent')
    // What the hub forwards for a remote rest (§6.3): wake_on [] (R29).
    const rest = await remote.h.callTool('collab_session_rest', { workspace_id: remote.workspace, idempotency_key: 'r1', mode: 'resting', wake_on: [] })
    expect(rest.isError).toBeFalsy()
    const seq = await note(air, remote, 'n1')
    expect(await read(w, remote)).toEqual(QUIET)
    expect(await read(w, remote)).toEqual(QUIET)
    expect(existsSync(w.ledger)).toBe(false) // a held rest is never marked (K29)
    const back = await remote.h.callTool('collab_session_rest', { workspace_id: remote.workspace, idempotency_key: 'r2', mode: 'ready' })
    expect(back.isError).toBeFalsy()
    expect(await read(w, remote)).toEqual({ t: 'knock_report', count: 1, origins: ['air'], seqs: [seq] })
    expect(await read(w, remote)).toEqual(QUIET)
  }, 30_000)

  test('under 1 s left answers expired and leaves the knock ledger unchanged', async () => {
    const w = world()
    const remote = await session(w, 'nuance/macair · self-declared: claude')
    const air = await session(w, 'air-agent')
    await note(air, remote, 'n1')
    expect(await read(w, remote)).toMatchObject({ count: 1 }) // the ledger file now exists
    const seq = await note(air, remote, 'n2')
    const before = readFileSync(w.ledger)
    const calls: string[][] = []
    const counting: HostCli = (args, ms) => { calls.push(args); return w.hostCli(args, ms) }
    const o = { hostCli: counting, journal: w.journal, index: () => new Map() as Index }
    expect(await knockReportFor(remote.id, 999, o)).toEqual({ t: 'knock_report', expired: true })
    expect(await knockReportFor(remote.id, 0, o)).toEqual({ t: 'knock_report', expired: true })
    expect(calls).toEqual([])
    expect(readFileSync(w.ledger).equals(before)).toBe(true)
    // Nothing was marked, so the note still taps at the next read with time enough.
    expect(await knockReportFor(remote.id, 2000, o)).toEqual({ t: 'knock_report', count: 1, origins: ['air'], seqs: [seq] })
  }, 30_000)

  test('an ended session is count 0', async () => {
    const w = world()
    const remote = await session(w, 'nuance/macair · self-declared: claude')
    const air = await session(w, 'air-agent')
    await note(air, remote, 'n1')
    const end = await remote.h.callTool('collab_session_end', { reason: 'done' })
    expect(end.isError).toBeFalsy()
    expect(await read(w, remote)).toEqual(QUIET)
    expect(mapKnock(report([{ seq: 3, from_session_id: null }], { liveness: 'ended' }), new Map())).toEqual({ count: 0, origins: [], seqs: [] })
  }, 30_000)
})

describe('knockReportFor around the host CLI', () => {
  const fake = (answer: () => Promise<{ code: number | null; stdout: string; stderr: string }>) => {

      .toEqual({ t: 'knock_report', expired: true })

    expect(calls.map((c) => c.ms)).toEqual([1600, 800])
  })

  test('a failing, timed-out, garbled or throwing host CLI is count 0', async () => {
    const answers = [
      async () => ({ code: 1, stdout: line('session_b'), stderr: 'boom' }),
      async () => ({ code: null, stdout: '', stderr: '' }),
      async () => ({ code: 0, stdout: 'not json\n', stderr: '' }),

    }

  test('a report for another session is count 0', async () => {

    expect(await knockReportFor('session_b', 2000, { hostCli: cli, journal: '/j', index: () => new Map() })).toEqual(QUIET)
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Write minimal implementation**

`/Users/yuai/Projects/.worktrees/agenttool-collab-bridge/packages/collab-bridge/src/air/knocks.ts`:

```ts
// The hub's knock read for one remote session (spec §8 items 3–4, R22). It runs C10's session-addressed read on the
// shared journal through the installed host CLI, which marks what it reports in Collab's own knock ledger beside that
// journal, so a note taps once. The hub never reads `waiting` and never trusts `from_actor`: the count is the `new`
// items, and their origins come only from the senders' session ids looked up in the hub's own session index (K31, K63).
// Every doubt is count 0, which the pipe and the tap turn into silence (§8).
import { MAX_KNOCK_COUNT, ORIGIN_RE, type HubKnockReportMsg } from '../link/messages.ts'
import { TIMING } from '../timing.ts'
import type { HostCli } from './pool.ts'

/** The knock report's protocol (KN `src/host.ts:56`): a report in any other shape is refused, never guessed at. */
export const COLLAB_KNOCK_PROTOCOL = 'agenttool.collab-knock/1'
/** The host CLI gets this much less than the pipe's budget, so the answer leaves the hub before the pipe stops waiting. */
export const KNOCK_CLI_MARGIN_MS = 200
const MAX_ORIGINS = 3

export interface CollabKnockItem { seq: number; kind: string; from_actor: string; ref_id: string; from_session_id?: string | null }
export interface CollabKnockReport { protocol: string; session_id: string; liveness: 'live' | 'resting' | 'stale' | 'ended';
  rest: { wake_on: string[] } | null; waiting: number; new: CollabKnockItem[] }

type Obj = Record<string, unknown>
const isObj = (v: unknown): v is Obj => typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v)
const LIVENESS: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(['live', 'resting', 'stale', 'ended'])
const isCount = (v: unknown): v is number => Number.isSafeInteger(v) && (v as number) >= 0

function parseItem(v: unknown): CollabKnockItem | null {
  if (!isObj(v) || !isCount(v.seq)) return null
  if (typeof v.kind !== 'string' || typeof v.from_actor !== 'string' || typeof v.ref_id !== 'string') return null
  const item: CollabKnockItem = { seq: v.seq, kind: v.kind, from_actor: v.from_actor, ref_id: v.ref_id }
  if (Object.hasOwn(v, 'from_session_id')) {
    if (v.from_session_id !== null && typeof v.from_session_id !== 'string') return null
    item.from_session_id = v.from_session_id
  }
  return item
}

/** The one line `knocks --session` prints, or null for silence (no line), a second line, or any field out of shape. */
export function parseKnockReport(line: string): CollabKnockReport | null {
  const text = line.trim()
  if (text === '' || text.includes('\n')) return null
  let v: unknown
  try { v = JSON.parse(text) } catch { return null }
  if (!isObj(v) || v.protocol !== COLLAB_KNOCK_PROTOCOL || typeof v.session_id !== 'string') return null
  if (typeof v.liveness !== 'string' || !LIVENESS.has(v.liveness) || !isCount(v.waiting) || !Array.isArray(v.new)) return null
  let rest: { wake_on: string[] } | null = null
  if (v.rest !== null) {
    if (!isObj(v.rest) || !Array.isArray(v.rest.wake_on) || !v.rest.wake_on.every((w) => typeof w === 'string')) return null
    rest = { wake_on: [...(v.rest.wake_on as string[])] }
  }
  const items: CollabKnockItem[] = []
  for (const x of v.new) {
    const item = parseItem(x)
    if (!item) return null
    items.push(item)
  }
  return { protocol: COLLAB_KNOCK_PROTOCOL, session_id: v.session_id, liveness: v.liveness as CollabKnockReport['liveness'],
    rest, waiting: v.waiting, new: items }
}

/** A sender the hub stamped shows as `<device>/<user>`; any other sender, or none, is `air` (§8 item 4). An index entry
 *  that would not make a valid origin is dropped, never shown as `air`, which would name the wrong Mac. */
function originOf(item: CollabKnockItem, index: Map<string, { device: string; user: string }>): string | null {
  const sender = typeof item.from_session_id === 'string' ? index.get(item.from_session_id) : undefined
  if (!sender) return 'air'
  const origin = `${sender.device}/${sender.user}`
  return ORIGIN_RE.test(origin) ? origin : null
}

/**
 * Count 0 when the report is null, when the session ended (defence only: C10 reports only active sessions), when it rests
 * without consenting to addressed wakes (every remote rest in Phase 1, R29), or when nothing is new. Otherwise count is the
 * number of `new` items (at most 999), seqs are theirs (P41), and origins come from those same items, deduplicated, at most 3.
 */
export function mapKnock(r: CollabKnockReport | null, index: Map<string, { device: string; user: string }>): { count: number; origins: string[]; seqs: number[] } {
  const none = { count: 0, origins: [] as string[], seqs: [] as number[] }
  if (r === null || r.liveness === 'ended' || r.new.length === 0) return none
  if (r.liveness === 'resting' && !(r.rest?.wake_on.includes('addressed') ?? false)) return none
  const items = r.new.slice(0, MAX_KNOCK_COUNT)
  const origins: string[] = []
  for (const item of items) {
    if (origins.length >= MAX_ORIGINS) break
    const origin = originOf(item, index)
    if (origin !== null && !origins.includes(origin)) origins.push(origin)
  }
  return { count: items.length, origins, seqs: items.map((i) => i.seq) }
}

/** C10's read (§8 item 3): the session by id, marking what it reports, with each item's sender, on the shared journal. */
export function knocksArgs(sessionId: string, journal: string): string[] {
  return ['knocks', '--session', sessionId, '--mark-tapped', '--with-sender', '--db', journal]
}

/**
 * `timeoutMs` is what remains of the pipe's knocks budget on the hub's clock. Under 1 s the read never starts, so nothing
 * is marked (§8 item 3); otherwise the host CLI gets 200 ms less, and a failed, timed-out or unparsable run, or a report
 * about another session, is count 0.
 */
export async function knockReportFor(sessionId: string, timeoutMs: number,
  o: { hostCli: HostCli; journal: string; index(): Map<string, { device: string; user: string }> }): Promise<HubKnockReportMsg> {
  if (!Number.isFinite(timeoutMs) || timeoutMs < TIMING.knocksMinRemainingMs) return { t: 'knock_report', expired: true }
  const quiet: HubKnockReportMsg = { t: 'knock_report', count: 0, origins: [], seqs: [] }
  const budget = Math.min(timeoutMs, TIMING.knocksMaxMs) - KNOCK_CLI_MARGIN_MS
  try {
    const run = await o.hostCli(knocksArgs(sessionId, o.journal), budget)
    if (run.code !== 0) return quiet
    const report = parseKnockReport(run.stdout)
    if (report !== null && report.session_id !== sessionId) return quiet
    return { t: 'knock_report', ...mapKnock(report, o.index()) }
  } catch {
    return quiet
  }
}
```

```ts
// src/air/streams.ts
export interface SeatRef { device: string; user: string; lineage: string; harness: string; entrypoint: string; folder: string; stream: number }
export interface SeatHandlers { call(seat: SeatRef, m: CallMsg): Promise<ResultMsg | 'close'>; cancel(seat: SeatRef, callRef: string): void;
  knocks(seat: SeatRef, m: KnocksMsg): Promise<HubKnockReportMsg> }
export class AttachTable { attach(lineage: string, close: () => void): void; detach(lineage: string, close: () => void): void; has(lineage: string): boolean }
//   attach of an attached lineage calls the older one's close (which sends notice{hub_lost})
export interface LinkSessionDeps { link: DeviceLink; device(): DeviceFile; tools(): { digest: string; list: ToolDef[] }; hubBuild: string;
  store: LineageStore; pool: ChildPool; attachments: AttachTable; handlers: SeatHandlers; status(s: Partial<DeviceStatus>): void;
  onRelayReplaced(): void; ledger(f: LedgerFields): void; mono(): number; now(): Date; stepMs?: number; pingMs?: number; pongDropMs?: number }
export class LinkSession {
  constructor(deps: LinkSessionDeps)
  run(): Promise<void>            // until the link closes, the device is unpaired, or no PONG for pongDropMs (P47)
  close(reason: string): void     // sends notice{code:'link_closing'} on every attached stream, then closes the link (§5.4)
}
//   per stream: attach (≤ 2 KiB; device paired with a seat key; folder → shareForFolder else refused folder_not_shared; retired lineage →
//   refused seat_session_ended; a new lineage when pool.liveCount(device) ≥ 8 → refused lineage_cap; ledger {event:'attach', device,
//   user, lineage, code: entrypoint}) → challenge → prove (≤ 1 KiB, verifySeat else refused seat_proof_failed) → ready {tools_digest,
//   hub_build, skew_s: round((now − attach.clock)/1000), session_hint}, and status({skew_s}) on every ready (§9.9); after ready,
//   tools_refused → status({refused_tools: `${lineage}: ${digest.slice(0, 8)} ${reason}`}) and one ledger line (P51); anything but
//   attach/prove before ready, or a call_ref of another lineage, closes the stream; a stream close → pool.detached(lineage);
//   stream 0: PONG noted; {t:'relay_replaced'} → deps.onRelayReplaced() (the hub's per-device DialPolicy keeps the 10-minute
//   window across links, because the relay exits right after sending it) and the link is treated as dropped
```

  Also consumed: `LedgerFields` (Task 12, the type in `LinkSessionDeps`), `RATES.lineagesPerDevice` (Task 34, the cap of 8, so the number lives in one place), `MAX_HUB_TO_PIPE` (Task 15), and Task 19's `generateSeatKey` and `signSeat` in the test only. `BACKOFF` is not needed here: the backoff after a dropped link is the dial loop's (Task 48). Also produced, beside the signatures above:
  - `LinkSession.notice(code: 'collab_build_changed'): void` — DATA `notice{collab_build_changed}` on every attached stream, the link and its calls untouched. Task 52 needs it for §10.4's "notice{collab_build_changed} to every stream", which `run()` and `close()` alone cannot send.
  - The first proven attach of a lineage the store does not know writes its `LineageEntry` in state `pending` (`session_id`, `credential_path`, `workspace_id`, `pending_start`, `parked`, `detached_since` null, `past_sessions` `[]`, `mirror_id` from `shareForFolder`, `created_at` = `now()`), before `ready`, so the lineage's first call (Task 51) and `pool.liveCount` (Task 40a) always find its seat, folder and mirror. Nothing is written for an attach that never proves its seat.
  - A known lineage whose entry names another device or user is refused `seat_proof_failed` (P29: an impostor or a pipe bug), and one whose entry names another folder is refused `folder_not_shared`, since its session is rooted at that folder's mirror. A device that is not `paired` with a `seat_public` refuses attaches `hub_away`, and at the next PING tick the session runs `close('unpaired')`, which sends `link_closing` to every attached stream and closes the link.
  - The newer proven stream of a lineage takes over at its `ready`, never at its attach (an attach without the key must not knock the real seat off). The stream it replaces gets `notice{hub_lost}` then CLOSE, and its end never calls `pool.detached`, even when it is on another link that ends later (Review Focus 3).
  - `pool.attached(lineage)` on every `ready`; `pool.detached(lineage)` when a ready stream that still holds its lineage closes, from either side or because its link ended.
  - The first PING goes out when `run()` starts, then one every `pingMs`; each tick first drops the link when `mono() − lastPong > pongDropMs` (mono counts sleep, so a long sleep drops it at once, Review Focus 4). A PONG is the only thing that refreshes it.
  - A `call` handler that rejects, and a result whose payload would exceed `MAX_HUB_TO_PIPE`, answer `{t:'result', call_ref, outcome:'unknown'}` (R18: the forwarder had the call); a rejected `knocks` handler answers count 0; `tools_get` answers the current `tools()`. A result that resolves after its stream closed is dropped (the forwarder has ledgered it).
  - Ledger lines beside `attach` and `tools_refused`: `{event:'attach_refused', device, user, lineage, code}` for every refused handshake and `{event:'link_end', device, user, code: <reason>}` once per session (`no_pong`, `relay_replaced`, `link_closed`, `unpaired`, `malformed`, `write_failed`, or the `close()` reason), all within `AIR_LEDGER_KEYS`.
  - An inbound frame over `MAX_PIPE_TO_HUB` refuses that stream `frame_too_large` while it is in its handshake and closes it after; a malformed frame ends the link.

```ts
// Seat streams on the Air (Task 50; spec §5.3, §5.4, §6.1, §6.2, §6.6, §9.9, §12.2 Seats/Children/Link). Each test runs a
// LinkSession over an in-memory DeviceLink whose far end is a scripted relay: it opens streams, sends DATA and CLOSE frames
// as the real relay would (stream ids from 1, stream 0 for PONG and relay_replaced), and records every frame the hub sends.
import { afterEach, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test'
import { createPrivateKey, type KeyObject } from 'node:crypto'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import type { DeviceFile } from '../src/air/devices.ts'
import { DialPolicy, type DeviceLink } from '../src/air/dialer.ts'
import { LineageStore, type LineageEntry } from '../src/air/lineages.ts'
import type { ChildPool } from '../src/air/pool.ts'
import type { DeviceStatus } from '../src/air/status.ts'
import { AttachTable, LinkSession, type LinkSessionDeps, type SeatHandlers, type SeatRef } from '../src/air/streams.ts'
import type { LedgerFields } from '../src/ledger.ts'

function device(o: Partial<DeviceFile> = {}): DeviceFile {
  return {
    v: 1, device: 'nuance', user: 'macair', state: 'paired', host_alias: 'collab-nuance', seat_public: seat.publicHex,
    bundle_build: 'abcdef01', key_expiry: '20270111', trailer: 'Co-Authored-By: The Fable of the Eternal Universe <Yu@Ai-love.cc>',
    git: { path: '/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin/git', version: '2.39.5', sha256: 'b'.repeat(64), guard: true, apple: true },
    summon: { key_sha256: 'c'.repeat(64), dropin_stat: '1 2 3 0 600' },
    shares: [{ remote_realpath: FOLDER, remote_gitdir: `${FOLDER}/.git`, air_clone: '/Users/yuai/Projects/collab-trial', mirror_id: MIRROR_ID,
      mirror_worktree_id: null, workspace_id: 'ws_0123456789abcdef01234567', caps: { maxEntries: 10_000, maxTotalBytes: 64 << 20, maxBlobBytes: 16 << 20, maxChangedPaths: 128 } }],
    prepared_at: '2026-10-13T10:00:00.000Z', paired_at: '2026-10-13T11:00:00.000Z', ...o,
  }
}

function entry(lineage: string, o: Partial<LineageEntry> = {}): LineageEntry {
  return { lineage, device: 'nuance', user: 'macair', harness: 'claude', folder: FOLDER, state: 'pending', session_id: null,
    credential_path: null, past_sessions: [], mirror_id: MIRROR_ID, workspace_id: null, pending_start: null, parked: null,
    detached_since: null, created_at: NOW.toISOString(), ...o }
}

/** The relay end of the link: what the hub wrote, decoded, plus the frames a relay would send. */
interface Relay {
  link: DeviceLink
  sent: Frame[]                                         // every frame the hub wrote, oldest first
  events: string[]                                      // `data:<stream>:<t>`, `close:<stream>` and `link_closed`, in order
  messages(stream: number): Array<Record<string, unknown>>
  closes(stream: number): number
  open(stream: number): void
  data(stream: number, m: object | Uint8Array): void
  close(stream: number): void
  pong(): void
  closedByHub(): boolean
}

function relay(o: { autoPong?: boolean } = {}): Relay {
  let onData: ((chunk: Uint8Array) => void) | null = null
  let shut = false
  let resolveClosed!: (v: { code: number | null; stderr: string }) => void
  const closed = new Promise<{ code: number | null; stderr: string }>((r) => { resolveClosed = r })
  const decoder = new FrameDecoder(MAX_HUB_TO_PIPE)
  const sent: Frame[] = []
  const events: string[] = []
  const toHub = (type: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5, stream: number, payload?: Uint8Array) => { if (!shut) onData?.(encodeFrame(type, stream, payload)) }
  const link: DeviceLink = {
    send(bytes) {
      if (shut) throw new Error('link closed')
      for (const f of decoder.push(bytes)) {
        sent.push(f)
        if (f.type === FRAME_TYPE.DATA) events.push(`data:${f.stream}:${String(decodeJson(f.payload)?.t)}`)
        if (f.type === FRAME_TYPE.CLOSE) events.push(`close:${f.stream}`)
        if (f.type === FRAME_TYPE.PING && o.autoPong) queueMicrotask(() => toHub(FRAME_TYPE.PONG, 0))
      }
    },
    onData(cb) { onData = cb },
    close() { if (!shut) { shut = true; events.push('link_closed'); resolveClosed({ code: 0, stderr: '' }) } },
    closed,
  }
  return {
    link, sent, events,
    messages: (stream) => sent.filter((f) => f.type === FRAME_TYPE.DATA && f.stream === stream).map((f) => decodeJson(f.payload)!),
    closes: (stream) => sent.filter((f) => f.type === FRAME_TYPE.CLOSE && f.stream === stream).length,
    open: (stream) => toHub(FRAME_TYPE.OPEN, stream),
    data: (stream, m) => toHub(FRAME_TYPE.DATA, stream, m instanceof Uint8Array ? m : encodeMessage(m as { t: string })),
    close: (stream) => toHub(FRAME_TYPE.CLOSE, stream),
    pong: () => toHub(FRAME_TYPE.PONG, 0),
    closedByHub: () => shut,
  }
}

interface Rig {
  relay: Relay; session: LinkSession; store: LineageStore; attachments: AttachTable; pool: { live: number; calls: string[][] }
  statuses: Array<Partial<DeviceStatus>>; ledger: LedgerFields[]; calls: Array<{ seat: SeatRef; m: CallMsg }>; cancels: string[]
  knocks: Array<{ seat: SeatRef; m: KnocksMsg }>; deps: LinkSessionDeps; run: Promise<void>
}

function rig(o: { dev?: () => DeviceFile; store?: LineageStore; attachments?: AttachTable; handlers?: Partial<SeatHandlers>;
  relay?: Relay; live?: number; deps?: Partial<LinkSessionDeps> } = {}): Rig {
  const r = o.relay ?? relay()
  const store = o.store ?? new LineageStore(join(temp('cb-streams-'), 'lineages.json'))
  store.load()                                         // a missing file is an empty store
  const pool = { live: o.live ?? 0, calls: [] as string[][] }
  const fakePool = {
    liveCount: (d: string) => { pool.calls.push(['liveCount', d]); return pool.live },
    attached: (l: string) => { pool.calls.push(['attached', l]) },
    detached: (l: string) => { pool.calls.push(['detached', l]) },
  } as unknown as ChildPool
  const statuses: Array<Partial<DeviceStatus>> = []
  const ledger: LedgerFields[] = []
  const calls: Rig['calls'] = []
  const cancels: string[] = []
  const knocks: Rig['knocks'] = []
  const handlers: SeatHandlers = {
    call: o.handlers?.call ?? (async (s, m) => { calls.push({ seat: s, m }); return { t: 'result', call_ref: m.call_ref, outcome: 'ok', result: { content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'ok' }] } } }),
    cancel: o.handlers?.cancel ?? ((_s, ref) => { cancels.push(ref) }),
    knocks: o.handlers?.knocks ?? (async (s, m) => { knocks.push({ seat: s, m }); return { t: 'knock_report', count: 1, origins: ['air'], seqs: [4] } }),
  }
  const attachments = o.attachments ?? new AttachTable()
  const deps: LinkSessionDeps = {
    link: r.link, device: o.dev ?? (() => device()), tools: () => ({ digest: DIGEST, list: [] }), hubBuild: '1234abcd',
    store, pool: fakePool, attachments, handlers, status: (s) => { statuses.push(s) }, onRelayReplaced: () => {},
    ledger: (f) => { ledger.push(f) }, mono: () => performance.now(), now: () => NOW, stepMs: 5_000, pingMs: 15_000, pongDropMs: 45_000,
    ...o.deps,
  }
  const session = new LinkSession(deps)
  const run = session.run()
  return { relay: r, session, store, attachments, pool, statuses, ledger, calls, cancels, knocks, deps, run }
}

function attachMsg(lineage: string, o: Record<string, unknown> = {}) {
  return { t: 'attach', v: 1, lineage, harness: 'claude', entrypoint: 'cli', folder: FOLDER, pipe_build: 'abcdef01',
    tools_digest: 'b'.repeat(64), clock: NOW.toISOString(), ...o }
}

/** OPEN, attach, then a prove signed by `key` over the challenge; returns the last message the hub sent on the stream. */
function handshake(r: Relay, stream: number, lineage: string, o: { key?: KeyObject; attach?: Record<string, unknown> } = {}) {
  r.open(stream)
  r.data(stream, attachMsg(lineage, o.attach))
  const challenge = r.messages(stream).find((m) => m.t === 'challenge')
  if (challenge) r.data(stream, { t: 'prove', sig: signSeat(o.key ?? SEAT_PRIV, 'nuance', 'macair', lineage, challenge.nonce as string) })
  return r.messages(stream).at(-1)
}

const until = async (cond: () => boolean, ms = 2000) => {
  const end = performance.now() + ms
  while (!cond()) {
    if (performance.now() > end) throw new Error('condition not met in time')
    await Bun.sleep(2)
  }
}

describe('the handshake', () => {
  test("attach, challenge, prove, ready with the lineage's session hint", async () => {
    const t = rig()
    const known = newLineage()
    t.store.upsert(entry(known, { state: 'live', session_id: 'session_1', credential_path: '/tmp/session_1.json', workspace_id: 'ws_1' }))
    const fresh = newLineage()
    t.relay.open(1)
    t.relay.data(1, attachMsg(known))
    const challenge = t.relay.messages(1)[0]!
    expect(challenge.t).toBe('challenge')
    expect(challenge.nonce).toMatch(/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/)
    t.relay.data(1, { t: 'prove', sig: signSeat(SEAT_PRIV, 'nuance', 'macair', known, challenge.nonce as string) })
    expect(t.relay.messages(1)[1]).toEqual({ t: 'ready', tools_digest: DIGEST, hub_build: '1234abcd', skew_s: 0, session_hint: { session_id: 'session_1', workspace_id: 'ws_1' } })
    // A brand-new lineage gets no hint, and the store records it as pending with the share's mirror, so its first call has an entry.
    expect(handshake(t.relay, 2, fresh)).toMatchObject({ t: 'ready', session_hint: null })
    expect(t.store.get(fresh)).toEqual(entry(fresh))
    expect(t.attachments.has(known) && t.attachments.has(fresh)).toBe(true)
    expect(t.pool.calls).toContainEqual(['attached', known])
    // The relay closes stream 1 (the pipe went away): the lineage detaches, and its 10-minute window starts.
    t.relay.close(1)
    expect(t.attachments.has(known)).toBe(false)
    expect(t.pool.calls).toContainEqual(['detached', known])
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })

  test('a wrong proof is refused seat_proof_failed and the stream closes', async () => {
    const t = rig()
    const lineage = newLineage()
    expect(handshake(t.relay, 1, lineage, { key: OTHER_PRIV })).toEqual({ t: 'refused', code: 'seat_proof_failed' })
    expect(t.relay.closes(1)).toBe(1)
    expect(t.attachments.has(lineage)).toBe(false)
    expect(t.store.get(lineage)).toBeUndefined() // nothing is written for an unproven seat
    expect(t.pool.calls.filter((c) => c[0] === 'attached')).toEqual([])
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })

  test('an attach over 2 KiB and a prove over 1 KiB are refused frame_too_large', async () => {
    const t = rig()
    t.relay.open(1)
    t.relay.data(1, attachMsg(newLineage(), { pad: 'x'.repeat(2048) }))
    expect(t.relay.messages(1)).toEqual([{ t: 'refused', code: 'frame_too_large' }])
    expect(t.relay.closes(1)).toBe(1)
    t.relay.open(2)
    t.relay.data(2, attachMsg(newLineage()))
    t.relay.data(2, { t: 'prove', sig: 'f'.repeat(128), pad: 'x'.repeat(1024) })
    expect(t.relay.messages(2).map((m) => m.t)).toEqual(['challenge', 'refused'])
    expect(t.relay.messages(2)[1]).toEqual({ t: 'refused', code: 'frame_too_large' })
    expect(t.relay.closes(2)).toBe(1)
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })

  test('a step past 5 s closes the stream', async () => {
    const t = rig({ deps: { stepMs: 30 } })            // 30 ms stands in for the 5 s step
    t.relay.open(1)                                    // no attach
    t.relay.open(2)
    t.relay.data(2, attachMsg(newLineage()))           // a challenge, then no prove
    await until(() => t.relay.closes(1) === 1 && t.relay.closes(2) === 1)
    expect(t.relay.messages(1)).toEqual([])
    expect(t.relay.messages(2).map((m) => m.t)).toEqual(['challenge'])
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })

  test('a call before ready closes the stream', async () => {
    const t = rig()
    const lineage = newLineage()
    const call = { t: 'call', call_ref: `${lineage}:0a0b0c0d:1`, name: 'collab_next', arguments: {}, timeout_ms: 60_000 }
    t.relay.open(1)
    t.relay.data(1, call)                              // before attach
    t.relay.open(2)
    t.relay.data(2, attachMsg(lineage))
    t.relay.data(2, call)                              // after attach, before prove
    expect(t.relay.closes(1)).toBe(1)
    expect(t.relay.closes(2)).toBe(1)
    expect(t.calls).toEqual([])
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })

  test('a tools_get or knocks before ready closes the stream and reaches no handler', async () => {
    // §5.4: "A `call`, `tools_get` or `knocks` before `ready` closes the stream."
    const t = rig()
    const lineage = newLineage()
    const early = [{ t: 'tools_get', digest: DIGEST }, { t: 'knocks', timeout_ms: 1800 }]
    early.forEach((m, i) => {                          // before attach: streams 1 and 2
      t.relay.open(1 + i)
      t.relay.data(1 + i, m)
    })
    early.forEach((m, i) => {                          // after attach, before prove: streams 3 and 4
      t.relay.open(3 + i)
      t.relay.data(3 + i, attachMsg(lineage))
      t.relay.data(3 + i, m)
    })
    await Bun.sleep(5)                                 // a wrongly dispatched knocks would answer after a microtask
    for (const n of [1, 2, 3, 4]) expect(t.relay.closes(n)).toBe(1)
    expect(t.relay.messages(1)).toEqual([])            // no tools list, no knock_report
    expect(t.relay.messages(2)).toEqual([])
    expect(t.relay.messages(3).map((m) => m.t)).toEqual(['challenge'])
    expect(t.relay.messages(4).map((m) => m.t)).toEqual(['challenge'])
    expect(t.knocks).toEqual([])
    expect(t.attachments.has(lineage)).toBe(false)
    expect(t.pool.calls.filter((c) => c[0] === 'attached')).toEqual([])
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })

  test('a folder that is not a device share is refused folder_not_shared', async () => {
    const t = rig()
    t.relay.open(1)
    t.relay.data(1, attachMsg(newLineage(), { folder: '/Users/macair/Projects/elsewhere' }))
    expect(t.relay.messages(1)).toEqual([{ t: 'refused', code: 'folder_not_shared' }])
    expect(t.relay.closes(1)).toBe(1)
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })

  test('a retired lineage is refused seat_session_ended', async () => {
    const t = rig()
    const lineage = newLineage()
    t.store.upsert(entry(lineage, { state: 'retired', past_sessions: ['session_old'], detached_since: '2026-10-01T00:00:00.000Z' }))
    t.relay.open(1)
    t.relay.data(1, attachMsg(lineage))
    expect(t.relay.messages(1)).toEqual([{ t: 'refused', code: 'seat_session_ended' }])
    expect(t.relay.closes(1)).toBe(1)
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })

  test('a ninth new lineage is lineage_cap, a reattach of a live one is not', async () => {
    const t = rig({ live: 8 })
    const known = newLineage()
    t.store.upsert(entry(known, { state: 'live', session_id: 'session_1', credential_path: '/tmp/session_1.json', workspace_id: 'ws_1' }))
    t.relay.open(1)
    t.relay.data(1, attachMsg(newLineage()))
    expect(t.relay.messages(1)).toEqual([{ t: 'refused', code: 'lineage_cap' }])
    expect(handshake(t.relay, 2, known)).toMatchObject({ t: 'ready' })
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })

  test('a lineage of another seat or another folder is refused', async () => {
    const t = rig()
    const foreign = newLineage()
    const moved = newLineage()
    t.store.upsert(entry(foreign, { device: 'zerone', user: 'yu' }))
    t.store.upsert(entry(moved, { folder: '/Users/macair/Projects/other' }))
    t.relay.open(1)
    t.relay.data(1, attachMsg(foreign))
    t.relay.open(2)
    t.relay.data(2, attachMsg(moved))
    expect(t.relay.messages(1)).toEqual([{ t: 'refused', code: 'seat_proof_failed' }])
    expect(t.relay.messages(2)).toEqual([{ t: 'refused', code: 'folder_not_shared' }])
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })

  test('the attach ledger line records the entrypoint label', async () => {
    const t = rig()
    const lineage = newLineage()
    handshake(t.relay, 1, lineage, { attach: { entrypoint: 'unknown' } })
    expect(t.ledger).toContainEqual({ event: 'attach', device: 'nuance', user: 'macair', lineage, code: 'unknown' })
    const keys = new Set(t.ledger.flatMap((f) => Object.keys(f)))
    for (const k of keys) expect(['event', 'device', 'user', 'lineage', 'code']).toContain(k)
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })

  test('ready carries the skew and a 61 s skew is written to the device status', async () => {
    const t = rig()
    const ready = handshake(t.relay, 1, newLineage(), { attach: { clock: new Date(NOW.getTime() - 61_000).toISOString() } })
    expect(ready).toMatchObject({ t: 'ready', skew_s: 61 })
    expect(t.statuses).toContainEqual({ skew_s: 61 })
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })
})

describe('one attach per lineage', () => {
  test('a second attach of one lineage sends hub_lost to the first', async () => {
    const t = rig()
    const lineage = newLineage()
    handshake(t.relay, 1, lineage)
    expect(handshake(t.relay, 2, lineage)).toMatchObject({ t: 'ready' })
    expect(t.relay.messages(1).at(-1)).toEqual({ t: 'notice', code: 'hub_lost' })
    expect(t.relay.closes(1)).toBe(1)
    // The newer stream still holds the lineage: the older one's end never detaches it.
    expect(t.attachments.has(lineage)).toBe(true)
    expect(t.pool.calls.filter((c) => c[0] === 'detached')).toEqual([])
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })

  test("a reattach on a new link keeps the lineage attached when the old link ends", async () => {
    // Review Focus 3: after a Wi-Fi drop the pipe re-attaches through a new relay, possibly before the hub has noticed
    // that the old link is dead; the old link's end must not start the lineage's detach window.
    const attachments = new AttachTable()
    const old = rig({ attachments })
    const lineage = newLineage()
    handshake(old.relay, 1, lineage)
    const fresh = rig({ attachments, store: old.store })
    expect(handshake(fresh.relay, 1, lineage)).toMatchObject({ t: 'ready' })
    old.relay.data(0, { t: 'relay_replaced' })
    await old.run
    expect(attachments.has(lineage)).toBe(true)
    expect(old.pool.calls.filter((c) => c[0] === 'detached')).toEqual([])
    fresh.session.close('test')
    await fresh.run
  })

  test('a newer attach on another link wins too, and the AttachTable keeps only the newest', () => {
    const table = new AttachTable()
    const closed: string[] = []
    const first = () => closed.push('first')
    const second = () => closed.push('second')
    table.attach('lin_x', first)
    table.attach('lin_x', second)
    expect(closed).toEqual(['first'])
    table.detach('lin_x', first)                       // a late detach of the loser changes nothing
    expect(table.has('lin_x')).toBe(true)
    table.detach('lin_x', second)
    expect(table.has('lin_x')).toBe(false)
  })
})

describe('after ready', () => {
  test('calls, cancels, knocks and tools_get reach their handlers and answer on the same stream', async () => {
    const t = rig()
    const lineage = newLineage()
    handshake(t.relay, 3, lineage)
    t.relay.data(3, { t: 'call', call_ref: `${lineage}:0a0b0c0d:1`, name: 'collab_next', arguments: { workspace_id: 'ws_1' }, timeout_ms: 60_000 })
    t.relay.data(3, { t: 'cancel', call_ref: `${lineage}:0a0b0c0d:1` })
    t.relay.data(3, { t: 'knocks', timeout_ms: 1800 })
    t.relay.data(3, { t: 'tools_get', digest: DIGEST })
    await until(() => t.relay.messages(3).filter((m) => m.t === 'result' || m.t === 'knock_report').length === 2)
    expect(t.calls).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(t.calls[0]!.seat).toEqual({ device: 'nuance', user: 'macair', lineage, harness: 'claude', entrypoint: 'cli', folder: FOLDER, stream: 3 })
    expect(t.cancels).toEqual([`${lineage}:0a0b0c0d:1`])
    expect(t.knocks[0]!.m).toEqual({ t: 'knocks', timeout_ms: 1800 })
    const out = t.relay.messages(3)
    expect(out).toContainEqual({ t: 'result', call_ref: `${lineage}:0a0b0c0d:1`, outcome: 'ok', result: { content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'ok' }] } })
    expect(out).toContainEqual({ t: 'knock_report', count: 1, origins: ['air'], seqs: [4] })
    expect(out).toContainEqual({ t: 'tools', digest: DIGEST, list: [] })
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })

  test('a handler that throws, or a result too large for one frame, answers unknown and never drops the call', async () => {
    const big: ResultMsg = { t: 'result', call_ref: '', outcome: 'ok', result: { content: [{ type: 'text', text: 'x'.repeat(MAX_HUB_TO_PIPE) }] } }
    const t = rig({ handlers: {
      call: async (_s, m) => { if (m.name === 'collab_task_list') return { ...big, call_ref: m.call_ref }; throw new Error('forwarder bug') },
      knocks: async (): Promise<HubKnockReportMsg> => { throw new Error('knock bug') },
    } })
    const lineage = newLineage()
    handshake(t.relay, 1, lineage)
    t.relay.data(1, { t: 'call', call_ref: `${lineage}:0a0b0c0d:1`, name: 'collab_next', arguments: {}, timeout_ms: 60_000 })
    t.relay.data(1, { t: 'call', call_ref: `${lineage}:0a0b0c0d:2`, name: 'collab_task_list', arguments: {}, timeout_ms: 60_000 })
    t.relay.data(1, { t: 'knocks', timeout_ms: 1800 })
    await until(() => t.relay.messages(1).filter((m) => m.t === 'result' || m.t === 'knock_report').length === 3)
    const out = t.relay.messages(1)
    expect(out).toContainEqual({ t: 'result', call_ref: `${lineage}:0a0b0c0d:1`, outcome: 'unknown' })
    expect(out).toContainEqual({ t: 'result', call_ref: `${lineage}:0a0b0c0d:2`, outcome: 'unknown' })
    expect(out).toContainEqual({ t: 'knock_report', count: 0, origins: [], seqs: [] })
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })

  test('a call_ref of another lineage closes the stream', async () => {
    const t = rig()
    const lineage = newLineage()
    handshake(t.relay, 1, lineage)
    t.relay.data(1, { t: 'call', call_ref: `${newLineage()}:0a0b0c0d:1`, name: 'collab_next', arguments: {}, timeout_ms: 60_000 })
    expect(t.relay.closes(1)).toBe(1)
    expect(t.calls).toEqual([])
    expect(t.pool.calls).toContainEqual(['detached', lineage])
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })

  test("a pipe's tools_refused shows in the device status", async () => {
    const t = rig()
    const lineage = newLineage()
    handshake(t.relay, 1, lineage)
    t.relay.data(1, { t: 'tools_refused', digest: 'f'.repeat(64), reason: 'digest_mismatch' })
    expect(t.statuses).toContainEqual({ refused_tools: `${lineage}: ffffffff digest_mismatch` })
    expect(t.ledger).toContainEqual({ event: 'tools_refused', device: 'nuance', user: 'macair', lineage, code: 'digest_mismatch' })
    expect(t.relay.closes(1)).toBe(0)
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })
})

describe('the link', () => {
  test('PINGs go out every 15 s and a link with no PONG for 45 s is dropped', async () => {
    // At a 1/1000 scale: PING every 15 ms, dropped after 45 ms without a PONG.
    const answered = rig({ relay: relay({ autoPong: true }), deps: { pingMs: 15, pongDropMs: 45 } })
    await Bun.sleep(160)
    expect(answered.relay.closedByHub()).toBe(false)
    expect(answered.relay.sent.filter((f) => f.type === FRAME_TYPE.PING).length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(5)
    answered.session.close('test')
    await answered.run
    const silent = rig({ deps: { pingMs: 15, pongDropMs: 45 } })
    const started = performance.now()
    await silent.run
    const took = performance.now() - started
    expect(took).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(45)
    expect(took).toBeLessThan(1000)
    expect(silent.relay.closedByHub()).toBe(true)
    expect(silent.ledger).toContainEqual({ event: 'link_end', device: 'nuance', user: 'macair', code: 'no_pong' })
  })

  test('a 30-minute jump of the monotonic clock drops the link at the next tick', async () => {
    // Review Focus 4: mono counts sleep, so a Mac that slept with the link up drops it at once instead of trusting it.
    let jump = 0
    const t = rig({ relay: relay({ autoPong: true }), deps: { pingMs: 10, mono: () => performance.now() + jump } })
    await Bun.sleep(40)
    expect(t.relay.closedByHub()).toBe(false)
    jump = 30 * 60 * 1000
    await t.run
    expect(t.ledger).toContainEqual({ event: 'link_end', device: 'nuance', user: 'macair', code: 'no_pong' })
  })

  test('four successive LinkSessions on one device sharing one DialPolicy, each ending with relay_replaced, set relay_contested on the fourth', async () => {
    const policy = new DialPolicy({ mono: () => 1_000, now: () => NOW, rand: () => 0.5 })
    const statuses: Array<Partial<DeviceStatus>> = []
    const status = (s: Partial<DeviceStatus>) => { statuses.push(s) }
    for (let i = 1; i <= 4; i++) {
      const t = rig({ deps: { status, onRelayReplaced: () => { if (policy.noteRelayReplaced()) status({ relay_contested: true }) } } })
      handshake(t.relay, 1, newLineage())
      t.relay.data(0, { t: 'relay_replaced' })
      await t.run                                      // the relay exits right after sending it: the link is dropped
      expect(t.relay.closedByHub()).toBe(true)
      expect(statuses.filter((s) => s.relay_contested === true)).toHaveLength(i === 4 ? 1 : 0)
    }
  })

  test('close sends link_closing to every attached stream before the link closes', async () => {
    const t = rig()
    handshake(t.relay, 1, newLineage())
    handshake(t.relay, 2, newLineage())
    t.relay.open(3)                                    // still in its handshake: not attached, gets nothing
    t.session.close('hub_off')
    await t.run
    const closing = t.relay.events.filter((e) => e.endsWith(':notice') || e === 'link_closed')
    expect(closing).toEqual(['data:1:notice', 'data:2:notice', 'link_closed'])
    expect(t.relay.messages(1).at(-1)).toEqual({ t: 'notice', code: 'link_closing' })
    expect(t.relay.messages(3)).toEqual([])
  })

  test('notice sends collab_build_changed to every attached stream and keeps the link', async () => {
    const t = rig()
    handshake(t.relay, 1, newLineage())
    handshake(t.relay, 2, newLineage())
    t.relay.open(3)
    t.session.notice('collab_build_changed')
    expect(t.relay.messages(1).at(-1)).toEqual({ t: 'notice', code: 'collab_build_changed' })
    expect(t.relay.messages(2).at(-1)).toEqual({ t: 'notice', code: 'collab_build_changed' })
    expect(t.relay.messages(3)).toEqual([])
    expect(t.relay.closedByHub()).toBe(false)
    t.session.close('test')
    await t.run
  })

  test('an unpaired device refuses new attaches with hub_away and ends the session at the next tick', async () => {
    let state: DeviceFile['state'] = 'paired'
    const t = rig({ dev: () => device({ state, seat_public: state === 'paired' ? seat.publicHex : null }), deps: { pingMs: 20 } })
    handshake(t.relay, 1, newLineage())
    state = 'unpaired'
    t.relay.open(2)
    t.relay.data(2, attachMsg(newLineage()))
    expect(t.relay.messages(2)).toEqual([{ t: 'refused', code: 'hub_away' }])
    await t.run
    expect(t.relay.messages(1).at(-1)).toEqual({ t: 'notice', code: 'link_closing' })
    expect(t.relay.closedByHub()).toBe(true)
  })
})
```
