`/Users/yuai/Projects/.worktrees/agenttool-collab-bridge/packages/collab-bridge/src/air/streams.ts`:

```ts
// Seat streams on the Air (C7; spec §5.4, §6.1, §6.2, §6.6, §9.9). One LinkSession serves one ssh link to one device:
// the relay opens a stream per local pipe connection, and each stream must attach, answer a fresh challenge with its seat
// key and be told `ready` before anything else; any other message before ready closes it (§5.4). Device and user come
// from the link and the device file, never from the stream (§6.1). Only one stream per lineage is attached: the newest
// proven one wins and the older gets notice{hub_lost} (§6.2). The session PINGs on stream 0, drops a link whose PONGs
// stopped (P47), and treats the relay's relay_replaced as the end of the link (§5.3).
import type { LedgerFields } from '../ledger.ts'
import { FRAME_TYPE, FrameMalformed, FrameTooLarge, type Frame } from '../link/frame.ts'
import { Mux } from '../link/mux.ts'
import {
  callRefLineage, decodeJson, encodeMessage, MAX_ATTACH_BYTES, MAX_HANDSHAKE_BYTES, MAX_HUB_TO_PIPE, MAX_PIPE_TO_HUB,
  newChallengeNonce, parseAttach, parseCall, parseCancel, parseKnocks, parseProve, parseToolsGet, parseToolsRefused,
  type AttachMsg, type CallMsg, type ChallengeMsg, type HubKnockReportMsg, type KnocksMsg, type NoticeMsg, type ReadyMsg, type RefusedCode,
  type RefusedMsg, type ResultMsg, type ToolDef, type ToolsMsg,
} from '../link/messages.ts'
import { scaled, TIMING } from '../timing.ts'
import { shareForFolder, type DeviceFile } from './devices.ts'
import type { DeviceLink } from './dialer.ts'
import { RATES } from './limits.ts'
import type { LineageEntry, LineageStore } from './lineages.ts'
import type { ChildPool } from './pool.ts'
import { verifySeat } from './seats.ts'
import type { DeviceStatus } from './status.ts'

export interface SeatRef { device: string; user: string; lineage: string; harness: string; entrypoint: string; folder: string; stream: number }
export interface SeatHandlers { call(seat: SeatRef, m: CallMsg): Promise<ResultMsg | 'close'>; cancel(seat: SeatRef, callRef: string): void;
  knocks(seat: SeatRef, m: KnocksMsg): Promise<HubKnockReportMsg> }

/**
 * Which stream holds each lineage, across every link of the hub (§6.2: the newest wins). attach() of a lineage that is
 * already attached registers the new holder first, then calls the older one's close, which sends notice{hub_lost}.
 * detach() removes a holder only while it is still the registered one, so a late detach of a loser changes nothing.
 */
export class AttachTable {
  private readonly holders = new Map<string, () => void>()

  attach(lineage: string, close: () => void): void {
    const older = this.holders.get(lineage)
    this.holders.set(lineage, close)
    if (older !== undefined && older !== close) older()
  }

  detach(lineage: string, close: () => void): void {
    if (this.holders.get(lineage) === close) this.holders.delete(lineage)
  }

  has(lineage: string): boolean {
    return this.holders.has(lineage)
  }
}

export interface LinkSessionDeps { link: DeviceLink; device(): DeviceFile; tools(): { digest: string; list: ToolDef[] }; hubBuild: string;
  store: LineageStore; pool: ChildPool; attachments: AttachTable; handlers: SeatHandlers; status(s: Partial<DeviceStatus>): void;
  onRelayReplaced(): void; ledger(f: LedgerFields): void; mono(): number; now(): Date; stepMs?: number; pingMs?: number; pongDropMs?: number }

type Phase = 'attach' | 'prove' | 'ready' | 'closed'
interface Stream {
  id: number
  phase: Phase
  attach: AttachMsg | null
  nonce: string | null
  seat: SeatRef | null
  timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null
  replaced: boolean            // a newer stream of the same lineage won: this one's end never detaches the lineage
  holder: (() => void) | null  // what the AttachTable calls when a newer stream wins
}

/** Everything the hub says on a seat stream (§5.4's hub → pipe rows). */
type HubToPipe = ChallengeMsg | ReadyMsg | RefusedMsg | ResultMsg | ToolsMsg | HubKnockReportMsg | NoticeMsg

const quietKnocks = (): HubKnockReportMsg => ({ t: 'knock_report', count: 0, origins: [], seqs: [] })

export class LinkSession {
  private readonly mux: Mux
  private readonly streams = new Map<number, Stream>()
  private readonly stepMs: number
  private readonly pingMs: number
  private readonly pongDropMs: number
  private lastPong = 0
  private pinger: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null
  private started = false
  private ended = false
  private resolveDone!: () => void
  private readonly done: Promise<void>

  constructor(private readonly deps: LinkSessionDeps) {
    // Inbound frames are pipe → hub: the relay already closes a local connection whose frame is over 2 MiB (§6.6).
    this.mux = new Mux({ write: (b) => this.write(b), maxInbound: MAX_PIPE_TO_HUB })
    this.stepMs = deps.stepMs ?? scaled(TIMING.handshakeStepMs)
    this.pingMs = deps.pingMs ?? scaled(TIMING.pingMs)
    this.pongDropMs = deps.pongDropMs ?? scaled(TIMING.pongDropMs)
    this.done = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { this.resolveDone = resolve })
  }

  /** Serves the link until it closes, the device is unpaired, no PONG came for pongDropMs (P47) or the relay was replaced. */
  run(): Promise<void> {
    if (this.started || this.ended) return this.done
    this.started = true
    this.lastPong = this.deps.mono()
    this.deps.link.onData((chunk) => this.onBytes(chunk))
    void this.deps.link.closed.then(() => this.end('link_closed'), () => this.end('link_closed'))
    this.mux.ping() // the first PING at once, so the relay and its pipes count freshness from now (§5.3)
    this.pinger = setInterval(() => this.tick(), this.pingMs)
    return this.done
  }

  /** The hub is stopping or the device left (§5.4): every attached stream hears link_closing, then the link closes. */
  close(reason: string): void {
    if (this.ended) return
    for (const s of this.streams.values()) if (s.phase === 'ready') this.send(s, { t: 'notice', code: 'link_closing' })
    this.end(reason)
  }

  /** §10.4: the Collab build changed under the hub. Every attached stream hears it; the link and its calls go on. */
  notice(code: 'collab_build_changed'): void {
    if (this.ended) return
    for (const s of this.streams.values()) if (s.phase === 'ready') this.send(s, { t: 'notice', code })
  }

  private tick(): void {
    if (this.ended) return
    const d = this.currentDevice()
    if (d !== null && (d.state !== 'paired' || d.seat_public === null)) return this.close('unpaired')
    // §9.7: a Mac asleep or gone stops answering; mono counts sleep, so a long sleep drops the link at once.
    if (this.deps.mono() - this.lastPong > this.pongDropMs) return this.end('no_pong')
    this.mux.ping()
  }

  private onBytes(chunk: Uint8Array): void {
    if (this.ended) return
    let frames: Frame[]
    try {
      frames = this.mux.feed(chunk)
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof FrameTooLarge) {
        for (const f of e.frames) this.onFrame(f)
        return this.oversized(e.stream)
      }
      if (e instanceof FrameMalformed) {
        for (const f of e.frames) this.onFrame(f)
        return this.end('malformed')
      }
      throw e
    }
    for (const f of frames) this.onFrame(f)
  }

  private onFrame(f: Frame): void {
    if (this.ended) return
    if (f.type === FRAME_TYPE.PONG) { this.lastPong = this.deps.mono(); return }
    if (f.type === FRAME_TYPE.OPEN) return this.onOpen(f.stream)
    if (f.type === FRAME_TYPE.CLOSE) {
      const s = this.streams.get(f.stream)
      if (s) this.finish(s)
      return
    }
    if (f.type !== FRAME_TYPE.DATA) return // the relay never PINGs the hub
    if (f.stream === 0) return this.onRelayNote(f.payload)
    const s = this.streams.get(f.stream)
    if (!s || s.phase === 'closed') return
    if (s.phase === 'attach') return this.onAttach(s, f.payload)
    if (s.phase === 'prove') return this.onProve(s, f.payload)
    return this.onSeatMessage(s, f.payload)
  }

  /** §5.3: a newer relay took hub.sock and this one exits right after saying so; the hub's DialPolicy counts these (T5). */
  private onRelayNote(payload: Uint8Array): void {
    if (decodeJson(payload)?.t !== 'relay_replaced') return
    try { this.deps.onRelayReplaced() } catch { /* status only */ }
    this.end('relay_replaced')
  }

  private onOpen(id: number): void {
    if (id === 0 || this.streams.has(id)) return // the relay never reuses an id within a link (§5.3)
    const s: Stream = { id, phase: 'attach', attach: null, nonce: null, seat: null, timer: null, replaced: false, holder: null }
    this.streams.set(id, s)
    this.arm(s)
  }

  /** Each handshake step has 5 s (§5.4); a stream that misses one is closed without an answer. */
  private arm(s: Stream): void {
    this.disarm(s)
    s.timer = setTimeout(() => {
      s.timer = null
      if (s.phase === 'attach' || s.phase === 'prove') this.closeStream(s)
    }, this.stepMs)
  }

  private disarm(s: Stream): void {
    if (s.timer !== null) { clearTimeout(s.timer); s.timer = null }
  }

  private onAttach(s: Stream, payload: Uint8Array): void {
    if (payload.byteLength > MAX_ATTACH_BYTES) return this.refuse(s, 'frame_too_large')
    const a = parseAttach(decodeJson(payload))
    if (!a) return this.closeStream(s) // anything but a well-formed attach first closes the stream (§5.4)
    const d = this.currentDevice()
    if (d === null || d.state !== 'paired' || d.seat_public === null) return this.refuse(s, 'hub_away', a.lineage)
    if (!shareForFolder(d, a.folder)) return this.refuse(s, 'folder_not_shared', a.lineage)
    const known = this.deps.store.get(a.lineage)
    if (known) {
      // A lineage belongs to one seat and one shared folder: its session is rooted at that folder's mirror.
      if (known.device !== d.device || known.user !== d.user) return this.refuse(s, 'seat_proof_failed', a.lineage)
      if (known.folder !== a.folder) return this.refuse(s, 'folder_not_shared', a.lineage)
      if (known.state === 'retired') return this.refuse(s, 'seat_session_ended', a.lineage)
    } else if (this.deps.pool.liveCount(d.device) >= RATES.lineagesPerDevice) {
      // A reattach of a known lineage always comes before a new one (§6.6).
      return this.refuse(s, 'lineage_cap', a.lineage)
    }
    this.ledger({ event: 'attach', device: d.device, user: d.user, lineage: a.lineage, code: a.entrypoint })
    s.attach = a
    s.nonce = newChallengeNonce()
    s.phase = 'prove'
    this.send(s, { t: 'challenge', nonce: s.nonce })
    this.arm(s)
  }

  private onProve(s: Stream, payload: Uint8Array): void {
    const a = s.attach!
    if (payload.byteLength > MAX_HANDSHAKE_BYTES) return this.refuse(s, 'frame_too_large', a.lineage)
    const p = parseProve(decodeJson(payload))
    if (!p) return this.closeStream(s)
    const d = this.currentDevice()
    if (d === null || d.state !== 'paired' || d.seat_public === null) return this.refuse(s, 'hub_away', a.lineage)
    // P29: a wrong signature is a pipe bug or an impostor; the pipe answers its agent hub_away.
    if (!verifySeat(d.seat_public, d.device, d.user, a.lineage, s.nonce!, p.sig)) return this.refuse(s, 'seat_proof_failed', a.lineage)
    const share = shareForFolder(d, a.folder)
    if (!share) return this.refuse(s, 'folder_not_shared', a.lineage) // the device file changed between the two steps
    let entry = this.deps.store.get(a.lineage)
    if (!entry) {
      // The first proven attach records the lineage, so its first call finds its seat, folder and mirror (§6.2).
      entry = { lineage: a.lineage, device: d.device, user: d.user, harness: a.harness, folder: a.folder, state: 'pending',
        session_id: null, credential_path: null, past_sessions: [], mirror_id: share.mirror_id, workspace_id: null,
        pending_start: null, parked: null, detached_since: null, created_at: this.deps.now().toISOString() } satisfies LineageEntry
      try { this.deps.store.upsert(entry) } catch { return this.refuse(s, 'hub_away', a.lineage) }
    }
    this.disarm(s)
    s.seat = { device: d.device, user: d.user, lineage: a.lineage, harness: a.harness, entrypoint: a.entrypoint, folder: a.folder, stream: s.id }
    s.phase = 'ready'
    s.holder = () => {
      s.replaced = true
      this.send(s, { t: 'notice', code: 'hub_lost' })
      this.closeStream(s)
    }
    this.deps.attachments.attach(a.lineage, s.holder)
    this.deps.pool.attached(a.lineage)
    // §9.9: skew is warned about, never bounded; it feeds only the status.
    const skew = Math.round((this.deps.now().getTime() - Date.parse(a.clock)) / 1000) || 0
    const hint = entry.state === 'live' && entry.session_id !== null && entry.workspace_id !== null
      ? { session_id: entry.session_id, workspace_id: entry.workspace_id } : null
    this.send(s, { t: 'ready', tools_digest: this.deps.tools().digest, hub_build: this.deps.hubBuild, skew_s: skew, session_hint: hint })
    this.status({ skew_s: skew })
  }

  private onSeatMessage(s: Stream, payload: Uint8Array): void {
    const seat = s.seat!
    const o = decodeJson(payload)
    switch (o?.t) {
      case 'call': {
        const m = parseCall(o)
        // §9.3 item 2: a call_ref with another lineage's prefix closes the stream.
        if (!m || callRefLineage(m.call_ref) !== seat.lineage) return this.closeStream(s)
        void this.runCall(s, seat, m)
        return
      }
      case 'cancel': {
        const m = parseCancel(o)
        if (!m || callRefLineage(m.call_ref) !== seat.lineage) return this.closeStream(s)
        try { this.deps.handlers.cancel(seat, m.call_ref) } catch { /* the forwarder only ledgers a cancel */ }
        return
      }
      case 'knocks': {
        const m = parseKnocks(o)
        if (!m) return this.closeStream(s)
        void this.runKnocks(s, seat, m)
        return
      }
      case 'tools_get': {
        if (!parseToolsGet(o)) return this.closeStream(s)
        const t = this.deps.tools()
        return this.send(s, { t: 'tools', digest: t.digest, list: t.list })
      }
      case 'tools_refused': {
        const m = parseToolsRefused(o)
        if (!m) return this.closeStream(s)
        // P51: the pipe kept its own list; hub status shows which list it refused and why.
        this.status({ refused_tools: `${seat.lineage}: ${m.digest.slice(0, 8)} ${m.reason}` })
        this.ledger({ event: 'tools_refused', device: seat.device, user: seat.user, lineage: seat.lineage, code: m.reason })
        return
      }
      default:
        return this.closeStream(s)
    }
  }

  /** The forwarder has the call once it is handed over (R18): from here, any failure is `unknown`, never a dropped answer. */
  private async runCall(s: Stream, seat: SeatRef, m: CallMsg): Promise<void> {
    let r: ResultMsg | 'close'
    try {
      r = await this.deps.handlers.call(seat, m)
    } catch {
      r = { t: 'result', call_ref: m.call_ref, outcome: 'unknown' }
    }
    if (s.phase !== 'ready') return // the stream went away meanwhile; the forwarder ledgered the result
    if (r === 'close') return this.closeStream(s)
    const payload = encodeMessage(r)
    // The forwarder checks the 4 MiB frame first; this guard keeps an oversized frame off the link whatever happens (§6.6).
    if (payload.byteLength > MAX_HUB_TO_PIPE) return this.send(s, { t: 'result', call_ref: m.call_ref, outcome: 'unknown' })
    this.mux.data(s.id, payload)
  }

  private async runKnocks(s: Stream, seat: SeatRef, m: KnocksMsg): Promise<void> {
    let r: HubKnockReportMsg
    try {
      r = await this.deps.handlers.knocks(seat, m)
    } catch {
      r = quietKnocks()
    }
    if (s.phase === 'ready') this.send(s, r)
  }

  /** A refused handshake: DATA refused{code}, then CLOSE (§5.4). */
  private refuse(s: Stream, code: RefusedCode, lineage?: string): void {
    this.send(s, { t: 'refused', code })
    const d = this.currentDevice()
    this.ledger({ event: 'attach_refused', device: d?.device, user: d?.user, lineage, code })
    this.closeStream(s)
  }

  private oversized(id: number): void {
    const s = this.streams.get(id)
    if (!s) return
    if (s.phase === 'attach' || s.phase === 'prove') return this.refuse(s, 'frame_too_large', s.attach?.lineage)
    this.closeStream(s)
  }

  /** The hub ends this stream: CLOSE toward the relay, which closes that pipe's connection. */
  private closeStream(s: Stream): void {
    if (s.phase === 'closed') return
    this.mux.close(s.id)
    this.finish(s)
  }

  /** A stream is over, from either side. A ready one that was not replaced detaches its lineage (its child's window starts). */
  private finish(s: Stream): void {
    if (s.phase === 'closed') return
    const wasReady = s.phase === 'ready'
    s.phase = 'closed'
    this.disarm(s)
    this.streams.delete(s.id)
    if (wasReady && !s.replaced && s.seat !== null && s.holder !== null) {
      this.deps.attachments.detach(s.seat.lineage, s.holder)
      this.deps.pool.detached(s.seat.lineage)
    }
  }

  private end(reason: string): void {
    if (this.ended) return
    this.ended = true
    if (this.pinger !== null) { clearInterval(this.pinger); this.pinger = null }
    for (const s of [...this.streams.values()]) this.finish(s)
    const d = this.currentDevice()
    this.ledger({ event: 'link_end', device: d?.device, user: d?.user, code: reason })
    try { this.deps.link.close() } catch { /* already gone */ }
    this.resolveDone()
  }

  private send(s: Stream, m: HubToPipe): void {
    if (s.phase === 'closed') return
    this.mux.data(s.id, encodeMessage(m))
  }

  private write(bytes: Uint8Array): void {
    if (this.ended) return
    try {
      this.deps.link.send(bytes)
    } catch {
      this.end('write_failed')
    }
  }

  private currentDevice(): DeviceFile | null {
    try { return this.deps.device() } catch { return null }
  }

  private ledger(f: LedgerFields): void {
    try { this.deps.ledger(f) } catch { /* the hub runs on without its ledger */ }
  }

  private status(s: Partial<DeviceStatus>): void {
```

```ts
export class Forwarder implements SeatHandlers {
```

  Also produced, beside the signatures above (Task 52 wires them; Tasks 62 and 68 read the ledger lines):
  - `export const FORWARD_MESSAGES` — the one-sentence messages of the Forwarder's own refusals (`duplicate`, `inflight`, `mutations`, `next`, `verify`, `noLineage`, `notPaired`, `noShare`, `ended`, `tampered`, `late`, `stopped`, `unknown`).
  - Ledger lines, all within `AIR_LEDGER_KEYS` and never an argument or a body: `{event:'call', device, user, lineage, tool, call_ref, code: <the registry's verdict>}` on receipt; for a forwarded call `{event:'forward', device, user, lineage, session_id, tool, call_ref, journal}` then `{event:'result', …, outcome: 'ok' | 'error' | 'unknown', code: <Collab's error code or the unknown reason>, bytes, ms}`; for a refusal `{event:'result', …, outcome:'refused', code: <the agent code, or deadline_passed for a call refused at its deadline>}` and no `forward` line; `{event:'cancel', …, call_ref}`; `{event:'workspace_id', device, user, lineage, code: 'recorded' | 'corrected' | 'device_write_failed'}`.
  - The order inside `call`: the deadline fixed on receipt, the call_ref verdict, then the rates (a refused call takes no token and moves no window), then the lineage entry (missing → `hub_away`), the device (not `paired` in the hub's view → `hub_away`), the share (the seat's folder must be a share whose mirror id is the lineage's → `folder_not_shared`), a retired lineage or an ended one on anything but session_start → `seat_session_ended` (Collab itself unbinds on session_end and would answer a later call in legacy mode, P53), then `decide`.
  - A session_start on a lineage whose credential file has vanished (a host end) gets `seat_session_ended` from the pool's `childFor`, which also moves the entry to `ended`; the Forwarder then takes the pending/ended path, so that start begins a new session (P53).
  - The pending/ended path runs under the mirror's lock (the same lock the edit flows take), because Collab registers the mirror as a worktree and runs git in it.
  - Every edit flow and the start check get `{ ...deps.mirrorDeps, alias: device.host_alias }`: the hub keeps one `MirrorDeps`, and each device fetches through its own ssh Host alias.
  - The deadline is checked where the hub can wait (§9.4's budgets assume it does not): after `childFor` (a resume, or a respawn behind a drain that waits for zero in flight), inside the mirror lock (one lock per mirror, shared by every lineage of the seat, held up to the child's 600 s), and inside the pool after its start chain, drains and reconcile. A late call is refused with `structuredContent.reason: 'deadline_passed'` and is never written, so nothing is withdrawn from a child: §9.3 item 4, K28 and K65 stand, the 600000 ms child timer and the no-`notifications/cancelled` rule with them, and a call written before its deadline is never cut short.

Notes for the implementer:
- These Collab answers were read from this tree's tracked dist while the plan was written, and the tests depend on them: a second session_start in a bound process answers `{error: 'session_already_bound', message, session_id}`; a claim over another task's claimed scope answers `path_scope_conflict` with `conflicting_task_id`, `conflicting_workspace_id`, `assignee`, `assignee_session_id`, `lease_expires_at` and `conflicts`; report kinds are `observation`, `inference`, `proposal` and `decision`; `mode: 'ready'` with any `wake_on` answers `invalid_wake_on` ("wake_on applies only to mode \"resting\""); a report addressed to a resting session shows `addressee.delivery` `held`, to a live one `tap`; a same-key replay of a rest returns byte-identical `structuredContent`; Collab stores the role with its trailing space trimmed, which `roleNonce` (Task 33) reads correctly because the nonce sits before it. An argument that fails the SDK's input validation comes back as `{content, isError: true}` with no `structuredContent`, so `errorOf` reads a code only when there is one.
- Both ledger lines of a forwarded call are written once the call has been forwarded and answered: `pool.startSession` and `runEditFlow` decide for themselves whether they forward (a refusal inside them sends nothing), and their `CallOutcome` is the proof that one tools/call was written. There is still exactly one `forward` line per call_ref.
- The limits and waits that need a held or huge Collab answer run on Task 37's fake Collab bin (`writeFakeCollab` into a temp dist, read through the pool exactly as the real one is; it reads its script once at spawn, so each test passes its script to `fakeWorld`): `big` gives a 5 MiB answer, and the `wait_file` kind this task adds holds a call inside the child until the test writes `<dist>/release` (its timer is unref'd, so a pending wait never keeps the fake alive after stdin EOF). The child's own reply cap (Task 37, 4 MiB − 64 KiB) turns a 5 MiB answer into `unknown oversized` before the Forwarder's 4 MiB frame check can see it, and both paths answer `hub_outcome_unknown`.
- The deadline (§5.4, the knocks rule applied to calls): `timeout_ms` is the pipe's own budget, so a call the hub forwards after the pipe has answered `hub_outcome_unknown` would apply after the agent's prescribed check (task_get, not claimed) had already told it otherwise. A refusal that reaches the pipe after its own unknown is ledgered there as `late_result` and the in-flight record stays (P49): the agent's read and a same-key replay then agree that it was not applied. A refusal after a sync leaves the mirror at the fetched commit with nothing forwarded, the same state as Collab's own refusal after a sync (§12.2), so the next same-key call simply resyncs. `TIMING.callMinRemainingMs` (Task 8), `RATES.knocksMinMs` (Task 34), `startSession`'s sixth parameter (Task 40b) and `EditFlowCtx.notAfterMono`/`mono` (Task 45) are those tasks' own.
- Knock reads (T9): each knocks frame would start a bun host CLI on the Air, all writing one knock ledger, and any same-uid Nuance process that holds the seat can send many on one stream (T7). The Forwarder runs at most one read per lineage at a time and starts the next only `RATES.knocksMinMs` after the last; a refused read is count 0, marks nothing, and its note taps at a later turn or shows through collab_next.
- `accepting()` (Task 37) is checked in the same synchronous turn as each plain `child.call` here, so a child stopped between `childFor`'s answer and the forward (a park, an end or a drain) gives `hub_away`, not sent, never an unknown (§9.3 item 3). `pool.startSession` checks it itself before its own writes (Task 40b), and `runEditFlow` checks it before both of its forwards (Task 45).
- `world()` builds the hub's half of one paired Nuance in one process; it repeats Task 42's mirror world (an Air clone, a "Nuance" clone reached through the fake ssh and the source gate, INSTALLED, `shares.json` and the Summon allowlist) and adds the device file, a real `ChildPool` with an injected clock and a 1 s child window, and the Forwarder wired as Task 52 wires it.

```ts
  const mirrors = new MirrorRegistry()
  mirrors.set({ spec, lock: new MirrorLock(), worktreeId: null })
  const devices = new Map([['nuance', device]]) // the hub's in-memory view, reloaded on its own tick (Task 52)
  const deps: ForwardDeps = {
    pool, store, calls: new CallRegistry(), mirrors, mirrorDeps, devices: () => devices, devicePath: (d) => paths.deviceFile(d),
    seatTools: () => SEAT_TOOLS, journal: paths.sharedJournal, ledger, mono: () => clock.mono, now: () => new Date(clock.now),
    knock: (sid, ms) => knockReportFor(sid, ms, { hostCli, journal: paths.sharedJournal, index: () => store.sessionIndex() }),
  }
  const fwd = new Forwarder(deps)
  const w: World = {
    air, paths, airClone, base, nuance, share, spec, mirrorDeps, device, workspaceId, store, pool, mirrors, fwd, deps, hostCli,
    clock, statuses, build,
    seat() {
      // What a seat stream records at its first proven attach (Task 50).
      const lineage = newLineage()
      const e: LineageEntry = {
        lineage, device: 'nuance', user: 'macair', harness: 'claude', folder: share, state: 'pending', session_id: null,
        credential_path: null, past_sessions: [], mirror_id: mirrorId, workspace_id: null, pending_start: null, parked: null,
        detached_since: null, created_at: new Date(clock.now).toISOString(),
      }
      store.upsert(e)
      return { ref: { device: 'nuance', user: 'macair', lineage, harness: 'claude', entrypoint: 'cli', folder: share, stream: 1 }, seq: 0 }
    },
  }
  return w
}

interface CallOpts { declared?: Declared; callRef?: string; timeoutMs?: number }
const ref = (s: Seat) => `${s.ref.lineage}:0000abcd:${s.seq++}`
const msg = (s: Seat, name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>, o: CallOpts = {}): CallMsg =>
  ({ t: 'call', call_ref: o.callRef ?? ref(s), name, arguments: args, timeout_ms: o.timeoutMs ?? 60_000, ...(o.declared ? { declared: o.declared } : {}) })
async function call(w: World, s: Seat, name: string, args: Record<string, unknown> = {}, o: CallOpts = {}): Promise<ResultMsg> {
  const r = await w.fwd.call(s.ref, msg(s, name, args, o))
  if (r === 'close') throw new Error(`${name}: the stream was closed`)
  return r
}
const sc = (r: ResultMsg): Record<string, any> => (r.result?.structuredContent ?? {}) as Record<string, any>
const codeOf = (r: ResultMsg) => sc(r).error
async function start(w: World, s: Seat, args: Record<string, unknown> = { actor: 'claude (Nuance account)', role: 'implementer' }): Promise<ResultMsg> {
  const r = await call(w, s, 'collab_session_start', args)
  w.clock.mono += 1_000 // the next collab_next is never inside its 1 s window by accident
  return r
}
const lines = (w: World, event: string): LedgerEntry[] => readLedger(w.paths.ledger).filter((l) => l.event === event)

/** An Air Claude session in the trial clone on the shared journal, run the hub's way (§10.2 step 4). */
async function airSession(w: World): Promise<{ h: StdioHarness; sessionId: string }> {
  const h = collabHarness({ journal: w.paths.sharedJournal, home: w.air })
  harnesses.push(h)
  await h.initialize()
  const r = await h.callTool('collab_session_start', { root_path: w.airClone, actor: 'air reviewer' })
  if (r.isError) throw new Error(`air session_start: ${r.content[0].text}`)
  return { h, sessionId: r.structuredContent.session.id }
}

async function activeSessions(w: World): Promise<Array<{ id: string; role: string | null }>> {
  const h = collabHarness({ journal: w.paths.sharedJournal, home: w.air })
  try {
    await h.initialize()
    const r = await h.callTool('collab_workspace_status', { workspace_id: w.workspaceId })
    return r.isError ? [] : r.structuredContent.active_sessions
  } finally {
    await h.close()
  }
}

describe('session_start', () => {
  test('a call before session_start is session_required', async () => {
    const w = await world()
    const s = w.seat()
    const r = await call(w, s, 'collab_next', {})
    expect(r.outcome).toBe('error')
    expect(sc(r)).toMatchObject({ error: 'session_required', delivered: false, retry: 'never automatic' })
    expect(lines(w, 'child_start')).toEqual([])
    expect(lines(w, 'forward')).toEqual([])
  }, T)

  test('session_start binds to the mirror, stamps actor and role, and records the mirror worktree id', async () => {
    const w = await world()
    const s = w.seat()
    const r = await start(w, s, { actor: 'claude (Nuance account)', role: 'implementer', root_path: '/etc', repository_key: 'explicit:x' })
    expect(r.outcome).toBe('ok')
    const out = sc(r)
    expect(out.session.actor).toBe('nuance/macair · self-declared: claude (Nuance account)')
    expect(out.session.role).toMatch(/^remote\(nuance\/macair; start=[0-9a-f]{16}\) self-declared: harness=claude; implementer$/)
    expect(out.worktree.root_path).toBe(w.spec.mirrorPath) // root_path injected, the seat's own dropped (§6.3)
    expect(out.worktree.repository_key).toStartWith('local-git:') // no explicit repository_key reached Collab
    expect(out.workspace.id).toBe(w.workspaceId) // P55: pin-device's derived id is Collab's own
    expect(readDevice(w.paths.deviceFile('nuance'))!.shares[0]!.mirror_worktree_id).toBe(out.worktree.id)
    expect(w.mirrors.get('nuance', 'macair', w.spec.mirrorId)!.worktreeId).toBe(out.worktree.id)
    expect(w.store.get(s.ref.lineage)).toMatchObject({ state: 'live', session_id: out.session.id, workspace_id: w.workspaceId, pending_start: null })
  }, T)

  test('the pending_start nonce equals roleNonce of the stamped role', async () => {
    const w = await world()
    const s = w.seat()
    const seen: string[] = []
    const real = w.pool.startSession.bind(w.pool)
    w.pool.startSession = (lineage, args, callRef, nonce, workspaceId, notAfterMono) => {
      seen.push(nonce)
      return real(lineage, args, callRef, nonce, workspaceId, notAfterMono)
    }
    const r = await start(w, s)
    expect(r.outcome).toBe('ok')
    expect(seen.length).toBe(1)
    expect(roleNonce(sc(r).session.role, 'nuance', 'macair')).toBe(seen[0]!)
    const [only] = await activeSessions(w)
    expect(roleNonce(only!.role!, 'nuance', 'macair')).toBe(seen[0]!)
  }, T)

  test('the first claim after the first session_start is not mirror_busy', async () => {
    const w = await world()
    const s = w.seat()
    expect((await start(w, s)).outcome).toBe('ok')
    const created = await call(w, s, 'collab_task_create', { idempotency_key: 'c1', task_id: 't-notes-1', title: 'a note',
      path_scopes: ['notes'], work_mode: 'edit', completion_policy: 'accepted', expected_base_sha: w.base })
    expect(created.outcome).toBe('ok')
    const claimed = await call(w, s, 'collab_task_claim', { task_id: 't-notes-1', idempotency_key: 'k1', expected_version: sc(created).task.version },
      { declared: { head: w.base, branch: 'main', dirty: false } })
    expect(codeOf(claimed)).toBeUndefined()
    expect(claimed.outcome).toBe('ok')
    expect(sc(claimed).task.status).toBe('claimed')
  }, T)

  test('the recorded worktree id never overwrites an unpair written meanwhile', async () => {
    const w = await world()
    const s = w.seat()
    // `collab-bridge unpair` (another process) writes the file; the hub's in-memory view still says paired.
    updateDevice(w.paths.deviceFile('nuance'), (d) => ({ ...d, state: 'unpaired', seat_public: null }))
    const r = await start(w, s)
    expect(r.outcome).toBe('ok')
    const onDisk = readDevice(w.paths.deviceFile('nuance'))!
    expect(onDisk.state).toBe('unpaired')
    expect(onDisk.seat_public).toBeNull()
    expect(onDisk.shares[0]!.mirror_worktree_id).toBeNull()
    expect(lines(w, 'workspace_id')).toEqual([])
  }, T)

  test('a second session_start on a bound lineage, live and after the 10-minute window, answers session_already_bound and leaves exactly one session', async () => {
    const w = await world()
    const s = w.seat()
    const first = await start(w, s)
    expect(first.outcome).toBe('ok')
    const live = await start(w, s)
    expect(live.outcome).toBe('error')
    expect(codeOf(live)).toBe('session_already_bound')
    w.pool.detached(s.ref.lineage)
    w.clock.mono += 1_001 // past the (injected) child window
    await w.pool.tick()
    const resumed = await start(w, s)
    expect(codeOf(resumed)).toBe('session_already_bound')
    expect(lines(w, 'child_start').map((l) => l.code)).toEqual(['fresh', 'resume'])
    const active = (await activeSessions(w)).filter((x) => roleNonce(x.role ?? '', 'nuance', 'macair') !== null)
    expect(active.map((x) => x.id)).toEqual([sc(first).session.id])
  }, T)

  test('after session_end, a call is seat_session_ended and a new session_start starts a new session with a new nonce', async () => {
    const w = await world()
    const s = w.seat()
    const first = await start(w, s)
    const ended = await call(w, s, 'collab_session_end', { reason: 'done' })
    expect(ended.outcome).toBe('ok')
    expect(w.store.get(s.ref.lineage)!.state).toBe('ended')
    const after = await call(w, s, 'collab_next', {})
    expect(sc(after)).toMatchObject({ error: 'seat_session_ended', delivered: false })
    const second = await start(w, s)
    expect(second.outcome).toBe('ok')
    expect(sc(second).session.id).not.toBe(sc(first).session.id)
    expect(roleNonce(sc(second).session.role, 'nuance', 'macair')).not.toBe(roleNonce(sc(first).session.role, 'nuance', 'macair'))
    expect(w.store.get(s.ref.lineage)!.past_sessions).toEqual([sc(first).session.id])
  }, T)

  test('a session_start on a missing or unborn mirror is refused mirror_tampered and never reaches Collab', async () => {
    for (const mode of ['missing', 'unborn'] as const) {
      const w = await world({ mirror: mode })
      const s = w.seat()
      const r = await start(w, s)
      expect([mode, sc(r).error, sc(r).delivered]).toEqual([mode, 'mirror_tampered', false])
      expect(existsSync(w.paths.sharedJournal)).toBe(false) // no child ever opened the shared journal
      expect(lines(w, 'child_start')).toEqual([])
      expect(lines(w, 'forward')).toEqual([])
      expect(w.store.get(s.ref.lineage)!.state).toBe('pending')
    }
  }, T)
})

describe('at most once', () => {
  test('the child sees exactly one call per call_ref; a duplicate is duplicate_call_ref', async () => {
    const w = await world()
    const s = w.seat()
    await start(w, s)
    const callRef = ref(s)
    const args = { idempotency_key: 'k-once', kind: 'observation', body: 'sent once' }
    expect((await call(w, s, 'collab_report_append', args, { callRef })).outcome).toBe('ok')
    const again = await call(w, s, 'collab_report_append', args, { callRef })
    expect(again.outcome).toBe('error')
    expect(sc(again)).toMatchObject({ error: 'duplicate_call_ref', delivered: false, call_ref: callRef })
    const listed = await call(w, s, 'collab_report_list', {})
    expect(sc(listed).reports.filter((x: { body: string }) => x.body === 'sent once').length).toBe(1)
    expect(lines(w, 'forward').filter((l) => l.call_ref === callRef).length).toBe(1)
  }, T)

  test('another lineage\'s call_ref closes the stream', async () => {
    const w = await world()
    const s = w.seat()
    const r = await w.fwd.call(s.ref, { t: 'call', call_ref: `${newLineage()}:0000abcd:0`, name: 'collab_next', arguments: {}, timeout_ms: 60_000 })
    expect(r).toBe('close')
    expect(lines(w, 'forward')).toEqual([])
  }, T)

  test('a cancel is ledgered and never forwarded', async () => {
    const w = await world()
    const s = w.seat()
    await start(w, s)
    const m = msg(s, 'collab_report_append', { idempotency_key: 'k-cancel', kind: 'observation', body: 'not cancelled' })
    const pending = w.fwd.call(s.ref, m)
    w.fwd.cancel(s.ref, m.call_ref)
    const r = await pending
    expect(r !== 'close' && r.outcome).toBe('ok')
    expect(lines(w, 'cancel').map((l) => l.call_ref)).toEqual([m.call_ref])
    const listed = await call(w, s, 'collab_report_list', {})
    expect(sc(listed).reports.some((x: { body: string }) => x.body === 'not cancelled')).toBe(true)
  }, T)
})

describe('deadlines', () => {
  /**
   * A coordination task's claim (an edit flow with nothing to sync, Task 44's planClaim) sent with the 150 s claim timeout
   * while the test holds the mirror lock, as another lineage's capture would; the clock moves `waitedMs` before the lock frees.
   */
  async function heldClaim(w: World, s: Seat, waitedMs: number): Promise<{ r: ResultMsg; callRef: string }> {
    const created = await call(w, s, 'collab_task_create', { idempotency_key: 'c-held', task_id: 't-held', title: 'held', work_mode: 'coordination' })
    expect(created.outcome).toBe('ok')
    let release: (() => void) | undefined
    const held = w.mirrors.get('nuance', 'macair', w.spec.mirrorId)!.lock.run(() => new Promise<void>((r) => { release = r }))
    await until(() => release !== undefined, 'the test to hold the mirror lock')
    const m = msg(s, 'collab_task_claim', { task_id: 't-held', idempotency_key: 'k-held', expected_version: sc(created).task.version }, { timeoutMs: 150_000 })
    const pending = w.fwd.call(s.ref, m)
    w.clock.mono += waitedMs
    release!()
    await held
    const r = await pending
    if (r === 'close') throw new Error('collab_task_claim: the stream was closed')
    return { r, callRef: m.call_ref }
  }

  test('a claim held on the mirror lock until less than a second of its timeout remains is refused hub_away and never forwarded', async () => {
    const w = await world()
    const s = w.seat()
    await start(w, s)
    const { r, callRef } = await heldClaim(w, s, 149_500)
    expect(r.outcome).toBe('error')
    expect(sc(r)).toMatchObject({ error: 'hub_away', delivered: false, reason: 'deadline_passed' })
    expect(lines(w, 'forward').filter((l) => l.call_ref === callRef)).toEqual([])
    expect(lines(w, 'result').filter((l) => l.call_ref === callRef).map((l) => [l.outcome, l.code])).toEqual([['refused', 'deadline_passed']])
    // What the agent's own read then shows agrees: the claim was not applied (§9.3 item 5).
    expect(sc(await call(w, s, 'collab_task_get', { task_id: 't-held' })).task.status).toBe('open')
  }, T)

  test('a claim held on the mirror lock with more than a second left is forwarded and applies', async () => {
    const w = await world()
    const s = w.seat()
    await start(w, s)
    const { r, callRef } = await heldClaim(w, s, 148_000)
    expect(r.outcome).toBe('ok')
    expect(sc(r).task.status).toBe('claimed')
    expect(lines(w, 'forward').filter((l) => l.call_ref === callRef).length).toBe(1)
  }, T)
})

describe('rest and replays', () => {
  test('rest resting then ready succeeds and the addressee hint goes from held to tap', async () => {
    const w = await world()
    const s = w.seat()
    const remote = sc(await start(w, s)).session.id
    const { h } = await airSession(w)
    const note = async (key: string) => (await h.callTool('collab_report_append', { workspace_id: w.workspaceId, idempotency_key: key,
      kind: 'observation', body: 'for nuance', to_session_id: remote })).structuredContent.addressee.delivery
    expect((await call(w, s, 'collab_session_rest', { idempotency_key: 'r1', mode: 'resting' })).outcome).toBe('ok')
    expect(await note('a1')).toBe('held')
    expect((await call(w, s, 'collab_session_rest', { idempotency_key: 'r2', mode: 'ready' })).outcome).toBe('ok')
    expect(await note('a2')).toBe('tap')
  }, T)

  test('wake_on [] on ready still gets Collab\'s invalid_wake_on', async () => {
    const w = await world()
    const s = w.seat()
    await start(w, s)
    const r = await call(w, s, 'collab_session_rest', { idempotency_key: 'r1', mode: 'ready', wake_on: [] })
    expect(r.outcome).toBe('error')
    expect(codeOf(r)).toBe('invalid_wake_on')
    expect(sc(r).retry).toBeUndefined() // Collab's own failure, passed through unchanged
  }, T)

  test('a same-key replay of a rewritten rest returns its receipt', async () => {
    const w = await world()
    const s = w.seat()
    await start(w, s)
    const first = await call(w, s, 'collab_session_rest', { idempotency_key: 'r1', mode: 'resting', wake_on: [] })
    const replay = await call(w, s, 'collab_session_rest', { idempotency_key: 'r1', mode: 'resting' })
    expect(first.outcome).toBe('ok')
    expect(replay.outcome).toBe('ok')
    expect(sc(replay)).toEqual(sc(first))
  }, T)

  test('a remote path_scope_conflict names the bound workspace', async () => {
    const w = await world()
    const s = w.seat()
    await start(w, s)
    const { h } = await airSession(w)
    const a = await h.callTool('collab_task_create', { workspace_id: w.workspaceId, idempotency_key: 'ca', task_id: 'air-notes', title: 'air',
      path_scopes: ['notes'], work_mode: 'edit', completion_policy: 'accepted' })
    expect((await h.callTool('collab_task_claim', { workspace_id: w.workspaceId, task_id: 'air-notes', idempotency_key: 'ka',
      expected_version: a.structuredContent.task.version })).isError).toBeUndefined()
    const b = await call(w, s, 'collab_task_create', { idempotency_key: 'cb', task_id: 'nuance-notes', title: 'nuance',
      path_scopes: ['notes'], work_mode: 'edit', completion_policy: 'accepted', expected_base_sha: w.base })
    const r = await call(w, s, 'collab_task_claim', { task_id: 'nuance-notes', idempotency_key: 'kb', expected_version: sc(b).task.version },
      { declared: { head: w.base, branch: 'main', dirty: false } })
    expect(codeOf(r)).toBe('path_scope_conflict')
    expect(sc(r).conflicting_workspace_id).toBe(w.workspaceId)
    expect(sc(r).conflicting_task_id).toBe('air-notes')
  }, T)
})

describe('child faults and the build', () => {
  test('cursor_reset_required parks the lineage', async () => {
    const w = await world()

    const r = await call(w, s, 'collab_next', { known_cursor: { epoch_id: 'epoch_x', sequence: 99, hash: 'a'.repeat(64) } })

    expect(sc(later)).toMatchObject({ error: 'seat_recovery_required', delivered: false })

    const w = await world()

    w.build.changed = true

    const other = w.seat()
    const r = await start(w, other)
    expect(sc(r)).toMatchObject({ error: 'collab_build_changed', delivered: false })
  }, T)

  test('the ledger has one forward line per call_ref naming the shared journal, and no argument text', async () => {
    const w = await world()

    await start(w, s, { actor: 'ACTOR-SECRET-1', role: 'ROLE-SECRET-2' })
    await call(w, s, 'collab_report_append', { idempotency_key: 'k1', kind: 'observation', body: 'BODY-SECRET-3' })
    await call(w, s, 'collab_task_create', { idempotency_key: 'c1', task_id: 't1', title: 'TITLE-SECRET-4', work_mode: 'coordination' })
    await call(w, s, 'collab_next', {})

    for (const secret of ['ACTOR-SECRET-1', 'ROLE-SECRET-2', 'BODY-SECRET-3', 'TITLE-SECRET-4']) expect(text).not.toContain(secret)
  }, T)

// ---- Task 37's fake Collab bin, for the limits that need a slow or huge answer, and a scripted knock read ----

interface FakeWorld {
  paths: AirPaths; dist: string; fwd: Forwarder; pool: ChildPool; store: LineageStore; seat: Seat; clock: Clock
  release(): void; calls(): string[]
}

/**
 * A lineage that is already live (its credential file present), so the pool resumes it on Task 37's fake Collab dist,
 * which reads its script once at spawn: each test passes its script here. `knock` stands in for the host CLI's knock read.
 */
function fakeWorld(script: FakeScript = {}, o: { knock?: ForwardDeps['knock'] } = {}): FakeWorld {
  const air = temp('cb-fwd-fake-')
  const paths = airPaths(air)
  const dist = writeFakeCollab(temp('cb-fwd-fakedist-'), script)
  const sessionId = 'session_fake'
  mkdirSync(paths.collabSessions, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 })
  writeFileSync(paths.credentialFile(sessionId), '{}\n', { mode: 0o600 })
  const store = new LineageStore(paths.lineages)
  store.load()
  const lineage = newLineage()
  const folder = '/Users/macair/Projects/collab-trial'
  const mirrorId = mirrorIdOf(folder)
  const workspaceId = `ws_${'1'.repeat(24)}`
  store.upsert({ lineage, device: 'nuance', user: 'macair', harness: 'claude', folder, state: 'live', session_id: sessionId,
    credential_path: paths.credentialFile(sessionId), past_sessions: [], mirror_id: mirrorId, workspace_id: workspaceId, pending_start: null,
    parked: null, detached_since: null, created_at: '2026-10-13T13:00:00.000Z' })
  const clock: Clock = { mono: 5_000_000, now: Date.parse('2026-10-13T13:00:00.000Z') }
  const ledger = (f: Parameters<typeof appendLedger>[2]) => { appendLedger(paths.ledger, AIR_LEDGER_KEYS, f) }
  const pool = new ChildPool({
    spec: { bun: process.execPath, dist, journal: paths.sharedJournal, home: air }, store, paths,
    hostCli: makeHostCli({ bun: process.execPath, dist, journal: paths.sharedJournal, home: air }), mono: () => clock.mono,
    now: () => new Date(clock.now), ledger, procAlive: liveProcAlive('/bin/ps'), status: () => {}, buildChanged: () => false,
  })
  pools.push(pool)
  const device: DeviceFile = {
    v: 1, device: 'nuance', user: 'macair', state: 'paired', host_alias: 'collab-nuance', seat_public: 'ab'.repeat(32),
    bundle_build: 'abcdef01', key_expiry: '20270111', trailer: 'Co-Authored-By: The Fable of the Eternal Universe <Yu@Ai-love.cc>',

const fcall = async (f: FakeWorld, name: string, args: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => {

  if (r === 'close') throw new Error('closed')

/** The script that holds every collab_task_get inside the child until the test calls release(). */
const HOLD_GETS: FakeScript = { tools: { collab_task_get: { kind: 'wait_file', file: 'release' } } }

describe('front-door limits', () => {
  test('a fifth call in flight is rate_limited', async () => {
    const f = fakeWorld(HOLD_GETS)
    const four = [0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => fcall(f, 'collab_task_get', { task_id: `t${i}` }))
    await until(() => f.calls().length === 4, 'all four calls to be inside the child')
    const fifth = await fcall(f, 'collab_task_get', { task_id: 't4' })
    expect(sc(fifth)).toMatchObject({ error: 'rate_limited', delivered: false })
    f.release()
    for (const r of await Promise.all(four)) expect(r.outcome).toBe('ok')
    expect(f.calls()).toEqual(['collab_task_get', 'collab_task_get', 'collab_task_get', 'collab_task_get'])
  }, T)

  test('the 21st mutation in a burst is rate_limited', async () => {
    const f = fakeWorld()
    for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
      expect((await fcall(f, 'collab_report_append', { idempotency_key: `k${i}`, kind: 'observation', body: `n${i}` })).outcome).toBe('ok')
    }
    const r21 = await fcall(f, 'collab_report_append', { idempotency_key: 'k20', kind: 'observation', body: 'n20' })
    expect(sc(r21)).toMatchObject({ error: 'rate_limited', delivered: false })
    expect(f.calls().length).toBe(20)
    f.clock.mono += 200 // one more token at 5 a second
    expect((await fcall(f, 'collab_report_append', { idempotency_key: 'k21', kind: 'observation', body: 'n21' })).outcome).toBe('ok')
  }, T)

  test('collab_next twice within a second is rate_limited', async () => {
    const f = fakeWorld()
    expect((await fcall(f, 'collab_next')).outcome).toBe('ok')
    f.clock.mono += 999
    expect(sc(await fcall(f, 'collab_next'))).toMatchObject({ error: 'rate_limited' })
    f.clock.mono += 1
    expect((await fcall(f, 'collab_next')).outcome).toBe('ok')
  }, T)

  test('journal_verify twice within a minute is rate_limited', async () => {
    const f = fakeWorld()
    expect((await fcall(f, 'collab_journal_verify')).outcome).toBe('ok')
    f.clock.mono += 59_999
    expect(sc(await fcall(f, 'collab_journal_verify'))).toMatchObject({ error: 'rate_limited' })
    f.clock.mono += 1
    expect((await fcall(f, 'collab_journal_verify')).outcome).toBe('ok')
  }, T)

  test('a result too large for one frame is hub_outcome_unknown', async () => {
    const f = fakeWorld({ tools: { collab_report_list: { kind: 'big', bytes: 5 * 1024 * 1024 } } })
    const r = await fcall(f, 'collab_report_list')
    expect(r.outcome).toBe('unknown')
    expect(sc(r)).toMatchObject({ error: 'hub_outcome_unknown', delivered: 'unknown', retry: 'never automatic' })
    expect(readLedger(f.paths.ledger).filter((l) => l.event === 'result').map((l) => [l.outcome, l.code])).toEqual([['unknown', 'oversized']])
  }, T)
})

describe('not sent after a wait inside the hub', () => {
  test('a call that waited past its deadline for a draining child to stop is not sent to the respawned child', async () => {
    const f = fakeWorld(HOLD_GETS)
    const first = fcall(f, 'collab_task_get', { task_id: 't0' })
    await until(() => f.calls().length === 1, 'the first call to be inside the child')
    f.pool.detached(f.seat.ref.lineage)
    f.clock.mono += TIMING.childDetachedMs
    await f.pool.tick() // the child is now draining; one call is in flight, so it is not stopped yet
    const later = fcall(f, 'collab_task_list', {}) // childFor respawns, behind the old child's stop (rt.starting)
    f.clock.mono += 60_000 // the list's whole timeout_ms passes while it waits
    f.release()
    expect((await first).outcome).toBe('ok') // written before its deadline, so never cut short
    const r = await later
    expect(sc(r)).toMatchObject({ error: 'hub_away', delivered: false, reason: 'deadline_passed' })
    expect(fakeLog(f.dist).filter((l) => l.start).length).toBe(2) // the respawned child started, and was sent nothing
    expect(f.calls()).toEqual(['collab_task_get'])
    expect(readLedger(f.paths.ledger).filter((l) => l.event === 'forward').map((l) => l.tool)).toEqual(['collab_task_get'])
  }, T)

  test('a child that began stopping after childFor handed it out is not sent to', async () => {
    const f = fakeWorld()
    const handOut = f.pool.childFor.bind(f.pool)
    // A park, an end or a drain in the gap between childFor's answer and the forward (Task 37's accepting()).
    f.pool.childFor = async (lineage, opts) => {
      const got = await handOut(lineage, opts)
      if (got.ok) await got.child.stop(2000)
      return got
    }
    const r = await fcall(f, 'collab_task_get', { task_id: 't0' })
    expect(r.outcome).toBe('error')
    expect(sc(r)).toMatchObject({ error: 'hub_away', delivered: false })
    expect(f.calls()).toEqual([])
    expect(readLedger(f.paths.ledger).filter((l) => l.event === 'forward')).toEqual([])
  }, T)
})

describe('knock reads (T9)', () => {
  const QUIET: HubKnockReportMsg = { t: 'knock_report', count: 0, origins: [], seqs: [] }
  const ONE: HubKnockReportMsg = { t: 'knock_report', count: 1, origins: ['air'], seqs: [7] }

  /** A knock read that waits until the test answers it, counting how many the Forwarder started. */
  function scriptedKnock(): { knock: ForwardDeps['knock']; started(): number; answer(): void } {
    let started = 0
    let answer: (() => void) | null = null
    return {
      knock: async () => {
        started += 1
        await new Promise<void>((r) => { answer = r })
        return ONE
      },
      started: () => started,
      answer: () => { const a = answer; answer = null; a?.() },
    }
  }

  test('one host-CLI read at a time per lineage, at least 1 s apart; an overlap does not move the window', async () => {
    const k = scriptedKnock()
    const f = fakeWorld({}, { knock: k.knock })
    const knocks = () => f.fwd.knocks(f.seat.ref, { t: 'knocks', timeout_ms: 2_000 })
    const first = knocks()
    const rest = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 49 }, () => knocks()))
    expect(k.started()).toBe(1)
    expect(rest).toEqual(Array.from({ length: 49 }, () => QUIET))
    k.answer()
    expect(await first).toEqual(ONE)
    expect(await knocks()).toEqual(QUIET) // the same mono: inside the 1 s window
    expect(k.started()).toBe(1)
    f.clock.mono += 1_000
    const second = knocks()
    expect(k.started()).toBe(2)
    f.clock.mono += 1_000 // the window has passed, but the second read is still running
    const overlap = knocks()
    expect(k.started()).toBe(2)
    expect(await overlap).toEqual(QUIET)
    k.answer()
    expect(await second).toEqual(ONE)
    const third = knocks() // the overlap just refused did not move the window: 1 s since the second read
    expect(k.started()).toBe(3)
    k.answer()
    expect(await third).toEqual(ONE)
  }, T)

  test('knocks on a lineage with no live session run nothing and do not move the window', async () => {
    const k = scriptedKnock()
    const f = fakeWorld({}, { knock: k.knock })
    const live = f.store.get(f.seat.ref.lineage)!
    f.store.upsert({ ...live, state: 'pending', session_id: null, credential_path: null })
    expect(await f.fwd.knocks(f.seat.ref, { t: 'knocks', timeout_ms: 2_000 })).toEqual(QUIET)
    expect(k.started()).toBe(0)
    f.store.upsert(live) // live again at the same mono: the earlier knocks took no slot
    const r = f.fwd.knocks(f.seat.ref, { t: 'knocks', timeout_ms: 2_000 })
    expect(k.started()).toBe(1)
    k.answer()
    expect(await r).toEqual(ONE)
  }, T)
})
```

```ts
// The hub's call pipeline (C7, C8, C9; spec §6.3, §6.6, §7.2, §9.3). Every remote call arrives here from its seat
// stream and leaves, at most once, toward that lineage's Collab child. In order:
//   1. the call_ref is recorded on receipt (§9.3 item 2): another lineage's prefix closes the stream, a repeat is
//      duplicate_call_ref and never runs twice; there is no result cache;
//   2. the front-door rates (§6.6): 4 calls in flight per lineage, 5 mutations a second (burst 20) per seat,
//      collab_next at least 1 s apart and journal_verify at most once a minute per lineage;
//   3. the policy decision (Task 36), which stamps, normalises, pins the workspace and refuses what remote seats may
//      not do; nothing the seat sent reaches Collab any other way;
//   4. session_start binds only to a mirror that is synced (K17: an unborn or missing mirror would let review pass
//      with no git evidence), through the pool's durable start marker (§9.3 item 8), and records the mirror's Collab
//      worktree id and workspace id from Collab's own answer (§7.2, P55);
//   5. claim, complete, takeover and attach run as edit flows under the mirror lock (Task 45); everything else is one
//      tools/call on the lineage's child;
//   6. a call is written to a child only while TIMING.callMinRemainingMs of its timeout_ms remains on the hub's own
//      monotonic clock (§5.4, as for knocks): a call held on the Air (the mirror lock, the start chain, a drain before a
//      respawn) past that is refused hub_away and never sent, so the agent's read after the pipe's unknown tells the truth
//      (P49). This is not a cancel: nothing already written to a child is ever withdrawn (§9.3 item 4, K28, K65);
//   7. knock reads run one at a time per lineage, at least RATES.knocksMinMs apart (T9): each one starts a host CLI.
// Every refusal is an isError result with outcome `error` (P50), so "not sent" stays definite; anything after the
// request reached a child without a definite answer is hub_outcome_unknown (§9.3 item 4). Nothing here retries.
import { bridgeFailure, type AgentCode } from '../failure.ts'
import type { LedgerFields } from '../ledger.ts'
import {
  encodeMessage, MAX_HUB_TO_PIPE, newStartNonce,
  type CallMsg, type HubKnockReportMsg, type KnocksMsg, type ResultMsg, type ToolDef, type ToolResult,
} from '../link/messages.ts'
import type { CallRegistry } from './calls.ts'
import type { CallOutcome } from './children.ts'
import { scaled, TIMING } from '../timing.ts'
import { shareForFolder, updateDevice, type DeviceFile, type DeviceShare } from './devices.ts'
import { runEditFlow } from './edit-flows.ts'
import { MinInterval, RATES, TokenBucket } from './limits.ts'
import type { LineageEntry, LineageStore } from './lineages.ts'
import { mirrorHead, mirrorWorkspaceId, syncedOid, type MirrorDeps } from './mirror.ts'
import { decide, isMutation, type SeatCtx } from './policy.ts'
import type { ChildPool } from './pool.ts'
import type { SeatHandlers, SeatRef } from './streams.ts'
import type { MirrorHandle, MirrorRegistry } from './sync-points.ts'

export interface ForwardDeps { pool: ChildPool; store: LineageStore; calls: CallRegistry; mirrors: MirrorRegistry; mirrorDeps: MirrorDeps;
  devices(): Map<string, DeviceFile>; devicePath(device: string): string; seatTools(device: string): ToolDef[];
  knock(sessionId: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<HubKnockReportMsg>; journal: string;
  ledger(f: LedgerFields): void; mono(): number; now(): Date }

const START = 'collab_session_start'

export const FORWARD_MESSAGES = {
  duplicate: 'This call_ref was already received in this hub run, so it was not run again; nothing was sent.',
  inflight: 'Four Collab calls of this session are already in flight; nothing was sent. Wait for one to answer.',
  mutations: 'Too many Collab changes from this Mac in a short time (5 a second, burst 20); nothing was sent.',
  next: 'collab_next was called less than a second ago; nothing was sent.',
  verify: 'collab_journal_verify runs at most once a minute per session; nothing was sent.',
  noLineage: 'The hub has no record of this Collab session; nothing was sent.',
  notPaired: 'This Mac is not paired with the Air hub; nothing was sent.',
  noShare: 'This folder is not shared with the Air; nothing was sent. Start Claude at a shared folder\'s root.',
  ended: 'This Collab session has ended; nothing was sent. Start a new one with collab_session_start.',
  tampered: 'The mirror of this folder on the Air is missing or not at its last synced commit; nothing was sent. Ai looks on the Air.',
  late: 'This call waited on the Air past its deadline and was not sent; nothing was applied.',
  stopped: 'This session\'s Collab child on the Air was stopping, so nothing was sent; call again if you choose.',
  unknown: 'The Collab call may or may not have taken effect on the Air. Never re-send it under a new idempotency_key: check with ' +
    'collab_task_get, collab_task_list, collab_next or collab_report_list, or replay it with the same key.',
} as const

type Obj = Record<string, unknown>
const isObj = (v: unknown): v is Obj => typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v)
/** Collab's error code of an isError result, or null (an SDK input-validation result has no structuredContent). */
const errorOf = (r: ToolResult): string | null => (isObj(r.structuredContent) && typeof r.structuredContent.error === 'string' ? r.structuredContent.error : null)
/** Silence for the tap: no read ran and nothing was marked (§8 item 4). */
const quiet = (): HubKnockReportMsg => ({ t: 'knock_report', count: 0, origins: [], seqs: [] })
const DEADLINE = { reason: 'deadline_passed' } as const

export class Forwarder implements SeatHandlers {
  private readonly inflight = new Map<string, number>()
  private readonly buckets = new Map<string, TokenBucket>()
  private readonly nextGap: MinInterval
  private readonly verifyGap: MinInterval
  private readonly knocking = new Set<string>()
  private readonly knockGap: MinInterval

  constructor(private readonly deps: ForwardDeps) {
    this.nextGap = new MinInterval(RATES.nextMinMs, () => deps.mono())
    this.verifyGap = new MinInterval(RATES.journalVerifyMinMs, () => deps.mono())
    this.knockGap = new MinInterval(RATES.knocksMinMs, () => deps.mono())
  }

  async call(seat: SeatRef, m: CallMsg): Promise<ResultMsg | 'close'> {
    // timeout_ms is a relative duration on the hub's own clock (§5.4), counted from receipt.
    const notAfter = this.deps.mono() + m.timeout_ms - scaled(TIMING.callMinRemainingMs)
    const verdict = this.deps.calls.accept(seat.lineage, m.call_ref)
    this.ledger({ event: 'call', device: seat.device, user: seat.user, lineage: seat.lineage, tool: m.name, call_ref: m.call_ref, code: verdict })
    if (verdict === 'foreign_prefix' || verdict === 'malformed') return 'close'
    if (verdict === 'duplicate') return this.refused(seat, m, 'duplicate_call_ref', FORWARD_MESSAGES.duplicate)
    const limited = this.rateLimited(seat, m.name)
    if (limited !== null) return this.refused(seat, m, 'rate_limited', limited)
    this.inflight.set(seat.lineage, (this.inflight.get(seat.lineage) ?? 0) + 1)
    try {
      return await this.run(seat, m, notAfter)
    } finally {
      const n = (this.inflight.get(seat.lineage) ?? 1) - 1
      if (n > 0) this.inflight.set(seat.lineage, n)
      else this.inflight.delete(seat.lineage)
    }
  }

  /** Recorded, never forwarded: a cancel cannot stop Collab's synchronous handlers and would only drop the result (§9.3 item 4, K28). */
  cancel(seat: SeatRef, callRef: string): void {
    this.ledger({ event: 'cancel', device: seat.device, user: seat.user, lineage: seat.lineage, call_ref: callRef })
  }

  /**
   * Only for the stream's own bound session (§8 item 3); a lineage with no live session hears count 0. Each read starts
   * a host CLI on the Air, so a seat may not start them faster than one at a time per lineage, RATES.knocksMinMs apart
   * (T9); an overlapping or early read is silence and marks nothing, and its note still taps at a later turn.
   */
  async knocks(seat: SeatRef, m: KnocksMsg): Promise<HubKnockReportMsg> {
    const received = this.deps.mono()
    const e = this.deps.store.get(seat.lineage)
    if (!e || e.state !== 'live' || e.session_id === null) return quiet()
    // The in-flight check comes before allow(), so a refused overlap does not move the window.
    if (this.knocking.has(seat.lineage)) return quiet()
    if (!this.knockGap.allow(seat.lineage)) return quiet()
    this.knocking.add(seat.lineage)
    try {
      return await this.deps.knock(e.session_id, m.timeout_ms - (this.deps.mono() - received))
    } finally {
      this.knocking.delete(seat.lineage)
    }
  }

  /** The §6.6 rates, before anything else is read. A refused call takes no token and does not move a window. */
  private rateLimited(seat: SeatRef, name: string): string | null {
    if ((this.inflight.get(seat.lineage) ?? 0) >= RATES.inflightPerLineage) return FORWARD_MESSAGES.inflight
    if (isMutation(name)) {
      const key = `${seat.device}/${seat.user}`
      let bucket = this.buckets.get(key)
      if (!bucket) {
        bucket = new TokenBucket(RATES.mutationsPerS, RATES.mutationBurst, () => this.deps.mono())
        this.buckets.set(key, bucket)
      }
      if (!bucket.take()) return FORWARD_MESSAGES.mutations
    }
    if (name === 'collab_next' && !this.nextGap.allow(seat.lineage)) return FORWARD_MESSAGES.next
    if (name === 'collab_journal_verify' && !this.verifyGap.allow(seat.lineage)) return FORWARD_MESSAGES.verify
    return null
  }

  private async run(seat: SeatRef, m: CallMsg, notAfter: number): Promise<ResultMsg> {
    const entry = this.deps.store.get(seat.lineage)
    if (!entry) return this.refused(seat, m, 'hub_away', FORWARD_MESSAGES.noLineage)
    const device = this.deps.devices().get(seat.device)
    if (!device || device.state !== 'paired') return this.refused(seat, m, 'hub_away', FORWARD_MESSAGES.notPaired)
    const share = shareForFolder(device, seat.folder)
    if (!share || share.mirror_id !== entry.mirror_id) return this.refused(seat, m, 'folder_not_shared', FORWARD_MESSAGES.noShare)
    // A retired lineage is never used again; an ended one may only start a new session (§9.2, P53).
    if (entry.state === 'retired' || (entry.state === 'ended' && m.name !== START)) return this.refused(seat, m, 'seat_session_ended', FORWARD_MESSAGES.ended)
    const handle = this.deps.mirrors.get(seat.device, seat.user, entry.mirror_id) ?? null
    const nonce = m.name === START ? newStartNonce() : ''
    const ctx: SeatCtx = {
      device: seat.device, user: seat.user, harness: entry.harness, lineage: seat.lineage,
      sessionId: entry.state === 'live' ? entry.session_id : null,
      workspaceId: entry.workspace_id ?? share.workspace_id,
      mirrorPath: handle?.spec.mirrorPath ?? '',
      sameSeatSessions: this.deps.store.sameSeat(seat.device, seat.user),
      startNonce: nonce,
      tool: this.deps.seatTools(seat.device).find((t) => t.name === m.name) ?? null,
    }
    const d = decide(ctx, m.name, m.arguments)
    if (d.kind === 'refuse') return this.refused(seat, m, d.code, d.message)
    if (d.kind === 'session_start') return this.sessionStart(seat, m, entry, device, share, handle, d.args, nonce, notAfter)

    const got = await this.deps.pool.childFor(seat.lineage)
    if (!got.ok) return this.refused(seat, m, got.code, got.message)
    const sessionId = entry.session_id!
    if (d.kind === 'edit_flow') {
      if (!handle) return this.refused(seat, m, 'mirror_tampered', FORWARD_MESSAGES.tampered)
      const flow = await runEditFlow({
        flow: d.flow, name: m.name, args: d.args, declared: m.declared, device: seat.device, user: seat.user, sessionId,
        workspaceId: entry.workspace_id!, child: got.child, mirror: handle,
        // One MirrorDeps for the hub; the Host alias is the device's own, so a second Mac fetches from itself (§5.6).
        mirrorDeps: { ...this.deps.mirrorDeps, alias: device.host_alias }, nowMs: this.deps.now().getTime(),
        notAfterMono: notAfter, mono: () => this.deps.mono(),
      })
      if (flow.kind === 'refuse') {
        return this.refused(seat, m, flow.code, flow.message, flow.extra, flow.extra?.reason === DEADLINE.reason ? DEADLINE.reason : undefined)
      }
      return this.settle(seat, m, sessionId, flow.outcome)
    }
    // In the same turn as the write: too little time left, or a child stopped since childFor answered, is not sent (§9.3 item 3).
    if (this.deps.mono() >= notAfter) return this.late(seat, m)
    if (!got.child.accepting()) return this.refused(seat, m, 'hub_away', FORWARD_MESSAGES.stopped)
    return this.settle(seat, m, sessionId, await got.child.call(m.name, d.args))
  }

  /**
   * A remote session_start (§6.3 rewritten row, §9.3 item 8). A lineage with a session is forwarded to its own child,
   * resumed when needed, and Collab answers session_already_bound. Otherwise the start binds to the mirror only when its
   * HEAD reads and equals the synced ref, through the pool's durable marker, never re-sent.
   */
  private async sessionStart(seat: SeatRef, m: CallMsg, entry: LineageEntry, device: DeviceFile, share: DeviceShare,
    handle: MirrorHandle | null, args: Record<string, unknown>, nonce: string, notAfter: number): Promise<ResultMsg> {
    if (entry.state === 'live') {
      const got = await this.deps.pool.childFor(seat.lineage)
      if (got.ok) {
        if (this.deps.mono() >= notAfter) return this.late(seat, m)
        if (!got.child.accepting()) return this.refused(seat, m, 'hub_away', FORWARD_MESSAGES.stopped)
        return this.settle(seat, m, entry.session_id, await got.child.call(START, args))
      }
      // The credential was gone (a host end, K23): the pool has ended the lineage, so this start begins a new session (P53).
      const now = this.deps.store.get(seat.lineage)
      if (got.code !== 'seat_session_ended' || now?.state !== 'ended') return this.refused(seat, m, got.code, got.message)
      entry = now
    }
    if (!handle) return this.refused(seat, m, 'mirror_tampered', FORWARD_MESSAGES.tampered)
    const mirrorDeps: MirrorDeps = { ...this.deps.mirrorDeps, alias: device.host_alias }
    return handle.lock.run(async () => {
      const head = await mirrorHead(handle.spec, mirrorDeps)
      const synced = await syncedOid(handle.spec, mirrorDeps)
      if (head === null || synced === null || head !== synced) return this.refused(seat, m, 'mirror_tampered', FORWARD_MESSAGES.tampered)
      const got = await this.deps.pool.childFor(seat.lineage, { forStart: true })
      if (!got.ok) return this.refused(seat, m, got.code, got.message)
      const workspaceId = entry.workspace_id ?? share.workspace_id ?? await mirrorWorkspaceId(handle.spec, mirrorDeps)
      if (workspaceId === null) return this.refused(seat, m, 'mirror_tampered', FORWARD_MESSAGES.tampered)
      // The pool checks the deadline again after its own waits (the start chain, a drain, a reconcile), before the marker.
      const out = await this.deps.pool.startSession(seat.lineage, args, m.call_ref, nonce, workspaceId, notAfter)
      if ('refuse' in out) return this.refused(seat, m, out.refuse, out.message)
      if (out.outcome === 'ok') this.recordBinding(seat, share, handle, out.result)
      return this.settle(seat, m, this.deps.store.get(seat.lineage)?.session_id ?? null, out)
    })
  }

  /**
   * Collab's answer names the mirror's worktree id and the workspace (§7.2, P55). The device file is re-read under its
   * lock and written only while it is still paired, so an unpair written meanwhile by another process is never undone;
   * the registry gets the worktree id either way, so the very next claim sees it (the one-task rule needs it).
   */
  private recordBinding(seat: SeatRef, share: DeviceShare, handle: MirrorHandle, result: ToolResult): void {
    const sc = result.structuredContent
    const worktreeId = isObj(sc) && isObj(sc.worktree) && typeof sc.worktree.id === 'string' ? sc.worktree.id : null
    const workspaceId = isObj(sc) && isObj(sc.workspace) && typeof sc.workspace.id === 'string' ? sc.workspace.id : null
    if (worktreeId === null || workspaceId === null) return
    let code: 'recorded' | 'corrected' | null = null
    try {
      updateDevice(this.deps.devicePath(seat.device), (d) => {
        if (d.state !== 'paired') return null
        const s = d.shares.find((x) => x.mirror_id === share.mirror_id)
        if (!s || (s.mirror_worktree_id === worktreeId && s.workspace_id === workspaceId)) return null
        code = s.workspace_id === null ? 'recorded' : s.workspace_id !== workspaceId ? 'corrected' : null
        return { ...d, shares: d.shares.map((x) => (x === s ? { ...x, mirror_worktree_id: worktreeId, workspace_id: workspaceId } : x)) }
      })
    } catch {
      code = null
      this.ledger({ event: 'workspace_id', device: seat.device, user: seat.user, lineage: seat.lineage, code: 'device_write_failed' })
    }
    if (code !== null) this.ledger({ event: 'workspace_id', device: seat.device, user: seat.user, lineage: seat.lineage, code })
    this.deps.mirrors.set({ ...handle, worktreeId })
  }

  /**
   * One forwarded call's answer. Both ledger lines are written once the call has been forwarded (the pool and the edit
   * flows decide that themselves, and their CallOutcome says it happened): one `forward` line per call_ref, naming the
   * journal the child was given (§11.2), and one `result` line. Never an argument or a body.
   */
  private settle(seat: SeatRef, m: CallMsg, sessionId: string | null, out: CallOutcome): ResultMsg {
    const base = { device: seat.device, user: seat.user, lineage: seat.lineage, session_id: sessionId ?? undefined, tool: m.name, call_ref: m.call_ref }
    this.ledger({ event: 'forward', ...base, journal: this.deps.journal })
    if (out.outcome === 'unknown') {
      this.ledger({ event: 'result', ...base, outcome: 'unknown', code: out.reason, ms: out.ms })
      return this.unknown(m)
    }
    const msg: ResultMsg = { t: 'result', call_ref: m.call_ref, outcome: out.outcome, result: out.result }
    const bytes = encodeMessage(msg).byteLength
    if (bytes > MAX_HUB_TO_PIPE) {
      // Collab answered, but the answer cannot cross in one frame (§6.6): to the agent it is an unknown outcome.
      this.ledger({ event: 'result', ...base, outcome: 'unknown', code: 'frame_too_large', bytes, ms: out.ms })
      return this.unknown(m)
    }
    const code = out.outcome === 'error' ? errorOf(out.result) : null
    this.ledger({ event: 'result', ...base, outcome: out.outcome, code: code ?? undefined, bytes, ms: out.ms })
    if (code === 'cursor_reset_required') {
      // §9.6 item 5: the lineage is parked until Ai repairs it; Collab's answer still goes back unchanged.
      const { error: _error, message: _message, ...details } = out.result.structuredContent as Obj
      this.deps.pool.park(seat.lineage, 'cursor_reset_required', details)
    }
    if (out.outcome === 'ok' && m.name === 'collab_session_end') this.deps.pool.sessionEnded(seat.lineage)
    return msg
  }

  /** A definite "not sent" (P50). `ledgerCode` names the cause in the ledger when the agent code alone does not (deadline_passed). */
  private refused(seat: SeatRef, m: CallMsg, code: AgentCode, message: string, extra?: Record<string, unknown>, ledgerCode?: string): ResultMsg {
    this.ledger({ event: 'result', device: seat.device, user: seat.user, lineage: seat.lineage, tool: m.name, call_ref: m.call_ref, outcome: 'refused', code: ledgerCode ?? code })
    return { t: 'result', call_ref: m.call_ref, outcome: 'error', result: bridgeFailure(code, message, m.call_ref, extra) }
  }

  /** Held on the Air until too little of its timeout_ms remained: never written to a child, so never applied (§5.4). */
  private late(seat: SeatRef, m: CallMsg): ResultMsg {
    return this.refused(seat, m, 'hub_away', FORWARD_MESSAGES.late, DEADLINE, DEADLINE.reason)
  }

  private unknown(m: CallMsg): ResultMsg {
    return { t: 'result', call_ref: m.call_ref, outcome: 'unknown', result: bridgeFailure('hub_outcome_unknown', FORWARD_MESSAGES.unknown, m.call_ref) }
  }

  private ledger(f: LedgerFields): void {
    try { this.deps.ledger(f) } catch { /* the call goes on without its ledger line */ }
  }
}
```

Backoff sleeps go through `scaled()` (P33), and a stop or an unpair ends a sleep at once.

Notes for the implementer:
- `declare const __COLLAB_BRIDGE_BUILD__` plus `typeof __COLLAB_BRIDGE_BUILD__ !== 'undefined'`: from source the identifier does not exist and `typeof` of an undeclared name is `'undefined'`, never a ReferenceError; Task 59's `Bun.build({ define: { __COLLAB_BRIDGE_BUILD__: JSON.stringify(info) } })` replaces the identifier with the object literal.
- A second start while a hub runs (`hub run` in Terminal beside the LaunchAgent) writes `refused: lock_held` over the running hub's `hub.status.json`, as every refusal writes status; the running hub puts its own status back at its next reload tick (within `deviceReloadMs`). The test shows both.
- A stop waits at most 5 s for the dial loops and 5 s for the children (`pool.stopAll` waits for calls in flight, which may take up to 600 s); anything still running ends on stdin EOF once the hub process exits (K23), and every pipe has already answered its calls in flight `hub_outcome_unknown` when the link closed.
- The hub never reads the host-key ack itself: `writeDeviceStatus` (Task 47) reads it on every write, the dial loop's included, and drops every warning at or before it, so an ack written while the hub runs is gone from the file at the loop's next status write and never comes back; `hub status` and `hub doctor` filter what they show the same way (P52).
- An unpaired device stops its loop and is not dialled again until the hub restarts, as is a device whose loop stopped for Yu (`auth_refused`, `config`, `login_shell_noise`): neither heals by itself. A device that becomes paired while the hub runs gets its loop at the next reload.
- A damaged device file seen by a reload (not at start) keeps the last good view and logs one line until it parses again; at start it is `needs Yu: config`. An editor that saves in two steps must not unpair a Mac.
- The in-process hub tests inject `passwd` and `expected` (`{uid: 502, name: 'yuai'}`) so they run for any user; the real getpwuid check is the spawned test, which compares `defaultHubDeps(env).passwd()` with `/usr/bin/id -un` and shows that `os.userInfo()` reads `USER=bogus` (F3). The source-mode spawned hub is told to expect whoever runs the suite for the same reason.
- The linked tests set `COLLAB_BRIDGE_TEST_TIME_SCALE=0.01` in this process (the hub, its seat streams and the `LinkClient`) and in the relay's env (through the fake ssh), and `afterEach` removes it: PING every 150 ms, stale after 200 ms, the relay's exit after 450 ms, 50 ms handshake steps, the pipe's 20 ms reattach, backoff from 50 ms. The relay's socket is under the short socket root `testEnv` makes (K46).

```ts
  const d: DeviceFile = {
```
