```ts
  test('run and hub run refuse inside any agent harness and for any uid but 502, with no question; launchd and Terminal pass', async () => {
    const refused: Array<[NonNullable<Parameters<typeof cli>[0]>, string]> = [
      [{ env: { CLAUDECODE: '1' } }, 'CLAUDECODE is set'],
      [{ env: { HERMES_HOME: '/Users/yuai/.hermes' } }, 'HERMES_HOME is set'],
      [{ table: UNDER_CLAUDE }, 'claude (pid 9000) is an ancestor of this process'],

        expect([argv, why, await runAirCli(argv, c.deps), ran]).toEqual([argv, why, 1, 0])
        expect(c.err.join('\n')).toContain(`✗ refused: ${why}`)
        nothingWritten(c)
      }
      for (const chain of [UNDER_LAUNCHD, TERMINAL]) {

        expect([argv, await runAirCli(argv, c.deps), ran, c.err]).toEqual([argv, 7, 1, []])

  test('the launcher text is the exact zsh line', () => {
    const text = cliLauncherText(SHA)
    expect(text).toBe('#!/bin/zsh -f\n'
      + `cd / && exec /usr/bin/env -u BUN_OPTIONS -u BUN_BE_BUN /Users/yuai/.bun/bin/bun --no-env-file --config=/dev/null /Users/yuai/.local/share/collab-bridge/air/${SHA}/hub.js "$@"\n`)
    const f = join(temp('cb-launcher-'), 'collab-bridge')

    expect(() => cliLauncherText('B'.repeat(64))).toThrow('cliLauncherText: sha must be 64 lowercase hex')
  }, 20_000)

  test('version prints {"build":null} from source', async () => {
    const home = temp('cb-version-')
    const r = Bun.spawnSync([process.execPath, '--no-env-file', '--config=/dev/null', join(PKG, 'bin', 'collab-bridge.ts'), 'version'],
      { cwd: '/', env: testEnv(home) })
    expect([r.exitCode, r.stdout.toString(), r.stderr.toString()]).toEqual([0, '{"build":null}\n', ''])
    // a pinned bundle prints its embedded build info

    expect(JSON.parse(c.out[0]!)).toEqual(sourceBuild(COLLAB_DIST))

  test('an unknown verb exits 2', async () => {
    const c = cli()

      ['hub', 'unpark'], ['launch'], ['version', 'x'], ['--help'], ['run', 'x'], ['hub', 'run', 'x']]) {

describe('the bin: run and hub run from source', () => {

    // the preload's ps stub chains every caller to a fake claude at pid 4100 (P43), as an agent's shell would
    const home = temp('cb-run-refused-')

      if (process.getuid!() !== HUB_UID) {

        const s = readHubStatus(paths)

      p.kill(signal)
      expect([signal, await p.exited]).toEqual([signal, 0])
      await drained

})
```

`/Users/yuai/Projects/.worktrees/agenttool-collab-bridge/packages/collab-bridge/src/cli.ts`:

```ts
// The Air's verbs (C14). `hub on` and `hub off` are Yu's: they refuse inside any agent harness and read his y from
// /dev/tty, so only Yu turns the hub on or off (spec §10.3 step 7, §10.4). `hub doctor --ack-host-key` is his too: it
// acknowledges a security warning (§5.5). `hub status`, `hub doctor` and `version` only read. The bare `run` is
// launchd's verb (the plist's ProgramArguments end `…/hub.js`, `run`: C7, §10.4) and `hub run` is the Terminal fallback
// (C14, §10.4); both are refused inside any agent harness and for any uid but 502, with no question, so no agent starts
// a hub that serves seats without Yu. `hub unpark` is Ai's repair step after a seat recovery (§9.6 item 5, P54).
// Every side effect comes through AirCliDeps; bin/collab-bridge.ts is the only place that builds the live ones.
import { chmodSync, closeSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, openSync, readFileSync, readSync, rmSync, writeSync } from 'node:fs'
import { basename, dirname } from 'node:path'
import { listDevices, type DeviceFile } from './air/devices.ts'
import { distMatches, type BuildInfo } from './air/hub.ts'
import { LineageStore } from './air/lineages.ts'
import { renderPlist } from './air/plist.ts'
import {
  activeSticky, readDeviceStatus, readHostKeyAck, readHubStatus, statusLines, writeDeviceStatus, writeHostKeyAck, type DeviceStatus,
} from './air/status.ts'
import { LINEAGE_RE } from './link/messages.ts'
import { writeFileDurable } from './native.ts'
import { mkdirPrivate } from './private-dir.ts'
import type { AirPaths } from './paths.ts'
import { ancestry, HARNESS_COMMS, type ProcTable } from './proc.ts'
import { overrideActive, type Env } from './sysbin.ts'

export const HUB_LABEL = 'dev.agenttool.collab-bridge'
/** yuai's uid: the hub lives in gui/502 only, never in another account's domain on this Air (P10). */
export const HUB_UID = 502
const DOMAIN = `gui/${HUB_UID}`
const SERVICE = `${DOMAIN}/${HUB_LABEL}`

export interface AirCliDeps {
  paths: AirPaths; env: Env; selfPid: number; uid(): number; table(): ProcTable | null; ask(prompt: string): string | null
  launchctl: string; codesign: string; bun: string; hubSha: string | null; build: BuildInfo | null; collabDist: string
  runHub(): Promise<number>; out(line: string): void; err(line: string): void; now(): Date
}

export const USAGE: readonly string[] = [
  'usage: collab-bridge hub on | hub off | hub status [--json] | hub doctor [--ack-host-key] | hub run | hub unpark <lineage>',
  '       collab-bridge version | run (launchd only)',
]

const SHA_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/
/** Per-run launchd entries: apps Yu opens and one-shot jobs come and go between the baseline and any later check. */
const PER_RUN: readonly RegExp[] = [/^application\./, /^\[0x/, /^com\.apple\.xpc\.launchd\.oneshot\./]
const REPLY_MAX_BYTES = 256

/** The fixed ~/.local/bin/collab-bridge (spec §4.3 with P14's env -u): zsh -f reads no rc file, and bun gets no BUN_OPTIONS. */
export function cliLauncherText(sha: string): string {
  if (!SHA_RE.test(sha)) throw new Error('cliLauncherText: sha must be 64 lowercase hex')
  return '#!/bin/zsh -f\n'
    + `cd / && exec /usr/bin/env -u BUN_OPTIONS -u BUN_BE_BUN /Users/yuai/.bun/bin/bun --no-env-file --config=/dev/null /Users/yuai/.local/share/collab-bridge/air/${sha}/hub.js "$@"\n`
}

/** One label from a `launchctl list` row (`PID\tStatus\tLabel`), or from a line of the stored baseline (the label alone). */
function labelOf(line: string): string | null {
  const trimmed = line.trim()
  if (trimmed === '') return null
  let cols = line.split('\t')
  if (cols.length < 3) {
    const words = trimmed.split(/\s+/)
    cols = words.length >= 3 && /^(-|\d+)$/.test(words[0]!) && /^-?\d+$/.test(words[1]!) ? words
      : words[0] === 'PID' ? words : [trimmed]
  }
  if (cols.length < 3) return trimmed
  if (cols[0]!.trim() === 'PID') return null // launchctl's header
  return cols.slice(2).join(' ').trim() || null
}

export function stableLabels(launchctlList: string): string[] {
  const labels = new Set<string>()
  for (const line of launchctlList.split('\n')) {
    const label = labelOf(line)
    if (label !== null && !PER_RUN.some((re) => re.test(label))) labels.add(label)
  }
  return [...labels].sort()
}

export function labelDiff(baseline: string, current: string): { added: string[]; removed: string[] } {
  const before = new Set(stableLabels(baseline))
  const after = new Set(stableLabels(current))
  return { added: [...after].filter((l) => !before.has(l)), removed: [...before].filter((l) => !after.has(l)) }
}

/**
 * Why this process may not turn the hub on or off, or start it (`run`, `hub run`), or null when it may. Fails closed: a
 * process table that cannot be read, or that does not hold this process, cannot rule out a harness ancestor. An agent
 * may ask Yu; it never answers for him.
 */
export function hubOnRefusal(env: Env, table: ProcTable | null, selfPid: number, uid: number): string | null {
  const only = 'only Yu turns the hub on or off, from his own Terminal'
  if (env.CLAUDECODE !== undefined) return `CLAUDECODE is set (a Claude Code session); ${only}`
  for (const k of Object.keys(env).sort()) {
    if (env[k] !== undefined && (k.startsWith('CODEX_') || k.startsWith('HERMES_'))) {
      return `${k} is set (an agent harness); ${only} (if his shell exports it, run it as env -u ${k} collab-bridge …)`
    }
  }
  if (table === null) return `the process table could not be read, so an agent harness ancestor cannot be ruled out; ${only}`
  const chain = ancestry(selfPid, table)
  if (chain.length === 0) return `this process is not in the process table, so an agent harness ancestor cannot be ruled out; ${only}`
  for (const rec of chain) {
    const name = basename(rec.comm)
    if (HARNESS_COMMS.has(name)) return `${name} (pid ${rec.pid}) is an ancestor of this process; ${only}`
  }
  if (uid !== HUB_UID) return `this is uid ${uid}; the hub runs as uid ${HUB_UID} (yuai) in ${DOMAIN} only`
  return null
}

/** Reads one reply line from an open tty fd, at most REPLY_MAX_BYTES; null at once on EOF. */
function readReply(fd: number): string | null {
  const bytes: number[] = []
  const one = Buffer.alloc(1)
  while (bytes.length < REPLY_MAX_BYTES) {
    if (readSync(fd, one, 0, 1, null) !== 1) return bytes.length === 0 ? null : Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8')
    if (one[0] === 0x0a) break
    bytes.push(one[0]!)
  }
  return Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8').replace(/\r$/, '')
}

/**
 * The question, asked on /dev/tty. Under the test override it never opens the real tty: it reads COLLAB_BRIDGE_TTY, one
 * line per question, and with no such file there is no tty (spec §12.1 Prompts). No tty → null, which is never a yes.
 */
export function ttyAsk(env: Env): (prompt: string) => string | null {
  if (overrideActive(env)) {
    const file = env.COLLAB_BRIDGE_TTY
    let next = 0
    return () => {
      if (!file) return null
      let lines: string[]
      try { lines = readFileSync(file, 'utf8').split('\n') } catch { return null }
      return next < lines.length ? lines[next++]! : null
    }
  }
  return (prompt) => {
    let fd: number
    try { fd = openSync('/dev/tty', 'r+') } catch { return null } // no controlling terminal: launchd, ssh -T, a harness
    try {
      writeSync(fd, prompt)
      return readReply(fd)
    } catch {
      return null
    } finally {
      closeSync(fd)
    }
  }
}

const isYes = (answer: string | null) => answer !== null && /^y$/i.test(answer.trim())
const firstLine = (s: string) => s.split('\n').map((l) => l.trim()).find((l) => l !== '') ?? ''
const message = (e: unknown) => firstLine(String((e as Error)?.message ?? e))

/** launchctl (or codesign) with a built env, never an inherited one (P14), from cwd /. */
function run(deps: AirCliDeps, argv: string[]): { code: number | null; stdout: string; stderr: string } {
  try {
    const r = Bun.spawnSync(argv, { cwd: '/', env: { PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin', HOME: deps.paths.home }, stdin: 'ignore', stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'pipe' })
    return { code: r.exitCode, stdout: r.stdout.toString(), stderr: r.stderr.toString() }
  } catch (e) {
    return { code: null, stdout: '', stderr: message(e) }
  }
}

const launchctl = (deps: AirCliDeps, ...args: string[]) => run(deps, [deps.launchctl, ...args])

/** The refusal and the y/N question shared by every verb that is Yu's alone; true when he said y. */
function yuConfirms(deps: AirCliDeps, question: string): boolean {
  const refusal = hubOnRefusal(deps.env, deps.table(), deps.selfPid, deps.uid())
  if (refusal !== null) {
    deps.err(`✗ refused: ${refusal}`)
    return false
  }
  if (!isYes(deps.ask(question))) {
    deps.err('✗ Not confirmed')
    return false
  }
  return true
}

function devicesOrNote(deps: AirCliDeps, notes: string[]): DeviceFile[] {
  try {
    return listDevices(deps.paths.devicesDir)
  } catch (e) {
    notes.push(`devices: ${message(e)}`)
    return []
  }
}

/** Each device's status as `hub status` and `hub doctor` show it: sticky warnings already acknowledged are left out (P52). */
function shownStatus(paths: AirPaths, device: string): DeviceStatus | null {
  const s = readDeviceStatus(paths, device)
  return s && { ...s, sticky: activeSticky(s.sticky, readHostKeyAck(paths, device)) }
}

/** §9.2's lines for the hub and every paired device, then a line for each device the hub has not reported on. */
function statusReport(deps: AirCliDeps, devices: DeviceFile[]): string[] {
  const paired = devices.filter((d) => d.state === 'paired')
  const shown = paired.map((d) => shownStatus(deps.paths, d.device))
  const lines = statusLines(readHubStatus(deps.paths), shown.filter((s): s is DeviceStatus => s !== null))
  paired.forEach((d, i) => { if (shown[i] === null) lines.push(`${d.device}: no status yet (is the hub on?)`) })
  for (const d of devices) if (d.state !== 'paired') lines.push(`${d.device}: ${d.state} (device file)`)
  return lines
}

/** Waits until launchd has let go of the service, so the bootstrap that follows a bootout does not race it. */
async function untilGone(deps: AirCliDeps): Promise<void> {
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    if (launchctl(deps, 'print', SERVICE).code !== 0) return
    await Bun.sleep(250)
  }
}

async function hubOn(deps: AirCliDeps): Promise<number> {
  const { paths } = deps
  const refusal = hubOnRefusal(deps.env, deps.table(), deps.selfPid, deps.uid())
  if (refusal !== null) {
    deps.err(`✗ refused: ${refusal}`)
    return 1
  }
  // What the plist will run must exist before Yu is asked, or launchd would restart a missing program every 10 s.
  if (deps.hubSha === null) {
    deps.err('✗ this collab-bridge is not a pinned hub bundle: run ~/.local/bin/collab-bridge, which runs ~/.local/share/collab-bridge/air/<sha>/hub.js')
    return 1
  }
  if (!existsSync(paths.hubJs(deps.hubSha))) {
    deps.err(`✗ the pinned hub bundle is missing: ${paths.hubJs(deps.hubSha)}`)
    return 1
  }
  if (!existsSync(paths.launcherExe)) {
    deps.err(`✗ the launcher app is missing: ${paths.launcherExe}`)
    return 1
  }
  if (!isYes(deps.ask('Turn the Collab bridge hub on? [y/N] '))) {
    deps.err('✗ Not confirmed')
    return 1
  }
  mkdirPrivate(paths.stateDir)
  // The first hub on records what launchd ran before the hub, so §12.3 step 8 can show the hub added exactly one label.
  if (!existsSync(paths.baselineLabels)) {
    const list = launchctl(deps, 'list')
    if (list.code !== 0) {
      deps.err(`✗ launchctl list failed (exit ${list.code}): ${firstLine(list.stderr)}; nothing was written`)
      return 1
    }
    const labels = stableLabels(list.stdout).filter((l) => l !== HUB_LABEL)
    writeFileDurable(paths.baselineLabels, labels.map((l) => `${l}\n`).join(''), 0o600)
  }
  if (!existsSync(paths.hubLog)) closeSync(openSync(paths.hubLog, 'a', 0o600))
  chmodSync(paths.hubLog, 0o600) // launchd opens StandardErrorPath with its own mode only when the file is missing
  mkdirSync(dirname(paths.plist), { recursive: true })
  writeFileDurable(paths.plist, renderPlist({ home: paths.home, sha: deps.hubSha, bun: deps.bun }), 0o644)
  if (launchctl(deps, 'bootout', SERVICE).code === 0) await untilGone(deps) // a running hub restarts on the new plist
  const boot = launchctl(deps, 'bootstrap', DOMAIN, paths.plist)
  if (boot.code !== 0) {
    deps.err(`✗ launchctl bootstrap ${DOMAIN} failed (exit ${boot.code}): ${firstLine(boot.stderr)}`)
    return 1
  }
  deps.out(`✓ Hub on: ${HUB_LABEL} is bootstrapped in ${DOMAIN}.`)
  const notes: string[] = []
  const devices = devicesOrNote(deps, notes)
  for (const line of [...statusReport(deps, devices), ...notes]) deps.out(line)
  deps.out('collab-bridge hub status shows each link once the hub has dialled (about a minute).')
  return 0
}

async function hubOff(deps: AirCliDeps): Promise<number> {
  if (!yuConfirms(deps, 'Turn the Collab bridge hub off? [y/N] ')) return 1
  const out = launchctl(deps, 'bootout', SERVICE) // not loaded is fine: off is the state Yu asked for
  rmSync(deps.paths.plist, { force: true })
  deps.out(out.code === 0 ? `✓ Hub off: ${HUB_LABEL} is booted out of ${DOMAIN} and its plist removed.`
    : `✓ Hub off: ${HUB_LABEL} was not loaded in ${DOMAIN}; its plist is removed.`)
  return 0
}

function hubStatus(deps: AirCliDeps, json: boolean): number {
  const notes: string[] = []
  const devices = devicesOrNote(deps, notes)
  if (json) {
    deps.out(JSON.stringify({
      hub: readHubStatus(deps.paths),
      devices: devices.map((d) => ({ device: d.device, state: d.state, status: shownStatus(deps.paths, d.device) })),
      ...(notes.length > 0 ? { notes } : {}),
    }))
  } else {
    for (const line of [...statusReport(deps, devices), ...notes]) deps.out(line)
  }
  return notes.length > 0 ? 1 : 0
}

/** The pinned summon-<device> lines of a known_hosts text, sorted (spec §5.6: the copy must equal Summon's pin). */
function pinLines(text: string, alias: string): string[] {
  return text.split('\n').map((l) => l.trim()).filter((l) => l.startsWith(`${alias} `)).sort()
}

function pinProblem(paths: AirPaths, device: string): string | null {
  const alias = `summon-${device}`
  let summon: string
  let copy: string
  try { summon = readFileSync(paths.summonKnownHosts, 'utf8') } catch { return `${device}: Summon's pin is missing (${paths.summonKnownHosts}); tell Yu` }
  try { copy = readFileSync(paths.knownHosts, 'utf8') } catch { return `${device}: the known_hosts copy is missing (${paths.knownHosts}); pin-device writes it` }
  const a = pinLines(copy, alias)
  const b = pinLines(summon, alias)
  if (a.length === 0 || a.join('\n') !== b.join('\n')) {
    return `${device}: the known_hosts copy differs from Summon's pin for ${alias}: never re-pin from the network; tell Yu`
  }
  return null
}

async function hubDoctor(deps: AirCliDeps, ack: boolean): Promise<number> {
  const { paths } = deps
  const warnings: string[] = []
  const devices = devicesOrNote(deps, warnings)
  if (ack) {
    const owed = devices.filter((d) => (shownStatus(paths, d.device)?.sticky.length ?? 0) > 0)
    if (owed.length === 0) {
      deps.out('No host-key warning to acknowledge.')
    } else {
      const names = owed.map((d) => d.device).join(', ')
      if (!yuConfirms(deps, `Acknowledge the host-key warning(s) of ${names}? [y/N] `)) return 1
      const at = deps.now().toISOString()
      for (const d of owed) {
        writeHostKeyAck(paths, d.device, at)
        // writeDeviceStatus drops every warning at or before the ack, so this rewrite clears them from the file at once,
        // and every later write (the hub's dial loop included) keeps them out (P52).
        const s = readDeviceStatus(paths, d.device)
        if (s) writeDeviceStatus(paths, s)
        deps.out(`✓ Acknowledged ${d.device}'s host-key warning(s) at ${at}; they are gone from the status file, and no later status write brings them back.`)
      }
    }
  }
  // The pinned bundle this command runs from.
  if (deps.hubSha === null) deps.out('hub bundle: source mode (not a pinned bundle)')
  else if (!existsSync(paths.hubJs(deps.hubSha))) warnings.push(`the pinned hub bundle is missing: ${paths.hubJs(deps.hubSha)}`)
  else deps.out(`hub bundle: ${paths.hubJs(deps.hubSha)}`)
  // The installed Collab against the build the bundle embeds (§10.4 build check).
  if (deps.build === null) deps.out('collab dist: not checked (no embedded build)')
  else if (!distMatches(deps.collabDist, deps.build)) {
    warnings.push("the installed Collab dist differs from this hub's build (collab_build_mismatch): rebuild the hub bundle from the installed build's commit")
  } else deps.out(`collab dist: matches build ${deps.build.hub_build}`)
  // The launcher: the hub's own Local Network identity (C15).
  if (!existsSync(paths.launcherExe)) warnings.push(`the launcher app is missing: ${paths.launcherExe}`)
  else {
    const v = run(deps, [deps.codesign, '--verify', '--deep', '--strict', paths.launcherApp])
    if (v.code !== 0) warnings.push(`the launcher app fails codesign --verify --deep --strict: ${firstLine(v.stderr) || `exit ${v.code}`}`)
    else deps.out('launcher: the signature verifies')
  }
  // The host-key copy against Summon's pin, for every paired device (§5.6).
  for (const d of devices) {
    if (d.state !== 'paired') continue
    const p = pinProblem(paths, d.device)
    if (p) warnings.push(p)
  }
  // launchd: the service, and every label added since the first hub on (§12.3 step 8).
  deps.out(launchctl(deps, 'print', SERVICE).code === 0 ? `launchd: ${HUB_LABEL} is loaded in ${DOMAIN}` : `launchd: ${HUB_LABEL} is not loaded in ${DOMAIN}`)
  if (!existsSync(paths.baselineLabels)) deps.out('launchd labels added since hub on: unknown (no baseline: hub on has not run)')
  else {
    const list = launchctl(deps, 'list')
    if (list.code !== 0) warnings.push(`launchctl list failed (exit ${list.code}): ${firstLine(list.stderr)}`)
    else {
      const diff = labelDiff(readFileSync(paths.baselineLabels, 'utf8'), list.stdout)
      deps.out(`launchd labels added since hub on: ${diff.added.length > 0 ? diff.added.join(', ') : 'none'}`)
      deps.out(`launchd labels removed since hub on: ${diff.removed.length > 0 ? diff.removed.join(', ') : 'none'}`)
    }
  }
  // §9.2's status lines, the sticky host-key warning among them.
  const sticky = devices.reduce((n, d) => n + (d.state === 'paired' ? (shownStatus(paths, d.device)?.sticky.length ?? 0) : 0), 0)
  for (const line of statusReport(deps, devices)) deps.out(line)
  for (const w of warnings) deps.out(`warn: ${w}`)
  return warnings.length > 0 || sticky > 0 ? 1 : 0
}

/** §9.6 item 5, after Ai's repair: a request file the running hub (or its next start) applies through pool.unpark (P54). */
function hubUnpark(deps: AirCliDeps, lineage: string): number {
  const uid = deps.uid()
  if (uid !== HUB_UID) {
    deps.err(`✗ refused: this is uid ${uid}; hub unpark runs as uid ${HUB_UID} (yuai) only`)
    return 1
  }
  const store = new LineageStore(deps.paths.lineages)
  try { store.load() } catch (e) {
    deps.err(`✗ ${message(e)}; nothing was written`)
    return 1
  }
  const entry = store.get(lineage)
  if (!entry) {
    deps.err(`✗ ${lineage} is not in ${deps.paths.lineages}; nothing was written`)
    return 1
  }
  if (entry.parked === null) {
    deps.err(`✗ ${lineage} is not parked; nothing was written`)
    return 1
  }
  mkdirPrivate(deps.paths.requestsDir)
  const req = deps.paths.unparkRequest(lineage)
  writeFileDurable(req, JSON.stringify({ v: 1, lineage, requested_at: deps.now().toISOString() }) + '\n', 0o600)
  deps.out(`Unpark requested: ${req}`)
  deps.out("It is applied at the hub's next reload (or its next start), and refused while a child of that lineage still runs.")
  return 0
}

/**
 * `run` (launchd's) and `hub run` (the Terminal fallback): the hub starts only where `hub on` could be answered, so an
 * agent cannot start one that dials devices and serves seats without Yu. No question, since launchd has no tty, and
 * nothing is touched before the refusal, so a refused start never writes `lock_held` over a running hub's status.
 */
async function startHub(deps: AirCliDeps): Promise<number> {
  const refusal = hubOnRefusal(deps.env, deps.table(), deps.selfPid, deps.uid())
  if (refusal !== null) {
    deps.err(`✗ refused: ${refusal}`)
    return 1
  }
  return deps.runHub()
}

function usage(deps: AirCliDeps): number {
  for (const line of USAGE) deps.err(line)
  return 2
}

export async function runAirCli(argv: string[], deps: AirCliDeps): Promise<number> {
  const [verb, sub, ...rest] = argv
  if (verb === 'version' && sub === undefined) {
    deps.out(JSON.stringify(deps.build ?? { build: null }))
    return 0
  }
  // launchd's verb: the plist's ProgramArguments end '…/hub.js', 'run' (spec C7, §10.4)
  if (verb === 'run' && sub === undefined) return startHub(deps)
  if (verb !== 'hub') return usage(deps)
  if (sub === 'on' && rest.length === 0) return hubOn(deps)
  if (sub === 'off' && rest.length === 0) return hubOff(deps)
  if (sub === 'status' && (rest.length === 0 || (rest.length === 1 && rest[0] === '--json'))) return hubStatus(deps, rest.length === 1)
  if (sub === 'doctor' && (rest.length === 0 || (rest.length === 1 && rest[0] === '--ack-host-key'))) return hubDoctor(deps, rest.length === 1)
  if (sub === 'run' && rest.length === 0) return startHub(deps) // the Terminal fallback (C14, §10.4)
  if (sub === 'unpark' && rest.length === 1 && LINEAGE_RE.test(rest[0]!)) return hubUnpark(deps, rest[0]!)
  return usage(deps)
}
```

```ts
#!/usr/bin/env -S bun --no-env-file --config=/dev/null
// The Air's collab-bridge (C14): argv → runAirCli(defaultAirDeps()) → exit. Built into the pinned
// ~/.local/share/collab-bridge/air/<sha>/hub.js, which ~/.local/bin/collab-bridge and the LaunchAgent run with
// bun --no-env-file --config=/dev/null from cwd / (R39). Exit codes: 0 done; 1 refused or failed; 2 a usage error.
import { basename } from 'node:path'
import { defaultHubDeps, embeddedBuild, runHub } from '../src/air/hub.ts'
import { runAirCli, ttyAsk, type AirCliDeps } from '../src/cli.ts'
import { getuid } from '../src/native.ts'
import { airPaths, collabDist, homeOf } from '../src/paths.ts'
import { readPs } from '../src/proc.ts'
import { systemBin } from '../src/sysbin.ts'

const SHA_DIR_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/
const STOP_SIGNALS = ['SIGTERM', 'SIGINT', 'SIGHUP'] as const

/** The live wiring. hubSha is the pinned bundle's own directory name, so a source run (tests, Task 62) has none. */
export function defaultAirDeps(): AirCliDeps {
  const env = process.env
  const paths = airPaths(homeOf(env))
  const dir = basename(import.meta.dir)
  return {
    paths,
    env,
    selfPid: process.pid,
    uid: getuid,
    table: () => readPs(systemBin('ps', env)),
    ask: ttyAsk(env),
    launchctl: systemBin('launchctl', env),
    codesign: systemBin('codesign', env),
    bun: systemBin('bun', env),
    hubSha: SHA_DIR_RE.test(dir) ? dir : null,
    build: embeddedBuild(),
    collabDist: collabDist(env),
    // `run` and `hub run` only, installed before the hub starts: SIGTERM (`hub off`'s bootout, which the launcher
    // forwards; logout under launchd), SIGINT (Ctrl-C) and SIGHUP (the fallback's Terminal window closing, or logout)
    // reach runHub's clean stop, so the run is recorded clean and hub_stop is ledgered (P58). `once`: a second signal
    // takes its default action. The bin's unref'd exit timer ends a process that a child handle would keep alive.
    runHub: () => {
      const ac = new AbortController()
      const stop = () => ac.abort()
      for (const s of STOP_SIGNALS) process.once(s, stop)
      return runHub({ ...defaultHubDeps(env), signal: ac.signal }).finally(() => {
        for (const s of STOP_SIGNALS) process.off(s, stop)
      })
    },
    out: (line) => { process.stdout.write(`${line}\n`) },
    err: (line) => { process.stderr.write(`${line}\n`) },
    now: () => new Date(),
  }
}

if (import.meta.main) {
  let code: number
  try {
    code = await runAirCli(process.argv.slice(2), defaultAirDeps())
  } catch (e) {
    process.stderr.write(`✗ collab-bridge: ${String((e as Error)?.message ?? e).split('\n')[0]}\n`)
    code = 1
  }
  // Exit once stdout drains; the unref'd timer only ends a process that something else would keep alive.
  process.exitCode = code
  setTimeout(() => process.exit(code), 2000).unref()
}
```

`/Users/yuai/Projects/.worktrees/agenttool-collab-bridge/packages/collab-bridge/README.md`:

````markdown
# collab-bridge

> **Type:** guide · **Purpose:** the verbs, status words, files and repairs of the cross-device Collab bridge, for Yu and Ai.
> **Evidence:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-13-cross-device-collab-design.md` (Phase 1) and this package's tests.

Agent sessions on Yu's other Macs, under their own logins, work in one shared Collab journal on the Air
(`~/.local/share/agenttool/collab-shared/collab.sqlite`), never the Air's private one. Phase 1 is Claude Code on Nuance,
in `~/Projects/collab-trial`, on the home network. On the Air the hub (a LaunchAgent in gui/502 that only Yu turns on)
dials one ssh per device, checks each seat, applies the remote tool policy, keeps a read-only git mirror per device and
forwards each call once to a long-lived Collab child. On Nuance one binary is the ssh gate, the relay, the Claude MCP
pipe and the knock tap.

## The Air's verbs

`~/.local/bin/collab-bridge` runs the pinned hub bundle `~/.local/share/collab-bridge/air/<sha>/hub.js` with
`bun --no-env-file --config=/dev/null` from `/`, so no `bunfig.toml`, `.env` or `BUN_OPTIONS` reaches it.

| Verb | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `collab-bridge hub on` | Yu, in his own Terminal | Refused inside Claude Code, Codex or Hermes (`CLAUDECODE`, any `CODEX_*` or `HERMES_*` variable, or a `claude`, `codex` or `hermes` ancestor process) and for any uid but 502. Asks `Turn the Collab bridge hub on? [y/N]` on `/dev/tty`. The first time, records the gui/502 launchd labels in `~/.local/state/collab-bridge/baseline-labels.txt`; then writes `~/Library/LaunchAgents/dev.agenttool.collab-bridge.plist` (0644), boots out any running hub and bootstraps the plist in gui/502. |
| `collab-bridge hub off` | Yu | The same refusals and question; `launchctl bootout gui/502/dev.agenttool.collab-bridge`, then the plist is removed. |
| `collab-bridge hub status [--json]` | anyone | The status words below; `--json` prints the status files themselves. |
| `collab-bridge hub doctor` | Ai | Checks the pinned bundle, the installed Collab against the build the bundle embeds, the launcher's signature (`codesign --verify --deep --strict`), each paired device's `known_hosts` copy against Summon's pin, and prints `launchd labels added since hub on: …`. Exit 1 when it printed a `warn:` line or a host-key warning. |
| `collab-bridge hub doctor --ack-host-key` | Yu | Acknowledges the sticky host-key warnings (the same refusals as `hub on`, and a y/N question); they leave the status file at once, and no later status write, the running hub's included, brings them back. |
| `collab-bridge hub run` | Yu, in his own Terminal (the fallback) | Runs the hub in the foreground, when the Local Network check finds no grant for the launcher; that hub stops at logout. Refused inside an agent harness and for any uid but 502, like `hub on`, with no question. Ctrl-C, closing the window or logout stop it cleanly. |
| `collab-bridge run` | launchd, through `~/Applications/CollabBridgeHub.app` | The LaunchAgent's own verb (`…/hub.js run`): the same hub and the same refusals; `hub off` stops it cleanly. |
| `collab-bridge hub unpark <lineage>` | Ai | Un-parks a seat after its repair (Seat recovery, below). uid 502 only; no question. |
| `collab-bridge version` | anyone | One JSON line: the build the bundle embeds, or `{"build":null}` from source. |

Exit codes: 0 done; 1 refused, not confirmed or failed; 2 a usage error. `run` and `hub run` exit with the hub's own
code once they start it.

## Status words

`collab-bridge hub status` prints the hub's line, then each device's lines (spec §9.2):

- `up`; `connecting`, or `connecting (no preamble; check ~/.zshenv)` after three silent dials; `away since <T>`.
- `host_key_mismatch (retrying since <T>)`; after 3 mismatches within 30 minutes, `needs Yu: host_key_mismatch`.
- `needs Yu: auth_refused`, `needs Yu: config`, `needs Yu: login_shell_noise`: that device's dialling has stopped.
- `relay_contested`: the device's relay socket was replaced more than 3 times in 10 minutes.
- `host key mismatch seen at <T>, presented <fp>`: sticky until `hub doctor --ack-host-key`.
- `clock skew <n> s (warn)` above 60 s; `hub tool list refused: <lineage>: <digest> <reason>`.
- Seat notes: `needs Ai: seat_recovery <session_id>`, `orphan_session <id>`, `journal_invalid`, `child_start_failed`.
- The hub itself: `hub: not running`, `hub: running`, or the code of a refused start: `lock_held`, `wrong_user`,
  `needs Yu: config`, `collab_build_mismatch`, `collab_build_changed`, `policy_unclassified_tool`.

## The hub's files

| Path | Mode | Holds |
|---|---|---|
| `~/.local/share/agenttool/collab-shared/` | 0700 | `collab.sqlite` (the shared journal), Collab's `collab-sessions/` (credentials, `knock-ledger.json`), `mirrors/<device>/<user>/<mirror_id>/` |
| `~/.local/share/collab-bridge/air/<sha>/hub.js` | 0700 dir | the pinned hub bundle; never changed once written |
| `~/Applications/CollabBridgeHub.app` | 0755 | the launcher: the hub's own Local Network identity |
| `~/.local/bin/collab-bridge` | 0755 | the fixed zsh launcher of the pinned bundle |
| `~/.config/collab-bridge/devices/<device>.json` | 0600 | the device file: state, seat key, git, Summon baselines, shares |
| `~/.ssh/collab-bridge/` | 0700 | `config`, `collab_<device>_ed25519` and `.pub`, `known_hosts` (a copy of Summon's pin) |
| `~/.local/state/collab-bridge/` | 0700 | `ledger.jsonl`, `lineages.json`, `hub.status.json`, `devices/<device>.status.json` and `.host-key-ack`, `requests/`, `baseline-labels.txt`, `hub.lock`, `hub.log` |
| `~/Library/LaunchAgents/dev.agenttool.collab-bridge.plist` | 0644 | written only by `collab-bridge hub on` |

## Seat recovery (`needs Ai: seat_recovery <session_id>`)

A lineage whose Collab session answered `cursor_reset_required` is parked and never resumed on its own (spec §9.6
item 5). The hub stopped its child when it parked it. Ai picks one of two repairs. Set `L` to the lineage id the
status line names (`<device>/<user> <lineage>: needs Ai: seat_recovery <session_id>`), then:

```sh
LJ=/Users/yuai/.local/state/collab-bridge/lineages.json
S=$(jq -r --arg l "$L" '.lineages[] | select(.lineage == $l) | .session_id' "$LJ")
W=$(jq -r --arg l "$L" '.lineages[] | select(.lineage == $l) | .workspace_id' "$LJ")
```

**(a) The audited reset**, which keeps the session's leases and receipts. One manual Collab child, the hub's way, with
`AGENTOOL_COLLAB_ALLOW_CURSOR_RECOVERY=1`. Its first answer names the persisted cursor and the expected cursor version;
the reset then moves the cursor there (or to another valid anchor, chosen after checking §9.8 when the journal itself is
in doubt):

```sh

    AGENTOOL_COLLAB_ALLOW_CURSOR_RECOVERY=1 \
    /Users/yuai/.bun/bin/bun --no-env-file --config=/dev/null /opt/homebrew/lib/node_modules/@agenttool/collab/dist/agenttool-collab-mcp.js) |
  jq -c 'select(.id == 2) | .result.structuredContent'
}
jq -nc --arg w "$W" '{jsonrpc:"2.0",id:2,method:"tools/call",params:{name:"collab_next",arguments:{workspace_id:$w}}}' > "$R/call.json"
collab_repair | tee "$R/need.json"
# expect {"error":"cursor_recovery_required", …, "persisted_cursor":{…}, "expected_cursor_version":<n>}

collab_repair
# expect {"session":{…}} and no "error"

```

**(b) An exit**, when the session should end instead. Without `--release-leases` first: Collab refuses while a lease is
live, so live claims are never dropped by accident; add `--release-leases` only after deciding to drop them. After an
end, outcomes left unknown under the old session cannot be replayed, so the agent checks with `collab_task_list` or
````

### Task 54: Unpair

**Kind:** [implementer] (bridge worktree) · **Group:** 18 · **Spec:** §9.10 (steps 1–5, Air side first, works with Nuance unreachable), §10.6 Air rollback lines; R30.

Unpair is Yu's verb (the same refusals and question as `hub off`) and the Air side of revocation; it never dials the device, so it works with Nuance asleep or gone (R30). It reads `lineages.json` but never writes it: the running hub owns those writes and moves a session whose credential has gone to `ended` itself (P53), and unpair's host ends remove exactly those credentials (K23). The sessions it ends are every lineage session of the device and every active session whose role starts with the hub's stamp `remote(<device>/<user>;` and whose worktree is that device's mirror: an Air session can write itself any role, so a remote-looking role outside the mirror is left alone and named. Facts this task builds on, measured on this Air for this plan with the C10 host bundle and the 0.5.0 MCP bundle on a temp shared journal: linked worktrees of one clone share one workspace while each has its own `worktree_id`; `collab_workspace_status` lists `pending_reviews` with `reported_by_session_id` and `active_sessions` with `worktree_id` and `role`; `agenttool-collab-host end … --release-leases` answers `{"status":"ended","released":[…]}`, frees the live lease and removes the credential file; a completed task's review stays `pending` after its reporter's session ends; and a Collab task title may hold U+202E, so unpair prints titles through `displayText`.

```ts
import { afterAll, afterEach, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from 'bun:test'
import { chmodSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { CollabChild } from '../src/air/children.ts'

import { LineageStore, type LineageEntry } from '../src/air/lineages.ts'
import { makeHostCli } from '../src/air/pool.ts'
import { rolePrefix } from '../src/air/stamp.ts'
import { archiveName, displayText, unpairDevice, withoutHostBlock, type UnpairDeps } from '../src/air/unpair.ts'
import { AIR_LEDGER_KEYS, appendLedger, readLedger, verifyLedger } from '../src/ledger.ts'
import { airPaths, type AirPaths } from '../src/paths.ts'
import { cleanupTmps, COLLAB_DIST, commitFiles, makeRepo, modeOf, PKG, repoGit, temp } from './helpers.ts'
import { collabHarness, startCollabSession } from './mcp-harness.ts'

afterEach(cleanupTmps)

const NOW = new Date('2026-10-13T12:00:00.000Z')
const MIRROR_ID = '0123456789abcdef'
const Z_MIRROR_ID = 'fedcba9876543210'
const NUANCE_BLOCK = 'Host collab-nuance\n  HostName nuance.local\n  User macair\n  IdentityFile /Users/yuai/.ssh/collab-bridge/collab_nuance_ed25519\n\n'
const ZERONE_BLOCK = 'Host collab-zerone\n  HostName zerone.local\n  User macair\n  IdentityFile /Users/yuai/.ssh/collab-bridge/collab_zerone_ed25519\n'

type Session = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof startCollabSession>>

function device(paths: AirPaths, o: { device: string; airClone: string; mirrorId: string; worktreeId: string | null; workspaceId: string | null }): DeviceFile {
  return {
    v: 1, device: o.device, user: 'macair', state: 'paired', host_alias: `collab-${o.device}`, seat_public: 'a1'.repeat(32),
    bundle_build: 'abcdef01', key_expiry: '20270111', trailer: 'Co-Authored-By: The Fable of the Eternal Universe <Yu@Ai-love.cc>',
    git: { path: '/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin/git', version: '2.39.5', sha256: 'c'.repeat(64), guard: true, apple: true },
    summon: { key_sha256: 'd'.repeat(64), dropin_stat: '1234567 287 1760000000000 0 600' },
    shares: [{ remote_realpath: '/Users/macair/Projects/collab-trial', remote_gitdir: '/Users/macair/Projects/collab-trial/.git',
      air_clone: o.airClone, mirror_id: o.mirrorId, mirror_worktree_id: o.worktreeId, workspace_id: o.workspaceId, caps: DEFAULT_CAPS }],
    prepared_at: '2026-10-13T10:00:00.000Z', paired_at: '2026-10-13T11:00:00.000Z',
  }
}

function lineage(over: Partial<LineageEntry>): LineageEntry {
  return { lineage: 'lin_' + '1'.repeat(32), device: 'nuance', user: 'macair', harness: 'claude', folder: '/Users/macair/Projects/collab-trial',
    state: 'pending', session_id: null, credential_path: null, past_sessions: [], mirror_id: MIRROR_ID, workspace_id: null,
    pending_start: null, parked: null, detached_since: null, created_at: '2026-10-13T11:00:00.000Z', ...over }
}

/** The shared journal's current view of one workspace, through a fresh unbound child the hub's way. */
async function status(paths: AirPaths, home: string, ws: string): Promise<any> {
  const c = await CollabChild.start({ bun: process.execPath, dist: COLLAB_DIST, journal: paths.sharedJournal, home })
  if ('failed' in c) throw new Error(`Collab did not start: ${c.lastErrLine}`)
  try {
    const r = await c.call('collab_workspace_status', { workspace_id: ws })
    if (r.outcome !== 'ok') throw new Error('workspace_status failed')
    return r.result.structuredContent
  } finally {
    await c.stop()
  }
}

/** One call as a session, through the hub-way harness resumed from that session's own credential. */
async function asSession(home: string, journal: string, s: Session, calls: (call: (name: string, args: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<any>) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  const h = collabHarness({ journal, home, sessionFile: s.credentialFile })
  try {
    await h.initialize()
    await calls(async (name, args) => {
      const r = await h.callTool(name, args)
      if (r.isError) throw new Error(`${name} failed: ${r.content[0].text}`)
      return r.structuredContent
    })
  } finally {
    await h.close()
  }
}

/**
 * A shared journal as a Phase 1 Air would hold it: nuance's mirror (a linked worktree of the Air clone) with three remote
 * sessions (A holds a lineage and has a completed edit task pending review; B holds a lineage whose credential is gone; C
 * holds a live lease and is in no lineage, as after a lost session_start marker), an Air reviewer, an Air session that
 * wrote itself a remote-looking role, and zerone's own remote session; the device files, ssh config, keys and ledger of
 * both devices. Then `unpair nuance`, once.
 */
describe('unpair nuance against a real shared journal', () => {
  let root = ''
  let home = ''
  let paths: AirPaths
  let ws = ''
  let s: Record<'a' | 'b' | 'c' | 'air' | 'forger' | 'z', Session>
  let before: DeviceFile
  let code = -1
  const out: string[] = []
  const hostCalls: string[][] = []
  let tripwire = ''

  beforeAll(async () => {
    root = realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'cb-unpair-')))
    home = join(root, 'home')
    mkdirSync(home)
    paths = airPaths(home)
    mkdirSync(paths.sharedDir, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 })
    const airClone = join(home, 'Projects', 'collab-trial')
    makeRepo(airClone)
    const mirror = paths.mirrorDir('nuance', 'macair', MIRROR_ID)
    const zMirror = paths.mirrorDir('zerone', 'macair', Z_MIRROR_ID)
    repoGit(airClone, ['worktree', 'add', '-q', '--detach', mirror, 'HEAD'])
    repoGit(airClone, ['worktree', 'add', '-q', '--detach', zMirror, 'HEAD'])
    const journal = paths.sharedJournal
    const start = (at: string, actor: string, role: string) => startCollabSession({ journal, home, root: at, actor, role })
    const remote = (dev: string, nonce: string, rest: string) => rolePrefix(dev, 'macair', nonce, 'claude') + rest
    s = {
      a: await start(mirror, 'nuance/macair · self-declared: claude A', remote('nuance', 'a'.repeat(16), 'worker')),
      b: await start(mirror, 'nuance/macair · self-declared: claude B', remote('nuance', 'b'.repeat(16), 'worker')),
      c: await start(mirror, 'nuance/macair · self-declared: claude C', remote('nuance', 'c'.repeat(16), 'worker')),
      air: await start(airClone, 'air reviewer', 'reviewer'),
      forger: await start(airClone, 'air session with a borrowed role', remote('nuance', 'f'.repeat(16), 'not remote at all')),
      z: await start(zMirror, 'zerone/macair · self-declared: claude Z', remote('zerone', 'e'.repeat(16), 'worker')),
    }
    ws = s.a.workspaceId
    // A completes an edit task in the mirror: its review is pending, and stays so.
    await asSession(home, journal, s.a, async (call) => {
      const created = await call('collab_task_create', { workspace_id: ws, idempotency_key: 'create-review', task_id: 't-review',
        title: 'Add notes/a.md \u202e', work_mode: 'edit', path_scopes: ['notes'], completion_policy: 'accepted' })
      const claimed = await call('collab_task_claim', { workspace_id: ws, task_id: 't-review', idempotency_key: 'claim-review', expected_version: created.task.version })
      commitFiles(mirror, { 'notes/a.md': 'a\n' }, 'notes: a')
      await call('collab_task_complete', { workspace_id: ws, task_id: 't-review', lease_id: claimed.task.lease_id, idempotency_key: 'complete-review',
        expected_version: claimed.task.version, summary: 'added notes/a.md' })
    })
    // C holds a live lease: --release-leases frees it.
    await asSession(home, journal, s.c, async (call) => {
      const created = await call('collab_task_create', { workspace_id: ws, idempotency_key: 'create-lease', task_id: 't-lease', title: 'Coordinate', work_mode: 'coordination' })
      await call('collab_task_claim', { workspace_id: ws, task_id: 't-lease', idempotency_key: 'claim-lease', expected_version: created.task.version })
    })
    before = device(paths, { device: 'nuance', airClone, mirrorId: MIRROR_ID, worktreeId: s.a.worktreeId, workspaceId: ws })
    writeDevice(paths.deviceFile('nuance'), before)
    writeDevice(paths.deviceFile('zerone'), device(paths, { device: 'zerone', airClone, mirrorId: Z_MIRROR_ID, worktreeId: s.z.worktreeId, workspaceId: ws }))
    const store = new LineageStore(paths.lineages)
    store.load()
    store.upsert(lineage({ lineage: 'lin_' + 'a'.repeat(32), state: 'live', session_id: s.a.sessionId, credential_path: s.a.credentialFile, workspace_id: ws }))
    store.upsert(lineage({ lineage: 'lin_' + 'b'.repeat(32), state: 'live', session_id: s.b.sessionId, credential_path: s.b.credentialFile, workspace_id: ws }))
    store.upsert(lineage({ lineage: 'lin_' + '9'.repeat(32), device: 'zerone', mirror_id: Z_MIRROR_ID, state: 'live', session_id: s.z.sessionId,
      credential_path: s.z.credentialFile, workspace_id: ws }))
    rmSync(s.b.credentialFile)
    mkdirSync(paths.sshDir, { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 })
    writeFileSync(paths.sshConfig, NUANCE_BLOCK + ZERONE_BLOCK, { mode: 0o600 })
    for (const dev of ['nuance', 'zerone']) {
      writeFileSync(paths.sshKey(dev), `private key of ${dev}\n`, { mode: 0o600 })
      writeFileSync(`${paths.sshKey(dev)}.pub`, `ssh-ed25519 AAAA ${dev} collab-air\n`, { mode: 0o600 })
    }
    appendLedger(paths.ledger, AIR_LEDGER_KEYS, { event: 'dial', device: 'nuance', outcome: 'ok' }, Date.parse('2026-10-13T11:00:00.000Z'))
    // A tripwire for ssh: the knob and the first PATH entry both name a stub that records any call in a fixed file.
    const trip = join(root, 'tripwire')
    mkdirSync(trip)
    tripwire = join(trip, 'calls')
    writeFileSync(join(trip, 'ssh'), `#!/bin/bash\nprintf '%s\\n' "$*" >> '${tripwire}'\nexit 255\n`)
    chmodSync(join(trip, 'ssh'), 0o755)
    const saved = { knob: process.env.COLLAB_BRIDGE_BIN_SSH, path: process.env.PATH }
    process.env.COLLAB_BRIDGE_BIN_SSH = join(trip, 'ssh')
    process.env.PATH = `${trip}:${saved.path}`
    const real = makeHostCli({ bun: process.execPath, dist: COLLAB_DIST, journal, home })
    const deps: UnpairDeps = {
      paths, store: new LineageStore(paths.lineages),
      hostCli: async (args, timeoutMs) => { hostCalls.push(args); return real(args, timeoutMs) },
      unboundChild: () => CollabChild.start({ bun: process.execPath, dist: COLLAB_DIST, journal, home }),
      out: (l) => { out.push(l) }, now: () => NOW,
    }
    try {
      code = await unpairDevice('nuance', deps)
    } finally {
      process.env.COLLAB_BRIDGE_BIN_SSH = saved.knob
      process.env.PATH = saved.path
    }
  }, 60_000)

  afterAll(() => { rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }) })

  test('marks the device unpaired and drops its seat key', () => {
    expect(readDevice(paths.deviceFile('nuance'))).toEqual({ ...before, state: 'unpaired', seat_public: null })
    expect(readDevice(paths.deviceFile('zerone'))!.state).toBe('paired')
    expect(out[0]).toBe('1. nuance is marked unpaired on the Air and its seat key is dropped; a running hub closes its link and stops its children at its next reload.')
  })

  test('lists pending reviews without deciding them', async () => {
    expect(out).toContain('2. Pending reviews from nuance, left for an Air session (accept only while the mirror is still at the completed commit, else request_changes; unpair decides none):')
    expect(out).toContain(`   - t-review in ${ws}: Add notes/a.md ? (reported by ${s.a.sessionId})`)
    const after = await status(paths, home, ws)
    const review = after.pending_reviews.find((t: any) => t.id === 't-review')
    expect([review?.status, review?.review_status, review?.accepted_by_session_id]).toEqual(['completed', 'pending', null])
  }, 20_000)

  test('ends every remote session with --release-leases', async () => {
    const end = (cred: string) => ['end', '--session-file', cred, '--reason', 'device unpaired', '--release-leases', '--db', paths.sharedJournal]
    expect([...hostCalls].sort()).toEqual([end(s.a.credentialFile), end(s.c.credentialFile)].sort())
    expect(out).toContain('3. Ending nuance\'s remote sessions with --release-leases:')
    expect(out).toContain(`   - ended ${s.a.sessionId} (0 lease(s) released)`)
    expect(out).toContain(`   - ended ${s.c.sessionId} (1 lease(s) released)`)
    const after = await status(paths, home, ws)
    const active = after.active_sessions.map((x: any) => x.id)
    expect(active).not.toContain(s.a.sessionId)
    expect(active).not.toContain(s.c.sessionId)
    for (const kept of [s.air, s.forger, s.z]) expect(active).toContain(kept.sessionId)
    expect(after.active_claims.map((t: any) => t.id)).not.toContain('t-lease')
    // the Collab credential files of the ended sessions are gone, as Collab's end removes them (K23)
    expect(existsSync(s.a.credentialFile)).toBe(false)
    expect(existsSync(s.c.credentialFile)).toBe(false)
    // lineages.json is the running hub's to write: unpair leaves it exactly as it was
    const entries = new LineageStore(paths.lineages)
    entries.load()
    expect(entries.get('lin_' + 'a'.repeat(32))!.state).toBe('live')
  }, 20_000)

  test('reports a session with no credential file', async () => {
    expect(out).toContain(`   - ${s.b.sessionId}: no credential file (${s.b.credentialFile}); it cannot be ended from the Air, and its expired claims wait for recovery from an Air session`)
    expect(hostCalls.some((a) => a.includes(s.b.credentialFile))).toBe(false)
    expect((await status(paths, home, ws)).active_sessions.map((x: any) => x.id)).toContain(s.b.sessionId)
    expect(code).toBe(1)
    expect(out.at(-1)).toBe('✗ nuance is unpaired on the Air, with 1 item(s) above for Ai.')
  }, 20_000)

  test('leaves alone an Air session whose role only looks remote', () => {
    expect(out).toContain(`   - ${s.forger.sessionId} has a remote-looking role but is not in nuance's mirror; left alone`)
    expect(hostCalls.some((a) => a.some((x) => x.includes(s.forger.sessionId)))).toBe(false)
  })

  test('removes the Host block and the key, archives the ledger', () => {
    expect(readFileSync(paths.sshConfig, 'utf8')).toBe(ZERONE_BLOCK)
    expect(modeOf(paths.sshConfig)).toBe(0o600)
    expect(existsSync(paths.sshKey('nuance'))).toBe(false)
    expect(existsSync(`${paths.sshKey('nuance')}.pub`)).toBe(false)
    expect(existsSync(paths.sshKey('zerone'))).toBe(true)
    const archive = join(paths.stateDir, 'ledger.20261013T120000Z.jsonl')
    expect(out).toContain(`   - the hub ledger is archived as ${archive}`)
    expect(modeOf(archive)).toBe(0o600)
    expect(verifyLedger(archive).ok).toBe(true)
    const archived = readLedger(archive)
    expect(archived.map((e) => e.event)).toEqual(['dial', 'unpair_end', 'unpair_end', 'unpair_end', 'unpair'])
    expect(archived.at(-1)).toMatchObject({ event: 'unpair', device: 'nuance', user: 'macair', outcome: 'incomplete' })
    const fresh = readLedger(paths.ledger)
    expect(fresh.map((e) => [e.event, e.code])).toEqual([['ledger_archived', 'ledger.20261013T120000Z.jsonl']])
    expect(verifyLedger(paths.ledger).ok).toBe(true)
    // content-free: no title, path or credential reached either ledger
    for (const text of [readFileSync(archive, 'utf8'), readFileSync(paths.ledger, 'utf8')]) {
      expect(text).not.toContain('notes/a.md')
      expect(text).not.toContain('collab-sessions')
    }
  })

  test('never runs ssh', () => {
    expect(existsSync(tripwire)).toBe(false)
    expect(readFileSync(join(PKG, 'src', 'air', 'unpair.ts'), 'utf8')).not.toMatch(/systemBin|\/usr\/bin\/ssh|'ssh'/)
  })

  test('prints the incomplete-revocation line', () => {
    expect(out).toContain('5. Revocation is incomplete until the " collab-air" line is removed from ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on nuance '
      + "(there: sed -i '' '/ collab-air$/d' ~/.ssh/authorized_keys) or the key expires on 2027-01-11.")
    expect(out.indexOf(out.find((l) => l.startsWith('5. '))!)).toBeGreaterThan(out.indexOf(out.find((l) => l.startsWith('4. '))!))
  })
})
```

```ts
// Unpair a device, Air side first (spec §9.10, R30): it works with the device unreachable, because nothing here dials it.
// 1. The device file goes `unpaired` without its seat key, and a running hub (Task 52) closes the link, stops that
//    device's children and refuses its attaches at its next reload. 2. The device's pending reviews are listed for an Air
//    session to review; unpair decides none. 3. Every remote session of the device is ended through Collab's own host CLI
//    with --release-leases, so its scopes are free again (K12); one without a credential file is reported, never skipped.
// 4. The hub ledger is archived, and the device's Host block and key files are removed. 5. Revocation stays incomplete
//    until the ` collab-air` line is gone on the device or expires (T5), and the output says so.
// lineages.json is only read here: the running hub owns its writes, and it moves a session whose credential is gone
// to `ended` itself (P53).
import { chmodSync, existsSync, readFileSync, renameSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs'
import { basename, join } from 'node:path'
import { AIR_LEDGER_KEYS, appendLedger, withLock, type LedgerFields } from '../ledger.ts'
import { writeFileDurable } from '../native.ts'
import type { AirPaths } from '../paths.ts'
import { CollabChild, type StartFailure } from './children.ts'
import { updateDevice, type DeviceFile } from './devices.ts'
import { LineageStore } from './lineages.ts'
import { makeHostCli, type HostCli } from './pool.ts'

export interface UnpairDeps { paths: AirPaths; store: LineageStore; hostCli: HostCli; unboundChild(): Promise<CollabChild | StartFailure>; out(line: string): void; now(): Date }

export const UNPAIR_REASON = 'device unpaired'
/** One host end: a resume and an end on the shared journal, two chain passes at most (K21); far above what it takes. */
export const HOST_END_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000
const DEVICE_RE = /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$/
const TITLE_MAX = 120

interface ActiveSession { id: string; worktree_id: string; role: string | null }
interface PendingReview { id: string; title: string; reported_by_session_id: string | null }
interface WorkspaceView { pending_reviews: PendingReview[]; active_sessions: ActiveSession[] }

const isRecord = (v: unknown): v is Record<string, unknown> => typeof v === 'object' && v !== null && !Array.isArray(v)
const message = (e: unknown) => String((e as Error)?.message ?? e).split('\n')[0]!

/** Seat text shown on Ai's terminal: no control, bidi or line-separator character survives, and it is cut short. */
export function displayText(s: string): string {
  const clean = s.replace(/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f-\u009f\u061c\u200e\u200f\u2028\u2029\u202a-\u202e\u2066-\u2069]/g, '?')
  return clean.length > TITLE_MAX ? `${clean.slice(0, TITLE_MAX)}…` : clean
}

/** `ledger.<UTC stamp>.jsonl` beside the ledger, never over an earlier archive. */
export function archiveName(stateDir: string, now: Date, exists: (p: string) => boolean = existsSync): string {
  const stamp = now.toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').replace(/\.\d{3}Z$/, 'Z')
  for (let n = 1; ; n++) {
    const p = join(stateDir, n === 1 ? `ledger.${stamp}.jsonl` : `ledger.${stamp}-${n}.jsonl`)
    if (!exists(p)) return p
  }
}

/** The ssh config without the single-pattern `Host <alias>` block (up to the next Host or Match line). */
export function withoutHostBlock(config: string, alias: string): { text: string; removed: boolean } {
  const kept: string[] = []
  let skipping = false
  let removed = false
  for (const line of config.split('\n')) {
    const head = /^\s*(Host|Match)\s+(.+?)\s*$/i.exec(line)
    if (head) skipping = head[1]!.toLowerCase() === 'host' && head[2] === alias
    if (skipping) removed = true
    else kept.push(line)
  }
  return { text: kept.join('\n'), removed }
}

function workspaceView(sc: unknown): WorkspaceView | null {
  if (!isRecord(sc) || !Array.isArray(sc.pending_reviews) || !Array.isArray(sc.active_sessions)) return null
  const reviews = sc.pending_reviews.filter(isRecord).filter((t) => typeof t.id === 'string').map((t) => ({
    id: t.id as string, title: typeof t.title === 'string' ? t.title : '', reported_by_session_id: typeof t.reported_by_session_id === 'string' ? t.reported_by_session_id : null,
  }))
  const sessions = sc.active_sessions.filter(isRecord).filter((s) => typeof s.id === 'string' && typeof s.worktree_id === 'string').map((s) => ({
    id: s.id as string, worktree_id: s.worktree_id as string, role: typeof s.role === 'string' ? s.role : null,
  }))
  return { pending_reviews: reviews, active_sessions: sessions }
}

/** Each bound workspace's status, read once through one fresh unbound child on the shared journal (its caller stops it). */
async function readWorkspaces(ids: string[], deps: UnpairDeps, problems: string[]): Promise<Map<string, WorkspaceView>> {
  const views = new Map<string, WorkspaceView>()
  if (ids.length === 0) return views
  const child = await deps.unboundChild()
  if ('failed' in child) {
    problems.push(`Collab did not start on the shared journal (${child.lastErrLine ?? `exit ${child.exitCode}`}): pending reviews and journal sessions were not read`)
    return views
  }
  try {
    for (const id of ids) {
      const r = await child.call('collab_workspace_status', { workspace_id: id })
      const view = r.outcome === 'ok' ? workspaceView(r.result.structuredContent) : null
      if (view) views.set(id, view)
      else {
        const code = r.outcome === 'unknown' ? r.reason : String(r.result.structuredContent?.error ?? 'error')
        problems.push(`workspace ${id} could not be read (${code})`)
      }
    }
  } finally {
    await child.stop()
  }
  return views
}

export async function unpairDevice(device: string, deps: UnpairDeps): Promise<number> {
  const { paths, out } = deps
  if (!DEVICE_RE.test(device)) {
    out(`✗ ${JSON.stringify(device).slice(0, 40)} is not a device name; nothing was changed`)
    return 1
  }
  const ledger = (f: LedgerFields) => appendLedger(paths.ledger, AIR_LEDGER_KEYS, f, deps.now().getTime())
  const problems: string[] = []
  const report = (line: string) => { problems.push(line); out(line) }

  // 1. The device file: through updateDevice, so a hub writing the same file never puts the seat key back.
  let d: DeviceFile | null
  try {
    d = updateDevice(paths.deviceFile(device), (cur) => ({ ...cur, state: 'unpaired', seat_public: null }))
  } catch (e) {
    out(`✗ ${device}: the device file could not be updated (${message(e)}); nothing was changed`)
    return 1
  }
  if (d === null) {
    out(`✗ ${device}: no device file at ${paths.deviceFile(device)}; nothing was changed`)
    return 1
  }
  const user = d.user
  out(`1. ${device} is marked unpaired on the Air and its seat key is dropped; a running hub closes its link and stops its children at its next reload.`)

  // What the Air knows of the device's sessions: its lineages (read only) and the workspaces they and its shares bound.
  let mine: ReturnType<LineageStore['all']> = []
  try {
    deps.store.load()
    mine = deps.store.all().filter((e) => e.device === device)
  } catch (e) {
    report(`   lineages.json could not be read (${message(e)}): sessions are found from the journal only`)
  }
  const workspaces = [...new Set([...d.shares.map((s) => s.workspace_id), ...mine.map((e) => e.workspace_id), ...mine.map((e) => e.pending_start?.workspace_id ?? null)]
    .filter((w): w is string => typeof w === 'string'))].sort()
  const mirrorWorktrees = new Set(d.shares.map((s) => s.mirror_worktree_id).filter((w): w is string => w !== null))
  const readProblems: string[] = []
  const views = await readWorkspaces(workspaces, deps, readProblems)

  // The sessions to end: every lineage's session, and every active session the hub stamped for this seat in its mirror.
  const rolePrefix = `remote(${device}/${user};`
  const toEnd = new Map<string, string>()
  for (const e of mine) if (e.session_id !== null && e.credential_path !== null) toEnd.set(e.session_id, e.credential_path)
  const leftAlone: string[] = []
  for (const view of views.values()) {
    for (const s of view.active_sessions) {
      if (s.role === null || !s.role.startsWith(rolePrefix)) continue
      if (mirrorWorktrees.has(s.worktree_id)) { if (!toEnd.has(s.id)) toEnd.set(s.id, paths.credentialFile(s.id)) }
      else if (!toEnd.has(s.id)) leftAlone.push(s.id) // an Air session can write any role; only the mirror is the seat's
    }
  }
  const deviceSessions = new Set([...mine.flatMap((e) => [...e.past_sessions, ...(e.session_id ? [e.session_id] : [])]), ...toEnd.keys()])

  // 2. Pending reviews: listed, never decided.
  if (workspaces.length === 0) out(`2. No workspace is recorded for ${device}, so there is no pending review to list.`)
  else {
    const reviews = [...views.entries()].flatMap(([ws, v]) => v.pending_reviews
      .filter((t) => t.reported_by_session_id !== null && deviceSessions.has(t.reported_by_session_id)).map((t) => ({ ws, t })))
    if (reviews.length === 0 && readProblems.length === 0) out(`2. No pending review from ${device}.`)
    else {
      out(`2. Pending reviews from ${device}, left for an Air session (accept only while the mirror is still at the completed commit, else request_changes; unpair decides none):`)
      for (const { ws, t } of reviews) out(`   - ${t.id} in ${ws}: ${displayText(t.title)} (reported by ${t.reported_by_session_id})`)
    }
    for (const p of readProblems) report(`   ${p}`)
  }

  // 3. End each session with its leases released (spec §9.10 step 3).
  if (toEnd.size === 0 && leftAlone.length === 0) out(`3. No remote session of ${device} is active.`)
  else out(`3. Ending ${device}'s remote sessions with --release-leases:`)
  for (const [id, credential] of [...toEnd.entries()].sort(([a], [b]) => (a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0))) {
    if (!existsSync(credential)) {
      report(`   - ${id}: no credential file (${credential}); it cannot be ended from the Air, and its expired claims wait for recovery from an Air session`)
      ledger({ event: 'unpair_end', device, user, session_id: id, outcome: 'no_credential' })
      continue
    }
    const r = await deps.hostCli(['end', '--session-file', credential, '--reason', UNPAIR_REASON, '--release-leases', '--db', paths.sharedJournal], HOST_END_TIMEOUT_MS)
    let receipt: Record<string, unknown> | null = null
    try { const v = JSON.parse(r.stdout.split('\n')[0] ?? ''); receipt = isRecord(v) ? v : null } catch { receipt = null }
    const status = typeof receipt?.status === 'string' ? receipt.status : null
    if (r.code === 0 && status === 'ended') {
      const released = Array.isArray(receipt?.released) ? receipt.released.length : 0
      out(`   - ended ${id} (${released} lease(s) released)`)
    } else if (r.code === 0 && status === 'already_ended') {
      out(`   - ${id} had already ended`)
    } else {
      const code = typeof receipt?.error === 'string' ? receipt.error : r.code === null ? 'timeout' : `exit ${r.code}`
      report(`   - ${id}: the host end failed (${code}); the session may still be active`)
    }
    ledger({ event: 'unpair_end', device, user, session_id: id, outcome: status ?? 'failed', code: typeof receipt?.error === 'string' ? receipt.error : undefined })
  }
  for (const id of leftAlone.sort()) out(`   - ${id} has a remote-looking role but is not in ${device}'s mirror; left alone`)

  // 4. The Air's files: the hub ledger archived whole, then this device's Host block and key files.
  out('4. Air files:')
  ledger({ event: 'unpair', device, user, outcome: problems.length === 0 ? 'ok' : 'incomplete', code: `${toEnd.size} session(s)` })
  const archive = archiveName(paths.stateDir, deps.now())
  withLock(paths.ledger, () => renameSync(paths.ledger, archive)) // the hub appends under the same lock
  chmodSync(archive, 0o600)
  ledger({ event: 'ledger_archived', device, code: basename(archive) })
  out(`   - the hub ledger is archived as ${archive}`)
  if (existsSync(paths.sshConfig)) {
    const { text, removed } = withoutHostBlock(readFileSync(paths.sshConfig, 'utf8'), d.host_alias)
    if (!removed) out(`   - no Host ${d.host_alias} block in ${paths.sshConfig}`)
    else {
      if (text.trim() === '') rmSync(paths.sshConfig)
      else writeFileDurable(paths.sshConfig, text.endsWith('\n') ? text : `${text}\n`, 0o600)
      out(`   - removed the Host ${d.host_alias} block from ${paths.sshConfig}`)
    }
  }
  for (const f of [paths.sshKey(device), `${paths.sshKey(device)}.pub`]) {
    if (existsSync(f)) { rmSync(f); out(`   - removed ${f}`) }
  }
  out(`   - a running hub stops ${device}'s children at its next reload; with the hub off there are none`)

  // 5. What the Air cannot do on its own.
  const expiry = `${d.key_expiry.slice(0, 4)}-${d.key_expiry.slice(4, 6)}-${d.key_expiry.slice(6, 8)}`
  out(`5. Revocation is incomplete until the " collab-air" line is removed from ~/.ssh/authorized_keys on ${device} (there: sed -i '' '/ collab-air$/d' ~/.ssh/authorized_keys) or the key expires on ${expiry}.`)
  if (problems.length === 0) {
    out(`✓ ${device} is unpaired on the Air.`)
    return 0
  }
  out(`✗ ${device} is unpaired on the Air, with ${problems.length} item(s) above for Ai.`)
  return 1
}

/** The live wiring `collab-bridge unpair` uses: Collab's own host CLI and a fresh unbound child, both the hub's way. */
export function liveUnpairDeps(o: { paths: AirPaths; bun: string; dist: string; out(line: string): void }): UnpairDeps {
  return {
    paths: o.paths,
    store: new LineageStore(o.paths.lineages),
    hostCli: makeHostCli({ bun: o.bun, dist: o.dist, journal: o.paths.sharedJournal, home: o.paths.home }),
    unboundChild: () => CollabChild.start({ bun: o.bun, dist: o.dist, journal: o.paths.sharedJournal, home: o.paths.home }),
    out: o.out,
    now: () => new Date(),
  }
}
```
