```ts
// The Air's verbs (C14). `hub on` and `hub off` are Yu's: they refuse inside any agent harness and read his y from
// /dev/tty, so only Yu turns the hub on or off (spec §10.3 step 7, §10.4). `hub doctor --ack-host-key` is his too: it
// acknowledges a security warning (§5.5). So is `unpair <device>`, which revokes a device (§9.10, §10.6). `hub status`,
// `hub doctor` and `version` only read. The bare `run` is launchd's verb (the plist's ProgramArguments end `…/hub.js`,
// `run`: C7, §10.4) and `hub run` is the Terminal fallback (C14, §10.4); both are refused inside any agent harness and
// for any uid but 502, with no question, so no agent starts a hub that serves seats without Yu. `hub unpark` is Ai's
// repair step after a seat recovery (§9.6 item 5, P54).
// Every side effect comes through AirCliDeps; bin/collab-bridge.ts is the only place that builds the live ones.
import { chmodSync, closeSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, openSync, readFileSync, readSync, rmSync, writeSync } from 'node:fs'
import { basename, dirname } from 'node:path'
import { listDevices, type DeviceFile } from './air/devices.ts'
import { distMatches, type BuildInfo } from './air/hub.ts'
import { LineageStore } from './air/lineages.ts'
import { renderPlist } from './air/plist.ts'
import {
  activeSticky, readDeviceStatus, readHostKeyAck, readHubStatus, statusLines, writeDeviceStatus, writeHostKeyAck, type DeviceStatus,
} from './air/status.ts'
import { LINEAGE_RE } from './link/messages.ts'
import { writeFileDurable } from './native.ts'
import { mkdirPrivate } from './private-dir.ts'
import type { AirPaths } from './paths.ts'
import { ancestry, HARNESS_COMMS, type ProcTable } from './proc.ts'
import { overrideActive, type Env } from './sysbin.ts'

export const HUB_LABEL = 'dev.agenttool.collab-bridge'
/** yuai's uid: the hub lives in gui/502 only, never in another account's domain on this Air (P10). */
export const HUB_UID = 502
const DOMAIN = `gui/${HUB_UID}`
const SERVICE = `${DOMAIN}/${HUB_LABEL}`

export interface AirCliDeps {
  paths: AirPaths; env: Env; selfPid: number; uid(): number; table(): ProcTable | null; ask(prompt: string): string | null
  launchctl: string; codesign: string; bun: string; hubSha: string | null; build: BuildInfo | null; collabDist: string
  runHub(): Promise<number>; out(line: string): void; err(line: string): void; now(): Date
  unpair(device: string): Promise<number>
}

export const USAGE: readonly string[] = [
  'usage: collab-bridge hub on | hub off | hub status [--json] | hub doctor [--ack-host-key] | hub run | hub unpark <lineage>',
  '       collab-bridge unpair <device>',
  '       collab-bridge version | run (launchd only)',
]

const SHA_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/
/** Summon's device names, the ones the device files carry (Task 47). */
const DEVICE_RE = /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$/
/** Per-run launchd entries: apps Yu opens and one-shot jobs come and go between the baseline and any later check. */
const PER_RUN: readonly RegExp[] = [/^application\./, /^\[0x/, /^com\.apple\.xpc\.launchd\.oneshot\./]
const REPLY_MAX_BYTES = 256

/** The fixed ~/.local/bin/collab-bridge (spec §4.3 with P14's env -u): zsh -f reads no rc file, and bun gets no BUN_OPTIONS. */
export function cliLauncherText(sha: string): string {
  if (!SHA_RE.test(sha)) throw new Error('cliLauncherText: sha must be 64 lowercase hex')
  return '#!/bin/zsh -f\n'
    + `cd / && exec /usr/bin/env -u BUN_OPTIONS -u BUN_BE_BUN /Users/yuai/.bun/bin/bun --no-env-file --config=/dev/null /Users/yuai/.local/share/collab-bridge/air/${sha}/hub.js "$@"\n`
}

/** One label from a `launchctl list` row (`PID\tStatus\tLabel`), or from a line of the stored baseline (the label alone). */
function labelOf(line: string): string | null {
  const trimmed = line.trim()
  if (trimmed === '') return null
  let cols = line.split('\t')
  if (cols.length < 3) {
    const words = trimmed.split(/\s+/)
    cols = words.length >= 3 && /^(-|\d+)$/.test(words[0]!) && /^-?\d+$/.test(words[1]!) ? words
      : words[0] === 'PID' ? words : [trimmed]
  }
  if (cols.length < 3) return trimmed
  if (cols[0]!.trim() === 'PID') return null // launchctl's header
  return cols.slice(2).join(' ').trim() || null
}

export function stableLabels(launchctlList: string): string[] {
  const labels = new Set<string>()
  for (const line of launchctlList.split('\n')) {
    const label = labelOf(line)
    if (label !== null && !PER_RUN.some((re) => re.test(label))) labels.add(label)
  }
  return [...labels].sort()
}

export function labelDiff(baseline: string, current: string): { added: string[]; removed: string[] } {
  const before = new Set(stableLabels(baseline))
  const after = new Set(stableLabels(current))
  return { added: [...after].filter((l) => !before.has(l)), removed: [...before].filter((l) => !after.has(l)) }
}

/**
 * Why this process may not turn the hub on or off, or start it (`run`, `hub run`), or null when it may. Fails closed: a
 * process table that cannot be read, or that does not hold this process, cannot rule out a harness ancestor. An agent
 * may ask Yu; it never answers for him.
 */
export function hubOnRefusal(env: Env, table: ProcTable | null, selfPid: number, uid: number): string | null {
  const only = 'only Yu turns the hub on or off, from his own Terminal'
  if (env.CLAUDECODE !== undefined) return `CLAUDECODE is set (a Claude Code session); ${only}`
  for (const k of Object.keys(env).sort()) {
    if (env[k] !== undefined && (k.startsWith('CODEX_') || k.startsWith('HERMES_'))) {
      return `${k} is set (an agent harness); ${only} (if his shell exports it, run it as env -u ${k} collab-bridge …)`
    }
  }
  if (table === null) return `the process table could not be read, so an agent harness ancestor cannot be ruled out; ${only}`
  const chain = ancestry(selfPid, table)
  if (chain.length === 0) return `this process is not in the process table, so an agent harness ancestor cannot be ruled out; ${only}`
  for (const rec of chain) {
    const name = basename(rec.comm)
    if (HARNESS_COMMS.has(name)) return `${name} (pid ${rec.pid}) is an ancestor of this process; ${only}`
  }
  if (uid !== HUB_UID) return `this is uid ${uid}; the hub runs as uid ${HUB_UID} (yuai) in ${DOMAIN} only`
  return null
}

/** Reads one reply line from an open tty fd, at most REPLY_MAX_BYTES; null at once on EOF. */
function readReply(fd: number): string | null {
  const bytes: number[] = []
  const one = Buffer.alloc(1)
  while (bytes.length < REPLY_MAX_BYTES) {
    if (readSync(fd, one, 0, 1, null) !== 1) return bytes.length === 0 ? null : Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8')
    if (one[0] === 0x0a) break
    bytes.push(one[0]!)
  }
  return Buffer.from(bytes).toString('utf8').replace(/\r$/, '')
}

/**
 * The question, asked on /dev/tty. Under the test override it never opens the real tty: it reads COLLAB_BRIDGE_TTY, one
 * line per question, and with no such file there is no tty (spec §12.1 Prompts). No tty → null, which is never a yes.
 */
export function ttyAsk(env: Env): (prompt: string) => string | null {
  if (overrideActive(env)) {
    const file = env.COLLAB_BRIDGE_TTY
    let next = 0
    return () => {
      if (!file) return null
      let lines: string[]
      try { lines = readFileSync(file, 'utf8').split('\n') } catch { return null }
      return next < lines.length ? lines[next++]! : null
    }
  }
  return (prompt) => {
    let fd: number
    try { fd = openSync('/dev/tty', 'r+') } catch { return null } // no controlling terminal: launchd, ssh -T, a harness
    try {
      writeSync(fd, prompt)
      return readReply(fd)
    } catch {
      return null
    } finally {
      closeSync(fd)
    }
  }
}

const isYes = (answer: string | null) => answer !== null && /^y$/i.test(answer.trim())
const firstLine = (s: string) => s.split('\n').map((l) => l.trim()).find((l) => l !== '') ?? ''
const message = (e: unknown) => firstLine(String((e as Error)?.message ?? e))

/** launchctl (or codesign) with a built env, never an inherited one (P14), from cwd /. */
function run(deps: AirCliDeps, argv: string[]): { code: number | null; stdout: string; stderr: string } {
  try {
    const r = Bun.spawnSync(argv, { cwd: '/', env: { PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin', HOME: deps.paths.home }, stdin: 'ignore', stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'pipe' })
    return { code: r.exitCode, stdout: r.stdout.toString(), stderr: r.stderr.toString() }
  } catch (e) {
    return { code: null, stdout: '', stderr: message(e) }
  }
}

const launchctl = (deps: AirCliDeps, ...args: string[]) => run(deps, [deps.launchctl, ...args])

/** The refusal and the y/N question shared by every verb that is Yu's alone; true when he said y. */
function yuConfirms(deps: AirCliDeps, question: string): boolean {
  const refusal = hubOnRefusal(deps.env, deps.table(), deps.selfPid, deps.uid())
  if (refusal !== null) {
    deps.err(`✗ refused: ${refusal}`)
    return false
  }
  if (!isYes(deps.ask(question))) {
    deps.err('✗ Not confirmed')
    return false
  }
  return true
}

function devicesOrNote(deps: AirCliDeps, notes: string[]): DeviceFile[] {
  try {
    return listDevices(deps.paths.devicesDir)
  } catch (e) {
    notes.push(`devices: ${message(e)}`)
    return []
  }
}

/** Each device's status as `hub status` and `hub doctor` show it: sticky warnings already acknowledged are left out (P52). */
function shownStatus(paths: AirPaths, device: string): DeviceStatus | null {
  const s = readDeviceStatus(paths, device)
  return s && { ...s, sticky: activeSticky(s.sticky, readHostKeyAck(paths, device)) }
}

/** §9.2's lines for the hub and every paired device, then a line for each device the hub has not reported on. */
function statusReport(deps: AirCliDeps, devices: DeviceFile[]): string[] {
  const paired = devices.filter((d) => d.state === 'paired')
  const shown = paired.map((d) => shownStatus(deps.paths, d.device))
  const lines = statusLines(readHubStatus(deps.paths), shown.filter((s): s is DeviceStatus => s !== null))
  paired.forEach((d, i) => { if (shown[i] === null) lines.push(`${d.device}: no status yet (is the hub on?)`) })
  for (const d of devices) if (d.state !== 'paired') lines.push(`${d.device}: ${d.state} (device file)`)
  return lines
}

/** Waits until launchd has let go of the service, so the bootstrap that follows a bootout does not race it. */
async function untilGone(deps: AirCliDeps): Promise<void> {
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    if (launchctl(deps, 'print', SERVICE).code !== 0) return
    await Bun.sleep(250)
  }
}

async function hubOn(deps: AirCliDeps): Promise<number> {
  const { paths } = deps
  const refusal = hubOnRefusal(deps.env, deps.table(), deps.selfPid, deps.uid())
  if (refusal !== null) {
    deps.err(`✗ refused: ${refusal}`)
    return 1
  }
  // What the plist will run must exist before Yu is asked, or launchd would restart a missing program every 10 s.
  if (deps.hubSha === null) {
    deps.err('✗ this collab-bridge is not a pinned hub bundle: run ~/.local/bin/collab-bridge, which runs ~/.local/share/collab-bridge/air/<sha>/hub.js')
    return 1
  }
  if (!existsSync(paths.hubJs(deps.hubSha))) {
    deps.err(`✗ the pinned hub bundle is missing: ${paths.hubJs(deps.hubSha)}`)
    return 1
  }
  if (!existsSync(paths.launcherExe)) {
    deps.err(`✗ the launcher app is missing: ${paths.launcherExe}`)
    return 1
  }
  if (!isYes(deps.ask('Turn the Collab bridge hub on? [y/N] '))) {
    deps.err('✗ Not confirmed')
    return 1
  }
  mkdirPrivate(paths.stateDir)
  // The first hub on records what launchd ran before the hub, so §12.3 step 8 can show the hub added exactly one label.
  if (!existsSync(paths.baselineLabels)) {
    const list = launchctl(deps, 'list')
    if (list.code !== 0) {
      deps.err(`✗ launchctl list failed (exit ${list.code}): ${firstLine(list.stderr)}; nothing was written`)
      return 1
    }
    const labels = stableLabels(list.stdout).filter((l) => l !== HUB_LABEL)
    writeFileDurable(paths.baselineLabels, labels.map((l) => `${l}\n`).join(''), 0o600)
  }
  if (!existsSync(paths.hubLog)) closeSync(openSync(paths.hubLog, 'a', 0o600))
  chmodSync(paths.hubLog, 0o600) // launchd opens StandardErrorPath with its own mode only when the file is missing
  mkdirSync(dirname(paths.plist), { recursive: true })
  writeFileDurable(paths.plist, renderPlist({ home: paths.home, sha: deps.hubSha, bun: deps.bun }), 0o644)
  if (launchctl(deps, 'bootout', SERVICE).code === 0) await untilGone(deps) // a running hub restarts on the new plist
  const boot = launchctl(deps, 'bootstrap', DOMAIN, paths.plist)
  if (boot.code !== 0) {
    deps.err(`✗ launchctl bootstrap ${DOMAIN} failed (exit ${boot.code}): ${firstLine(boot.stderr)}`)
    return 1
  }
  deps.out(`✓ Hub on: ${HUB_LABEL} is bootstrapped in ${DOMAIN}.`)
  const notes: string[] = []
  const devices = devicesOrNote(deps, notes)
  for (const line of [...statusReport(deps, devices), ...notes]) deps.out(line)
  deps.out('collab-bridge hub status shows each link once the hub has dialled (about a minute).')
  return 0
}

async function hubOff(deps: AirCliDeps): Promise<number> {
  if (!yuConfirms(deps, 'Turn the Collab bridge hub off? [y/N] ')) return 1
  const out = launchctl(deps, 'bootout', SERVICE) // not loaded is fine: off is the state Yu asked for
  rmSync(deps.paths.plist, { force: true })
  deps.out(out.code === 0 ? `✓ Hub off: ${HUB_LABEL} is booted out of ${DOMAIN} and its plist removed.`
    : `✓ Hub off: ${HUB_LABEL} was not loaded in ${DOMAIN}; its plist is removed.`)
  return 0
}

function hubStatus(deps: AirCliDeps, json: boolean): number {
  const notes: string[] = []
  const devices = devicesOrNote(deps, notes)
  if (json) {
    deps.out(JSON.stringify({
      hub: readHubStatus(deps.paths),
      devices: devices.map((d) => ({ device: d.device, state: d.state, status: shownStatus(deps.paths, d.device) })),
      ...(notes.length > 0 ? { notes } : {}),
    }))
  } else {
    for (const line of [...statusReport(deps, devices), ...notes]) deps.out(line)
  }
  return notes.length > 0 ? 1 : 0
}

/** The pinned summon-<device> lines of a known_hosts text, sorted (spec §5.6: the copy must equal Summon's pin). */
function pinLines(text: string, alias: string): string[] {
  return text.split('\n').map((l) => l.trim()).filter((l) => l.startsWith(`${alias} `)).sort()
}

function pinProblem(paths: AirPaths, device: string): string | null {
  const alias = `summon-${device}`
  let summon: string
  let copy: string
  try { summon = readFileSync(paths.summonKnownHosts, 'utf8') } catch { return `${device}: Summon's pin is missing (${paths.summonKnownHosts}); tell Yu` }
  try { copy = readFileSync(paths.knownHosts, 'utf8') } catch { return `${device}: the known_hosts copy is missing (${paths.knownHosts}); pin-device writes it` }
  const a = pinLines(copy, alias)
  const b = pinLines(summon, alias)
  if (a.length === 0 || a.join('\n') !== b.join('\n')) {
    return `${device}: the known_hosts copy differs from Summon's pin for ${alias}: never re-pin from the network; tell Yu`
  }
  return null
}

async function hubDoctor(deps: AirCliDeps, ack: boolean): Promise<number> {
  const { paths } = deps
  const warnings: string[] = []
  const devices = devicesOrNote(deps, warnings)
  if (ack) {
    const owed = devices.filter((d) => (shownStatus(paths, d.device)?.sticky.length ?? 0) > 0)
    if (owed.length === 0) {
      deps.out('No host-key warning to acknowledge.')
    } else {
      const names = owed.map((d) => d.device).join(', ')
      if (!yuConfirms(deps, `Acknowledge the host-key warning(s) of ${names}? [y/N] `)) return 1
      const at = deps.now().toISOString()
      for (const d of owed) {
        writeHostKeyAck(paths, d.device, at)
        // writeDeviceStatus drops every warning at or before the ack, so this rewrite clears them from the file at once,
        // and every later write (the hub's dial loop included) keeps them out (P52).
        const s = readDeviceStatus(paths, d.device)
        if (s) writeDeviceStatus(paths, s)
        deps.out(`✓ Acknowledged ${d.device}'s host-key warning(s) at ${at}; they are gone from the status file, and no later status write brings them back.`)
      }
    }
  }
  // The pinned bundle this command runs from.
  if (deps.hubSha === null) deps.out('hub bundle: source mode (not a pinned bundle)')
  else if (!existsSync(paths.hubJs(deps.hubSha))) warnings.push(`the pinned hub bundle is missing: ${paths.hubJs(deps.hubSha)}`)
  else deps.out(`hub bundle: ${paths.hubJs(deps.hubSha)}`)
  // The installed Collab against the build the bundle embeds (§10.4 build check).
  if (deps.build === null) deps.out('collab dist: not checked (no embedded build)')
  else if (!distMatches(deps.collabDist, deps.build)) {
    warnings.push("the installed Collab dist differs from this hub's build (collab_build_mismatch): rebuild the hub bundle from the installed build's commit")
  } else deps.out(`collab dist: matches build ${deps.build.hub_build}`)
  // The launcher: the hub's own Local Network identity (C15).
  if (!existsSync(paths.launcherExe)) warnings.push(`the launcher app is missing: ${paths.launcherExe}`)
  else {
    const v = run(deps, [deps.codesign, '--verify', '--deep', '--strict', paths.launcherApp])
    if (v.code !== 0) warnings.push(`the launcher app fails codesign --verify --deep --strict: ${firstLine(v.stderr) || `exit ${v.code}`}`)
    else deps.out('launcher: the signature verifies')
  }
  // The host-key copy against Summon's pin, for every paired device (§5.6).
  for (const d of devices) {
    if (d.state !== 'paired') continue
    const p = pinProblem(paths, d.device)
    if (p) warnings.push(p)
  }
  // launchd: the service, and every label added since the first hub on (§12.3 step 8).
  deps.out(launchctl(deps, 'print', SERVICE).code === 0 ? `launchd: ${HUB_LABEL} is loaded in ${DOMAIN}` : `launchd: ${HUB_LABEL} is not loaded in ${DOMAIN}`)
  if (!existsSync(paths.baselineLabels)) deps.out('launchd labels added since hub on: unknown (no baseline: hub on has not run)')
  else {
    const list = launchctl(deps, 'list')
    if (list.code !== 0) warnings.push(`launchctl list failed (exit ${list.code}): ${firstLine(list.stderr)}`)
    else {
      const diff = labelDiff(readFileSync(paths.baselineLabels, 'utf8'), list.stdout)
      deps.out(`launchd labels added since hub on: ${diff.added.length > 0 ? diff.added.join(', ') : 'none'}`)
      deps.out(`launchd labels removed since hub on: ${diff.removed.length > 0 ? diff.removed.join(', ') : 'none'}`)
    }
  }
  // §9.2's status lines, the sticky host-key warning among them.
  const sticky = devices.reduce((n, d) => n + (d.state === 'paired' ? (shownStatus(paths, d.device)?.sticky.length ?? 0) : 0), 0)
  for (const line of statusReport(deps, devices)) deps.out(line)
  for (const w of warnings) deps.out(`warn: ${w}`)
  return warnings.length > 0 || sticky > 0 ? 1 : 0
}

/** §9.6 item 5, after Ai's repair: a request file the running hub (or its next start) applies through pool.unpark (P54). */
function hubUnpark(deps: AirCliDeps, lineage: string): number {
  const uid = deps.uid()
  if (uid !== HUB_UID) {
    deps.err(`✗ refused: this is uid ${uid}; hub unpark runs as uid ${HUB_UID} (yuai) only`)
    return 1
  }
  const store = new LineageStore(deps.paths.lineages)
  try { store.load() } catch (e) {
    deps.err(`✗ ${message(e)}; nothing was written`)
    return 1
  }
  const entry = store.get(lineage)
  if (!entry) {
    deps.err(`✗ ${lineage} is not in ${deps.paths.lineages}; nothing was written`)
    return 1
  }
  if (entry.parked === null) {
    deps.err(`✗ ${lineage} is not parked; nothing was written`)
    return 1
  }
  mkdirPrivate(deps.paths.requestsDir)
  const req = deps.paths.unparkRequest(lineage)
  writeFileDurable(req, JSON.stringify({ v: 1, lineage, requested_at: deps.now().toISOString() }) + '\n', 0o600)
  deps.out(`Unpark requested: ${req}`)
  deps.out("It is applied at the hub's next reload (or its next start), and refused while a child of that lineage still runs.")
  return 0
}

/** §9.10: Yu's verb, behind the same refusals and question as `hub off`; the work is unpairDevice (Task 54). */
async function unpair(deps: AirCliDeps, device: string): Promise<number> {
  if (!yuConfirms(deps, `Unpair ${device}? Its link, seat key and remote sessions end now. [y/N] `)) return 1
  return deps.unpair(device)
}

/**
 * `run` (launchd's) and `hub run` (the Terminal fallback): the hub starts only where `hub on` could be answered, so an
 * agent cannot start one that dials devices and serves seats without Yu. No question, since launchd has no tty, and
 * nothing is touched before the refusal, so a refused start never writes `lock_held` over a running hub's status.
 */
async function startHub(deps: AirCliDeps): Promise<number> {
  const refusal = hubOnRefusal(deps.env, deps.table(), deps.selfPid, deps.uid())
  if (refusal !== null) {
    deps.err(`✗ refused: ${refusal}`)
    return 1
  }
  return deps.runHub()
}

function usage(deps: AirCliDeps): number {
  for (const line of USAGE) deps.err(line)
  return 2
}

export async function runAirCli(argv: string[], deps: AirCliDeps): Promise<number> {
  const [verb, sub, ...rest] = argv
  if (verb === 'version' && sub === undefined) {
    deps.out(JSON.stringify(deps.build ?? { build: null }))
    return 0
  }
  // launchd's verb: the plist's ProgramArguments end '…/hub.js', 'run' (spec C7, §10.4)
  if (verb === 'run' && sub === undefined) return startHub(deps)
  if (verb === 'unpair') return sub !== undefined && rest.length === 0 && DEVICE_RE.test(sub) ? unpair(deps, sub) : usage(deps)
  if (verb !== 'hub') return usage(deps)
  if (sub === 'on' && rest.length === 0) return hubOn(deps)
  if (sub === 'off' && rest.length === 0) return hubOff(deps)
  if (sub === 'status' && (rest.length === 0 || (rest.length === 1 && rest[0] === '--json'))) return hubStatus(deps, rest.length === 1)
  if (sub === 'doctor' && (rest.length === 0 || (rest.length === 1 && rest[0] === '--ack-host-key'))) return hubDoctor(deps, rest.length === 1)
  if (sub === 'run' && rest.length === 0) return startHub(deps) // the Terminal fallback (C14, §10.4)
  if (sub === 'unpark' && rest.length === 1 && LINEAGE_RE.test(rest[0]!)) return hubUnpark(deps, rest[0]!)
  return usage(deps)
}
```

```ts
#!/usr/bin/env -S bun --no-env-file --config=/dev/null
// The Air's collab-bridge (C14): argv → runAirCli(defaultAirDeps()) → exit. Built into the pinned
// ~/.local/share/collab-bridge/air/<sha>/hub.js, which ~/.local/bin/collab-bridge and the LaunchAgent run with
// bun --no-env-file --config=/dev/null from cwd / (R39). Exit codes: 0 done; 1 refused or failed; 2 a usage error.
import { basename } from 'node:path'
import { defaultHubDeps, embeddedBuild, runHub } from '../src/air/hub.ts'
import { liveUnpairDeps, unpairDevice } from '../src/air/unpair.ts'
import { runAirCli, ttyAsk, type AirCliDeps } from '../src/cli.ts'
import { getuid } from '../src/native.ts'
import { airPaths, collabDist, homeOf } from '../src/paths.ts'
import { readPs } from '../src/proc.ts'
import { systemBin } from '../src/sysbin.ts'

const SHA_DIR_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/
const STOP_SIGNALS = ['SIGTERM', 'SIGINT', 'SIGHUP'] as const

/** The live wiring. hubSha is the pinned bundle's own directory name, so a source run (tests, Task 62) has none. */
export function defaultAirDeps(): AirCliDeps {
  const env = process.env
  const paths = airPaths(homeOf(env))
  const dir = basename(import.meta.dir)
  const bun = systemBin('bun', env)
  const dist = collabDist(env)
  const out = (line: string) => { process.stdout.write(`${line}\n`) }
  return {
    paths,
    env,
    selfPid: process.pid,
    uid: getuid,
    table: () => readPs(systemBin('ps', env)),
    ask: ttyAsk(env),
    launchctl: systemBin('launchctl', env),
    codesign: systemBin('codesign', env),
    bun,
    hubSha: SHA_DIR_RE.test(dir) ? dir : null,
    build: embeddedBuild(),
    collabDist: dist,
    // `run` and `hub run` only, installed before the hub starts: SIGTERM (`hub off`'s bootout, which the launcher
    // forwards; logout under launchd), SIGINT (Ctrl-C) and SIGHUP (the fallback's Terminal window closing, or logout)
    // reach runHub's clean stop, so the run is recorded clean and hub_stop is ledgered (P58). `once`: a second signal
    // takes its default action. The bin's unref'd exit timer ends a process that a child handle would keep alive.
    runHub: () => {
      const ac = new AbortController()
      const stop = () => ac.abort()
      for (const s of STOP_SIGNALS) process.once(s, stop)
      return runHub({ ...defaultHubDeps(env), signal: ac.signal }).finally(() => {
        for (const s of STOP_SIGNALS) process.off(s, stop)
      })
    },
    out,
    err: (line) => { process.stderr.write(`${line}\n`) },
    now: () => new Date(),
    unpair: (device) => unpairDevice(device, liveUnpairDeps({ paths, bun, dist, out })),
  }
}

if (import.meta.main) {
  let code: number
  try {
    code = await runAirCli(process.argv.slice(2), defaultAirDeps())
  } catch (e) {
    process.stderr.write(`✗ collab-bridge: ${String((e as Error)?.message ?? e).split('\n')[0]}\n`)
    code = 1
  }
  // Exit once stdout drains; the unref'd timer only ends a process that something else would keep alive.
  process.exitCode = code
  setTimeout(() => process.exit(code), 2000).unref()
}
```

````markdown
## Unpair a device

`collab-bridge unpair <device>` is Yu's: the same refusals and y/N question as `hub off`
(`Unpair nuance? Its link, seat key and remote sessions end now. [y/N]`). It works with the device away, because
nothing in it dials the device (spec §9.10). In order:

1. The device file goes `unpaired` and loses its seat key; a running hub closes the link, stops that device's
   children and refuses its attaches at its next reload.
2. The device's pending reviews are listed, and none is decided: an Air session reviews each, accepting only while the
   mirror is still at the completed commit, else requesting changes.
3. Every remote session of the device (each lineage's, and each active session whose role starts
   `remote(<device>/<user>;` in that device's mirror) is ended with
   `agenttool-collab-host end --session-file <credential> --reason "device unpaired" --release-leases --db <shared journal>`.
   A session whose credential file is gone cannot be ended from the Air; it is reported, never skipped.
4. The hub ledger is archived as `~/.local/state/collab-bridge/ledger.<UTC stamp>.jsonl` (0600), and the device's
   `Host collab-<device>` block and its `collab_<device>_ed25519` key pair are removed from `~/.ssh/collab-bridge/`.
5. Revocation stays incomplete until the ` collab-air` line is removed on the device, or the key expires. On the
   device, in Terminal:

```sh
sed -i '' '/ collab-air$/d' ~/.ssh/authorized_keys
```

It exits 0 when every step completed, and 1 when it listed items for Ai (a session it could not end, a workspace it
could not read).

## Rollback on the Air

Each step stands alone, and none needs sudo (spec §10.6). Yu runs the first two; the rest is Ai's.

```sh
collab-bridge unpair nuance
collab-bridge hub off
cd /Users/yuai/Projects/collab-trial && claude mcp remove -s local agenttool-collab
mkdir -p -m 700 /Users/yuai/.cache/agenttool/collab-bridge-archive
cp -p /Users/yuai/.local/state/collab-bridge/ledger*.jsonl /Users/yuai/.local/state/collab-bridge/hub.log /Users/yuai/.cache/agenttool/collab-bridge-archive/
rm -rf /Users/yuai/.local/state/collab-bridge
rm -rf /Users/yuai/.ssh/collab-bridge /Users/yuai/.config/collab-bridge /Users/yuai/.local/share/collab-bridge
rm -f /Users/yuai/.local/bin/collab-bridge
rm -rf /Users/yuai/Applications/CollabBridgeHub.app /Users/yuai/collab-bridge-*-bundle-*
```

The mirrors go last, and only after every session that used them has ended and their pending reviews are resolved.
Keeping the bridge refs first is optional (the `bundle create` line):

```sh
````

```ts
// src/nuance/install-steps.ts
export interface Manifest { device: string; build: string; prepared: string; expiry: string; binary_sha256: string; tools_digest: string;
  trial_commit: string; shares: string[]; files: Record<string, string> }      // files: name → sha256
export function renderManifest(m: Manifest): string     // `device …`, `build …`, `prepared …`, `expiry …`, `trial_commit …`, `tools_digest …`, one `share <path>` each, one `sha256 <hex> <name>` each
export function parseManifest(text: string): Manifest | null
export interface ShareCheck { path: string; state: 'exists' | 'absent'; realpath: string; gitdir: string }
export interface CheckReport { ok: boolean; failures: string[]; user: string; uid: number; git: ResolvedGit | null;
  summon: { key_sha256: string; dropin_stat: string } | null; shares: ShareCheck[]; manifest: Manifest | null }
export function citizenRoot(path: string, home: string): 'citizen' | 'clear' | 'unknown'   // REST or EVENT-ONLY at its root, under ~/love-unlimited, or unreadable
export function installCheck(o: { bundle: string; shares: string[]; terminalGit: string | null; claude: string | null; paths: NuancePaths;
  uid: number; user: string; platform: string; arch: string; zsh: string; xcrun: string; today: string; dropinOwnerUid: number; run?: Run }): CheckReport
//   Darwin/arm64, not root; Summon INSTALLED and keys-only; the drop-in exists, owned by dropinOwnerUid (0 in production), mode
//   0600; MANIFEST parses; key not expired
//   (expiry > today, YYYYMMDD local); not older than the installed collab-bridge (INSTALLED `prepared`) nor than an existing
//   ` collab-air` key line's expiry; zshenv clean; git resolved and acceptable; claude present and executable; each share: exists →
//   a git repo root whose history holds trial_commit, inside an `edit` folder by the longest match, not citizen, not TCC; absent → its
//   parent resolves, owned by uid, outside TCC and ~/love-unlimited, the folder-to-be matches an edit entry by exact spelling or by the
//   longest match through its parent, not citizen; records the Summon baselines (P22)
export function installClone(o: { bundle: string; share: string; git: ResolvedGit; trialCommit: string; home: string; rand(): string;
  recheck(share: string): string[] }): { ok: true; created: string } | { ok: false; reason: string }
//   `git clone --no-hardlinks <bundle>/collab-trial.bundle <parent>/.collab-trial.partial-<rand>` with the scrubbed env (P44), verify
//   trial_commit, remove the `origin` remote, mkdir the target exclusively then rename the partial over it (a target that appeared →
//   refuse), then recheck(share): any failure removes only the folder this run created
export async function runInstallVerb(argv: string[], env: Env, io: GateIo): Promise<number>   // 'check' | 'clone' here; Task 56 adds the rest
//   dropinOwnerUid = knobInt('COLLAB_BRIDGE_DROPIN_OWNER_UID', env) ?? 0: the knob is read only under the override (P60), so in
//   production the drop-in must be root's, and hermetic tests (whose drop-in under the suite root is the user's) can pass
```
  Added by this task (each the smallest workable change; reported as interface deviations):
  - `export interface CheckInput` names `installCheck`'s parameter type exactly as above, so `installCheck(o: CheckInput)` is the same signature and the fixtures can build one.
  - `export const BUNDLE_FILES = ['collab-bridge', 'tools.json', 'collab-trial.bundle'] as const` (the files MANIFEST must list; the installer and MANIFEST.txt pin each other, so neither lists itself); no share-path rule of its own: `installCheck` and `manifestProblems` import `sharePathProblem` from Task 20's `src/share-path.ts`, the one rule the gate, `shares.json`, the device file, `renderInstaller` (Task 57) and prepare-pairing (Task 60) all use; `export function localYmd(d: Date): string` (local YYYYMMDD, as sshd reads `expiry-time`); `export function dropinOwnerUidOf(env: Env): number` (the P60 rule above, named so the test can call it); `export const INSTALL_USAGE: string`.
  - MANIFEST has no separate `binary_sha256` line: it is the `sha256 <hex> collab-bridge` line, and `renderManifest` refuses a `Manifest` whose two values differ, so the skeleton's line list round-trips.
  - Each failure in `CheckReport.failures` is `<code>: <sentence>`. The codes: `platform`, `root`, `summon_not_installed`, `summon_keys_only`, `summon_key_missing` (no ` summon-air` line: Summon is not live), `authorized_keys`, `dropin_missing`, `dropin_owner`, `dropin_mode`, `manifest`, `checksum`, `expired`, `older_bundle`, `installed_unreadable`, `zshenv`, `git`, `git_unsafe`, `claude`, `allowlist`, `share_path`, `share_tcc`, `share_unresolved`, `share_not_dir`, `share_citizen`, `share_unclassified`, `share_not_edit`, `share_not_repo_root`, `share_gitdir`, `share_missing_commit`, `share_parent`, `share_parent_owner`.
  - An existing share's `.git` must be the repository's own folder (not a gitdir file, a linked worktree or a symlink): stricter than the fetch gate's rule, and the Phase 1 trial clone always meets it.
  - `install check|clone` take `--bundle <dir> --share <path>… --terminal-git <path> --claude <path>` (an empty `--terminal-git` or `--claude` value means none). A usage error also prints one JSON line, `{"ok":false,"failures":["usage"]}`, and exits 1, so every install verb exits 0 or 1. `install clone` runs the whole check first, then clones every absent share; on any failure it removes every folder this run cloned and prints `{"ok":false,"reason":…,"created":[]}`, else `{"ok":true,"created":[…]}`.

Notes for the implementer:
- The bash installer (Task 57) runs these verbs through the staged copy of the binary; this task's tests call `installCheck` and `installClone` in process and run the two verbs through `src/nuance/main.ts` from source. Every git command is the resolved git (the one INSTALLED will record, P44) with `gitEnv(home)` from the fetch gate, `-c core.fsmonitor=false -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null`, and cwd `/`.
- The tests use the real `/usr/bin/xcrun` (P42 allows it), which resolves the Command Line Tools git (`2.39.5 (Apple Git-154)`, with the guard) on this Air, and `/opt/homebrew/bin/git` as the "Terminal" git. Every repo, home and bundle is a temp dir; the Summon drop-in is the hermetic one under the test home (`testDropin`, owned by this user, P60).
- `citizenRoot` checks `REST` and `EVENT-ONLY` with `lstat`, so on APFS, which ignores case, `rest` counts too; a folder that cannot be read is `unknown`, which the checks refuse like a citizen's (§11.1 "or cannot be classified").
- For an absent share the edit entry is found by resolving each allowlist entry, or, when it does not resolve, its parent plus its last name (`~/Projects/collab-trial` before the clone exists). Summon's own `longestFolderMatch` skips unresolved entries, which is right for an existing folder and is used there.
- `installClone` claims the target with a plain `mkdirSync` (EEXIST when it appeared) and `renameSync`s the partial clone over that empty folder (a rename onto an empty directory replaces it; onto a non-empty one it fails `ENOTEMPTY`, measured on this Air). The "appears before the rename" test makes the target from inside `rand()`, which runs after the start-up check and before the clone.

```ts
// Fixtures for the installer's tests (Tasks 55–57): the trial repo on the "Air", a Nuance home where Summon is installed,
// and a bundle folder with its MANIFEST. A shared fixture lives here, never in a *.test.ts (Summon ruling R1: bun re-runs
// an imported test file). Task 57 adds the whole AirDrop bundle around the bash installer and a runner for it.
import { chmodSync, copyFileSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path'
import type { ToolDef } from '../src/link/messages.ts'
import { localYmd, renderManifest, type CheckInput, type Manifest } from '../src/nuance/install-steps.ts'
import { nuancePaths, type NuancePaths } from '../src/paths.ts'
import { writeToolsFile } from '../src/tools-digest.ts'
import { commitFiles, REAL_GIT, repoGit, sha256File, temp, testEnv, writeStub } from './helpers.ts'
import { allowlistYaml } from './nuance-home.ts'

export const FIXTURE_TRAILER = 'Co-Authored-By: The Fable of the Eternal Universe <Yu@Ai-love.cc>'

/** A small seat tool list for tools.json: the installer only stores and seeds it, so any valid list will do. */
export const FIXTURE_TOOLS: ToolDef[] = [
  { name: 'collab_next', description: 'What needs your attention next.', inputSchema: { type: 'object', properties: {} } },
  { name: 'collab_session_start', description: 'Start a Collab session.',
    inputSchema: { type: 'object', properties: { actor: { type: 'string', maxLength: 64 } }, required: ['actor'] } },
]

export interface TrialRepo { repo: string; commit: string }

/** The Air's trial repo (spec §10.2 step 1): README.md and notes/.gitkeep, one commit whose message ends with the trailer. */
export function makeTrialRepo(o: { files?: Record<string, string> } = {}): TrialRepo {
  const repo = temp('cb-air-trial-')
  repoGit(repo, ['init', '-q', '-b', 'main'])
  const commit = commitFiles(repo, o.files ?? { 'README.md': 'collab trial\n', 'notes/.gitkeep': '' }, `collab trial base\n\n${FIXTURE_TRAILER}`)
  return { repo, commit }
}

/** Summon's key line as its installer writes it (the key is a fixture, not a real key). */
export function summonLine(home: string): string {
  return `restrict,from="192.168.50.0/24",expiry-time="20270110",command="${home}/.local/share/summon/summon-gatekeeper" ` +
    'ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIFixtureFixtureFixtureFixtureFixtureFixture1 summon-air'
}

export interface NuanceHome { home: string; env: Record<string, string>; paths: NuancePaths; share: string }

/**
 * A "Nuance" home where Summon is installed and live (spec §10.1), as `install check` asks of a fresh home: its INSTALLED
 * and keys-only marker, the drop-in (owned by this user here: P60), its summon-air key line, ~/Projects, and an allowlist
 * (Task 21's allowlistYaml) with ~/Projects review-only and ~/Projects/collab-trial `access: edit` (Y1). `share` is the
 * trial folder, not yet there. `home` defaults to a new temp dir; Tasks 58 and 62 pass their own.
 */
export function summonReadyHome(o: { allowlist?: string; home?: string } = {}): NuanceHome {
  const home = o.home ?? temp('cb-nuance-')
  const env = testEnv(home)
  const paths = nuancePaths(home, env)
  mkdirSync(join(home, 'Projects'), { recursive: true })
  mkdirSync(dirname(paths.summonInstalled), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 })
  writeFileSync(paths.summonInstalled, 'build 5c09726b\nprepared 20261012090000\n', { mode: 0o600 })
  writeFileSync(paths.summonKeysOnly, '', { mode: 0o600 })
  mkdirSync(dirname(paths.summonDropin), { recursive: true })
  writeFileSync(paths.summonDropin, 'PasswordAuthentication no\n', { mode: 0o600 })
  chmodSync(paths.summonDropin, 0o600)
  mkdirSync(dirname(paths.authorizedKeys), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 })
  writeFileSync(paths.authorizedKeys, summonLine(home) + '\n', { mode: 0o600 })
  mkdirSync(dirname(paths.summonAllowlist), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 })
  writeFileSync(paths.summonAllowlist, o.allowlist ??
    allowlistYaml([{ path: '~/Projects', access: 'review' }, { path: '~/Projects/collab-trial', access: 'edit' }]))
  return { home, env, paths, share: join(home, 'Projects', 'collab-trial') }
}

export interface CheckBundle { dir: string; manifest: Manifest }

/**
 * A bundle folder as install check reads it: collab-bridge (the given file, or a two-line `exit 0` stand-in), tools.json, the trial repo's
 * git bundle and MANIFEST.txt listing all three. The build defaults to the first 8 hex of the binary's sha256 (Task 58).
 */
export function writeCheckBundle(o: { trial: TrialRepo; shares: string[]; dir?: string; binary?: string; tools?: ToolDef[];
  device?: string; build?: string; prepared?: string; expiry?: string }): CheckBundle {
  const dir = o.dir ?? temp('cb-bundle-')
  chmodSync(dir, 0o700)
  const bin = join(dir, 'collab-bridge')
  if (o.binary) copyFileSync(o.binary, bin)
  else writeFileSync(bin, '#!/bin/bash\nexit 0\n')
  chmodSync(bin, 0o700)
  const tools = writeToolsFile(join(dir, 'tools.json'), o.tools ?? FIXTURE_TOOLS)
  repoGit(o.trial.repo, ['bundle', 'create', '-q', join(dir, 'collab-trial.bundle'), '--all'])
  chmodSync(join(dir, 'collab-trial.bundle'), 0o600)
  const files = { 'collab-bridge': sha256File(bin), 'tools.json': sha256File(join(dir, 'tools.json')),
    'collab-trial.bundle': sha256File(join(dir, 'collab-trial.bundle')) }
  const manifest: Manifest = {
    device: o.device ?? 'nuance', build: o.build ?? files['collab-bridge'].slice(0, 8), prepared: o.prepared ?? '20261013120000',
    expiry: o.expiry ?? '20991231', binary_sha256: files['collab-bridge'], tools_digest: tools.digest, trial_commit: o.trial.commit,
    shares: o.shares, files,
  }
  writeFileSync(join(dir, 'MANIFEST.txt'), renderManifest(manifest), { mode: 0o600 })
  return { dir, manifest }
}

/** A claude stand-in that answers --version and does nothing else. */
export function claudeStub(): string {
  return writeStub(temp('cb-claude-'), 'claude', 'if [ "${1:-}" = --version ]; then echo "2.1.296 (Claude Code)"; fi\nexit 0')
}

/** installCheck's input for a home and a bundle, every check passing unless `over` changes one. */
export function checkInput(h: NuanceHome, b: CheckBundle, over: Partial<CheckInput> = {}): CheckInput {
  return {
    bundle: b.dir, shares: b.manifest.shares, terminalGit: REAL_GIT, claude: claudeStub(), paths: h.paths,
    uid: process.getuid!(), user: 'macair', platform: 'darwin', arch: 'arm64', zsh: '/bin/zsh', xcrun: '/usr/bin/xcrun',
    today: localYmd(new Date()), dropinOwnerUid: process.getuid!(), ...over,
  }
}
```

`/Users/yuai/Projects/.worktrees/agenttool-collab-bridge/packages/collab-bridge/src/nuance/install-steps.ts`:

```ts
// The installer's structured steps on Nuance (C6, spec §10.3 steps 4–6; P21). The bash installer checks the bundle's
// sha256s, asks on /dev/tty, writes the key line and runs `claude mcp`; everything with structure (MANIFEST, YAML,
// realpaths, the Summon allowlist, git, citizen roots, TCC folders, the trial clone, JSON settings) is one of these verbs,
// run by the staged, de-quarantined copy of the binary (Review Focus 1). Each verb prints one JSON line on stdout and
// human lines on stderr, and exits 0 or 1.
import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto'
import { accessSync, constants, lstatSync, mkdirSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, renameSync, rmdirSync, rmSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'
import { basename, dirname, join, normalize } from 'node:path'
import { expandHome, loadAllowlist, longestFolderMatch, safeRealpath, tccProtected, type Allowlist, type AllowlistFolder } from '../allowlist.ts'
import { passwdOfSelf } from '../native.ts'
import { homeOf, nuancePaths, type NuancePaths } from '../paths.ts'
import { sharePathProblem } from '../share-path.ts'
import { knobInt, systemBin, type Env } from '../sysbin.ts'
import { gitEnv } from './fetch-gate.ts'
import type { GateIo } from './gate-main.ts'
import { zshenvClean } from './gate.ts'
import { gitAcceptable, resolveGit, runCmd, sha256File, type ResolvedGit, type Run } from './git-resolve.ts'
import { dropinStat, parseInstalled, summonKeySha256 } from './installed.ts'

// ---- MANIFEST.txt ----

export interface Manifest { device: string; build: string; prepared: string; expiry: string; binary_sha256: string; tools_digest: string;
  trial_commit: string; shares: string[]; files: Record<string, string> }      // files: name → sha256

/** The three files a bundle carries besides its installer and MANIFEST.txt (which pin each other, so neither lists itself). */
export const BUNDLE_FILES = ['collab-bridge', 'tools.json', 'collab-trial.bundle'] as const

const SCALARS = {
  device: /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$/,
  build: /^[0-9a-f]{8}$/,
  prepared: /^\d{14}$/,
  expiry: /^\d{8}$/,
  trial_commit: /^[0-9a-f]{40}([0-9a-f]{24})?$/,
  tools_digest: /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/,
} as const
type Scalar = keyof typeof SCALARS
const SCALAR_KEYS = Object.keys(SCALARS) as Scalar[]
const SHA_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/
const FILE_NAME_RE = /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$/

// Each share is checked with the gate's own rule (Task 20's sharePathProblem, §5.2), so a path MANIFEST and the
// installer accept is one shares.json holds and the gate serves; bash's single quotes carry any path without '.
function manifestProblems(m: Manifest): string[] {
  const out: string[] = []
  for (const k of SCALAR_KEYS) if (typeof m[k] !== 'string' || !SCALARS[k].test(m[k])) out.push(`${k} is malformed`)
  if (!Array.isArray(m.shares) || m.shares.length === 0) out.push('no share')
  else {
    for (const s of m.shares) { const p = sharePathProblem(s); if (p) out.push(`share ${s} ${p}`) }
    if (new Set(m.shares).size !== m.shares.length) out.push('a share is listed twice')
  }
  for (const [name, sha] of Object.entries(m.files)) if (!FILE_NAME_RE.test(name) || !SHA_RE.test(sha)) out.push(`file ${name} is malformed`)
  if (m.files['collab-bridge'] !== m.binary_sha256) out.push('binary_sha256 is not the sha256 listed for collab-bridge')
  return out
}

/** `device …`, `build …`, `prepared …`, `expiry …`, `trial_commit …`, `tools_digest …`, one `share <path>` each, one `sha256 <hex> <name>` each. */
export function renderManifest(m: Manifest): string {
  const problems = manifestProblems(m)
  if (problems.length > 0) throw new Error(`MANIFEST: ${problems.join('; ')}`)
  return [
    ...SCALAR_KEYS.map((k) => `${k} ${m[k]}`),
    ...m.shares.map((s) => `share ${s}`),
    ...Object.keys(m.files).sort().map((name) => `sha256 ${m.files[name]} ${name}`),
  ].join('\n') + '\n'
}

/** Null unless every line is known and well-formed, each scalar appears once, and collab-bridge's sha256 is listed. */
export function parseManifest(text: string): Manifest | null {
  const v = new Map<Scalar, string>()
  const shares: string[] = []
  const files: Record<string, string> = {}
  for (const line of text.split('\n')) {
    if (line === '') continue
    const sp = line.indexOf(' ')
    if (sp < 1) return null
    const key = line.slice(0, sp), value = line.slice(sp + 1)
    if (key === 'share') shares.push(value)
    else if (key === 'sha256') {
      const m = /^([0-9a-f]{64}) ([A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64})$/.exec(value)
      if (!m || m[2]! in files) return null
      files[m[2]!] = m[1]!
    } else if ((SCALAR_KEYS as string[]).includes(key) && !v.has(key as Scalar)) v.set(key as Scalar, value)
    else return null
  }
  if (SCALAR_KEYS.some((k) => !v.has(k)) || files['collab-bridge'] === undefined) return null
  const m: Manifest = {
    device: v.get('device')!, build: v.get('build')!, prepared: v.get('prepared')!, expiry: v.get('expiry')!,
    binary_sha256: files['collab-bridge'], tools_digest: v.get('tools_digest')!, trial_commit: v.get('trial_commit')!, shares, files,
  }
  return manifestProblems(m).length === 0 ? m : null
}

// ---- the checks of §10.3 step 4 ----

export interface ShareCheck { path: string; state: 'exists' | 'absent'; realpath: string; gitdir: string }
export interface CheckReport { ok: boolean; failures: string[]; user: string; uid: number; git: ResolvedGit | null;
  summon: { key_sha256: string; dropin_stat: string } | null; shares: ShareCheck[]; manifest: Manifest | null }

const within = (child: string, parent: string) => child === parent || child.startsWith(parent.endsWith('/') ? parent : parent + '/')
const dashed = (ymd: string) => `${ymd.slice(0, 4)}-${ymd.slice(4, 6)}-${ymd.slice(6, 8)}`
const stamp = (p: string) => `${dashed(p)} ${p.slice(8, 10)}:${p.slice(10, 12)}:${p.slice(12, 14)} UTC`

/** Today on this Mac's clock as YYYYMMDD: sshd reads a key's expiry-time in local time. */
export function localYmd(d: Date): string {
  return `${d.getFullYear()}${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`
}

/** The drop-in's owner the check expects: root, or under the test override only, COLLAB_BRIDGE_DROPIN_OWNER_UID (P60). */
export function dropinOwnerUidOf(env: Env): number {
  return knobInt('COLLAB_BRIDGE_DROPIN_OWNER_UID', env) ?? 0
}

function errnoOf(e: unknown): string | undefined {
  return (e as NodeJS.ErrnoException | null)?.code
}

/** Whether something is at `p` (a dangling symlink counts): lstat, never a follow. */
function lexists(p: string): boolean {
  try { lstatSync(p); return true } catch { return false }
}

/**
 * §11.1: a citizen's folder is one with REST or EVENT-ONLY at its root, or anything under ~/love-unlimited, by spelling
 * or by what it resolves to. A folder that is not there holds no marker (`clear`); one that cannot be read is `unknown`,
 * which the installer refuses like a citizen. APFS ignores case, so `rest` is found as REST.
 */
export function citizenRoot(path: string, home: string): 'citizen' | 'clear' | 'unknown' {
  const lu = join(home, 'love-unlimited')
  if (within(normalize(path).toLowerCase(), lu.toLowerCase())) return 'citizen'
  const luReal = safeRealpath(lu)
  const real = safeRealpath(path)
  if (luReal && real && within(real, luReal)) return 'citizen'
  if (!real) {
    try { lstatSync(path) } catch (e) { return errnoOf(e) === 'ENOENT' ? 'clear' : 'unknown' }
    return 'unknown'                                  // there, but it does not resolve (a dangling link)
  }
  try { readdirSync(real) } catch { return 'unknown' }
  for (const marker of ['REST', 'EVENT-ONLY']) {
    try { lstatSync(join(real, marker)); return 'citizen' } catch (e) { if (errnoOf(e) !== 'ENOENT') return 'unknown' }
  }
  return 'clear'
}

/**
 * The entry that governs a folder that does not exist yet: the longest entry containing it, where an entry that does not
 * resolve is resolved through its parent (one missing leaf), so `~/Projects/collab-trial` matches before the clone.
 */
function absentFolderMatch(toBe: string, al: Allowlist, home: string, realpath: (p: string) => string | null): AllowlistFolder | null {
  let best: { real: string; f: AllowlistFolder } | null = null
  for (const f of al.folders) {
    const spelled = expandHome(f.path, home)
    let r = realpath(spelled)
    if (!r) { const pr = realpath(dirname(spelled)); r = pr ? join(pr, basename(spelled)) : null }
    if (r && within(toBe, r) && (!best || r.length > best.real.length)) best = { real: r, f }
  }
  return best ? best.f : null
}

interface ShareCtx { home: string; uid: number; allowlist: Allowlist | null; git: ResolvedGit | null; trialCommit: string | null; run: Run;
  realpath: (p: string) => string | null }
type ShareResult = { failures: string[]; check: ShareCheck | null }

/** The recorded git with the fetch gate's scrubbed env (P44) and no repo-configured fsmonitor or hooks. */
function shareGit(c: ShareCtx, folder: string, args: string[]) {
  return c.run(c.git!.path, ['-c', 'core.fsmonitor=false', '-c', 'core.hooksPath=/dev/null', '-C', folder, ...args],
    { env: gitEnv(c.home), timeoutMs: 10_000 })
}

/** A share folder that exists: a git repo root whose history holds the trial commit, in an edit folder, not a citizen's, not TCC. */
function existingShare(path: string, c: ShareCtx): ShareResult {
  const failures: string[] = []
  const fail = (code: string, text: string) => { failures.push(`${code}: ${text}`) }
  const done = (): ShareResult => ({ failures, check: null })
  const tcc = tccProtected(path, c.home, c.realpath)
  if (tcc) { fail('share_tcc', `${path} is in ~/${tcc}, which macOS protects; share a folder outside Desktop, Documents, Downloads and iCloud Drive`); return done() }
  const real = c.realpath(path)
  if (!real) { fail('share_unresolved', `${path} is there but does not resolve`); return done() }
  try { if (!statSync(real).isDirectory()) { fail('share_not_dir', `${path} is not a folder`); return done() } } catch { fail('share_unresolved', `${path} cannot be read`); return done() }
  const citizen = citizenRoot(real, c.home)
  if (citizen === 'citizen') fail('share_citizen', `${path} is a citizen's folder (REST or EVENT-ONLY at its root, or under ~/love-unlimited) and can never be shared`)
  if (citizen === 'unknown') fail('share_unclassified', `${path} cannot be read to check whether it is a citizen's folder`)
  if (c.allowlist && longestFolderMatch(real, c.allowlist, c.home, c.realpath)?.access !== 'edit') {
    fail('share_not_edit', `${path} is not inside an \`access: edit\` folder of Summon's allowlist (~/.config/summon/allowlist.yaml)`)
  }
  if (!c.git) return done()                           // the git failure is reported once, above the shares
  const top = shareGit(c, real, ['rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'])
  if (top.code !== 0 || c.realpath(top.stdout.trim()) !== real) { fail('share_not_repo_root', `${path} is not the root of a git repository`); return done() }
  const dotGit = join(real, '.git')
  let ownDir = false
  try { ownDir = lstatSync(dotGit).isDirectory() } catch { ownDir = false }
  const gd = shareGit(c, real, ['rev-parse', '--absolute-git-dir'])
  if (!ownDir || gd.code !== 0 || c.realpath(gd.stdout.trim()) !== dotGit) {
    fail('share_gitdir', `${path}/.git must be the repository's own folder (not a linked worktree, a gitdir file or a symlink)`)
    return done()
  }
  if (c.trialCommit) {
    const has = shareGit(c, real, ['merge-base', '--is-ancestor', c.trialCommit, 'HEAD'])
    if (has.code !== 0) fail('share_missing_commit', `${path} does not hold the trial commit ${c.trialCommit.slice(0, 12)} in its history`)
  }
  return failures.length > 0 ? done() : { failures, check: { path, state: 'exists', realpath: real, gitdir: dotGit } }
}

/** A share folder that is absent (it will be cloned): its parent resolves, is yours, is outside TCC and ~/love-unlimited, and it would be an edit folder. */
function absentShare(path: string, c: ShareCtx): ShareResult {
  const failures: string[] = []
  const fail = (code: string, text: string) => { failures.push(`${code}: ${text}`) }
  const done = (): ShareResult => ({ failures, check: null })
  const spelled = tccProtected(path, c.home, c.realpath)
  if (spelled) { fail('share_tcc', `${path} is in ~/${spelled}, which macOS protects`); return done() }
  const parent = dirname(path)
  const parentReal = c.realpath(parent)
  if (!parentReal) { fail('share_parent', `the folder ${parent} does not exist, so ${path} cannot be made there`); return done() }
  try {
    const st = statSync(parentReal)
    if (!st.isDirectory() || st.uid !== c.uid) fail('share_parent_owner', `${parent} is not a folder owned by you`)
  } catch { fail('share_parent', `${parent} cannot be read`); return done() }
  const viaParent = tccProtected(parent, c.home, c.realpath)
  if (viaParent) { fail('share_tcc', `${parent} leads into ~/${viaParent}, which macOS protects`); return done() }
  const toBe = join(parentReal, basename(path))
  const citizen = citizenRoot(toBe, c.home)
  if (citizen === 'citizen') fail('share_citizen', `${path} would be under ~/love-unlimited, a citizen's folder`)
  if (citizen === 'unknown') fail('share_unclassified', `${path} cannot be checked for a citizen's folder`)
  if (c.allowlist && absentFolderMatch(toBe, c.allowlist, c.home, c.realpath)?.access !== 'edit') {
    fail('share_not_edit', `${path} is not inside an \`access: edit\` folder of Summon's allowlist (~/.config/summon/allowlist.yaml)`)
  }
  return failures.length > 0 ? done() : { failures, check: { path, state: 'absent', realpath: toBe, gitdir: join(toBe, '.git') } }
}

export interface CheckInput { bundle: string; shares: string[]; terminalGit: string | null; claude: string | null; paths: NuancePaths;
  uid: number; user: string; platform: string; arch: string; zsh: string; xcrun: string; today: string; dropinOwnerUid: number; run?: Run }

/** The share checks with the context installCheck built: install clone's re-check after it cloned (§10.3 step 5). */
function shareCtxOf(o: CheckInput, allowlist: Allowlist | null, git: ResolvedGit | null, trialCommit: string | null): ShareCtx {
  return { home: o.paths.home, uid: o.uid, allowlist, git, trialCommit, run: o.run ?? runCmd, realpath: safeRealpath }
}

/**
 * Every check of §10.3 step 4, all collected (never only the first), before anything but the trial clone is written.
 * Each failure is `<code>: <sentence>`; ok is true only with none. The Summon baselines (P22) are recorded either way.
 */
export function installCheck(o: CheckInput): CheckReport {
  const failures: string[] = []
  const fail = (code: string, text: string) => { failures.push(`${code}: ${text}`) }
  const { paths } = o
  const run = o.run ?? runCmd
  if (o.platform !== 'darwin') fail('platform', `this installer is for macOS (this is ${o.platform})`)
  if (o.arch !== 'arm64') fail('platform', `this installer is for Apple Silicon (this is ${o.arch})`)
  if (o.uid === 0) fail('root', 'run it as your own user, not as root')

  // §10.1: Summon installed and live, with sshd taking keys only, is what makes leaning on Remote Login safe.
  const isFile = (p: string) => { try { return statSync(p).isFile() } catch { return false } }
  if (!isFile(paths.summonInstalled)) fail('summon_not_installed', `Summon is not installed here (no ${paths.summonInstalled}); install Summon first`)
  if (!isFile(paths.summonKeysOnly)) fail('summon_keys_only', `Summon's record that SSH takes keys only (${paths.summonKeysOnly}) is missing; run Summon's installer again`)
  let keys: string | null = null
  try { keys = readFileSync(paths.authorizedKeys, 'utf8') } catch { fail('authorized_keys', `${paths.authorizedKeys} cannot be read`) }
  if (keys !== null && !keys.split('\n').some((l) => l.endsWith(' summon-air'))) {
    fail('summon_key_missing', `Summon's summon-air key line is not in ${paths.authorizedKeys}`)
  }
  let dropinOk = false
  try {
    const st = lstatSync(paths.summonDropin)
    const owner = o.dropinOwnerUid === 0 ? 'root' : `uid ${o.dropinOwnerUid}`
    if (!st.isFile()) fail('dropin_missing', `${paths.summonDropin} is not a regular file`)
    else if (st.uid !== o.dropinOwnerUid) fail('dropin_owner', `${paths.summonDropin} is owned by uid ${st.uid}, not ${owner}`)
    else if ((st.mode & 0o7777) !== 0o600) fail('dropin_mode', `${paths.summonDropin} has mode ${(st.mode & 0o7777).toString(8)}, not 600`)
    else dropinOk = true
  } catch {
    fail('dropin_missing', `the password-off drop-in ${paths.summonDropin} is missing (Summon's installer puts it there)`)
  }
  const dstat = dropinStat(paths.summonDropin)
  const summon = keys !== null && dropinOk && dstat !== null ? { key_sha256: summonKeySha256(keys), dropin_stat: dstat } : null

  // The bundle: MANIFEST, the files it lists, the key's expiry, and never older than what is installed (K39's two checks).
  let manifest: Manifest | null = null
  try { manifest = parseManifest(readFileSync(join(o.bundle, 'MANIFEST.txt'), 'utf8')) } catch { manifest = null }
  if (!manifest) fail('manifest', `${join(o.bundle, 'MANIFEST.txt')} is missing or malformed`)
  else {
    for (const name of BUNDLE_FILES) if (manifest.files[name] === undefined) fail('manifest', `MANIFEST.txt does not list ${name}`)
    for (const [name, sha] of Object.entries(manifest.files)) {
      let got: string | null = null
      try { got = sha256File(join(o.bundle, name)) } catch { got = null }
      if (got !== sha) fail('checksum', `${name} does not match MANIFEST.txt; do not install this bundle`)
    }
    if (manifest.shares.join('\n') !== o.shares.join('\n')) fail('manifest', 'the shares given are not the ones MANIFEST.txt lists')
    if (!(Number(manifest.expiry) > Number(o.today))) fail('expired', `this bundle's key expired on ${dashed(manifest.expiry)}; ask Ai for a fresh bundle`)
    if (lexists(paths.installed)) {
      let installed = null
      try { installed = parseInstalled(readFileSync(paths.installed, 'utf8')) } catch { installed = null }
      if (!installed) fail('installed_unreadable', `${paths.installed} is there but cannot be read; tell Ai`)
      else if (manifest.prepared < installed.prepared) {
        fail('older_bundle', `this bundle was prepared ${stamp(manifest.prepared)}, before the installed one (${stamp(installed.prepared)}); run the newest bundle`)
      }
    }
    const keyExpiry = (keys ?? '').split('\n').map((l) => /expiry-time="(\d{8})".* collab-air$/.exec(l)?.[1]).filter((x): x is string => !!x).sort().pop()
    if (keyExpiry && manifest.expiry < keyExpiry) {
      fail('older_bundle', `this bundle's key expires ${dashed(manifest.expiry)}, before the installed collab-air key (${dashed(keyExpiry)}); run the newest bundle`)
    }
  }

  if (!zshenvClean(o.zsh, paths.home)) {
    fail('zshenv', '~/.zshenv (or another zsh start-up file) prints something or fails; it must stay silent for a non-interactive zsh, because the Air reads this Mac\'s output from the first byte')
  }
  let git: ResolvedGit | null = null
  const g = resolveGit({ xcrun: o.xcrun, terminalGit: o.terminalGit, home: paths.home, run })
  if (!g.ok) fail('git', g.reason)
  else {
    git = g.git
    if (!gitAcceptable(g.git)) {
      fail('git_unsafe', `${g.git.path} is git ${g.git.version}${g.git.apple ? ' (Apple)' : ''}${g.git.guard ? '' : ' without the GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH guard'}; the fetch gate needs git 2.45.1 or later, or Apple git 2.39.5 or later with the guard`)
    }
  }
  let claudeOk = false
  try { claudeOk = !!o.claude && o.claude.startsWith('/') && statSync(o.claude).isFile() && (accessSync(o.claude, constants.X_OK), true) } catch { claudeOk = false }
  if (!claudeOk) fail('claude', 'Claude Code (claude) was not found on your Terminal PATH')

  const al = loadAllowlist(paths.summonAllowlist)
  if (!al.ok) fail('allowlist', `Summon's allowlist ${paths.summonAllowlist} cannot be used (${al.detail})`)
  const ctx = shareCtxOf(o, al.ok ? al.allowlist : null, git, manifest ? manifest.trial_commit : null)
  const shares: ShareCheck[] = []
  for (const s of o.shares) {
    const problem = sharePathProblem(s)
    if (problem) { fail('share_path', `${s} ${problem}`); continue }
    const r = lexists(s) ? existingShare(s, ctx) : absentShare(s, ctx)
    failures.push(...r.failures)
    if (r.check) shares.push(r.check)
  }
  return { ok: failures.length === 0, failures, user: o.user, uid: o.uid, git, summon, shares, manifest }
}

// ---- the trial clone of §10.3 step 5 ----

const firstLine = (s: string) => s.split('\n').find((l) => l.trim() !== '')?.replace(/[^\x20-\x7e]/g, '?').slice(0, 200) ?? ''

/**
 * Clones the bundle into a fresh sibling `.<name>.partial-<random>` (never an existing path), checks it holds the trial
 * commit, drops its `origin` remote (the bundle file in Downloads), then claims the target with an exclusive mkdir and
 * renames the clone over that empty folder, so a target that appeared meanwhile is refused and left alone. Then the
 * existing-folder checks run again on the clone; on any failure this run's folder, and only it, is removed.
 */
export function installClone(o: { bundle: string; share: string; git: ResolvedGit; trialCommit: string; home: string; rand(): string;
  recheck(share: string): string[] }): { ok: true; created: string } | { ok: false; reason: string } {
  const parentReal = safeRealpath(dirname(o.share))
  if (!parentReal) return { ok: false, reason: `the folder ${dirname(o.share)} does not exist; nothing was cloned` }
  const name = basename(o.share)
  const target = join(parentReal, name)
  if (lexists(target)) return { ok: false, reason: `${o.share} already exists; nothing was cloned` }
  const r = o.rand()
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8,32}$/.test(r)) throw new Error('installClone: rand() must give 8 to 32 hex digits')
  const partial = join(parentReal, `.${name}.partial-${r}`)
  if (lexists(partial)) return { ok: false, reason: `${partial} already exists; nothing was cloned` }
  const git = (args: string[]) => runCmd(o.git.path, ['-c', 'core.fsmonitor=false', '-c', 'core.hooksPath=/dev/null', ...args],
    { env: gitEnv(o.home), timeoutMs: 120_000 })
  const dropPartial = () => rmSync(partial, { recursive: true, force: true })
  const cl = git(['clone', '--quiet', '--no-hardlinks', join(o.bundle, 'collab-trial.bundle'), partial])
  if (cl.code !== 0) { dropPartial(); return { ok: false, reason: `git clone of the trial bundle failed: ${firstLine(cl.stderr)}` } }
  if (git(['-C', partial, 'merge-base', '--is-ancestor', o.trialCommit, 'HEAD']).code !== 0) {
    dropPartial(); return { ok: false, reason: 'the clone does not hold the trial commit' }
  }
  if (git(['-C', partial, 'remote', 'remove', 'origin']).code !== 0) { dropPartial(); return { ok: false, reason: 'could not remove the clone\'s origin remote' } }
  try { mkdirSync(target) } catch {
    dropPartial(); return { ok: false, reason: `${o.share} appeared while the bundle was being cloned; it was left as it is` }
  }
  try { renameSync(partial, target) } catch {
    try { rmdirSync(target) } catch { /* someone else's files are in it now: leave it */ }
    dropPartial(); return { ok: false, reason: `${o.share} changed while the bundle was being cloned; it was left as it is` }
  }
  const problems = o.recheck(o.share)
  if (problems.length > 0) {
    rmSync(target, { recursive: true, force: true })
    return { ok: false, reason: `the new clone failed its checks and was removed: ${problems.join('; ')}` }
  }
  return { ok: true, created: target }
}

// ---- The verbs the bash installer runs (Task 55: check, clone; Task 56 adds write, settings, unsettings) ----

export const INSTALL_USAGE = 'usage: collab-bridge install check|clone --bundle <dir> --share <path>… --terminal-git <path> --claude <path>'

type FlagSpec = Record<string, 'one' | 'many' | 'flag'>
type Flags = Map<string, string[]>

/** Strict flags: only the named ones, each `one` exactly once, a `many` at least once, a value after every non-`flag`. */
function parseFlags(args: string[], spec: FlagSpec): Flags | null {
  const got: Flags = new Map()
  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
    const kind = spec[args[i]!]
    if (!kind) return null
    if (kind === 'flag') { if (got.has(args[i]!)) return null; got.set(args[i]!, []); continue }
    const value = args[i + 1]
    if (value === undefined) return null
    const list = got.get(args[i]!) ?? []
    if (kind === 'one' && list.length > 0) return null
    list.push(value)
    got.set(args[i]!, list)
    i++
  }
  for (const [name, kind] of Object.entries(spec)) if (kind !== 'flag' && !got.has(name)) return null
  return got
}

const CHECK_FLAGS: FlagSpec = { '--bundle': 'one', '--share': 'many', '--terminal-git': 'one', '--claude': 'one' }

/** installCheck's input from the flags and this process: the passwd user (never $USER), the systemBin zsh and xcrun. */
function checkInputOf(f: Flags, env: Env, paths: NuancePaths): CheckInput {
  const one = (k: string) => f.get(k)![0]!
  return {
    bundle: one('--bundle'), shares: f.get('--share')!, terminalGit: one('--terminal-git') || null, claude: one('--claude') || null,
    paths, uid: process.getuid!(), user: passwdOfSelf().name, platform: process.platform, arch: process.arch,
    zsh: systemBin('zsh', env), xcrun: systemBin('xcrun', env), today: localYmd(new Date()), dropinOwnerUid: dropinOwnerUidOf(env),
  }
}

export async function runInstallVerb(argv: string[], env: Env, io: GateIo): Promise<number> {
  const [verb, ...args] = argv
  const answer = (o: object, ok: boolean) => { io.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(o) + '\n'); return ok ? 0 : 1 }
  const usage = () => { io.stderr.write(INSTALL_USAGE + '\n'); return answer({ ok: false, failures: ['usage'] }, false) }
  const flags = verb === 'check' || verb === 'clone' ? parseFlags(args, CHECK_FLAGS) : null
  if (!flags) return usage()
  const paths = nuancePaths(homeOf(env), env)
  const input = checkInputOf(flags, env, paths)
  const report = installCheck(input)
  for (const f of report.failures) io.stderr.write(`✗ ${f}\n`)
  if (verb === 'check') {
    if (report.ok) {
      io.stderr.write(`✓ Summon is installed and SSH takes keys only; git ${report.git!.version} at ${report.git!.path}; Claude Code found\n`)
      for (const s of report.shares) io.stderr.write(s.state === 'exists' ? `✓ ${s.path}: a repository holding the trial commit\n` : `✓ ${s.path}: will be cloned from the bundle\n`)
    }
    return answer(report, report.ok)
  }
  if (!report.ok) return answer({ ok: false, reason: 'the checks failed; nothing was cloned', created: [] }, false)
  const created: string[] = []
  const al = loadAllowlist(paths.summonAllowlist)
  const ctx = shareCtxOf(input, al.ok ? al.allowlist : null, report.git, report.manifest!.trial_commit)
  for (const s of report.shares) {
    if (s.state !== 'absent') continue
    const r = installClone({ bundle: input.bundle, share: s.path, git: report.git!, trialCommit: report.manifest!.trial_commit, home: paths.home,
      rand: () => randomBytes(8).toString('hex'), recheck: (share) => existingShare(share, ctx).failures })
    if (!r.ok) {
      for (const c of created) rmSync(c, { recursive: true, force: true })     // only the folders this run made
      io.stderr.write(`✗ ${r.reason}\n`)
      return answer({ ok: false, reason: r.reason, created: [] }, false)
    }
    created.push(r.created)
    io.stderr.write(`✓ cloned the trial repo into ${s.path}\n`)
  }
  return answer({ ok: true, created }, true)
}
```

```ts
// The one compiled Nuance program (P20). sshd's forced command runs `collab-bridge gate`; Claude runs `collab-bridge pipe`
// and its hook `collab-bridge tap --host claude` (Tasks 31, 32); Yu runs `collab-bridge status`; the installer runs the
// hidden `install …` verbs (Tasks 55, 56). Nothing Air-side is in here.
import { monoNowMs, passwdOfSelf } from '../native.ts'
import { homeOf, nuancePaths } from '../paths.ts'
import { readPs, ttyOf } from '../proc.ts'
import { systemBin, type Env } from '../sysbin.ts'
import { scaled, TIMING } from '../timing.ts'
import { runGate, type GateIo } from './gate-main.ts'
import { runInstallVerb } from './install-steps.ts'
import { readInstalled } from './installed.ts'
import { bunConnect } from './link-client.ts'
import { runPipe, type PipeDeps } from './pipe.ts'
import { nuanceStatus, renderNuanceStatus } from './status.ts'
import { runTap } from './tap.ts'

export const NUANCE_USAGE = 'usage: collab-bridge gate | pipe | tap --host claude | status'

/**
 * The pipe's deps from the env Claude gave it: this Mac's paths, INSTALLED, the real process table (`ps` by systemBin, so a
 * test's P43 stub), the monotonic clock that counts sleep, the passwd user name (never $USER, F3) and this process's stdio.
 * A missing or malformed INSTALLED throws: the binary is not installed, and Claude shows the server as failed.
 */
export function livePipeDeps(env: Env): PipeDeps {
  const paths = nuancePaths(homeOf(env), env)
  const installed = readInstalled(paths)
  if (!installed) throw new Error('INSTALLED is missing or malformed; run the installer again')
  const ps = systemBin('ps', env)
  return {
    paths, env, cwd: process.cwd(), selfPid: process.pid,
    table: () => readPs(ps),
    ttyOf: (pid) => ttyOf(pid, ps),
    mono: monoNowMs,
    now: () => new Date(),
    rand: Math.random,
    stdin: Bun.stdin.stream(),
    write: (line) => { try { process.stdout.write(line) } catch { /* Claude is gone */ } },
    installed,
    user: passwdOfSelf().name,
    connect: bunConnect,
  }
}

/** argv is the verb and its arguments (process.argv.slice(2)); the result is the exit code. */
export async function runNuanceCli(argv: string[], env: Env, io: GateIo): Promise<number> {
  const [verb, ...rest] = argv
  switch (verb) {
    case 'gate':
      if (rest.length === 0) return runGate(env, io)
      break
    case 'pipe':
      // Claude's MCP server (§6.2): JSON-RPC on this process's stdio until stdin ends.
      if (rest.length === 0) return runPipe({ ...livePipeDeps(env), stdin: io.stdin, write: (line) => io.stdout.write(line) })
      break
    case 'tap': {
      // Claude's UserPromptSubmit hook (§8): the envelope or nothing on stdout, and always exit 0, even when misconfigured,
      // because a hook must never block a prompt.
      if (rest.length !== 2 || rest[0] !== '--host' || rest[1] !== 'claude') return 0
      let out: string | null = null
      try {
        const ps = systemBin('ps', env)
        out = await runTap({ paths: nuancePaths(homeOf(env), env), selfPid: process.pid, table: () => readPs(ps), stdin: io.stdin, mono: monoNowMs, connect: bunConnect })
      } catch { out = null }
      if (out !== null) io.stdout.write(out)
      return 0
    }
    case 'install':
      // The installer's hidden verbs (P21): one JSON line on stdout, human lines on stderr, exit 0 or 1.
      return runInstallVerb(rest, env, io)
    case 'status': {
      if (rest.length > 0) break
      const paths = nuancePaths(homeOf(env), env)
      const s = nuanceStatus(paths, monoNowMs, { staleMs: scaled(TIMING.staleMs, env) })
      for (const line of renderNuanceStatus(s, monoNowMs())) io.stdout.write(line + '\n')
      return 0
    }
  }
  io.stderr.write(NUANCE_USAGE + '\n')
  return 2
}

if (import.meta.main) {
  // First, before anything reads them: the gate's children and every path lookup see one locale and the system PATH (§5.2).
  process.env.LC_ALL = 'C'
  process.env.PATH = '/usr/bin:/bin'
  let flushed: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve()
  const io: GateIo = {
    stdin: Bun.stdin.stream(),
    // A write's callback means its bytes reached the kernel. process.exit right after a plain write loses what is still
    // buffered (8 MiB written, 64 KiB arrived, on this Air), so the exit below waits for the last write's callback.
    stdout: { write: (b) => { flushed = new Promise<void>((done) => { process.stdout.write(b, () => done()) }) } },
    stderr: { write: (s) => { process.stderr.write(s) } },
  }
  let code: number
  try {
    code = await runNuanceCli(process.argv.slice(2), process.env, io)
  } catch (e) {
    process.stderr.write(`collab-bridge: ${String(e instanceof Error ? e.message : e).replace(/[^\x20-\x7e]/g, '?').slice(0, 200)}\n`)
    code = 70
  }
  await Promise.race([flushed, Bun.sleep(2000)])
  process.exit(code)
}
```

```ts
// src/nuance/install-steps.ts (added)
export function installWrite(o: { paths: NuancePaths; report: CheckReport; bundle: string; claudeVersion: string | null; now: Date }): { ok: true; seat_public: string; created_seat: boolean } | { ok: false; reason: string }
//   order: INSTALLED (renderInstalled; binary_sha256 of the installed binary at paths.binary), the seat key (P34) and shares.json,
//   the state dirs run, pipes, lineages, tools (0700), the seeded tool list from readToolsFile(<bundle>/tools.json) (null, or a
//   digest other than the MANIFEST's, is refused before anything is written)
export function tapCommand(paths: NuancePaths): string          // `${paths.binary} tap --host claude`
export function installSettings(o: { folder: string; trailer: string; tap: boolean; paths: NuancePaths; git: ResolvedGit }): { ok: true; changed: boolean } | { ok: false; reason: string }
//   <folder>/.claude/settings.local.json: backup to settings.local.json.collab-bridge-backup before its first change (once); set
//   attribution.commit = trailer; with tap, add {"hooks":{"UserPromptSubmit":[{"hooks":[{"type":"command","command":tapCommand,"timeout":5}]}]}}
//   merged without touching other hooks, idempotent; atomic write; `.claude/settings.local.json` appended to .git/info/exclude unless
//   `git check-ignore -q` already ignores it (recorded git, scrubbed env)
export function uninstallSettings(o: { folder: string; paths: NuancePaths }): { ok: true; changed: boolean } | { ok: false; reason: string }
//   removes exactly the tap entry (by command) and the attribution.commit key; everything else byte-equivalent after JSON round trip
```
  Added by this task (each the smallest workable change; reported as interface deviations):
  - `src/nuance/main.ts` is not modified here, although the skeleton lists it: Task 55's `case 'install':` already hands every install sub-verb to `runInstallVerb`, so `write`, `settings` and `unsettings` are added inside `install-steps.ts` alone.
  - `.git/info/exclude` gains two lines, `.claude/settings.local.json` and `.claude/settings.local.json.collab-bridge-backup`, each only when `git check-ignore` does not already ignore it. A backup inside the share that git can see would make the tree dirty, so every remote complete would be refused `remote_uncommitted` (§7.5), and a `git add -A` would commit a `.claude` path (`remote_control_path`, §7.3).
  - `installWrite` refuses (before writing anything) a report that is not ok, a share still absent, and a binary at `paths.binary` whose sha256 is not MANIFEST's; `claudeVersion` keeps its first printable line, at most 128 characters, and an empty one is recorded as none.
  - `export const SETTINGS_BACKUP_SUFFIX = '.collab-bridge-backup'`; `export const TRAILER_RE = /^[ -&(-~]{1,200}$/` (printable ASCII without `'`, the rule Task 57's `renderInstaller` uses for `__TRAILER__`); `INSTALL_USAGE` gains the three new verbs.
  - The verbs: `install write <Task 55's check flags> --claude-version <text>` re-runs the whole check (every share must now exist) and then `installWrite`; `install settings --folder <share> --trailer <text> [--tap]` takes the git INSTALLED records (P44), refuses a folder whose realpath is not in `shares.json` and a trailer outside `TRAILER_RE`; `install unsettings --folder <share>` runs `uninstallSettings` (no INSTALLED needed, so the rollback works in any order). Each prints one JSON line and exits 0 or 1.
  - `uninstallSettings` also removes the containers it leaves empty (`UserPromptSubmit`, `hooks`, `attribution`), so a file the installer created reads `{}` afterwards; a file that is not a JSON object is refused and left as it is.

Notes for the implementer:
- The order test reads each file's `birthtimeNs`: every step is a new inode (`writeFileDurable` writes a temp file and renames it, the seat key is linked into place, the state dirs are new), and the writes are F_FULLFSYNCed, so the times are strictly increasing on APFS (six repeated runs on this Air, no tie).
- `installSettings` keeps the settings file's mode (`0600` when it creates it) and makes `.claude` `0700` only when it is absent. It never removes a hook it did not add, and never restores the backup.
