````markdown
holds the rules for Air sessions there, and `notes/.gitkeep`; the commit's message ends with the trailer, and it is the
shared base on both Macs; an existing repository is kept as it is); `~/.ssh/collab-bridge/collab_nuance_ed25519` once, with the comment `collab-air`;
one Nuance binary; the seat tool list, from a probe of the installed Collab on a throwaway journal; the AirDrop folder
`~/collab-bridge-nuance-bundle-<expiry>-<build>/` (0700: `collab-install.sh`, `collab-bridge`, `MANIFEST.txt`,
`tools.json`, `collab-trial.bundle`); and `~/.config/collab-bridge/devices/nuance.json` in state `prepared`. It prints the
bundle, the key's expiry (the pairing date plus 90 days), the two lines Yu adds under `folders:` in Nuance's
`~/.config/summon/allowlist.yaml`, and the line Yu runs there.

Every value that goes into the installer is checked before anything is written: a share path the gate's form cannot
carry (one with `'`, `!`, `\` or a control character, one that is not absolute and normalised, or one longer than 1019
bytes) is refused, and Phase 1 shares one folder. Older bundle
folders are listed with the command that removes them, never removed. Preparing again, to renew the key, writes the
device file as `prepared` again: a running hub drops the device's link and stops its children, and dials it again only
once it is pinned again and the hub has restarted.
````

```ts
export function summonPinLine(text: string): string | null                 // the `summon-nuance <type> <key>` line
export function collabSshConfig(o: { home: string; device: string; user: string }): string   // §5.6 exactly, absolute paths

//   on success, through updateDevice, the device file becomes 'paired' with the seat key, git, Summon baselines and, per share
//   from hello, remote_realpath, remote_gitdir and mirror_id = mirrorIdOf(hello's realpath); then createMirror per share, then
//   workspace_id = mirrorWorkspaceId(the share's mirror) (P55; the first session_start confirms or corrects it, Task 51);

```
  Also produced: `export const HELLO_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000` and `export function pinnedText(d: DeviceFile, paths: AirPaths): string` (what `main()` prints after a pin: the device, its git and each locked mirror). Beyond the skeleton, each the smallest workable change (reported as interface deviations): `pinDevice` creates, syncs and locks every mirror and derives its workspace id first, and only then writes the device file `paired`, in one `updateDevice` that re-reads the file under its lock and writes nothing when an unpair or a new prepare came in between; so a device whose mirror cannot be made stays `prepared`, and the hub, which dials only paired devices, never lets a session bind before its mirror exists (§7.1, K17). `checkHello` also checks hello's device and each share both ways (a prepared share hello does not report, and a share hello reports that was not prepared) and that each gitdir fits the gate's upload-pack form. `writeCollabSsh` refuses a device other than `nuance`: Summon pins only `summon-nuance` in Phase 0 (K40), and `summonPinLine` reads exactly that one line. A re-pin keeps a share's non-null `workspace_id`, which the hub may already have confirmed or corrected from Collab (Task 51).

Notes for the implementer:
- hello's `user` is the gate's `getpwuid` name (F3), so on this Mac it is the user running the tests: the tests prepare the device for `basename(REAL_HOME)`, never for `macair`.
- The dial runs the ssh it is given (`systemBin('ssh')` in `main()`, the fake in tests) with an env of `HOME`, `PATH` and `LC_ALL` only (P14), from cwd `/`. Exit 255 goes through Task 46's classifier with the config's own `HostName` and `User` (`ssh: <status> (<reason>): <detail>`); any other non-zero exit is the gate's refusal, reported with its first stderr line, clipped and printable; stdout must be exactly one line, read up to 1 MiB.
- Nothing on the Air runs real ssh in a test: the config is checked as text and through `targetOfConfig`, never with `ssh -G`.

```ts
const specOf = (w: PinWorld): MirrorSpec => {
  const mirrorId = mirrorIdOf(w.share)
  return { device: 'nuance', user: USER, mirrorId, mirrorPath: w.paths.mirrorDir('nuance', USER, mirrorId), airClone: w.airClone,
    remoteGitdir: join(w.share, '.git'), caps: DEFAULT_CAPS }
}
/** What the gate's hello prints for this world, read through the fake ssh as pin-device dials it. */
function helloOf(w: PinWorld): Hello {
  const r = Bun.spawnSync([w.fake.bin, '-F', w.paths.sshConfig, 'collab-nuance', 'hello'], { cwd: '/', env: { HOME: w.air, PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin' } })
  expect(r.exitCode).toBe(0)
  return parseHello(r.stdout.toString().trim())!
}

describe('the ssh config and the pinned host key (spec §5.6)', () => {
  test("copies Summon's pinned line and writes the exact config with absolute paths", async () => {
    expect(collabSshConfig({ home: '/Users/yuai', device: 'nuance', user: 'macair' })).toBe([
      'Host collab-nuance', '  HostName nuance.local', '  AddressFamily inet', '  User macair',
      '  IdentityFile /Users/yuai/.ssh/collab-bridge/collab_nuance_ed25519', '  IdentitiesOnly yes', '  IdentityAgent none',
      '  HostKeyAlias summon-nuance', '  UserKnownHostsFile /Users/yuai/.ssh/collab-bridge/known_hosts', '  GlobalKnownHostsFile /dev/null',
      '  StrictHostKeyChecking yes', '  UpdateHostKeys no', '  BatchMode yes', '  ConnectTimeout 8', '  ServerAliveInterval 15',
      '  ServerAliveCountMax 2', '  RequestTTY no', '  ForwardAgent no', '  ForwardX11 no', '  ClearAllForwardings yes',
      '  ControlMaster no', '  ControlPath none', '',
    ].join('\n'))
    for (const bad of [{ home: '/Users/yu ai', device: 'nuance', user: 'macair' }, { home: 'Users/yuai', device: 'nuance', user: 'macair' },
      { home: '/Users/yuai', device: 'Nuance', user: 'macair' }, { home: '/Users/yuai', device: 'nuance', user: 'mac air' }]) {
      expect(() => collabSshConfig(bad)).toThrow('pin:')
    }
    expect(summonPinLine(`${SUMMON_PIN}\n`)).toBe(SUMMON_PIN)
    expect(summonPinLine(`# pinned by Summon\n${SUMMON_PIN}\r\n`)).toBe(SUMMON_PIN)
    for (const text of ['', `${SUMMON_PIN}\n${SUMMON_PIN}x\n`, 'summon-zerone ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3Nza\n', 'summon-nuance ssh-rsa AAAAB3Nza\n',
      'summon-nuance ssh-ed25519 AAAA$bad\n', `${SUMMON_PIN} root@Nuance\n`]) expect(summonPinLine(text)).toBeNull()

    const w = pinWorld()
    const r = await pin(w)
    expect(r.ok).toBe(true)
    expect(readFileSync(w.paths.knownHosts, 'utf8')).toBe(`${SUMMON_PIN}\n`)
    expect(readFileSync(w.paths.sshConfig, 'utf8')).toBe(collabSshConfig({ home: w.air, device: 'nuance', user: USER }))
    expect(targetOfConfig(readFileSync(w.paths.sshConfig, 'utf8'), 'collab-nuance'))
      .toEqual({ host: 'nuance.local', user: USER, identityFile: w.paths.sshKey('nuance') })
    expect([modeOf(w.paths.sshDir), modeOf(w.paths.sshConfig), modeOf(w.paths.knownHosts)]).toEqual([0o700, 0o600, 0o600])
    // hello first, with the config's absolute path; then the first fetch through the gate's upload-pack form.
    expect(w.fake.calls()[0]).toEqual(['-F', w.paths.sshConfig, 'collab-nuance', 'hello'])
    expect(w.fake.calls().map((c) => c.at(-1))).toEqual(['hello', `git-upload-pack '${w.share}/.git'`])
    // A Summon pin that is missing or not one ed25519 line stops before any dial.
    const v = pinWorld()
    writeFileSync(v.paths.summonKnownHosts, 'summon-nuance ssh-rsa AAAAB3Nza\n')
    expect(await pin(v)).toEqual({ ok: false, problems: [expect.stringContaining("Summon's pin")] })
    expect(v.fake.calls()).toEqual([])
    expect(() => writeCollabSsh({ paths: v.paths, device: 'nuance', user: USER, summonKnownHosts: join(v.air, 'no-such-file') })).toThrow("Summon's pin")
  }, T)

describe('pinDevice (spec §10.2 step 2)', () => {
  test("records the device as paired from hello, with each share's remote gitdir and mirror id", async () => {
    const w = pinWorld()
    const r = await pin(w)
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.problems.join('; '))
    const d = readDevice(w.paths.deviceFile('nuance'))!
    expect(r.device).toEqual(d)
    expect(d.state).toBe('paired')
    expect(d.seat_public).toBe(readSeatPublicHex(nuancePaths(w.nuance))!)
    expect(d.git).toEqual(NUANCE_GIT)
    expect(d.summon).toEqual({ key_sha256: summonKeySha256(`${SUMMON_AIR_LINE}\n`), dropin_stat: '1 2 3 0 600' })
    expect(d.paired_at).toBe(new Date(PIN_AT).toISOString())
    expect([d.bundle_build, d.key_expiry, d.prepared_at]).toEqual([BUILD, EXPIRY, '2026-10-13T12:00:00.000Z'])
    expect(d.shares).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(d.shares[0]).toMatchObject({ remote_realpath: w.share, remote_gitdir: join(w.share, '.git'), air_clone: w.airClone,
      mirror_id: mirrorIdOf(w.share), mirror_worktree_id: null })
    expect(modeOf(w.paths.deviceFile('nuance'))).toBe(0o600)
    expect(pinnedText(d, w.paths)).toContain(`paired: nuance (${USER}), build ${BUILD}, the collab key expires 2027-01-11\n`)
    expect(pinnedText(d, w.paths)).toContain(`mirror ${w.paths.mirrorDir('nuance', USER, mirrorIdOf(w.share))}`)
  }, T)

  test("records the share's derived workspace id", async () => {
    const w = pinWorld()
    const r = await pin(w)
    if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.problems.join('; '))
    const ws = r.device.shares[0]!.workspace_id
    expect(ws).toMatch(/^ws_[0-9a-f]{24}$/)
    expect(ws).toBe((await mirrorWorkspaceId(specOf(w), w.deps))!)
    // The id a real Collab session rooted at the mirror reports, on a temp shared journal (P55).
    const s = await startCollabSession({ journal: w.paths.sharedJournal, home: w.air, root: specOf(w).mirrorPath, actor: 'pin-test' })
    expect(s.workspaceId).toBe(ws!)
  }, T)

  test('creates, syncs and locks the mirror before any session can bind', async () => {
    const w = pinWorld()
    const r = await pin(w)
    expect(r.ok).toBe(true)
    const spec = specOf(w)
    expect(repoGit(w.airClone, ['worktree', 'list', '--porcelain'])).toContain(`worktree ${spec.mirrorPath}\nHEAD ${w.base}\ndetached\nlocked collab-bridge mirror`)
    expect([await mirrorHead(spec, w.deps), await syncedOid(spec, w.deps)]).toEqual([w.base, w.base])
    // A device whose repository shares no history with the Air clone gets no mirror and stays prepared: the hub dials
    // only paired devices, so no session can ever bind to a missing or unborn mirror (§7.1, K17).
    const m = pinWorld({ related: false })
    const bad = await pin(m)
    expect(bad).toEqual({ ok: false, problems: [expect.stringContaining('repo_mismatch')] })
    expect(readFileSync(m.paths.deviceFile('nuance'), 'utf8')).toBe(m.deviceText)
    expect(existsSync(specOf(m).mirrorPath)).toBe(false)
  }, T)

  test('refuses a hello whose user, build or shares differ, or whose zshenv is noisy', async () => {
    const w = pinWorld()
    writeCollabSsh({ paths: w.paths, device: 'nuance', user: USER, summonKnownHosts: w.paths.summonKnownHosts })
    const h = helloOf(w)
    const d = readDevice(w.paths.deviceFile('nuance'))!
    expect(checkHello(h, d)).toEqual([])
    expect(checkHello(h, { ...d, user: 'someone' })).toEqual([expect.stringContaining('user')])
    expect(checkHello(h, { ...d, bundle_build: '00000000' })).toEqual([expect.stringContaining('build')])
    expect(checkHello(h, { ...d, key_expiry: '20270112' })).toEqual([expect.stringContaining('expir')])
    const other = { ...d.shares[0]!, remote_realpath: join(w.nuance, 'Projects', 'other'), mirror_id: mirrorIdOf(join(w.nuance, 'Projects', 'other')) }
    expect(checkHello(h, { ...d, shares: [other] })).toEqual([expect.stringContaining('not among'), expect.stringContaining('did not prepare')])
    expect(checkHello({ ...h, shares: [{ realpath: w.share, gitdir: "/x/it's.git" }] }, d)).toEqual([expect.stringContaining('gitdir')])
    expect(checkHello({ ...h, seat_public: '0'.repeat(64) }, d)).toEqual([expect.stringContaining('seat')])
    expect(checkHello({ ...h, device: 'zerone' }, d)).toEqual([expect.stringContaining('device')])
    // parseHello takes exactly hello's fields with their forms, and nothing else.
    expect(parseHello(JSON.stringify(h))).toEqual(h)
    for (const broken of [{ ...h, extra: 1 }, { ...h, v: 2 }, { ...h, build: 'ABCDEF01' }, { ...h, shares: 'x' }, { ...h, zshenv_clean: 'yes' },
      { ...h, git: { ...h.git, sha256: 'x' } }, { ...h, summon: { key_sha256: 'a'.repeat(64), dropin_stat: 'later' } }, { ...h, clock: 'now' }]) {
      expect(parseHello(JSON.stringify(broken))).toBeNull()
    }
    expect(parseHello('not json')).toBeNull()
    // Through the dial: a ~/.zshenv that prints at login makes hello say zshenv_clean false, and nothing is recorded.
    const z = pinWorld()
    writeFileSync(join(z.nuance, '.zshenv'), 'echo hello from zshenv\n')
    expect(await pin(z)).toEqual({ ok: false, problems: [expect.stringContaining('zshenv')] })
    expect(readFileSync(z.paths.deviceFile('nuance'), 'utf8')).toBe(z.deviceText)
    // A user other than the one prepared is refused the same way.
    const u = pinWorld({ device: { user: 'someone' } })
    expect(await pin(u)).toEqual({ ok: false, problems: [expect.stringContaining('user')] })
    expect(existsSync(specOf(u).mirrorPath)).toBe(false)
  }, T)

  test('refuses a git without the guard', async () => {
    const w = pinWorld()
    writeCollabSsh({ paths: w.paths, device: 'nuance', user: USER, summonKnownHosts: w.paths.summonKnownHosts })
    const h = helloOf(w)
    const d = readDevice(w.paths.deviceFile('nuance'))!
    const apple = { path: '/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/usr/bin/git', version: '2.39.5', sha256: 'c'.repeat(64), apple: true }
    expect(checkHello({ ...h, git: { ...apple, guard: true } }, d)).toEqual([])
    expect(checkHello({ ...h, git: { ...apple, guard: false } }, d)).toEqual([expect.stringContaining('guard')])
    expect(checkHello({ ...h, git: { ...h.git, version: '2.44.0', apple: false, guard: true } }, d)).toEqual([expect.stringContaining('guard')])
  }, T)

  test('an ssh failure is reported with its class and nothing is written', async () => {
    const w = pinWorld()
    w.fake.setFail255('ssh: connect to host nuance.local port 22: No route to host\r\n')
    expect(await pin(w)).toEqual({ ok: false, problems: ['ssh: unreachable (no_route): ssh: connect to host nuance.local port 22: No route to host'] })
    expect(readFileSync(w.paths.deviceFile('nuance'), 'utf8')).toBe(w.deviceText)
    expect(existsSync(w.paths.mirrorsRoot)).toBe(false)
    expect(repoGit(w.airClone, ['for-each-ref', 'refs/collab'])).toBe('')
    // The gate's own refusal (no INSTALLED on the device) is reported with its line, and nothing is written either.
    const g = pinWorld()
    rmSync(nuancePaths(g.nuance).installed)
    const r = await pin(g)
    expect(r).toEqual({ ok: false, problems: [expect.stringMatching(/^the device's gate refused hello \(exit 64\): collab-bridge gate: hello: INSTALLED/)] })
    expect(readFileSync(g.paths.deviceFile('nuance'), 'utf8')).toBe(g.deviceText)
    // An unpaired or missing device file is refused before any dial.
    const n = pinWorld({ device: { state: 'unpaired' } })
    expect(await pin(n)).toEqual({ ok: false, problems: [expect.stringContaining('unpaired')] })
    rmSync(n.paths.deviceFile('nuance'))
    expect(await pin(n)).toEqual({ ok: false, problems: [expect.stringContaining('prepare-pairing')] })
    expect(n.fake.calls()).toEqual([])
  }, T)
})
```

`/Users/yuai/Projects/.worktrees/agenttool-collab-bridge/packages/collab-bridge/scripts/pin-device.ts`:

```ts
// On the Air, after Yu's install at the device: copy Summon's pinned host key, write the bridge's own ssh config, dial
// `hello` from Terminal (exempt from Local Network privacy, K45), check it against the prepared device file, create,
// sync and lock each share's mirror, and only then record the device as paired (spec §10.2 step 2, §5.6, §7.1; R25).
//   cd / && bun --no-env-file --config=/dev/null <PKG>/scripts/pin-device.ts nuance
import { chmodSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { readDevice, updateDevice, type DeviceFile, type DeviceShare } from '../src/air/devices.ts'
import { airGit } from '../src/air/git.ts'
import { createMirror, liveMirrorDeps, mirrorIdOf, mirrorWorkspaceId, type MirrorDeps, type MirrorSpec } from '../src/air/mirror.ts'
import { parseSeatPublicHex } from '../src/air/seats.ts'
import { classifySshFailure, targetOfConfig, type DialFailure } from '../src/air/ssh.ts'
import { writeFileDurable } from '../src/native.ts'
import type { Hello } from '../src/nuance/gate.ts'
import { gitAcceptable } from '../src/nuance/git-resolve.ts'
import { airPaths, homeOf, type AirPaths } from '../src/paths.ts'
import { mkdirPrivate } from '../src/private-dir.ts'
import { systemBin } from '../src/sysbin.ts'

/** The hello dial: mDNS, ConnectTimeout 8, key exchange, auth, zsh and a cold binary all fit (as the preamble's 30 s does, §5.4). */
export const HELLO_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000
/** hello is one small JSON line; anything past this is not hello. */
const HELLO_MAX_BYTES = 1024 * 1024

const DEVICE_RE = /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$/ // Summon's DEVICE_RE
const USER_RE = /^[a-z_][a-z0-9._-]{0,31}$/ // the installer's (Task 57)
/** Summon's pin-nuance writes exactly `summon-nuance ssh-ed25519 <base64>` (SM scripts/pin-nuance.ts). */
const PIN_RE = /^summon-nuance ssh-ed25519 [A-Za-z0-9+/]+={0,2}$/
const HEX64_RE = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/
const DROPIN_STAT_RE = /^[0-9]+ [0-9]+ [0-9]+ [0-9]+ [0-7]{1,4}$/ // `<ino> <size> <mtime> <uid> <mode>` (P22)
const VERSION_RE = /^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)*$/
/** What the gate's upload-pack form can carry (spec §5.2): absolute, at most 1024 bytes, no ', !, \ or control character. */
const gateSafe = (p: string) => /^\/[^'!\\\x00-\x1f\x7f]*$/.test(p) && Buffer.byteLength(p, 'utf8') <= 1024

/** The one `summon-nuance <type> <key>` line of Summon's known_hosts, or null when there is none, or more than one. */
export function summonPinLine(text: string): string | null {
  const lines = text.split('\n').map((l) => l.replace(/\r$/, '')).filter((l) => l.startsWith('summon-nuance '))
  return lines.length === 1 && PIN_RE.test(lines[0]!) ? lines[0]! : null
}

/** §5.6 exactly, with absolute paths built from `home` (ssh opens -F paths and IdentityFile as given, never via $HOME). */
export function collabSshConfig(o: { home: string; device: string; user: string }): string {
  if (!o.home.startsWith('/') || /[\s"'\\#]/.test(o.home)) throw new Error('pin: the Air home must be an absolute path with no spaces or quotes')
  if (!DEVICE_RE.test(o.device)) throw new Error(`pin: bad device name ${JSON.stringify(o.device)}`)
  if (!USER_RE.test(o.user)) throw new Error(`pin: bad user name ${JSON.stringify(o.user)}`)
  const paths = airPaths(o.home)
  return [
    `Host collab-${o.device}`, `  HostName ${o.device}.local`, '  AddressFamily inet', `  User ${o.user}`,
    `  IdentityFile ${paths.sshKey(o.device)}`, '  IdentitiesOnly yes', '  IdentityAgent none', `  HostKeyAlias summon-${o.device}`,
    `  UserKnownHostsFile ${paths.knownHosts}`, '  GlobalKnownHostsFile /dev/null', '  StrictHostKeyChecking yes', '  UpdateHostKeys no',
    '  BatchMode yes', '  ConnectTimeout 8', '  ServerAliveInterval 15', '  ServerAliveCountMax 2', '  RequestTTY no', '  ForwardAgent no',
    '  ForwardX11 no', '  ClearAllForwardings yes', '  ControlMaster no', '  ControlPath none', '',
  ].join('\n')
}

/**
 * Copies Summon's pinned line into ~/.ssh/collab-bridge/known_hosts and writes the config, both 0600 in a 0700 dir. A
 * copy, because pin-nuance rewrites Summon's file whole and not atomically (K36); `hub doctor` warns when they diverge.
 * Summon pairs only nuance in Phase 0 (K40), so that is the one pin there is to copy.
 */
export function writeCollabSsh(o: { paths: AirPaths; device: string; user: string; summonKnownHosts: string }): void {
  if (o.device !== 'nuance') throw new Error(`pin: Summon pins only nuance in Phase 0 (K40), so ${o.device} has no host key to copy`)
  let text: string
  try { text = readFileSync(o.summonKnownHosts, 'utf8') } catch { throw new Error(`pin: Summon's pin ${o.summonKnownHosts} is missing; pin Summon first`) }
  const line = summonPinLine(text)
  if (line === null) throw new Error(`pin: Summon's pin ${o.summonKnownHosts} does not hold exactly one summon-nuance ssh-ed25519 line`)
  const config = collabSshConfig({ home: o.paths.home, device: o.device, user: o.user })
  mkdirPrivate(o.paths.sshDir)
  chmodSync(o.paths.sshDir, 0o700)
  writeFileDurable(o.paths.knownHosts, `${line}\n`, 0o600)
  writeFileDurable(o.paths.sshConfig, config, 0o600)
}

type Obj = Record<string, unknown>
const isObj = (v: unknown): v is Obj => v !== null && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v)
const keysAre = (o: Obj, keys: string[]) => Object.keys(o).length === keys.length && keys.every((k) => Object.hasOwn(o, k))
const str = (v: unknown, re?: RegExp): v is string => typeof v === 'string' && (re === undefined || re.test(v))
const HELLO_KEYS = ['v', 'device', 'build', 'prepared', 'expiry', 'user', 'seat_public', 'shares', 'git', 'summon', 'summon_now',
  'claude_version', 'zshenv_clean', 'clock']

/** hello's one JSON line with exactly its fields in their forms (Task 22's Hello), or null. */
export function parseHello(line: string): Hello | null {
  let o: unknown
  try { o = JSON.parse(line) } catch { return null }
  if (!isObj(o) || !keysAre(o, HELLO_KEYS) || o.v !== 1) return null
  if (!str(o.device, DEVICE_RE) || !str(o.build, /^[0-9a-f]{8}$/) || !str(o.prepared, /^[0-9]{14}$/) || !str(o.expiry, /^[0-9]{8}$/)) return null
  if (!str(o.user, USER_RE) || !str(o.seat_public, /^[0-9a-fA-F]{0,128}$/)) return null
  if (!Array.isArray(o.shares) || o.shares.length === 0 || o.shares.length > 64) return null
  for (const s of o.shares) if (!isObj(s) || !keysAre(s, ['realpath', 'gitdir']) || !str(s.realpath) || !str(s.gitdir)) return null
  const g = o.git
  if (!isObj(g) || !keysAre(g, ['path', 'version', 'sha256', 'guard', 'apple']) || !str(g.path) || !g.path.startsWith('/')
    || !str(g.version, VERSION_RE) || !str(g.sha256, HEX64_RE) || typeof g.guard !== 'boolean' || typeof g.apple !== 'boolean') return null
  const s = o.summon
  if (!isObj(s) || !keysAre(s, ['key_sha256', 'dropin_stat']) || !str(s.key_sha256, HEX64_RE) || !str(s.dropin_stat, DROPIN_STAT_RE)) return null
  const n = o.summon_now
  if (!isObj(n) || !keysAre(n, ['key_sha256', 'dropin_stat']) || !str(n.key_sha256, HEX64_RE)
    || !(n.dropin_stat === null || str(n.dropin_stat, DROPIN_STAT_RE))) return null
  if (!(o.claude_version === null || str(o.claude_version)) || typeof o.zshenv_clean !== 'boolean') return null
  if (!str(o.clock) || Number.isNaN(Date.parse(o.clock))) return null
  return o as unknown as Hello
}

/** Every reason this hello cannot pin this prepared device; empty when it can. */
export function checkHello(h: Hello, d: DeviceFile): string[] {
  const problems: string[] = []
  if (h.device !== d.device) problems.push(`hello is from device ${h.device}, not ${d.device}`)
  if (h.user !== d.user) problems.push(`hello's user is ${h.user}; this pairing was prepared for ${d.user}`)
  if (h.build !== d.bundle_build) problems.push(`the device runs build ${h.build}, not the prepared bundle's ${d.bundle_build}: run that bundle's installer`)
  if (h.expiry !== d.key_expiry) problems.push(`the device's collab key expires ${h.expiry}, not the prepared ${d.key_expiry}: run that bundle's installer`)
  const reported = new Set(h.shares.map((s) => s.realpath))
  const prepared = new Set(d.shares.map((s) => s.remote_realpath))
  for (const p of prepared) if (!reported.has(p)) problems.push(`the prepared share ${p} is not among the shares the device reports`)
  for (const s of h.shares) {
    if (!prepared.has(s.realpath)) problems.push(`the device shares ${s.realpath}, which this pairing did not prepare`)
    else if (!gateSafe(s.gitdir)) problems.push(`the gitdir of ${s.realpath} cannot pass the gate's upload-pack form`)
  }
  if (parseSeatPublicHex(h.seat_public) === null) problems.push("hello's seat public key is not a valid ed25519 key")
  if (!gitAcceptable(h.git)) problems.push(`the device's recorded git ${h.git.path} (${h.git.version}) has no lazy-fetch guard: it needs git ≥ 2.45.1, or an Apple git ≥ 2.39.5 with the guard, then a reinstall`)
  if (!h.zshenv_clean) problems.push('~/.zshenv on the device prints when a shell starts (login_shell_noise): make it silent, then pin again')
  return problems
}

function describeFailure(f: DialFailure): string {
  return `${f.status}${f.status === 'unreachable' ? ` (${f.reason})` : ''}: ${f.detail}`
}

async function readCapped(stream: ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, max: number): Promise<{ text: string; over: boolean }> {
  const chunks: Uint8Array[] = []
  let size = 0
  for await (const chunk of stream) {
    size += chunk.byteLength
    if (size <= max) chunks.push(chunk)
  }
  return { text: Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8'), over: size > max }
}

/** `ssh -F <config> <alias> hello`, once, with a 30 s limit; an env from explicit keys only (P14). */
async function dialHello(ssh: string, home: string, config: string, alias: string): Promise<{ ok: true; line: string } | { ok: false; problem: string }> {
  let proc: ReturnType<typeof Bun.spawn>
  try {
    proc = Bun.spawn([ssh, '-F', config, alias, 'hello'], { cwd: '/', env: { HOME: home, PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin', LC_ALL: 'C' },
      stdin: 'ignore', stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'pipe' })
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, problem: `ssh could not start: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}` }
  }
  let timedOut = false
  const timer = setTimeout(() => { timedOut = true; proc.kill('SIGKILL') }, HELLO_TIMEOUT_MS)
  try {
    const [out, err] = await Promise.all([readCapped(proc.stdout as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, HELLO_MAX_BYTES),
      readCapped(proc.stderr as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>, 64 * 1024)])
    const code = await proc.exited
    if (timedOut) return { ok: false, problem: `ssh: no answer to hello within ${HELLO_TIMEOUT_MS / 1000} s` }
    if (code === 255) {
      let configText = ''
      try { configText = readFileSync(config, 'utf8') } catch { /* classified without a target */ }
      return { ok: false, problem: `ssh: ${describeFailure(classifySshFailure(err.text, { ...targetOfConfig(configText, alias), config }))}` }
    }
    const said = err.text.trim().split('\n')[0]?.replace(/[^\x20-\x7e]/g, '?').slice(0, 200) ?? ''
    if (code !== 0) return { ok: false, problem: `the device's gate refused hello (exit ${code}): ${said}` }
    const lines = out.text.split('\n').filter((l) => l !== '')
    if (out.over || lines.length !== 1) return { ok: false, problem: 'hello did not answer exactly one line (is ~/.zshenv on the device printing?)' }
    return { ok: true, line: lines[0]! }
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer)
  }
}

/**
 * Pins one prepared device. Nothing about the device is recorded unless every check passes and every mirror exists: the
 * mirrors are created, synced and locked first, and only then does the device file become `paired` (the hub dials only
 * paired devices, so no session can bind before its mirror exists, §7.1, K17). The ssh config and the known_hosts copy
 * are written before the dial, which needs them.
 */
export async function pinDevice(o: { paths: AirPaths; device: string; ssh: string; mirrorDeps: MirrorDeps; now(): Date }):
  Promise<{ ok: true; device: DeviceFile } | { ok: false; problems: string[] }> {
  const fail = (problem: string) => ({ ok: false as const, problems: [problem] })
  if (!DEVICE_RE.test(o.device)) return fail(`bad device name ${JSON.stringify(o.device)}`)
  const file = o.paths.deviceFile(o.device)
  const d = readDevice(file)
  if (d === null) return fail(`no readable device file ${file}: run prepare-pairing first`)
  if (d.state === 'unpaired') return fail(`${o.device} was unpaired; run prepare-pairing again first`)
  try {
    writeCollabSsh({ paths: o.paths, device: d.device, user: d.user, summonKnownHosts: o.paths.summonKnownHosts })
  } catch (e) {
    return fail(e instanceof Error ? e.message.replace(/^pin: /, '') : String(e))
  }
  const dial = await dialHello(o.ssh, o.paths.home, o.paths.sshConfig, d.host_alias)
  if (!dial.ok) return fail(dial.problem)
  const h = parseHello(dial.line)
  if (h === null) return fail('hello did not answer a well-formed hello line')
  const problems = checkHello(h, d)
  if (problems.length > 0) return { ok: false, problems }

  const pinned = new Map<string, { gitdir: string; mirrorId: string; workspaceId: string }>()
  for (const s of d.shares) {
    const reported = h.shares.find((x) => x.realpath === s.remote_realpath)!
    const mirrorId = mirrorIdOf(reported.realpath) // recomputed from the realpath the device reports
    const spec: MirrorSpec = { device: d.device, user: d.user, mirrorId, mirrorPath: o.paths.mirrorDir(d.device, d.user, mirrorId),
      airClone: s.air_clone, remoteGitdir: reported.gitdir, caps: s.caps }
    const m = await createMirror(spec, o.mirrorDeps)
    if (!m.ok) return fail(`the mirror of ${reported.realpath}: ${m.code}: ${m.message}`)
    const ws = await mirrorWorkspaceId(spec, o.mirrorDeps)
    if (ws === null) return fail(`the mirror of ${reported.realpath}: git could not name its repository, so its workspace id is unknown`)
    pinned.set(s.remote_realpath, { gitdir: reported.gitdir, mirrorId, workspaceId: ws })
  }
  const at = o.now().toISOString()
  let written: DeviceFile | null
  try {
    written = updateDevice(file, (cur) => {
      // Re-read under the lock: a new prepare (another build) or an unpair since the read above wins, and nothing is written.
      if (cur.state === 'unpaired' || cur.bundle_build !== d.bundle_build || cur.shares.length !== pinned.size) return null
      const shares: DeviceShare[] = []
      for (const s of cur.shares) {
        const p = pinned.get(s.remote_realpath)
        if (p === undefined) return null
        // A workspace id Collab already confirmed or corrected (Task 51) is kept; a first pin takes the derived one (P55).
        shares.push({ ...s, remote_gitdir: p.gitdir, mirror_id: p.mirrorId, workspace_id: s.workspace_id ?? p.workspaceId })
      }
      return { ...cur, state: 'paired', seat_public: h.seat_public, git: h.git,
        summon: { key_sha256: h.summon.key_sha256, dropin_stat: h.summon.dropin_stat }, shares, paired_at: at }
    })
  } catch (e) {
    return fail(`the device file could not be written: ${e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e)}`)
  }
  if (written === null) return fail('the device file changed while pinning (a new prepare or an unpair); nothing was recorded')
  return { ok: true, device: written }
}

/** What the script prints after a pin: the device, its git, and each locked mirror. */
export function pinnedText(d: DeviceFile, paths: AirPaths): string {
  const day = `${d.key_expiry.slice(0, 4)}-${d.key_expiry.slice(4, 6)}-${d.key_expiry.slice(6)}`
  return [
    `paired: ${d.device} (${d.user}), build ${d.bundle_build}, the collab key expires ${day}`,
    ...(d.git ? [`the device's git: ${d.git.path} ${d.git.version}, lazy-fetch guard ${d.git.guard ? 'yes' : 'no'}`] : []),
    ...d.shares.map((s) => `mirror ${paths.mirrorDir(d.device, d.user, s.mirror_id)} (locked) of ${s.remote_realpath}, workspace ${s.workspace_id ?? 'unknown'}`),
    '',
  ].join('\n')
}

async function pinMain(argv: string[]): Promise<number> {
  if (argv.length !== 1 || !DEVICE_RE.test(argv[0]!)) {
    process.stderr.write('usage: bun --no-env-file --config=/dev/null scripts/pin-device.ts <device>\n')
    return 2
  }
  const device = argv[0]!
  const home = homeOf()
  const paths = airPaths(home)
  const ssh = systemBin('ssh')
  const mirrorDeps = liveMirrorDeps({ paths, git: airGit({ git: systemBin('git'), home }), ssh, alias: `collab-${device}` })
  const r = await pinDevice({ paths, device, ssh, mirrorDeps, now: () => new Date() })
  if (!r.ok) {
    for (const p of r.problems) process.stderr.write(`✗ ${p}\n`)
    process.stderr.write('Nothing was recorded as paired.\n')
    return 1
  }
  process.stdout.write(pinnedText(r.device, paths))
  return 0
}

if (import.meta.main) void pinMain(process.argv.slice(2)).then((code) => process.exit(code))
```

  Also produced, each the smallest workable change (reported as interface deviations): `World` gains `pipeStates(): string[]` (the states of the live pipe records, Task 24), because a call made before the pipe's handshake finishes answers `hub_away` and the tests must wait for `ready`; `export const WORLD_USER` (this Mac's user, the only one hello and the installer accept), `WORLD_TRAILER`, `WORLD_TIME_SCALE = 0.1`, and `export async function waitFor(what: string, ok: () => boolean, ms?: number): Promise<void>`. The world's default time scale is 0.1, not the skeleton's 0.01: both pass on this Air (measured, the file runs in about 11 s either way), and 0.1 keeps every deadline (a 500 ms handshake step, a 2 s stale window, a 6 s call) well above ordinary scheduling noise for no extra time. `e2e.test.ts` removes its temp dirs in each describe's `afterAll` rather than after each test, because one world outlives the tests that share it (as Task 58's compile does).

How the world is made, in production's order (notes for the implementer):
- **Prepare** (Task 60) runs in-process with the test's own bun and the tracked Collab dist, from a clean temp git repo holding the installer template, for the user `WORLD_USER`; the program in the bundle is a bash wrapper that runs the Nuance entry from source, or the compiled binary.
- **Install**: Task 57's `runInstaller` runs the bundle's real `collab-install.sh` against the temp Nuance home with two y's, as Yu does; Nuance starts as Task 55's `summonReadyHome({ home })` leaves it: Summon's `INSTALLED` and `keys-only`, the 0600 drop-in at `testDropin(home)`, the allowlist with Y1's edit entry, Summon's key line and `~/Projects` without the trial folder, so the installer clones it from the bundle. The fake ssh then runs the installed program (`<home>/.local/share/collab-bridge/collab-bridge gate`) as sshd's forced command would, and every pipe and tap runs that same installed program.
- **Pin** (Task 61) runs in-process through the fake ssh with `liveMirrorDeps` and only `freeBytes` replaced. Then the ssh config's `HostName` becomes `127.0.0.1`: the hub's own TCP connect before each dial loop (P56) must never leave this Mac, and the fake ssh ignores the HostName.
- **The hub** is spawned from source with `testEnv(air, …)`: the fake ssh as `COLLAB_BRIDGE_BIN_SSH`, a ps stub as `COLLAB_BRIDGE_BIN_PS`, and the time scale. The stub is the real `/bin/ps` with only the hub's own parent cut to launchd (pid 1), as Task 53's `launchdPs` writes it: Task 53's start check refuses `hub run` under a harness ancestor, and this suite itself runs under Claude, while every child pid and lstart the hub reads stays real (P43). It runs as this Mac's user, so the hub's own start check (uid 502, `yuai`) passes only on the Air, which is where this plan runs. Its own mirror syncs use `liveMirrorDeps`, so the Data volume needs at least 5 GiB plus 128 MiB free (§6.6's floor); below that the claim answers `mirror_low_disk`.
- **The drop** kills the relay with SIGKILL, which leaves its socket file behind (F8, Review Focus 5), and makes every redial fail with ssh's no-route line until the test clears `fakeSsh.setFail255(null)`: the link is down for as long as the test needs one `hub_away` answer, then comes back with nobody touching the pipe (Review Focus 3).
- **The SIGKILL mid-session_start** case watches `lineages.json` for the durable `pending_start` marker (written before the forward, cleared before the answer, §9.3 item 8) and kills the hub the moment it is on disk, waits for the orphaned Collab child to exit (the hub's reconcile requires it gone), restarts the hub, and holds the invariant either way the race fell: one active remote session, answered `session_already_bound` when reconcile recorded the child's committed session, or newly made when nothing was committed.
- The marker `cdc-7f3a-e2e-marker` goes into the task title, the report body, the complete's summary and limits, and the note file; neither ledger may contain it (§12.3 step 8).
- **The held child call** (§12.2 At most once) gets its own world at time scale 0.05. That puts the pipe's default deadline at 3000 ms, below Collab's own SQLite `busy_timeout` of 5000 ms, which P33 does not scale. A `/usr/bin/sqlite3` process holds the shared journal's write lock (`BEGIN IMMEDIATE`). It releases the lock 4000 ms after the hub's `call` line, so Collab's write gets through inside its 5 s wait and the child answers `ok` after the pipe has already answered `hub_outcome_unknown`. The anchor is the `call` line, written when the hub takes the call. `forward` and `result` are written only once the child answers (Task 51's `settle`). Measured on this Air in a scratch assembly of the plan: anchored on `forward`, the test first sees the line at 5015 ms, with result `error` / `internal_error` at 5005 ms. A lock held longer than 5 s, or a deadline above 5 s (the world's own 0.1 gives 6000 ms), gets Collab's own `internal_error` ("database is locked"), passed through as `error`. That is correct per §9.3 item 4: it is an answer the child gave. So only a deadline below 5 s can catch a real child mid-call. If session_start's 3000 ms deadline turns out too short on this Air, use 0.07 (a 4200 ms deadline) with the release at 4600 ms. The "no notifications/cancelled reaches the child" assertion stays in Task 37, where the fake bin records methods; the real dist child records nothing, so here the checks are that the hub ledger has no `cancel` line for the call and exactly one `result`, `ok`.

```ts
      `remote self-declared: none known ${MARK}`)
  }, 60_000)

  test('the Air session reviews the diff of the tasks ref and accepts; the accepted head is the Nuance commit', async () => {
    const ref = `refs/collab/nuance/${WORLD_USER}/${mirrorIdOf(w.nuanceShare)}/tasks/${TASK}`
    const diff = repoGit(w.airClone, ['diff', '--no-ext-diff', '--no-textconv', base, ref])
    expect(diff).toContain('+++ b/notes/a.md')
    expect(diff).toContain(`+a note from the Nuance seat ${MARK}`)
    const got = await air.callTool('collab_task_get', { workspace_id: workspaceId, task_id: TASK })
    const rv = await air.callTool('collab_task_review', { workspace_id: workspaceId, task_id: TASK, idempotency_key: 'e2e-review',
      expected_version: got.structuredContent.task.version, outcome: 'accept', summary: 'read the diff of the tasks ref' })
    expect(rv.isError).toBeUndefined()
    expect(rv.structuredContent.task).toMatchObject({ review_status: 'accepted', accepted_by_session_id: airSessionId })
    expect(rv.structuredContent.task.result_checkpoint.head_sha).toBe(head)
  }, 60_000)

  test('a dropped link answers hub_away, heals on its own, and the next call succeeds on the same session', async () => {
    const attaches = () => w.hubLedger().filter((e) => e.event === 'attach').length
    const before = attaches()
    await w.dropLink()
    const t0 = Date.now()
    const away = await nuance.callTool('collab_next', {})
    expect(Date.now() - t0).toBeLessThan(1_000)
    expect(away.structuredContent).toMatchObject({ error: 'hub_away', delivered: false })
    w.fakeSsh.setFail255(null) // the Wi-Fi is back: nobody touches the pipe
    await waitFor('the hub to redial and the pipe to re-attach on its own', () => attaches() > before && pipeReady(w), 30_000)
    const next = await nuance.callTool('collab_next', {})
    expect(next.isError).toBeUndefined()
    expect(next.structuredContent.session.id).toBe(sessionId)
    const last = w.hubLedger().filter((e) => e.event === 'forward' && e.tool === 'collab_next').at(-1)
    expect(last?.session_id).toBe(sessionId)
  }, 60_000)

  test('the checks of §12.3 step 8 hold', async () => {
    const v = await air.callTool('collab_journal_verify', { workspace_id: workspaceId })
    expect(v.structuredContent.chain_valid).toBe(true)
    const ledger = w.hubLedger()
    const forwards = ledger.filter((e) => e.event === 'forward')
    const perRef = new Map<string, number>()
    for (const f of forwards) perRef.set(String(f.call_ref), (perRef.get(String(f.call_ref)) ?? 0) + 1)
    expect([...perRef.values()].filter((n) => n !== 1)).toEqual([])
    expect(new Set(forwards.map((f) => f.journal))).toEqual(new Set([airPaths(w.air).sharedJournal]))
    // Each ok remote mutation has its event in the shared journal, and the remote seat wrote no other kind of event.
    const ok = (tool: string) => forwards.filter((f) => f.tool === tool
      && ledger.some((e) => e.event === 'result' && e.call_ref === f.call_ref && e.outcome === 'ok')).length
    const events = (await air.callTool('collab_events_since', { workspace_id: workspaceId, limit: 500 })).structuredContent.events
    const remote = events.filter((e: { actor: unknown }) => typeof e.actor === 'string' && e.actor.startsWith(`${SEAT} · `))
    const count = (type: string) => remote.filter((e: { type: string }) => e.type === type).length
    expect([count('session.joined'), count('task.claimed'), count('task.reported_complete')])
      .toEqual([ok('collab_session_start'), ok('collab_task_claim'), ok('collab_task_complete')])
    expect([ok('collab_session_start'), ok('collab_task_claim'), ok('collab_task_complete')]).toEqual([1, 1, 1])
    // The Nuance session started before any Air session, so its mirror opened the shared workspace (§6.3, T23).
    expect(new Set(remote.map((e: { type: string }) => e.type)))
      .toEqual(new Set(['workspace.opened', 'session.joined', 'task.claimed', 'report.posted', 'task.reported_complete']))
    // Both ledgers are content-free: the marker in the title, the report body and the note file is in neither.
    const np = nuancePaths(w.nuance, { HOME: w.nuance, COLLAB_BRIDGE_HOME_OVERRIDE: w.nuance, COLLAB_BRIDGE_SOCK_ROOT: w.sockRoot,
      COLLAB_BRIDGE_SUMMON_DROPIN: testDropin(w.nuance) })
    expect(w.nuanceLedger().length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
    for (const file of [airPaths(w.air).ledger, np.ledger]) expect({ file, marked: readFileSync(file, 'utf8').includes(MARK) }).toEqual({ file, marked: false })
    expect(existsSync(airPaths(w.air).privateJournal)).toBe(false)
  }, 60_000)
})

describe('a hub SIGKILLed mid-session_start (§12.2 At most once, §9.3 item 8)', () => {
  let w: World
  afterAll(async () => {
    await w?.close()
    cleanupTmps()
  }, 60_000)

  test('a hub SIGKILLed mid-session_start leaves exactly one active session after restart', async () => {
    w = await makeWorld()
    await w.startHub()
    const p = w.pipe()
    await p.initialize()
    await waitFor('the pipe to attach', () => pipeReady(w))
    const store = () => { const s = new LineageStore(airPaths(w.air).lineages); s.load(); return s.all() }
    const first = p.callTool('collab_session_start', { actor: 'first try' })
    // The durable pending_start marker is written before the forward and cleared before the answer (§9.3 item 8): kill
    // the hub the moment it is on disk.
    let marker: { child_pid: number } | null = null
    await waitFor('the pending_start marker', () => {
      marker = existsSync(airPaths(w.air).lineages) ? store().find((e) => e.pending_start !== null)?.pending_start ?? null : null
      return marker !== null
    }, 30_000)
    await w.killHub('SIGKILL')
    expect((await first).structuredContent).toMatchObject({ error: 'hub_outcome_unknown', delivered: 'unknown' })
    const child = (marker as { child_pid: number } | null)!.child_pid
    await waitFor('the orphaned Collab child to exit', () => !pidAlive(child), 30_000)
    await w.startHub()
    await waitFor('the pipe to re-attach', () => pipeReady(w))
    const second = await p.callTool('collab_session_start', { actor: 'second try' })
    // Either reconcile recorded the session the child committed (Collab answers session_already_bound from the resumed
    // child), or nothing was committed and this start made the one session.
    expect([undefined, 'session_already_bound']).toContain(second.structuredContent?.error)
    expect((await p.callTool('collab_next', {})).isError).toBeUndefined()
    const ws = readDevice(airPaths(w.air).deviceFile('nuance'))!.shares[0]!.workspace_id!
    const air = w.airSession()
    await air.initialize()
    await air.callTool('collab_session_start', { root_path: w.airClone, actor: 'air checker' })
    const st = await air.callTool('collab_workspace_status', { workspace_id: ws })
    const remote = st.structuredContent.active_sessions.filter((s: { role: string | null }) => (s.role ?? '').startsWith(`remote(${SEAT};`))
    expect(remote).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(store().filter((e) => e.pending_start !== null)).toEqual([])
  }, 180_000)
})

describe('the compiled Nuance binary', () => {
  let buildRoot = ''
  let built: NuanceBuild
  let w: World

  beforeAll(() => {
    buildRoot = realpathSync(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'cb-e2e-build-')))
    built = buildNuance(join(buildRoot, 'out'))
  }, 120_000)

  afterAll(async () => {
    await w?.close()
    cleanupTmps()
    if (buildRoot) rmSync(buildRoot, { recursive: true, force: true })
  }, 60_000)

  test('the same flow from session start to a knock and a fetch works through the compiled Nuance binary', async () => {
    w = await makeWorld({ compiled: built })
    const installed = nuancePaths(w.nuance, { HOME: w.nuance, COLLAB_BRIDGE_HOME_OVERRIDE: w.nuance, COLLAB_BRIDGE_SOCK_ROOT: w.sockRoot,
      COLLAB_BRIDGE_SUMMON_DROPIN: testDropin(w.nuance) }).binary
    expect(sha256File(installed)).toBe(built.sha256) // the installer put the compiled binary in place, byte for byte
    await w.startHub()
    const p = w.pipe()
    await p.initialize()
    await waitFor('the pipe to attach', () => pipeReady(w))
    const s = await p.callTool('collab_session_start', { actor: 'compiled seat' })
    expect(s.isError).toBeUndefined()
    expect(s.structuredContent.session.actor).toBe(`${SEAT} · self-declared: compiled seat`)
    const ws = s.structuredContent.workspace.id
    const air = w.airSession()
    await air.initialize()
    await air.callTool('collab_session_start', { root_path: w.airClone, actor: 'air reviewer' })
    const t = await air.callTool('collab_task_create', { workspace_id: ws, idempotency_key: 'c-create', task_id: TASK, title: 'a compiled note',
      work_mode: 'edit', path_scopes: ['notes'], completion_policy: 'accepted', expected_base_sha: repoGit(w.airClone, ['rev-parse', 'HEAD']) })
    await air.callTool('collab_report_append', { workspace_id: ws, idempotency_key: 'c-note', kind: 'proposal', body: 'please take it',
      to_session_id: s.structuredContent.session.id })
    const line = await w.tap()
    expect(line === null ? null : JSON.parse(line).hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext).toBe(KNOCK_LINE)
    const fetchesBefore = w.hubLedger().filter((e) => e.event === 'fetch' && e.outcome === 'ok').length
    const c = await p.callTool('collab_task_claim', { task_id: TASK, idempotency_key: 'c-claim', expected_version: t.structuredContent.task.version })
    expect(c.isError).toBeUndefined()
    expect(w.hubLedger().filter((e) => e.event === 'fetch' && e.outcome === 'ok').length).toBe(fetchesBefore + 1)
    expect(w.nuanceLedger().filter((e) => e.event === 'gate').map((e) => e.form)).toContain('upload-pack')
  }, 180_000)
})

describe('a real child call held past the pipe deadline (§12.2 At most once)', () => {
  // At 0.05 the pipe's default deadline is 3000 ms, below Collab's own busy_timeout of 5000 ms, which P33 does not scale.
  // At the world's 0.1 the deadline is 6000 ms, and Collab answers its own internal_error "database is locked" first
  // (measured: 5004 ms), which the hub passes through as error, rightly (§9.3 item 4). If session_start's 3000 ms is too
  // short on this Air, 0.07 with a release at 4600 ms is the fallback (a 4200 ms deadline, still inside the 5 s wait).
  const SCALE = 0.05
  const RELEASE_MS = 4_000
  let w: World
  let lock: ReturnType<typeof Bun.spawn> | null = null

  afterAll(async () => {
    if (lock !== null && lock.exitCode === null) { lock.kill('SIGKILL'); await lock.exited }
    await w?.close()
    cleanupTmps()
  }, 60_000)

  test('a held journal write lock answers hub_outcome_unknown at the pipe deadline, never error; the late result is ledgered, never cancelled, and the next call carries prior_unknown', async () => {
    w = await makeWorld({ timeScale: SCALE })
    await w.startHub()
    const p = w.pipe()
    await p.initialize()
    await waitFor('the pipe to attach', () => pipeReady(w))
    const s = await p.callTool('collab_session_start', { actor: 'held lock' })
    expect(s.isError).toBeUndefined()
    const ws = s.structuredContent.workspace.id
    // Another process holds the shared journal's write lock, as a long write on the Air would.
    const l = Bun.spawn(['/usr/bin/sqlite3', airPaths(w.air).sharedJournal], { cwd: '/', stdin: 'pipe', stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'pipe', env: { PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin' } })
    lock = l
    l.stdin.write("BEGIN IMMEDIATE;\nSELECT 'locked';\n")
    l.stdin.flush()
    const first = await (l.stdout as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>).getReader().read()
    expect(new TextDecoder().decode(first.value)).toContain('locked')
    const t0 = Date.now()
    const pending = p.callTool('collab_report_append', { workspace_id: ws, idempotency_key: 'held-1', kind: 'observation', body: 'held lock note' })
    // The hub writes its `call` line when the call arrives; `forward` and `result` only once the child answers (Task 51).
    const took = () => w.hubLedger().find((e) => e.event === 'call' && e.tool === 'collab_report_append')
    await waitFor('the hub to take the call', () => took() !== undefined)
    const tookAt = Date.now()
    const ref = String(took()!.call_ref)
    const r = await pending
    expect(Date.now() - t0).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(2_700)
    expect(r.isError).toBe(true)
    expect(r.structuredContent).toMatchObject({ error: 'hub_outcome_unknown', delivered: 'unknown', retry: 'never automatic' })
    // The child is still in Collab's busy wait: the hub has neither forwarded nor settled this call yet.
    expect(w.hubLedger().filter((e) => e.call_ref === ref && (e.event === 'forward' || e.event === 'result'))).toEqual([])
    await Bun.sleep(Math.max(0, tookAt + RELEASE_MS - Date.now()))
    l.stdin.write('ROLLBACK;\n.quit\n')
    l.stdin.end()
    await l.exited
    await waitFor('the late result', () => w.nuanceLedger().some((e) => e.event === 'late_result' && e.call_ref === ref), 10_000)
    expect(w.nuanceLedger().find((e) => e.event === 'late_result' && e.call_ref === ref)?.outcome).toBe('ok')
    expect(w.nuanceLedger().find((e) => e.event === 'call_unknown' && e.call_ref === ref)?.code).toBe('deadline')
    const mine = w.hubLedger().filter((e) => e.call_ref === ref)
    expect(mine.filter((e) => e.event === 'forward')).toHaveLength(1)
    expect(mine.filter((e) => e.event === 'result').map((e) => e.outcome)).toEqual(['ok']) // the child answered: never cancelled
    expect(mine.some((e) => e.event === 'cancel')).toBe(false) // the pipe's deadline sends no cancel either
    const next = await p.callTool('collab_next', {})
    expect(next.isError).toBeUndefined()
    // The same Collab session is still bound, so the note may advise a same-key replay (session_ended false, P66).
    expect(next.structuredContent.prior_unknown).toEqual([{ call_ref: ref, tool: 'collab_report_append', idempotency_key: 'held-1', session_ended: false }])
    const air = w.airSession()
    await air.initialize()
    await air.callTool('collab_session_start', { root_path: w.airClone, actor: 'air checker' })
    const reports = (await air.callTool('collab_report_list', { workspace_id: ws })).structuredContent.reports
    expect(reports.filter((x: { body: string }) => x.body.includes('held lock note'))).toHaveLength(1) // it took effect once
  }, 120_000)
})
```

`/Users/yuai/Projects/.worktrees/agenttool-collab-bridge/packages/collab-bridge/tests/world.ts`:

```ts
// One whole Phase 1 world on this Mac (spec §12.1, §12.3 in miniature): a temp "Air" home and a temp "Nuance" home, the
// bundle prepare-pairing makes, the real bash installer and its verbs at "Nuance", pin-device through the fake ssh (so
// the mirror exists), and a hub spawned from source exactly as `collab-bridge hub run` runs. Nothing here touches this
// Mac's ~/.ssh, launchd, the network or either real journal: ssh is the fake (Task 11), the hub's own TCP probe goes to
// 127.0.0.1, and every path is under a temp root. A shared fixture lives here, never in a *.test.ts (Summon ruling R1).
import { chmodSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'
import { basename, dirname, join } from 'node:path'
import { readDeviceStatus, readHubStatus } from '../src/air/status.ts'
import { airGit } from '../src/air/git.ts'
import { liveMirrorDeps } from '../src/air/mirror.ts'
import { readLedger, type LedgerEntry } from '../src/ledger.ts'
import { writeFileDurable } from '../src/native.ts'
import { readPipeRecords } from '../src/nuance/pipe-record.ts'
import { readRelayStatus } from '../src/nuance/relay.ts'
import { airPaths, nuancePaths, type AirPaths, type NuancePaths } from '../src/paths.ts'
import { pidAlive } from '../src/proc.ts'
import type { NuanceBuild } from '../scripts/build-nuance.ts'
import { pinDevice } from '../scripts/pin-device.ts'
import { prepareBundle } from '../scripts/prepare-pairing.ts'
import { makeFakeSsh, type FakeSsh } from './fake-ssh.ts'
import { COLLAB_DIST, makeRepo, PKG, REAL_GIT, REAL_HOME, repoGit, sha256File, shortSockRoot, temp, testDropin, testEnv } from './helpers.ts'
import { runInstaller, summonReadyHome } from './install-fixtures.ts'
import { collabHarness, stdioHarness, type StdioHarness } from './mcp-harness.ts'

export interface World { air: string; nuance: string; airClone: string; nuanceShare: string; sockRoot: string; fakeSsh: FakeSsh;
  startHub(): Promise<void>; killHub(signal?: 'SIGKILL' | 'SIGTERM'): Promise<void>; pipe(): StdioHarness; tap(): Promise<string | null>;
  airSession(): StdioHarness; commitOnNuance(files: Record<string, string>, message: string): string; dropLink(): Promise<void>;
  hubLedger(): LedgerEntry[]; nuanceLedger(): LedgerEntry[]; close(): Promise<void>
  pipeStates(): string[] }

/** hello's user is getpwuid's name (F3) and the installer refuses a bundle prepared for another user: this Mac's. */
export const WORLD_USER = basename(REAL_HOME)
export const WORLD_TRAILER = 'Co-Authored-By: The Fable of the Eternal Universe <Yu@Ai-love.cc>'
/** At 0.01 a session_start's 600 ms deadline is shorter than one Collab child's start, so the world runs at 0.1 (P33). */
export const WORLD_TIME_SCALE = 0.1
const SUMMON_PIN = 'summon-nuance ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIWorldHostKeyForTheCollabBridgeEndToEndTest'
/** The trial repo's commit gets a test identity: the temp Air home has no ~/.gitconfig. */
const GIT_ENV = { GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: '1', GIT_AUTHOR_NAME: 'Collab World', GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL: 'world@collab-bridge.invalid',
  GIT_COMMITTER_NAME: 'Collab World', GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL: 'world@collab-bridge.invalid' }

/** Polls `ok` every 20 ms; throws naming `what` after `ms`. */
export async function waitFor(what: string, ok: () => boolean, ms = 20_000): Promise<void> {
  const end = Date.now() + ms
  while (!ok()) {
    if (Date.now() > end) throw new Error(`world: timed out after ${ms} ms waiting for ${what}`)
    await Bun.sleep(20)
  }
}

/**
 * The hub's ps: the real /bin/ps with only the caller's parent shown as launchd (pid 1), the body of Task 53's launchdPs.
 * The hub's start check (Task 53) refuses a harness ancestor, and this suite runs under Claude; every pid and lstart the
 * hub reads for its children stays real (P43).
 */
function launchdPs(dir: string): string {
  const p = join(dir, 'ps')
  writeFileSync(p, ['#!/bin/bash', 'set -o pipefail', `LC_ALL=C /bin/ps "$@" | /usr/bin/awk -v me="$PPID" '$1 == me { $2 = 1 } { print }'`, ''].join('\n'))
  chmodSync(p, 0o755)
  return p
}

/** A clean git repo standing in for the bridge worktree: prepare reads the installer template from it and needs it clean. */
function bridgeRepo(): string {
  const repo = temp('cb-world-repo-')
  makeRepo(repo, { 'packages/collab-bridge/nuance/install.sh.tmpl': readFileSync(join(PKG, 'nuance', 'install.sh.tmpl'), 'utf8') })
  return repo
}

/** The bundle's program in source mode: the Nuance entry from source, as the installed binary would run (Task 57's shape). */
function sourceBuild(): NuanceBuild {
  const binary = join(temp('cb-world-build-'), 'collab-bridge')
  writeFileSync(binary, `#!/bin/bash\nexec '${process.execPath}' --no-env-file --config=/dev/null '${PKG}/src/nuance/main.ts' "$@"\n`, { mode: 0o755 })
  const sha256 = sha256File(binary)
  return { binary, sha256, build: sha256.slice(0, 8) }
}

export async function makeWorld(o: { compiled?: NuanceBuild; timeScale?: number } = {}): Promise<World> {
  const scale = String(o.timeScale ?? WORLD_TIME_SCALE)
  const air = temp('cb-world-air-')
  const nuance = temp('cb-world-nuance-')
  const sockRoot = shortSockRoot()
  const ap: AirPaths = airPaths(air)
  const airClone = join(air, 'Projects', 'collab-trial')
  const nuanceShare = join(nuance, 'Projects', 'collab-trial')
  // One socket root for the relay, the pipes and the taps; the time scale for every link deadline (P33).
  const nuanceEnv = testEnv(nuance, { COLLAB_BRIDGE_SOCK_ROOT: sockRoot, COLLAB_BRIDGE_TEST_TIME_SCALE: scale })
  const np: NuancePaths = nuancePaths(nuance, nuanceEnv)

  mkdirSync(join(air, '.ssh', 'summon'), { recursive: true, mode: 0o700 })
  writeFileSync(ap.summonKnownHosts, `${SUMMON_PIN}\n`, { mode: 0o600 })
  summonReadyHome({ home: nuance }) // Task 55: Summon installed and live, Y1's allowlist, ~/Projects without the trial folder

  // §10.2 step 1 (Task 60): the trial repo, the collab key, the bundle and the device file, prepared.
  const prepared = await prepareBundle({ home: air, repo: bridgeRepo(), device: 'nuance', user: WORLD_USER,
    shares: [{ remote: nuanceShare, airClone }], trailer: WORLD_TRAILER, collabDist: COLLAB_DIST, bun: process.execPath, git: REAL_GIT,
    build: o.compiled ? () => o.compiled! : sourceBuild, gitEnv: GIT_ENV })
  // §10.3 (Task 57): the real installer and its verbs at "Nuance", two y's; it clones the trial folder from the bundle.
  const inst = runInstaller(prepared.bundle, nuance, { answers: 'y\ny\n', extraEnv: { COLLAB_BRIDGE_SOCK_ROOT: sockRoot } })
  if (inst.code !== 0 || !/(^|\n)Done\b/.test(inst.stdout)) throw new Error(`world: the installer stopped (${inst.code}):\n${inst.stdout}\n${inst.stderr}`)
  // sshd's forced command runs the installed program: the wrapper (source) or the compiled binary.
  const fakeSsh = makeFakeSsh({ nuanceHome: nuance, target: [np.binary, 'gate'], env: nuanceEnv })
  // §10.2 step 2 (Task 61): hello through the fake ssh; the mirror is created, synced and locked here.
  const pinned = await pinDevice({ paths: ap, device: 'nuance', ssh: fakeSsh.bin, now: () => new Date(),
    mirrorDeps: { ...liveMirrorDeps({ paths: ap, git: airGit({ git: REAL_GIT, home: air }), ssh: fakeSsh.bin, alias: 'collab-nuance' }), freeBytes: () => 1e15 } })
  if (!pinned.ok) throw new Error(`world: pin-device refused: ${pinned.problems.join('; ')}`)
  // The hub's own TCP connect before each dial loop (P56) must stay on this Mac: only HostName changes; the fake ssh
  // ignores it, and the dial is still `ssh -F <config> collab-nuance relay 1 <nonce>`.
  writeFileDurable(ap.sshConfig, readFileSync(ap.sshConfig, 'utf8').replace('  HostName nuance.local\n', '  HostName 127.0.0.1\n'), 0o600)

  // The hub: from source, as `collab-bridge hub run`, the fake ssh as its ssh, the real ps for its pid checks with its
  // parent shown as launchd, so its start check passes under a harness (Task 53, P43).
  const hubEnv = testEnv(air, { COLLAB_BRIDGE_BIN_SSH: fakeSsh.bin, COLLAB_BRIDGE_BIN_PS: launchdPs(temp('cb-world-ps-')), COLLAB_BRIDGE_TEST_TIME_SCALE: scale })
  let hub: ReturnType<typeof Bun.spawn> | null = null
  let hubErr = ''
  const harnesses: StdioHarness[] = []
  const nuanceArgv = (verb: string[]) => [np.binary, ...verb]

  const killHub = async (signal: 'SIGKILL' | 'SIGTERM' = 'SIGTERM') => {
    if (hub === null) return
    const h = hub
    hub = null
    const relay = readRelayStatus(np)
    h.kill(signal)
    const gone = await Promise.race([h.exited.then(() => true), Bun.sleep(20_000).then(() => false)])
    if (!gone) { h.kill('SIGKILL'); await h.exited }
    // The relay's stdin is the hub's ssh: it exits on EOF, and a SIGKILL of the hub reaches it that way.
    if (relay && pidAlive(relay.pid)) await waitFor('the old relay to exit', () => !pidAlive(relay.pid), 10_000)
  }

  return {
    air, nuance, airClone, nuanceShare, sockRoot, fakeSsh,

    async startHub() {
      if (hub !== null) throw new Error('world: the hub is already running')
      const before = readRelayStatus(np)?.pid ?? null
      const h = Bun.spawn([process.execPath, '--no-env-file', '--config=/dev/null', join(PKG, 'bin', 'collab-bridge.ts'), 'hub', 'run'],
        { cwd: '/', env: hubEnv, stdin: 'ignore', stdout: 'ignore', stderr: 'pipe' })
      hub = h
      void (async () => { for await (const c of h.stderr as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>) hubErr += new TextDecoder().decode(c) })()
      try {
        await waitFor('the hub to bring nuance up', () => {
          if (h.exitCode !== null) throw new Error(`the hub exited ${h.exitCode}`)
          const r = readRelayStatus(np)
          return readDeviceStatus(ap, 'nuance')?.word === 'up' && r !== null && r.pid !== before && pidAlive(r.pid)
        }, 30_000)
      } catch (e) {
        throw new Error(`world: ${(e as Error).message}\nhub status: ${JSON.stringify(readHubStatus(ap))}\nhub stderr:\n${hubErr.slice(-4000)}`)
      }
    },

    killHub,

    pipe() {
      // Claude starts the pipe in the shared folder; the preload's ps stub (P43) gives it the claude host 4100 and a tty.
      const h = stdioHarness({ argv: nuanceArgv(['pipe']), env: { ...nuanceEnv, CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT: 'cli' }, cwd: nuanceShare })
      harnesses.push(h)
      return h
    },

    async tap() {
      const p = Bun.spawn(nuanceArgv(['tap', '--host', 'claude']), { cwd: nuanceShare, env: nuanceEnv, stdout: 'pipe', stderr: 'ignore',
        stdin: new Blob([JSON.stringify({ hook_event_name: 'UserPromptSubmit', prompt: 'the next prompt' })]) })
      const [out, code] = await Promise.all([new Response(p.stdout as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>).text(), p.exited])
      if (code !== 0) throw new Error(`world: the tap exited ${code}`)
      const line = out.trim()
      return line === '' ? null : line
    },

    airSession() {
      // An Air session in the trial folder: the shared journal, the hub's way (§10.2 step 4); the caller starts it.
      const h = collabHarness({ journal: ap.sharedJournal, home: air })
      harnesses.push(h)
      return h
    },

    commitOnNuance(files, message) {
      // As the Nuance agent commits: only its own files, never `add -A`.
      for (const [rel, text] of Object.entries(files)) {
        mkdirSync(dirname(join(nuanceShare, rel)), { recursive: true })
        writeFileSync(join(nuanceShare, rel), text)
      }
      repoGit(nuanceShare, ['add', '--', ...Object.keys(files)])
      repoGit(nuanceShare, ['-c', 'user.name=Nuance Seat', '-c', 'user.email=seat@collab-bridge.invalid', 'commit', '-q', '-m', message])
      return repoGit(nuanceShare, ['rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
    },

    async dropLink() {
      // The Air's Wi-Fi goes off: the relay dies with its socket left behind (F8), and every redial fails until the
      // caller clears fakeSsh.setFail255 again. Resolves once the pipe has seen the link go.
      const relay = readRelayStatus(np)
      if (relay === null || !pidAlive(relay.pid)) throw new Error('world: no relay to drop')
      fakeSsh.setFail255('ssh: connect to host 127.0.0.1 port 22: No route to host\r\n')
      process.kill(relay.pid, 'SIGKILL')
      await waitFor('the relay to die', () => !pidAlive(relay.pid), 10_000)
      await waitFor('the pipe to see the link go', () => readPipeRecords(np).every((r) => r.state !== 'ready'), 10_000)
    },

    pipeStates: () => readPipeRecords(np).map((r) => r.state),
    hubLedger: () => (existsSync(ap.ledger) ? readLedger(ap.ledger) : []),
    nuanceLedger: () => (existsSync(np.ledger) ? readLedger(np.ledger) : []),

    async close() {
      for (const h of harnesses.splice(0)) await h.close().catch(() => null)
      await killHub('SIGTERM')
      const relay = readRelayStatus(np)
      if (relay && pidAlive(relay.pid)) {
        process.kill(relay.pid, 'SIGKILL')
        await waitFor('the relay to exit', () => !pidAlive(relay.pid), 10_000)
      }
    },
  }
}
```

### Task 63: Adversarial review gate

**Kind:** [controller] · **Group:** 22 · **Spec:** §10.1 ("an adversarial review of the gate, relay, pipe, installer and launcher passed, as Summon did before Nuance"); P9, P63; Summon plan Task 12 (the model).

Nothing is installed on Nuance before this task ends with no open finding. A Workflow runs six lenses over the bridge package and the C10 diff, then one skeptic per finding tries to refute it. Every confirmed or uncertain finding is then folded: an implementer subagent writes the failing test first and fixes it, or the controller declines it with a one-line reason in the ledger (P63: safety, then Yu's words, then the spec, then the plan; nothing is queued for Yu). A second run of the same Workflow, in fold-check mode, reviews the fix commits themselves, until a round finds nothing new. Then both suites run whole, the compiled cases included, and the ledger records `REVIEWED_HEAD`, the only commit Task 65 ships.

Run each code block as one Bash call (shell variables do not carry between calls, so each block sets its own). Blocks that run the bridge suite or the seam ci need a 600000 ms timeout. The review's own files live outside every repo, in `/Users/yuai/.cache/agenttool/collab-bridge-review/` (0700). The only tooling is the Workflow script and `queue.sh`, one jq call that prints the open queue. What was done with each finding lives only in the ledger, as `Task 63: fold …` and `Task 63: added …` lines, and the ledger is the gate's record. Nothing tests the script before the run. If it turns out wrong after agents have answered, edit it and call the Workflow again with `resumeFromRunId`; the cached results of the agents that answered make that cheap.

The round of a ledger line is the number of `fold-check-<n>.json` files that exist when the line is written: `0` before the first fold check. The ledger lines, one per event, the newest per id being its state:
- `Task 63: fold <id> round <n> fixed <40 hex> test <tests/x.test.ts> :: <test name>`
- `Task 63: fold <id> round <n> declined: <reason>`
- `Task 63: fold <id> round <n> reopened by fold check <n>` (one per `not_closed` id, right after fold check `<n>` is saved)
- `Task 63: added V<k> <severity> <file>:<line> — <title> — <x-line>` (a defect found at visit (b), Task 65 Step 4)

Resuming after an interruption: if `/Users/yuai/.cache/agenttool/collab-bridge-review/review.json` exists, Steps 1–4 are done. `/bin/sh /Users/yuai/.cache/agenttool/collab-bridge-review/queue.sh` names what is still open, and the `fold-check-<n>.json` files name the fold checks already run. Resume at Step 5. If the stop came after 5b dispatched an implementer for the id in `current` and before 5c wrote its `fold` line, first compare its worktree's `git log -1 --format='%H %s'` with the `Commit subject:` line of `prompt-<id>.txt`: when they match, carry on from 5c with that commit. A finding is never dispatched twice blind (P10).

**Files:**
- Create (outside the repo, 0700 dir, 0600 files): `/Users/yuai/.cache/agenttool/collab-bridge-review/review-gate.workflow.js` and `queue.sh`; the run records `args-review.json`, `review.json`, `args-fold-check-<n>.json`, `fold-check-<n>.json`, `current`, `finding-<id>.json`, `prompt-<id>.txt`, `report-<id>.txt`, `suite-after-<id>.log`, `suite.log`, `suite-junit.xml`, `seam-ci.log`
- Modify: whatever confirmed findings touch, each fix with its failing test first, committed by an implementer in `/Users/yuai/Projects/.worktrees/agenttool-collab-bridge` (`fix(collab-bridge): …`) or, for C10, in `/Users/yuai/Projects/.worktrees/agenttool-collab-seam` (`fix(collab): …`) and then cherry-picked onto the bridge branch
- Ledger: `/Users/yuai/Projects/.worktrees/agenttool-cross-device-collab/.superpowers/sdd/2026-10-13-cross-device-collab-phase1/progress.md`: the `fold` and `added` lines above, a superseding C10 host line after each C10 fix, and Step 8's `open findings`, `refuted`, `suites` and `REVIEWED_HEAD` lines


The Workflow runtime wraps the script body in an async function with the hooks `agent`, `parallel`, `pipeline`, `phase`, `log` and `args`.

`/Users/yuai/.cache/agenttool/collab-bridge-review/review-gate.workflow.js`:

```js
export const meta = {
  name: 'collab-bridge-review-gate',
  description: 'Task 63: adversarial review of collab-bridge and C10 before anything is installed on Nuance',
  whenToUse: 'Cross-device Collab Phase 1, Task 63 only: mode review once, then mode fold-check after each round of fixes',
  phases: [
    { title: 'Find', detail: 'six lenses read the code (review), or one checker per fix (fold-check)' },
    { title: 'Verify', detail: 'one skeptic per finding tries to refute it' },
  ],
}

const A = args
if (!A || (A.mode !== 'review' && A.mode !== 'fold-check')) throw new Error('args.mode must be review or fold-check')
const HEX40 = /^[0-9a-f]{40}$/
if (A.mode === 'review') {
  if (![A.c10, A.bridgeHead, A.seamHead].every((s) => HEX40.test(String(s)))) throw new Error('args.c10, args.bridgeHead and args.seamHead must be 40 hex')
  if (!Array.isArray(A.files) || A.files.length === 0) throw new Error('args.files must list the bridge package')
  if (!Array.isArray(A.seamFiles)) throw new Error('args.seamFiles must be a list')
} else {
  if (!Number.isInteger(A.round) || A.round < 1) throw new Error('args.round must be a positive integer')
  if (!Array.isArray(A.fixes) || A.fixes.length === 0) throw new Error('args.fixes is empty: nothing to check')
}

const SEVERITIES = ['blocker', 'major', 'minor']
const RANK = { blocker: 0, major: 1, minor: 2 }
const FINDING = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    title: { type: 'string', maxLength: 60, description: 'a short label, used as a commit subject' },
    severity: { type: 'string', enum: SEVERITIES },
    file: { type: 'string', description: 'repo-relative path, e.g. packages/collab-bridge/src/nuance/gate.ts' },
    line: { type: 'integer', minimum: 1 },
    claim: { type: 'string', description: 'one sentence: what is wrong' },
    failure_scenario: { type: 'string', description: 'concrete input or state, then the wrong outcome' },
    evidence: { type: 'string', description: 'what you saw: file:line references, or a probe and its output' },
    spec_ref: { type: 'string', description: 'the spec section, Global Constraint or ruling it breaks' },
    test_idea: { type: 'string', description: 'the test file and what a failing test would assert' },
  },
  required: ['title', 'severity', 'file', 'line', 'claim', 'failure_scenario', 'evidence', 'spec_ref', 'test_idea'],
}
const FINDINGS = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: { findings: { type: 'array', items: FINDING }, read: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } } },
  required: ['findings', 'read'],
}
const VERDICT = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: {
    verdict: { type: 'string', enum: ['confirmed', 'refuted', 'uncertain'] },
    severity: { type: 'string', enum: SEVERITIES },
    reason: { type: 'string' },
    reproduction: { type: 'string' },
  },
  required: ['verdict', 'severity', 'reason', 'reproduction'],
}
const CHECK = {
  type: 'object',
  properties: { closed: { type: 'boolean' }, reason: { type: 'string' }, new_findings: { type: 'array', items: FINDING } },
  required: ['closed', 'reason', 'new_findings'],
}

const SEVERITY_SCALE = [
  'Severity scale:',
  '- blocker: breaks a standing safety rule (plan ruling P10, spec §11), lets a remote seat reach past the §6.3 policy or out of the shared journal, lets remote code run on the Air (R39), exposes a secret, or makes the §12.3 live test impossible to pass.',
  '- major: a spec rule, Global Constraint, §9.2 code or status word, or §12.2 line that the code does not enforce or gets wrong in a way a person or an agent would hit.',
  '- minor: any other real defect (a wrong message, an unreachable wrong mode bit, a comment or README line that would mislead an operator).',
  'Not findings: style, naming, preferences, refactors, missing features the spec defers (§15), and the accepted risks below.',
].join('\n')

const ACCEPTED = [
  'Accepted risks (the spec accepts them; do not raise them):',
  "- Software running as the same macOS user on either Mac (K41, T7), including a BUN_OPTIONS exported by macair's ~/.zshenv on Nuance.",
  '- have/delta object theft through upload-pack while the Air is the only client (K50, T13), and same-uid symlink races in the fetch gate (§7.4).',
  "- A holder of the Air's collab ssh key on the home LAN standing in for the hub toward Nuance pipes (§5.1, T5; the hub-to-pipe proof is D10).",
  "- The Air's own paths visible to remote seats in results and events (§6.3, T23).",
  "- A knock reply lost in the milliseconds between the hub's mark and the pipe receiving it (§8).",
  '- No cap on lease TTLs or task counts beyond §6.6 (R20, T8).',
].join('\n')

const RULES = [
  'Rules for you (binding):',
  `- Read only. Never create, edit or delete a file in ${A.bridge} or ${A.seam}. Git: only log, show, diff, ls-files, blame, rev-parse and cat-file; for a status use GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git status. Never commit, push, check out, reset, stash, cherry-pick or touch a ref.`,
  '- Never run ssh, summon, launchctl, sudo, open, osascript, or a claude, codex or hermes command; nothing may reach Nuance, launchd or the network. codesign only with --verify or -dv.',
  "- Never open ~/.local/share/agenttool/collab.sqlite or anything under ~/.local/share/agenttool/collab-shared/, ~/.ssh, /etc/ssh, ~/.claude.json, ~/Library/LaunchAgents or ~/.config/summon, and never read a credential, private key or token.",
  `- Probes only in a fresh directory from mktemp -d, with HOME and COLLAB_BRIDGE_HOME_OVERRIDE both set to it, through the package's own fakes (tests/fake-ssh.ts, tests/helpers.ts); remove it afterwards. You may run single test files: cd ${A.bridge}/packages/collab-bridge && bun test tests/<name>.test.ts, except tests/build.test.ts, tests/e2e.test.ts and tests/pairing.test.ts (they compile the 63 MB Nuance binary; the controller runs them once afterwards).`,
  '- 0 web searches and 0 web fetches.',
  "- Report only what you saw in the code or in a probe's output. When evidence is missing, write \"couldn't determine\" in the evidence field instead of guessing.",
].join('\n')

function sources() {
  return [
    `Sources: the spec ${A.spec} (binding); the plan ${A.plan}, whose "## Global Constraints", "## Review Focus" and "## Controller rulings" sections bind the code too.`,
    'Paths starting packages/collab/ are in the seam worktree; every other path is in the bridge worktree.',
  ].join('\n')
}

function rel(file) {
  let s = String(file).trim().replace(/^\.\//, '')
  for (const root of [A.bridge, A.seam]) if (root && s.startsWith(`${root}/`)) s = s.slice(root.length + 1)
  return s
}

function bySeverityFileLine(a, b) {
  return RANK[a.severity] - RANK[b.severity] || (a.file < b.file ? -1 : a.file > b.file ? 1 : 0) || a.line - b.line
}

async function skeptic(f, key) {
  const claim = JSON.stringify({ title: f.title, severity: f.reviewer_severity, file: f.file, line: f.line, claim: f.claim,
    failure_scenario: f.failure_scenario, evidence: f.evidence, spec_ref: f.spec_ref }, null, 2)
  const v = await agent([
    'You are a skeptic in the adversarial review gate of the cross-device Collab Phase 1 plan (Task 63): new code that is about to be installed on Yu\'s second Mac, Nuance. A reviewer claims the defect below. Try hard to refute it: read the code at the cited place and everything that calls it, check whether another layer already prevents the failure scenario, whether the spec or the plan\'s rulings make it intended, and whether it is one of the accepted risks. Where you can, reproduce it with a probe or a single test file under the rules.',
    '',
    'verdict: confirmed only when you reproduced it or traced a concrete code path that produces the failure scenario; refuted when the code, a test, the spec, a ruling or an accepted risk shows it cannot happen as claimed or is intended; uncertain otherwise. severity: your own judgement on the scale (it may differ from the reviewer\'s). reason: one or two sentences with file:line references. reproduction: the probe or test you ran and its output, the code path, or "none".',
    '',
    'The claim (JSON):',
    claim,
    '',
    sources(), '', SEVERITY_SCALE, '', ACCEPTED, '', RULES,
  ].join('\n'), { label: `skeptic:${key}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT })
  if (!v) return { ...f, verdict: 'uncertain', skeptic_reason: 'the skeptic did not answer', reproduction: 'none' }
  return { ...f, severity: v.severity, verdict: v.verdict, skeptic_reason: v.reason, reproduction: v.reproduction }
}

function partition(judged, prefix) {
  const pick = (verdict) => judged.filter((f) => f.verdict === verdict).sort(bySeverityFileLine)
  const name = (list, letter) => list.map((f, i) => ({ id: prefix ? `${prefix}${i + 1}` : `${letter}${i + 1}`, ...f }))
  // In review mode confirmed, uncertain and refuted findings get R, U and X ids; a fold check names its new ones F<round>.<n>.
  if (prefix) {
    const all = name([...pick('confirmed'), ...pick('uncertain'), ...pick('refuted')], '')
    return { confirmed: all.filter((f) => f.verdict === 'confirmed'), uncertain: all.filter((f) => f.verdict === 'uncertain'), refuted: all.filter((f) => f.verdict === 'refuted') }
  }
  return { confirmed: name(pick('confirmed'), 'R'), uncertain: name(pick('uncertain'), 'U'), refuted: name(pick('refuted'), 'X') }
}

function asFinding(raw, lenses) {
  return { title: String(raw.title).slice(0, 60), severity: raw.severity, reviewer_severity: raw.severity, file: rel(raw.file), line: raw.line,
```
